chapters.title: Chapter 1: All-Purpose King! Instantly Full Level
paragraphs: Ding Ling spent all his savings to buy an expensive game helmet. He was so worried about the helmet being damaged that he protected it carefully all the way until he rode his electric scooter back to his rental apartment.
Only then did he slightly breathe a sigh of relief.

This was his third year in the Blue Star World. In his previous life, he was an ordinary person. Coming to this world that was not much different from the Earth from his previous life, he could still only be an ordinary person.
The pressure from competition was too immense.
He could not even produce the betrothal money for marriage.
Not to mention buying a house, a car, the three golds, travel expenses, banquet fees, and the like.
So, even when he had a girlfriend, they broke up shortly after. Up to now, he was still single.
Just when Ding Ling thought his life would remain like this, a turning point appeared.
A month ago.
A revolutionary game called "Myth" appeared out of nowhere.
This game spread like wildfire almost at the speed of light across hundreds of countries on the Blue Star!
Especially after half a month of trial play by the beta testers, the various heartfelt comments they made about it caused the game’s popularity to explode.
Because the beta testers discovered that as long as a person became stronger in the game, they would also become stronger in the real world!
Although there were some prerequisites, once met, the speed of becoming stronger was beyond imagination!
After some beta testers shared videos comparing their before and after strength, agility, jumping ability, etc.,
it completely ignited the flames in the hearts of many.
A wave of people rushed to buy game helmets and entered this game world, beginning their journey of self-improvement.
Although many people’s attempts to improve failed,
the increasing player base meant more and more people emerged from the game with incredible strength!
When weak players suddenly transformed into muscular hulks,
many men were the first to feel restless.
Which man’s inner world doesn’t harbor a beast? Which man doesn’t yearn to be graceful like a dragon and become a hero?
And as waves of men flooded into the game,
many elderly people, desiring their bodies to become healthy and robust, followed closely behind.
Soon, women also began entering.
Although their reasons for entering varied, there was no denying that this game had become nearly universally known.
Walking down the street, you could easily see advertisements for this myth game or hear groups of people discussing its content and gameplay.
Busy with work, Ding Ling also wanted to enter the game. He even prepared himself to save up a little more money to buy a game helmet.
But two days ago, a library suddenly awakened in his mind!
The library was vast with endless bookshelves but contained not a single book.
Nor was there any explanation.
Nonetheless, Ding Ling was both incredibly excited and delighted!
He pondered hard for a long time, to no avail.
Finally, when he absentmindedly flipped through a book at home titled "Basic Psychology," he discovered the library’s secret.
"This library can be used in the real world!"
"I just don’t know if I can use it in the game."
Holding the helmet in his arms, Ding Ling’s heart pounded rapidly.
It was like a pauper suddenly gaining a billion dollars or a beggar suddenly becoming an emperor—that kind of excitement and dreamlike feeling was very real.
After all, Ding Ling had resigned himself to lying flat and being mediocre all his life.
With such a legendary "cheat" suddenly falling into his lap, how could he remain calm?
He closed his eyes slightly and then clearly saw the library.
In the library, five bookshelves at the front each had hundreds of books piled up.
There were:
"Pang’s Psychology," "High School Physics," "Higher Mathematics," "Electromagnetism," "Architecture"...

These books were discovered by Ding Ling after realizing that his "Basic Psychology" instantly reached full level, becoming proficient in them. Both surprised and delighted, he rushed to the library, frantically "flipping through" hundreds and thousands of books.
To be precise, all he did was flip. Glancing was just a casual look.
But without exception,
they all instantly reached full level!
You could say without exaggeration,
Right now, Ding Ling is clearly:
[A master proficient in dozens of foreign languages!]
[Doctor of Mathematics]
[Master of Psychology]
[Kitchen God]
[Master of Carving]
[Top Chess Player][Calligrapher][Top Pianist][Top Artist][Professional Racing Car Driver]
Apart from this,
Ding Ling spent more time searching for "fitness" books as well as various martial arts secret manuals.
Unfortunately,
The martial arts secret manuals in the real world are all just show.
Even though Ding Ling instantly reached full level,
what he learned were only routines.
Ding Ling could now say that when it came to the routine techniques of Tai Chi Fist, Xingyi Fist, Arhat Fist, Long Fist, Yong Chun, and so on, no one else could claim they were better.
Because he reached full level in all those routine martial arts! Who could compare to him!
[Fitness Master]
[Pseudo Tai Chi Fist Master]
[Pseudo Yong Chun Master]
[Pseudo Xingyi Fist Master!]
There were as many as over a hundred types of various fist, palm, and body techniques.
All were pseudo levels.
Of course, the above library cheats were not listed; Ding Ling organized them in his mind for convenience.
"I guess there should be real Tai Chi Fist masters, Xingyi Fist masters, and Yong Chun masters in the real world. What a pity... I have no access to them."
Ding Ling sighed.
If he could actually learn so many martial arts in the real world, he would do so without hesitation.
But this day, he took a day off to run through every library in the city.
He also searched for a lot of information online.
Unfortunately, he couldn’t obtain the martial arts he wanted.
However, he acquired various other books, giving Ding Ling quite a few new titles:
[Master of Frog Swim]
[Master of Butterfly Swim]
[Running Master]
Some libraries do have books teaching niche subjects like swimming, jumping, running, etc.
Ding Ling instantly reached full level.
In a mere moment, he became proficient in frog swimming, butterfly swimming, etc.
To think that previously, whilst not exactly a landlubber, he wasn’t far off and absolutely had no chance with swimming mastery before.
But now, he had a remarkably clear feeling that even if he fell into the Yangtze or Yellow River, he could easily swim frog or butterfly stroke in it.
Of course, he hadn’t tried.
Because he had already tried various routine martial arts yesterday.
The result was: martial arts routine techniques he had never known or understood, he executed with outstanding flair, far better than many movie stars.
Besides this,
many foreign languages he couldn’t understand before became instantly clear!

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Player Plaza’s Hot Topic—The Overall Ranking Number One
paragraphs: "This cheat is way too strong!"
Ding Ling was overjoyed.
If it weren’t for the mythological game being popular worldwide right now,
Just based on his current professional level,
What can’t he earn money from doing?
He wouldn’t need to do that miserable job of a coder anymore.
He decisively quit his job.
He didn’t care about the strange looks from colleagues and the boss, took his life savings and the money he just got from quitting, and went to buy this gaming headset.
"I hope the game’s world allows me to learn more Martial Arts!"
"Others can bring their game power to the real world. Why shouldn’t I be able to?"
"As long as I can instantly reach full level learning Martial Arts in the game, wouldn’t I be invincible in reality?"
Ding Ling looked forward to it!
In the real world, for over two days, he practically went through all the ’skill’ books in various libraries.
Of course, he also read some comics, novels, mythological books, but after finding them useless, he stopped reading them and focused on all kinds of ’skill’ books.
From basic skills like various foreign languages, architecture, physics, chemistry in the Blue Star World;
To medical skills like medicine, herbal identification, acupuncture, Western medicine;
Then to skills that improve physical fitness like fitness, sword dancing, fist technique, palm technique, body technique;
To put it this way,
In just a few days, Ding Ling has already become an almost all-powerful master!
"This feeling is incredible."
Ding Ling felt like he was dreaming these past few days.

He often read novels in his previous life, saw various cheats, golden fingers, systems, and he had countless times imagined himself getting cheats one day, but even after transcending worlds, he shouted countless times ’Old grandpa, system’ day and night in his heart, it was still useless! He remained ordinary.
It was only a few days ago that the ’library’ suddenly awakened.
Showing him hope.
Making him feel like he was dreaming.
"I really feel omnipotent right now."
Skills were ’floating’ in Ding Ling’s mind!
He felt his physical fitness had improved a lot too.
Those fitness essentials, Martial Arts routines, jogging secrets, swimming secrets were instantly full level, forging his muscles, viscera, etc.
To put it this way,
Ding Ling’s physical fitness now surpassed his past self.
He even tried lifting a hundred-pound bag of rice from home, easily doing several standard squats! Several high lifts!
That was absolutely impossible before!
"Really stronger now."
Ding Ling clenched his fist, his eyes flashed with brilliance:
"This ’library’ has endless bookshelves, now just a few shelves are filled with various basic books, it’s not enough."
"What if I fill the ’library’ shelves with all kinds of skill books, what would happen?"
Thinking about it made Ding Ling uncontrollably excited.
But achieving that in the real world is impossible.
Because, in the real world, Ding Ling at this level can only access knowledge points in libraries, on the internet, etc.
Some real essences, perhaps, will be accessible only when his status rises.
But now, his most urgent goal is to try the things in the game, to see if he can instantly learn and reach full level.
"Let’s begin."
Ding Ling followed the instructions in the manual, donned the headset, lay on the bed, and gently closed his eyes.
The next second.
It went dark before his eyes.
Ding Ling felt his soul and consciousness were forcibly taken to break through a barrier, flying to another dimension.
He felt dizzy.
But not long after.
The view brightened in front of him, and he discovered he had arrived at a new earth realm.
He quickly surveyed his surroundings.
It seemed like an extremely vast plaza.
The plaza was packed with people.

Everyone had a halo under their feet; some were setting up stalls to sell goods, some were loudly discussing things, some had dazed eyes staring into the void, even muttering words, appearing to say something.
Ding Ling felt slightly surprised; he hadn’t expected to come to such a place.
But quickly.
A hint panel emerged before his eyes too.
[Character: Ding Ling
Age: 23 years
Race: Human
Faction: None
Occupation: None
Level: None
Strength: [Root Bone 1 (Normal human is 1 point), Wisdom 2, Power 2 (Normal human is 1), Agility 2, Physique 2, Defense 2, Charm 2]
Weapon: None

Skills: Acupuncture (Level 10), Swimming (Level 10), Fitness (Level 10), Basic Psychology (Level 10) Bear Kingdom Language (Level 10), Northern Kingdom Language (Level 10), Southern Cuisine Cooking Skill (Level 10), Northern Cuisine Cooking Skill (Level 10), Carving (Level 10), Watercolor Painting (Level 10), Sketching (Level 10), Calligraphy (Level 10) Racing Car (Level 10)...]
The skills are hundreds in total.
Just in the drawing aspect alone, there are seven or eight types, including watercolor painting, comic painting, and traditional painting.
[Overall Evaluation: All-Around Master! A newcomer player who is Superman!]
[Considering Player Ding Ling is extremely outstanding, he is currently ranked first in the comprehensive leaderboard. Click to view the leaderboard...]
Seeing this, Ding Ling couldn’t help but be slightly shocked.
Just logged into the game and hasn’t figured out what’s going on yet, and he’s first in rank?
Curious, he clicked on the word ’Leaderboard’ in the void.
In the next moment.
Various leaderboards emerged.
The comprehensive leaderboard was right at the top.
And his name was highlighted, in bold and red, right at the top.
[First Place: Ding Ling. New player. Current Plane: None. Cleared Planes: None.]
Almost at the same time.
The entire plaza went into an uproar:
"Everyone, look! The comprehensive leaderboard refreshed, and out of nowhere, there’s a new first place, named Ding Ling. Oh my God, is this guy actually a new player?!"

"Unbelievable! How was it achieved?! You must know that the closed beta veteran player Kong Tianhua has been playing this game for a month. In the game, he’s as fierce as a 1000-pound force, already becoming a Military General! Yet Ding Ling’s overall strength is even stronger than Kong Tianhua!!"
"Something of a miracle. Ding Ling isn’t on any of the other leaderboards. How did he get to the top of the comprehensive leaderboard? Does he have some incredibly powerful overall skills or what?!"
The discussions were particularly loud.
Ding Ling listened clearly, not engaging in discussion with others, continued looking at the game manual.
He hadn’t forgotten the purpose of coming here.
After reading for a while.
Ding Ling finally understood, pondering:

"Inside this mythological game, there are countless plane worlds. From various times like Three Kingdoms, Sui Dynasty, Qin Dynasty, Ming Dynasty to martial hero planes like Divine Eagle, Celestial Dragon Eight Books, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, Fengyun, Romantic Swordsman, and Xianxia planes like Journey to the West, Divine Enthronement, The White Snake, Legend of Nezha, as well as advanced Xuanhuan and Primordial Chaos planes, and the most elite Chaos plane, etc."
"And players are to continuously enhance themselves, clear one plane after another set to conquer complete."
Ding Ling contemplated.
Why does this game have many familiar cinematic worlds?
This world is extremely similar to his previous life.
All the cultural works are here too.
That’s why Ding Ling had no chance to make money by copying content, and is this game world really developed by Blue Star at all?
Ding Ling couldn’t be sure either.
"If you can really bring the Martial Arts and abilities from the game back to the real world, then the waters of Blue Star are unavoidably deep!"

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Jizhou Faction in the Late Eastern Han Dynasty
paragraphs: Ding Ling was alert and solemn.
He felt that over the past few years, he might have only touched the surface of Blue Star.
"Forget it, let’s start the game first."
As a new player.
The initial planes he could access had only three choices:
Late Sui Dynasty!
Late Eastern Han Dynasty!
Late Qin Dynasty!
Ding Ling chose the Late Eastern Han Dynasty.
The reason was simple.
Because the Late Eastern Han Dynasty was a plane set based on the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, and Ding Ling was most familiar with the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
Although he was familiar with the Late Sui Dynasty and Late Qin Dynasty, he couldn’t know them as well as the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
How to choose?
Naturally, choose the most familiar!
[Player Ding Ling confirms choice of Late Eastern Han Dynasty plane?]
Confirm!
[Choice successful, about to initiate teleportation.]
Boom!
The next instant.
The light circle under his feet swirled, taking Ding Ling and made him instantly disappear from the Player Plaza.
The players were obviously used to this, still fervently discussing the comprehensive leaderboard’s ’Ding Ling’, completely unaware Ding Ling had just been standing right in front of them.
An hour later.
Ding Ling, along with many players donned in armor, stood on the plaza, listening to General Cheng Huan explaining training essentials.
Ding Ling did not expect to be randomly assigned to Hann Fu’s Jizhou camp!
Every new player initially has the right to choose a plane.
But they have no right to choose a camp.
Some people are lucky to become brothers with Zhao Zilong;
Some may be unlucky enough to end up under Dong Zhuo, constantly ’enjoying’ Dong Zhuo’s Silver Might!
Being in this Jizhou camp, it’s neither good nor bad.
An hour’s time.
Already allowed Ding Ling to fully adjust his mindset, and with a mix of resentment, vigor, or eager-faced players, began training.
The start was a half-hour weighted run around the ’military camp’.
After the run, many people directly collapsed.
More people fell behind, unable to keep up.
And this was just a selection process.
Those who performed exceptionally in the half-hour weighted run were directly assigned to General Cheng Huan.
Those who performed poorly were assigned to a Military Marquis or Village Chief.
At this moment.
General Cheng Huan had already taught players the training essentials.
He said loudly:
"Those who stand out with me will be assigned to our Jizhou’s Unrivaled Divine General, General Pan Feng, to learn higher tier martial arts skills. If you want to become stronger, then work hard."
Upon hearing Unrivaled Divine General Pan Feng.
Many people’s expressions were very peculiar.
But under General Cheng Huan’s watchful gaze, they couldn’t badmouth Pan Feng, so they had to hold it in, with faces somewhat twisted.
Ding Ling was not among them.
To him.
The Jizhou camp was just a stepping stone.
Once he learned all the skills, he could leap from here and learn elsewhere.
He was also learning along with the players.
Of course, most of his attention was still on the ’library’.
He noticed on a new bookshelf in the library, a book was slowly forming.
This book took shape after Cheng Huan explained the key points and precautions of the ’Pile Skill’, with Ding Ling thoughtfully going over it a few times in his mind to ensure nothing was missed.
The book surprisingly took form.
Then...
[Low-level Pile Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
Ding Ling felt his strength instantly increase significantly, making him feel lighter and more agile.
The previously seemingly difficult Pile Skill.
At this moment, he performed it like antelope’s horns, naturally integrated, as if he had always been this way.
’It’s really useful!’
Ding Ling was overjoyed.
’I just wonder if I can fully bring this power back to reality?’
’If possible, this game is truly remarkable. It’s unimaginable what the results will be if we later conquer the Journey to the West Plane or Gods’ Ascension Plane.’
If players collectively become immortals and gods in the future!
Reality would definitely be extremely exciting!
"Huh!"
Cheng Huan clearly noticed Ding Ling as well.
Ding Ling stood out like a sun among the poorly performing crowd, it was hard for Cheng Huan not to notice.
"What’s your name?"
Cheng Huan walked up to Ding Ling, staring at him with bright eyes, like looking at an extraordinary, out-of-this-world talent.
"My name is Ding Ling."
"Ding Ling, is it?"
Cheng Huan nodded with satisfaction:
"Your Pile Skill has met the standard, next you have two choices, continue training Pile Skill, or train an Initial Tier Military Saber Technique."
"Continue training Pile Skill."
Ding Ling did not hesitate.
"Good. I will teach you, listen well, watch closely."
Cheng Huan looked not like an NPC at all, his wisdom and actions indistinguishable from regular people.
This was why this game shocked the world, it was so realistic!
If not for the ability to be resurrected in the game world upon death, many people would think they had traveled through time!
Of course, no one wished to die, because death not only caused a level drop but also had a high chance of exploding all items, unless absolutely necessary, no one did such foolish things.
"This guy..."

Other players looked at Ding Ling, astonished, incredulous, whispering among themselves, no different than saying Ding Ling couldn’t possibly be a pure newbie, otherwise how could he stand out so quickly, wasn’t this a joke? Really treating them like losers?!
But the next moment.

Just seeing Ding Ling as if a magnificent horse, landing robustly on the ground, his body fluctuating, surprisingly showed the manifestation of having practiced ’Horse Stance Skill’ to the Transformation Realm.
All players couldn’t help but be dumbfounded, their eyes nearly popped out, then questioning and affirming among themselves:
"This guy must be an old player! Otherwise, it’s too defying! In this world, how could there be someone who learns it instantly and performs even better than the original after being told once?!"
They didn’t believe Ding Ling could be so defying.
Only Cheng Huan believed it, his face was shocked, dazed for a moment, he stepped forward and patted Ding Ling’s shoulder:

"It seems you have a great talent in Pile Skills. The next advanced version of Horse Stance Skill, ’Dragon-Tiger Stance’, I know it, but can’t masterfully control it. If you want to learn, I can take you to General Pan Feng for learning. Of course, if you want to learn Saber Technique, I can also continue to teach you."
"I’ll learn Saber Technique."
Ding Ling answered decisively.
Too much bites poorly!
This refers to lack of mastery and application.
But Ding Ling possessed a ’library’ cheat of instant full level.
For him, the more skills, the better.
Because learning a skill allows him to grow stronger!
Just after learning the Horse Stance Skill, he saw another game panel prompt.
[Horse Stance Skill Full Level]
[Strength +0.4]
[Agility +0.4]
[Constitution +0.4]

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Achievement Medal
paragraphs: This time, quite a few attribute points were gained again.
Ding Ling not only felt that his strength had greatly increased but also his body felt lighter; he felt as though with a gentle leap, he could jump several meters away!
This feeling made Ding Ling feel delighted and comfortable!
He just liked the sensation of constantly improving himself.
Being a couch potato in those years was really too painful.
Now, with the opportunity to become superior, Ding Ling naturally had no reason to slack off.
Therefore, when he heard General Cheng Huan mention whether he wanted to learn saber technique, he decisively agreed.
"Alright."
General Cheng Huan looked at Ding Ling more warmly:

"You didn’t aim too high, and instead chose to learn the simple saber technique first. This deserves acknowledgment and praise. After you learn the saber technique, I will recommend you to General Pan Feng to become a village chief in our army."
Upon hearing this.
All players couldn’t help but look sideways, envious.
Village Chief!
Above that is the Military Marquis, Military Marquis, Captain, and other officer positions!
The rank that so many dream of!
This guy named Ding Ling is definitely an experienced player pretending to be a newbie!

The other players became increasingly convinced, especially considering Ding Ling’s exceptional performance during weightlifting running, pile skill, horse stance skill training and practice, further affirming it.
It’s known that most newbie players are basic handicaps! Many cannot lift a shoulder or carry anything with their hand! The gap compared to veteran players is too obvious.
Moreover, to earn the favor of some generals, many veteran players undergo new recruit training just to start on a higher level, which has precedence.
Ding Ling found it somewhat difficult to respond.

He’s not really the type of person Cheng Huan envisions; the reason he’s learning saber technique is that Pan Feng excels at axe technique, and if he doesn’t learn saber technique now, learning it under Pan Feng would surely be even more challenging, so it’s better to learn here.
Of course, he didn’t state these thoughts openly, he just seriously looked at Cheng Huan.
Cheng Huan, obviously a practical general, wasn’t the least bit passive and began explaining the saber technique to Ding Ling.
He didn’t hide anything.
Every new recruit in attendance was allowed to listen.
Indeed, quite a few players among the recruits listened, but unfortunately, they haven’t even learned the basic pile skill, how could they learn saber technique?
After listening for a while, they felt cluelessly awed and then resignedly buried their heads in practicing pile skills.
As for Ding Ling?
After Cheng Huan repeated it twice.
A book automatically condensed on the bookshelf in the library.
On the book cover, four large words were strikingly written: Initial Tier Saber Technique.
[Initial Tier Saber Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Physique +0.1]
At the moment the book finished condensing.
The Initial Tier Saber Technique was already at full level.
Ding Ling’s strength not only increased greatly, but agility and physique were also on the rise.
This saber technique belongs to the category of external saber techniques, classified as an external skill, reaching full level naturally boosts strength, agility, and physique attribute points.
Moreover.
Ding Ling’s combat power increased substantially.
Before, he only had some fancy moves, devoid of any lethality, just having extremely strong entertainment value! It looked great in action!
But this Initial Tier Saber Technique is different.
Every move is lethal, targeting the foe’s vital spots.
With this saber technique in hand, It can be said.
Ding Ling’s combat power virtually doubled instantly!
Ding Ling’s spirit was invigorated as he checked his character panel:
[Character: Ding Ling
Age: 23 years old
Race: Human
Alignment: Jizhou Han Fu
Profession: Warrior
Level: 1
Strength: [Bone & Foundation 1 (normal human is 1 point), Intelligence 2, Strength 2+0.2+0.4+0.1(2.7), Agility 2+0.2+0.4+0.2(2.8), Physique 2+0.2+0.4+0.1(2.7), Defense 2, Charm 2]
Weapons: One set of armor, one saber.

Skills: Low-level Pile Skill (Level 10), Horse Stance Skill (Level 10), Initial Tier Saber Technique (Level 10), Acupuncture (Level 10), Swimming (Level 10), Fitness (Level 10), Basic Psychology (Level 10)...]
He only played the game for just over an hour.
Yet there has been such significant change.
The future holds great promise!
In the real world, the skills learned are rarely offensive or growable; most are superficial.
If he hadn’t learned hundreds of skills, it wouldn’t have been enough to enhance his strength.
Yet here, having learned just three kinds, strength, agility, and physique have almost increased by 1 point.
It proves that Cheng Huan’s teachings are real kung fu!
"Give it a try."

Cheng Huan explained it three times and seeing Ding Ling appear enlightened and understanding, he was somewhat bewildered and unsure; having just explained three times, how could Ding Ling have thoroughly grasped this saber technique?
It’s known that reaching mastery level for this saber technique in the past took him three years of learning! Even under his master’s hands-on guidance!
"Okay."
Ding Ling didn’t hold back either; to learn more genuine martial arts, he certainly wouldn’t be perfunctory, as only by standing out would he quickly learn more advanced martial arts!
Swish, swish!
Ding Ling wielded his saber, resembling a soaring bird, with graceful posture and composed demeanor, it’s as if his skill reached the Great Perfection, naturally supreme!
Clearly, he has cultivated the Initial Tier Saber Technique to the Great Perfection, beyond progression!
Cheng Huan’s gaze was dazed, his jaw almost dropped to the ground; when Ding Ling finished and stood still, he coughed a bit and incredulously asked:
"You’re sure this saber technique is just fresh to you?"
"I’m one hundred percent sure."
Ding Ling replied solemnly.
Cheng Huan was speechless.
All players couldn’t help but complain silently: An experienced player showing off at the new recruit camp, fun right?! So shameless!
No player believed Ding Ling was a newbie, learning the saber technique just now!
Should there indeed be someone who watched twice and wielded it better and more perfectly than the ’instructor’!
Players would happily call them the ’prodigy!’
Clearly, such a person doesn’t exist in this era!
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Camp Champion!]
[Annotation: Undoubtedly. You can already graduate from the recruit camp! And have become the most dazzling presence!]
And it was then.
Ding Ling heard the game notification sound, he opened it with his thoughts and saw these two sentences.
He was stunned, pondering: What is this achievement medal for?
Unable to find the manual for a while, he didn’t bother searching, just fixed his gaze on Cheng Huan.
Cheng Huan, being stared at by Ding Ling, felt somewhat uneasy, coughed a bit, containing the astonishment on his face, his ’old face’ slightly flushed, praised:
"Since my debut, it’s the first time I’ve seen such a gifted wonder like you. Perhaps only the young General Pan Feng can compare to you."
Upon hearing General Pan Feng.
The players looked at Ding Ling with a slightly amused expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Gao Lan
paragraphs: Who hasn’t read Romance of the Three Kingdoms knows that Pan Feng is just a dud!
Although his name is renowned, he dies faster than anyone else!
He is indeed the most unworthy of the title among the Divine Generals.
A person comparable to General Pan Feng! Doesn’t that mean Ding Ling’s future death will be quite spectacular?
These are the thoughts in the players’ minds.
Everyone is looking at Ding Ling, secretly laughing.
Ding Ling naturally understood the players’ thoughts. He twitched the corner of his eye but didn’t argue because he knew Cheng Huan’s good intentions.
It’s rare to meet someone as responsible as Cheng Huan in the Jizhou boot camp.
Therefore, Ding Ling listened very attentively.
Seeing this, Cheng Huan felt even more gratified:
"Such a genius, yet humble and calm, will surely become great in the future!"
[Achievement Medal Obtained: General Cheng Huan praises you thrice, a sincere compliment from the heart!]
[Note: You have completely won over the heart of Hann Fu’s subordinate, Cheng Huan!]
Is this even possible?!
Upon hearing the notification sound, Ding Ling couldn’t help but be slightly stunned.
Although he didn’t know what the Achievement Medal could be used for, instinctively, he felt it must be quite valuable!
Because it’s not easy to obtain.
Don’t be fooled that he got two in a short time.
That was entirely because he cheated!
Try it with an ordinary person?
"I wanted to take you to see General Pan Feng right away, but seeing your outstanding talent in saber technique, I really don’t want to let such a talent go to waste."
Cheng Huan stroked his beard while looking at Ding Ling, as if viewing a treasure:

"In our camp, there’s someone skilled in saber technique named Gao Lan. Although he is currently only a Military Marquis, his military strategy and martial arts are enough to serve as our Jizhou General. I can introduce you to him. As for whether he’ll teach you saber technique, I can’t guarantee it, but I’ll try my best to speak on your behalf."
"Thank you, General!"
Ding Ling expressed his gratitude.
He might not know the difficulty of ’finding a mentor’ with others, but from the jealous, almost spitting fire gaze of nearby players, he knew it must be very hard!
Cheng Huan’s actions towards him were truly kind and considerate.
Although Cheng Huan could only be considered a minor character in Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
But being recorded in history is nonetheless impressive.
"I don’t have much to teach you."
Cheng Huan sighed:
"Though I know a set of high-tier saber technique, I’m not very proficient in it—I fear misleading a student, so I won’t teach you."
Ding Ling wanted to say it’s okay, you can teach!
But seeing Cheng Huan’s decided expression, he didn’t voice it.
"Wait here a moment."
Cheng Huan strode away, evidently preparing to connect Ding Ling to people.
Many soldiers couldn’t help but whisper:

"It’s been so many years, but it’s the first time seeing General Cheng Huan so excited! It seems this Ding Ling indeed is a genius! If he prospers in the future, then General Cheng Huan will surely gain fame for cherishing talent!"
"Why don’t you think, Ding Ling is still in the initial stage. Befriending him now means we might have a chance to rise too in the future?"
Everyone understands the logic of one person reaching enlightenment and elevating those around.
Many NPCs couldn’t help but eagerly come to engage with Ding Ling.
Not many players came over.
In the players’ view, Ding Ling is just a crafty rascal!
Being too close might poison them.
Some are unafraid of poison, asking all sorts of questions to Ding Ling.
Only at this moment,
Ding Ling realized they didn’t know he was the top of the composite leaderboard.
At first, he was quite surprised.
Later, after carefully checking the character panel, it made sense.
Turns out only in the ’Player Plaza’ can one view the leaderboard, no wonder these folks hear his name and are unmoved.
Matters regarding the medals probably can be resolved in the Player Plaza too.
After a while.
Cheng Huan arrived, the players and NPCs surrounding Ding Ling quickly dispersed, returning to their squads.
Cheng Huan, seemingly excited, didn’t mind the actions of the NPCs and players, he waved to Ding Ling from afar:
"Ding Ling, come over!"
Ding Ling quickly walked over.
Approaching.
Cheng Huan laughed:
"After speaking much, Gao Lan finally agreed to teach you saber technique. But he’ll only teach you once. Whether you learn it, depends on your skills."
"Thank you, General, for the help!"
Ding Ling said solemnly.
"Just remember this if you become successful in the future, that there’s someone like me."
Cheng Huan laughed.
"Rest assured, I, Ding Ling, am not someone who forgets kindness."
"Alright."
Cheng Huan felt increasingly satisfied, finding Ding Ling very pleasing.
Humble, composed, respectful, grateful, honorable!
He’s practically heaven-sent for him, Cheng Huan!
"Follow me."
Cheng Huan walked ahead.
Ding Ling closely followed behind.
Ding Ling knew Gao Lan, later one of Hebei’s Four Pillars, having fought Xuu Chu equally during the Battle of Guan Du, showing his skills.
To be recognized as one of the Four Pillars on such a large earth realm! Thus evident are his martial skills, tactics!
As for Gao Lan’s eventual death?
Reading Romance of the Three Kingdoms makes it clear, he died from Zhao Yun’s surprise attack, not a fair duel. Facing an absolute expert like Zhao Yun’s ambush, how many could withstand it?
And this plane is based on Romance of the Three Kingdoms, showing generals’ combat strength aligns with the novel.
Though Gao Lan is currently only a Military Marquis.
His skill level is definitely among the top few in Jizhou!
Hann Fu arranged such a distinguished general just as a Military Marquis but let someone less skilled like Cheng Huan be a general.
No wonder Hann Fu later lost public support and had to leave Jizhou.
Ding Ling’s mind whirled with thoughts.
After a while.
Cheng Huan had already brought him to another boot camp.
Here, Gao Lan was instructing recruits in ’Basic Posture’.
Seeing Cheng Huan arrive.
Gao Lan let his assistant help with the recruits while he walked boldly to Cheng Huan, looking at Ding Ling with bright eyes:
"So you are the peerless genius Ding Ling that General Cheng mentioned?"
"I wouldn’t dare call myself a peerless genius. But yes, I am Ding Ling."
Ding Ling glanced at Gao Lan.
Seeing him standing tall at eight feet, holding a long spear, he was quite an attractive man, Ding Ling couldn’t help but ponder how to also learn spear technique from him.
"Come with me."
Gao Lan directly turned and headed to the Military Marquis tent.
The tent was empty.
Seeing Ding Ling follow inside, he wasted no words, directly put down his long spear, picked up a long saber from the weapon rack, and plainly stated:
"I’ll demonstrate the high-tier saber technique once, as for how much you can learn, depends on your fortune."
"Yes."
Ding Ling respectfully thanked him.
Gao Lan waved his hand, indicating Ding Ling needn’t be so formal, then directly began performing with the long saber.

sentences.text: Who hasn’t read Romance of the Three Kingdoms knows that Pan Feng is just a dud!
Although his name is renowned, he dies faster than anyone else!
He is indeed the most unworthy of the title among the Divine Generals.
A person comparable to General Pan Feng!
Doesn’t that mean Ding Ling’s future death will be quite spectacular?
These are the thoughts in the players’ minds.
Everyone is looking at Ding Ling, secretly laughing.
Ding Ling naturally understood the players’ thoughts.
He twitched the corner of his eye but didn’t argue because he knew Cheng Huan’s good intentions.
It’s rare to meet someone as responsible as Cheng Huan in the Jizhou boot camp.
Therefore, Ding Ling listened very attentively.
Seeing this, Cheng Huan felt even more gratified:
"Such a genius, yet humble and calm, will surely become great in the future!"
[Achievement Medal Obtained: General Cheng Huan praises you thrice, a sincere compliment from the heart!]
[Note: You have completely won over the heart of Hann Fu’s subordinate, Cheng Huan!]
Is this even possible?!
Upon hearing the notification sound, Ding Ling couldn’t help but be slightly stunned.
Although he didn’t know what the Achievement Medal could be used for, instinctively, he felt it must be quite valuable!
Because it’s not easy to obtain.
Don’t be fooled that he got two in a short time.
That was entirely because he cheated!
Try it with an ordinary person?
"I wanted to take you to see General Pan Feng right away, but seeing your outstanding talent in saber technique, I really don’t want to let such a talent go to waste."
Cheng Huan stroked his beard while looking at Ding Ling, as if viewing a treasure:
"In our camp, there’s someone skilled in saber technique named Gao Lan.
Although he is currently only a Military Marquis, his military strategy and martial arts are enough to serve as our Jizhou General.
I can introduce you to him.
As for whether he’ll teach you saber technique, I can’t guarantee it, but I’ll try my best to speak on your behalf."
"Thank you, General!"
Ding Ling expressed his gratitude.
He might not know the difficulty of ’finding a mentor’ with others, but from the jealous, almost spitting fire gaze of nearby players, he knew it must be very hard!
Cheng Huan’s actions towards him were truly kind and considerate.
Although Cheng Huan could only be considered a minor character in Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
But being recorded in history is nonetheless impressive.
"I don’t have much to teach you."
Cheng Huan sighed:
"Though I know a set of high-tier saber technique, I’m not very proficient in it—I fear misleading a student, so I won’t teach you."
Ding Ling wanted to say it’s okay, you can teach!
But seeing Cheng Huan’s decided expression, he didn’t voice it.
"Wait here a moment."
Cheng Huan strode away, evidently preparing to connect Ding Ling to people.
Many soldiers couldn’t help but whisper:
"It’s been so many years, but it’s the first time seeing General Cheng Huan so excited!
It seems this Ding Ling indeed is a genius!
If he prospers in the future, then General Cheng Huan will surely gain fame for cherishing talent!"
"Why don’t you think, Ding Ling is still in the initial stage.
Befriending him now means we might have a chance to rise too in the future?"
Everyone understands the logic of one person reaching enlightenment and elevating those around.
Many NPCs couldn’t help but eagerly come to engage with Ding Ling.
Not many players came over.
In the players’ view, Ding Ling is just a crafty rascal!
Being too close might poison them.
Some are unafraid of poison, asking all sorts of questions to Ding Ling.
Only at this moment,
Ding Ling realized they didn’t know he was the top of the composite leaderboard.
At first, he was quite surprised.
Later, after carefully checking the character panel, it made sense.
Turns out only in the ’Player Plaza’ can one view the leaderboard, no wonder these folks hear his name and are unmoved.
Matters regarding the medals probably can be resolved in the Player Plaza too.
After a while.
Cheng Huan arrived, the players and NPCs surrounding Ding Ling quickly dispersed, returning to their squads.
Cheng Huan, seemingly excited, didn’t mind the actions of the NPCs and players, he waved to Ding Ling from afar:
"Ding Ling, come over!"
Ding Ling quickly walked over.
Approaching.
Cheng Huan laughed:
"After speaking much, Gao Lan finally agreed to teach you saber technique.
But he’ll only teach you once.
Whether you learn it, depends on your skills."
"Thank you, General, for the help!"
Ding Ling said solemnly.
"Just remember this if you become successful in the future, that there’s someone like me."
Cheng Huan laughed.
"Rest assured, I, Ding Ling, am not someone who forgets kindness."
"Alright."
Cheng Huan felt increasingly satisfied, finding Ding Ling very pleasing.
Humble, composed, respectful, grateful, honorable!
He’s practically heaven-sent for him, Cheng Huan!
"Follow me."
Cheng Huan walked ahead.
Ding Ling closely followed behind.
Ding Ling knew Gao Lan, later one of Hebei’s Four Pillars, having fought Xuu Chu equally during the Battle of Guan Du, showing his skills.
To be recognized as one of the Four Pillars on such a large earth realm!
Thus evident are his martial skills, tactics!
As for Gao Lan’s eventual death?
Reading Romance of the Three Kingdoms makes it clear, he died from Zhao Yun’s surprise attack, not a fair duel.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: High-tier Saber Technique
paragraphs: Gao Lan’s weapon is a long saber.
The saber technique exhibited clearly follows battlefield maneuvers.
Every move is soul-stirring, the evil qi so intense that it could stop a child from crying!
By the end, he was even able to conjure waves of vigorous qi from thin air, and with a crackling sound, he shattered the weapon rack on the side.
"What a great saber technique!"
Cheng Huan also entered, unable to hold back his applause and praise:
"Gao Lan, your saber technique is becoming increasingly exquisite and perfect. To have reached the point where your vigorous qi can injure others is truly amazing. I am far beneath you!"
Gao Lan’s brows relaxed and his face showed pleasure. It was clear that he quite enjoyed Cheng Huan’s compliments.
It seems that Cheng Huan used this method to persuade Gao Lan to agree to Ding Ling learning the saber technique.
Ding Ling closed his eyes, carefully recalling each scene of the saber technique.
On a shelf in the library within his sea of consciousness, a book began to solidify at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Before long.
"High-tier Saber Technique" successfully coalesced.
Subsequently...
[High-tier Blade Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.5]
[Constitution +0.3]
In almost an instant, Ding Ling mastered the high-tier saber technique completely.
It was as if he had practiced this technique for more than ten years, various sword techniques were ingrained deeply into his instinct.
Ding Ling had a feeling.
He too could now effortlessly perform this set of high-tier saber techniques!
He was overjoyed.
Only because he realized that this high-tier saber technique was more than twice as powerful in lethality compared to the initial tier saber technique!
With this saber technique, Ding Ling’s combat power could easily double again!
"How was it?"

Seeing Ding Ling open his eyes with a face full of happiness, Cheng Huan couldn’t help but be slightly stunned, thinking: It can’t be possible to learn it just by watching the high-tier saber technique once, right!
Thinking this way, but he still instinctively asked out:
"Have you memorized it? Or have you learned it?"
"Learned?"
Gao Lan glanced sideways, displeased:
"It took me full four years to reach the realm of perfection in learning the high-tier saber technique. Though Ding Ling is a genius in using the saber, he cannot learn it by just watching it once."
You truly think Gao Lan is an idiot?!
Cheng Huan awkwardly cleared his throat:

"Gao Lan, you know I didn’t mean it that way. I was just a little overwhelmed. You haven’t seen the scene when Ding Ling was learning the pile skill and saber technique initially. If you had, you might share my thoughts."
"Oh?"
Gao Lan raised his eyebrows, not pursuing the matter further. He was also quite curious as he looked at Ding Ling:
"Cheng Huan praises you so much. It’s truly rare. If you’ve memorized this high-tier saber technique, show it to me, and if you really have memorized it, I will give you more guidance in the future.
"Yes!"
Ding Ling did not stand on ceremony.
He directly accepted the long saber handed to him by Gao Lan.
The long saber in hand sank slightly.
It was probably forty to fifty pounds!
Now that Ding Ling’s strength had reached 3 points, he could surprisingly exert three hundred pounds of force.
This long saber was a bit heavy for him.
Using it for sword techniques was a bit cumbersome, but feasible.
Ding Ling mustered all his strength, moved with power, boom! The sword techniques were like an impermeable wind wheel, one strike after another, extremely fierce and mighty!
He resembled a sturdy battlefield warrior displaying great prowess!
The vigorous qi was so intense that it made the void crackle, and with the final lethal move, crack! A tilted weapon rack on the side was once again split in half.
Cheng Huan was dumbstruck.
Gao Lan was speechless.
"General!"
Ding Ling sheathed the saber and stood upright, returning the long saber.
Gao Lan took it with a face full of intricate expressions, cleared his throat a bit uncomfortably, and asked with some disbelief:
"You, you, are you certain you only just came into contact with the high-tier saber technique?!"
His speech was somewhat incoherent.
This revealed the shock in his heart.
"Yes, General!"
Ding Ling solemnly replied.
Gao Lan was speechless, but instinctively still did not believe it because it was too outrageous!
It was simply a myth.
No genius could be like this.
To know, it took him full four years to learn this saber technique!
"Amazing, truly amazing!"
Cheng Huan clapped in admiration, his eyes filled with surprise as he looked at Ding Ling:
"I didn’t expect your talent to exceed my imagination! Initially, I wasn’t very confident about recommending you as Village Chief, but now I have great confidence!"
Gao Lan glanced sideways at Cheng Huan, looking at him with a strange expression:
"General Cheng, do you really believe this is true?"
"Of course!"
Cheng Huan nodded while stroking his beard, "Why else? Do you think it’s false?
"Not exactly."
Gao Lan was momentarily stuck, replying after a moment:
"I just think it’s too incredible."
"Indeed."
Cheng Huan agreed deeply:

"But in the Great Thousand Worlds, there is nothing strange. Wasn’t General Pan Feng also outstanding and formidable in his youth? It shows that for geniuses, we cannot look at them with ordinary eyes! Perhaps Ding Ling’s intuition and talent in saber techniques are terrifyingly strong. Just like General Pan Feng’s intuition in axe techniques."
Gao Lan was once again stumped, looking at Ding Ling with a thoughtful expression, seemingly very conflicted. After a long time, he gritted his teeth and said:

"Ding Ling, I have a family saber technique called Battlefield Saber Technique. It surpasses the high-tier, a true martial art! Currently, I haven’t fully learned it myself. If you really consider yourself gifted in saber techniques, I can show you the saber manual."
He looked very serious:
"But if you don’t feel confident, I won’t give it to you. It’s your choice."
"I want to see it."
Ding Ling said decisively.
This is simply a godsend benefit!
Gao Lan is one of the Four Pillars!
The Battlefield Saber Technique, which he hasn’t fully mastered!
It highlights its difficulty and preciousness!
"You can see it, but if you don’t learn it, you must become a servant for the Gao Family. Because the saber manual cannot be lost or leaked."
Gao Lan said solemnly:
"But if you learn it, the matter is dropped."
He gazed intently at Ding Ling:
"This is a gamble, do you dare to take it?"
He thought for sure he would win!
The Battlefield Saber Technique is extremely complex, and without fighting a hundred battles on the battlefield, it’s tough to perfect.
This was clearly stated in the opening of the saber technique!
Initially, Gao Lan didn’t believe it, but after more than ten years passed, he still couldn’t perfect the technique, and eventually, he had to believe!
Such a high-level saber technique.
How can an outsider possibly learn it in a short time!
"Bet!"
Ding Ling had a daring expression:
"If I lose, I’ll be at General Gao’s disposal!"
"Ding Ling, you!"
Cheng Huan was somewhat anxious.
This was the promising talent he finally discovered. Being snatched away by Gao Lan like this?
Although he had faith in Ding Ling.
But he had heard some reputation of the Battlefield Saber Technique, and Gao Lan’s ancestors made a name with it! It’s known to be extraordinary!
Such a saber technique, the difficulty surpasses the high-tier saber technique perhaps dozens of times, how could it be learned in a short time?!

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Battlefield Saber Technique
paragraphs: "General Cheng, rest assured."
Ding Ling seemed to be boosting his own morale, loudly declaring:
"I can definitely do it!"
He had read "Actor’s Self-Cultivation," "Actor’s Line Delivery Performance," and "Actor’s Facial Expression Notes," among others.
He had maxed out his skills in many aspects of acting!
His acting might not be divine.
But it could absolutely outshine most celebrities.
It could be said that his acting skills were exceptionally outstanding.
Because of this, he had actually deceived Cheng Huan and Gao Lan.
Cheng Huan grew increasingly anxious, almost ready to leave with Ding Ling directly.
Gao Lan, meanwhile, sighed a breath of relief and eagerly said:
"Have you decided to gamble?"
Ding Ling was indeed talented!
If used for personal advantage, as an aid to him, Gao Lan’s future career would definitely be smoother!
"I’ve decided!"
"Good."
Gao Lan laughed, perhaps at acquiring talent, or at Ding Ling’s audacity. He pulled out a scroll from his chest and handed it to Ding Ling, saying:
"This is the Battlefield Saber Technique. I’ll only give you one day. If you haven’t learned it by then, you must bring both yourself and the saber manual to my Gao Family!"
"No problem!"
Ding Ling nodded solemnly.
"Refreshing!"
Gao Lan nodded, looking at Ding Ling with a pleased face:
"Take your time and study it here. I’ll step out to attend to some things."
With that said.
He left.
Cheng Huan stayed in the tent, sighing in disappointment as he looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling didn’t explain, but hurriedly opened the Battlefield Saber Technique and read carefully.
As he successively trained his Initial Tier Saber Technique and High-tier Saber Technique to full level,
in terms of understanding saber techniques, Ding Ling, in a way, surpassed many third-class generals.
He was no longer a martial arts fool.
Because of this, he came to understand the value of the Battlefield Saber Technique.

"No wonder Gao Lan is so sure I won’t learn it. The difficulty of this Battlefield Saber Technique is tens or even hundreds of times harder than High-tier Saber Technique. They’re not even on the same level."
It’s like the difference between wood and metal and iron.
A world of difference.
"High-tier Saber Technique is said to be high-tier, but it’s just a foundational external skill."
"This Battlefield Saber Technique is the true advanced martial arts. Mastering it could absolutely elevate one to a second-class general!
The more Ding Ling read, the more his eyes gleamed.
Cheng Huan nearby noticed and was somewhat doubtful: "You understood it?"
"I’m researching it."
Ding Ling responded seriously and continued to study.
"Alas."
Cheng Huan lamented,:
"Even if you understood it, how could you learn it in just one day?"
Even Cheng Huan, who had great confidence in Ding Ling, thought so, which showed why Gao Lan was so confident and certain Ding Ling would fail.
This also demonstrated that the Battlefield Saber Technique was renowned and extraordinary!
At least in this Jizhou region, it was definitely the advanced version of martial arts.
"Although I understand a bit, with my qualifications, mastering it is indeed extremely difficult."
Ding Ling initially wanted to see if he could master it through self-study and practice.
But after half an hour of research, he still found it very challenging and strenuous.
He promptly abandoned the fruitless effort.
He had cheats! Why should he toil like others?
He would never do this silly thing again!
Ding Ling thought to himself, then glanced at the library.
Indeed.
As he focused his attention on the library, recalling the various aspects of the Battlefield Saber Technique,
In a flash.
A book coalesced in the library.
Then...
[Battlefield Saber Technique Full Level]
[Strength +1.3]
[Agility +1.5]
[Constitution +1.3]
Crack, crack!

Ding Ling’s skeleton sounded as if it were fracturing, a noise resonating like crackling, as vigorous qi condensed within his body, significantly increasing his strength, agility, and constitution, causing a substantial transformation in his bones and muscles.
Ding Ling felt as though he had grown a bit taller in that moment.
He clenched his fists.
A sense of transparent power emerged spontaneously.
He felt that he could now easily defeat two of his former selves.
Not only did his strength increase by over a hundred pounds,
his speed also surged significantly, his body becoming lighter, as if he could leap several dozen meters effortlessly.
He knew this wasn’t an illusion.
If he exerted all his strength now, he might actually jump that far.
"This feeling..."
It’s so perfect.
So exhilarating.
Ding Ling once again felt the joy of having cheats, realizing that others’ decades of hard work might not compare to his instant leap!
This is an overwhelming advantage!
"How is this possible?!"
Cheng Huan stood aghast, looking at Ding Ling incredulously:
"Your body, height, seemed to change just now? How could something like this happen suddenly?! Unless..."
He abruptly realized, his eyes widening like saucers, stuttering:
"You, you, could you be..."
"Indeed."
Without waiting for Cheng Huan to finish, Ding Ling replied with a smile:
"I have already mastered the Battlefield Saber Technique."
Cheng Huan’s face went blank, as if stunned.
How long had it been?!
Seems like only half an hour had passed, right?!
"I don’t believe it!"
Cheng Huan, after a while, squeezed out three words, then added:
"Unless you demonstrate it."

Originally, Ding Ling wanted to say it didn’t matter if he believed it or not, but since Cheng Huan had been a great help to him, greatly assisting his early progress, and seeing Cheng Huan’s curious, eager expression,
he nodded, picked up a long saber from the side, and began practicing the Battlefield Saber Technique.
Boom!
Once his aura expanded, a fierce battlefield aura exploded in all directions, with Cheng Huan bearing the brunt, retreating three steps back in shock.
He stopped at the tent’s entrance.

He watched Ding Ling, amazed and stunned. At that moment, he began to believe Ding Ling’s words because of the battlefield aura naturally evoked by the saber technique, enough to prove Ding Ling’s formidable expertise in the Battlefield Saber Technique.
"Incredible. How short a time it’s been!"
Clang!
With a long saber in hand,

Ding Ling wielded it ever more skillfully. Previously, he felt the long saber was slightly heavy for a weapon, but now it felt just right. Deploying the Battlefield Saber Technique, the long saber was like an extension of Ding Ling’s arm, hitting wherever he aimed, sometimes transforming into a raging dragon overturning river and sea, other times into an ironclad lion charging ferociously;
and sometimes into a divine blade sweeping through thousands of troops!
An ordinary long saber, in Ding Ling’s hands, unleashed power comparable to a divine weapon.
Crackle, crackle, crackle!
The final slash cut through accompanied by a clanging saber sound, swoosh! The entire tent was sliced through!

sentences.text: "General Cheng, rest assured."
Ding Ling seemed to be boosting his own morale, loudly declaring:
"I can definitely do it!"
He had read "Actor’s Self-Cultivation," "Actor’s Line Delivery Performance," and "Actor’s Facial Expression Notes," among others.
He had maxed out his skills in many aspects of acting!
His acting might not be divine.
But it could absolutely outshine most celebrities.
It could be said that his acting skills were exceptionally outstanding.
Because of this, he had actually deceived Cheng Huan and Gao Lan.
Cheng Huan grew increasingly anxious, almost ready to leave with Ding Ling directly.
Gao Lan, meanwhile, sighed a breath of relief and eagerly said:
"Have you decided to gamble?"
Ding Ling was indeed talented!
If used for personal advantage, as an aid to him, Gao Lan’s future career would definitely be smoother!
"I’ve decided!"
"Good."
Gao Lan laughed, perhaps at acquiring talent, or at Ding Ling’s audacity.
He pulled out a scroll from his chest and handed it to Ding Ling, saying:
"This is the Battlefield Saber Technique.
I’ll only give you one day.
If you haven’t learned it by then, you must bring both yourself and the saber manual to my Gao Family!"
"No problem!"
Ding Ling nodded solemnly.
"Refreshing!"
Gao Lan nodded, looking at Ding Ling with a pleased face:
"Take your time and study it here.
I’ll step out to attend to some things."
With that said.
He left.
Cheng Huan stayed in the tent, sighing in disappointment as he looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling didn’t explain, but hurriedly opened the Battlefield Saber Technique and read carefully.
As he successively trained his Initial Tier Saber Technique and High-tier Saber Technique to full level,
in terms of understanding saber techniques, Ding Ling, in a way, surpassed many third-class generals.
He was no longer a martial arts fool.
Because of this, he came to understand the value of the Battlefield Saber Technique.
"No wonder Gao Lan is so sure I won’t learn it.
The difficulty of this Battlefield Saber Technique is tens or even hundreds of times harder than High-tier Saber Technique.
They’re not even on the same level."
It’s like the difference between wood and metal and iron.
A world of difference.
"High-tier Saber Technique is said to be high-tier, but it’s just a foundational external skill."
"This Battlefield Saber Technique is the true advanced martial arts.
Mastering it could absolutely elevate one to a second-class general!
The more Ding Ling read, the more his eyes gleamed.
Cheng Huan nearby noticed and was somewhat doubtful: "You understood it?"
"I’m researching it."
Ding Ling responded seriously and continued to study.
"Alas."
Cheng Huan lamented,:
"Even if you understood it, how could you learn it in just one day?"
Even Cheng Huan, who had great confidence in Ding Ling, thought so, which showed why Gao Lan was so confident and certain Ding Ling would fail.
This also demonstrated that the Battlefield Saber Technique was renowned and extraordinary!
At least in this Jizhou region, it was definitely the advanced version of martial arts.
"Although I understand a bit, with my qualifications, mastering it is indeed extremely difficult."
Ding Ling initially wanted to see if he could master it through self-study and practice.
But after half an hour of research, he still found it very challenging and strenuous.
He promptly abandoned the fruitless effort.
He had cheats!
Why should he toil like others?
He would never do this silly thing again!
Ding Ling thought to himself, then glanced at the library.
Indeed.
As he focused his attention on the library, recalling the various aspects of the Battlefield Saber Technique,
In a flash.
A book coalesced in the library.
Then...
[Battlefield Saber Technique Full Level]
[Strength +1.3]
[Agility +1.5]
[Constitution +1.3]
Crack, crack!

Ding Ling’s skeleton sounded as if it were fracturing, a noise resonating like crackling, as vigorous qi condensed within his body, significantly increasing his strength, agility, and constitution, causing a substantial transformation in his bones and muscles.
Ding Ling felt as though he had grown a bit taller in that moment.
He clenched his fists.
A sense of transparent power emerged spontaneously.
He felt that he could now easily defeat two of his former selves.
Not only did his strength increase by over a hundred pounds,
his speed also surged significantly, his body becoming lighter, as if he could leap several dozen meters effortlessly.
He knew this wasn’t an illusion.
If he exerted all his strength now, he might actually jump that far.
"This feeling..."
It’s so perfect.
So exhilarating.
Ding Ling once again felt the joy of having cheats, realizing that others’ decades of hard work might not compare to his instant leap!
This is an overwhelming advantage!
"How is this possible?!"
Cheng Huan stood aghast, looking at Ding Ling incredulously:
"Your body, height, seemed to change just now?
How could something like this happen suddenly?!
Unless..."
He abruptly realized, his eyes widening like saucers, stuttering:
"You, you, could you be..."
"Indeed."
Without waiting for Cheng Huan to finish, Ding Ling replied with a smile:
"I have already mastered the Battlefield Saber Technique."
Cheng Huan’s face went blank, as if stunned.
How long had it been?!
Seems like only half an hour had passed, right?!
"I don’t believe it!"
Cheng Huan, after a while, squeezed out three words, then added:
"Unless you demonstrate it."

Originally, Ding Ling wanted to say it didn’t matter if he believed it or not, but since Cheng Huan had been a great help to him, greatly assisting his early progress, and seeing Cheng Huan’s curious, eager expression,
he nodded, picked up a long saber from the side, and began practicing the Battlefield Saber Technique.
Boom!
Once his aura expanded, a fierce battlefield aura exploded in all directions, with Cheng Huan bearing the brunt, retreating three steps back in shock.
He stopped at the tent’s entrance.
He watched Ding Ling, amazed and stunned.

At that moment, he began to believe Ding Ling’s words because of the battlefield aura naturally evoked by the saber technique, enough to prove Ding Ling’s formidable expertise in the Battlefield Saber Technique.
"Incredible.
How short a time it’s been!"
Clang!
With a long saber in hand,
Ding Ling wielded it ever more skillfully.
Previously, he felt the long saber was slightly heavy for a weapon, but now it felt just right.

Deploying the Battlefield Saber Technique, the long saber was like an extension of Ding Ling’s arm, hitting wherever he aimed, sometimes transforming into a raging dragon overturning river and sea, other times into an ironclad lion charging ferociously;
and sometimes into a divine blade sweeping through thousands of troops!
An ordinary long saber, in Ding Ling’s hands, unleashed power comparable to a divine weapon.
Crackle, crackle, crackle!
The final slash cut through accompanied by a clanging saber sound, swoosh!
The entire tent was sliced through!

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Gao Lan and the Players Are Shocked
paragraphs: Cheng Huan was so shocked that his scalp tingled, he couldn’t even speak, he just looked at Ding Ling with increasing astonishment, as if he was witnessing the rise of an Unrivaled Divine General!
"Huh?! What’s that sound?"
Gao Lan was happily teaching the recruits the Basic Posture.
He seemed to have already seen Ding Ling’s fate in a day: following him to the Gao Family in pain and helplessness, becoming their servant!
But suddenly, he seemed to hear a loud sound, emanating from the direction of his own tent.
"What happened?"
Gao Lan looked over in surprise.
And when he saw, he was taken aback.
His tent had actually collapsed.
And standing right in the middle with a long saber in hand was a young man.
That young man was none other than Ding Ling.
Beside Ding Ling stood Cheng Huan, whose state seemed somewhat off at the moment.
What exactly happened?!
Gao Lan instinctively sensed something was wrong, he thought of a possibility but felt it too far-fetched. What else could make Cheng Huan so shocked?!
Gao Lan’s mind was racing, he couldn’t focus on teaching the recruits anymore, he waved for the assistant: "You take over them."
Without waiting for the assistant to speak, he was already running towards Ding Ling’s direction with a long spear.
The recruits were left looking at each other in confusion.
The players did not know Ding Ling.
But someone who made their ’instructor’ Gao Lan run over so specifically must be extraordinary. Was he a native? Or a player?
’He must be a native NPC. No player in Jizhou seems to be doing exceptionally well to make someone like Gao Lan, who would be a future top-tier master, pay such attention.’
’Seeing how much Gao Lan values that guy, it’s clear he shouldn’t be underestimated. But which famous figure in history is he?’
The players couldn’t help but scrutinize Ding Ling, secretly speculating.
This mythical game is extraordinarily real, unlike other online games which label ’player’ names above their heads, so how to determine if someone is a player?
It can only be judged through daily interactions.

Or rather, those very weak-looking in the barracks are ten out of eight or nine times a player. Especially those participating in the recruit training who are clearly in their seventies or eighties, they are undoubtedly pure players.
Because in the Three Kingdoms World, it hasn’t yet reached a point where elderly are recruited to fight.
And those looking very strong.
Are most likely NPCs.
Ding Ling looked very strong, wielding a large saber as if it weighed nothing, naturally drawing the players’ attention and respect.
Gao Lan was even more focused than the players.
He briskly walked to the front of the tent, stared at Ding Ling for a moment, and couldn’t help but gasp, as he noticed the changes on Ding Ling.
He looked down at the tent again!
Sure enough, he saw the cut marks on the tent.
The marks were fresh and they were clearly made by a blade.
And the only one standing there was Ding Ling.
To cut through a tent in one stroke, and not intentionally but just with sheer Vigorous Qi, this kind of power?!
Gao Lan’s heart was pounding, he couldn’t believe it as he circled Ding Ling twice, hesitating:
"Ding Ling, I remember you couldn’t wield that saber so effortlessly before. How come you’ve progressed so much in just half an hour?"
"Because I learned the Battlefield Saber Technique."
Ding Ling was full of spirit, activating his Full-level Acting, perfectly portraying himself as a confident, radiant genius:
"And I completely comprehended the Battlefield Saber Technique. Hence the result."
Gao Lan’s mouth gaped open, wanting to say something, but found his tongue tied, he twisted his neck and only after a while, did he recover a bit, dryly laughing as he looked at Cheng Huan, saying:
"Do you believe it?"
"I saw it with my own eyes. How can it be fake?"
Cheng Huan had already come back to his senses from the shock, he sighed:
"Now I am a hundred percent certain. Ding Ling will absolutely become an Unrivaled Divine General akin to General Pan Feng in the future!"
Gao Lan’s pupils suddenly widened.
Although he had already speculated.
But actually getting such a result.
He still found it hard to accept!
"This is absolutely impossible!"
Gao Lan was even more agitated than Cheng Huan, his handsome face was either embarrassed or too shocked and disbelieving, turning a ghastly green:
"I don’t believe it!
"It doesn’t matter whether you believe it or not."

Cheng Huan had now come to terms, he’s just a Third-class General, facing someone like Ding Ling who’s destined to become a Super-Elite General, an Unrivaled Divine General in the future, he can only look up, so seeing Gao Lan’s disbelief, he couldn’t help but say:
"This is a fact!"
Gao Lan looked a bit grim, casting a glance at Cheng Huan, who had previously spoken so highly of him, but now that he had gotten benefits, he turned against him. Why should people act like this?
Cheng Huan obviously noticed how his words and expression might be misunderstood, he immediately solemnly said:
"Gao Lan, don’t misunderstand, I’m actually deeply shocked as well, that’s why I spoke so casually. How about this."
He looked towards Ding Ling:
"Display the Battlefield Saber Technique again, let Gao Lan properly witness your exceptional talent in saber techniques!"
He became visibly excited as he spoke.
Clearly, he felt honored and proud to have discovered such a treasure.
"Yes. General."

Ding Ling was still hoping Cheng Huan could continue teaching him other martial arts moves, or perhaps try and see if Gao Lan could teach him Spear Technique! Naturally, there was no reason to hide his skills.
Clang!

The long saber in his hand slightly rose, then the Battlefield Saber Technique activated, and a fierce aura was naturally emanated, boom! The saber moved with his body, transforming into a streak of white silk and a Flood Dragon.
Clang clang clang!
The wind was intense!
Cheng Huan was full of admiration, endlessly praising.
Gao Lan showed no expression on his face, but his pupils kept shrinking. Heaven knows how shocked he was at this moment!
It was as if his entire worldview was shattered!
"This guy is so strong!"
The players were somewhat absent-minded, each looking over with surprise, discussing among themselves:
"I’ve seen First-class Generals’ saber techniques that didn’t look this good! It’s really too stunning. What’s this saber technique? Even from a distance, it gives people a sense of alarm!"

"Yeah. Saber techniques that are both visually appealing and deadly are rare in the Three Kingdoms World. This person is obviously a renowned general from Jizhou. I think I heard Gao Lan call him Ding Ling. Do you guys remember any famous general named Ding Ling from the Three Kingdoms?"
"I’ve heard of Ding Feng and Ding Yuan, but Ding Ling, this is the first time I’ve heard of him."
Boom!
With his final strike, Ding Ling slashed out as if splitting mountains and seas, with a booming sound, causing the collapsed tent to further splinter apart.

chapters.title: Chapter 9: The Renowned General Zhang Hex
paragraphs: "Pardon my poor display."
Ding Ling sheathed his saber and stood up, addressing Gao Lan and Cheng Huan.
Gao Lan looked speechlessly at the sky, thinking, "If this is called a poor display, I might as well dig a hole and bury myself; wouldn’t that be better?"
"Good, good. Excellent!"
Cheng Huan clapped, laughed, and praised:
"Such an impressive display. Just based on this saber technique, Ding Ling, you are more than qualified to be a Military Marquis."
"I don’t dare claim that."
Ding Ling slightly reined in his demeanor.
Confidence is good, but over-acting might provoke Gao Lan’s displeasure, which would be counterproductive.
Being neither arrogant nor humble is the main theme, which makes one more admirable.
Sure enough, when Gao Lan first heard Cheng Huan’s words, his expression wasn’t pleasant, but Ding Ling’s modest words made his expression return to normal.
Gao Lan himself was only a Military Marquis.
Ding Ling, as a new recruit for less than half a day, had quickly reached a level equal to his, leaving Gao Lan at a loss.
Cheng Huan also realized this, cleared his throat, and promptly changed the subject:
"Ding Ling, with such talent, what are your plans next? Will you follow me to find General Pan Feng, or continue to learn from Gao Lan?"
"I am willing to continue learning from General Gao."
Ding Ling decisively took the opportunity to further his progress.
Gao Lan was speechless and waved his hand, a bit disheartenedly:

"I can’t teach you anymore. My specialty is the Battlefield Spear Technique. Next is the Sword Technique. But these two martial arts are family techniques. I made an exception to teach you the Battlefield Saber Technique, but I can’t teach you the Battlefield Spear Technique."
"That’s a great pity."
Ding Ling expressed regret.
Cheng Huan glanced sideways, "You want to learn spear technique too?"
"If possible, I certainly would like to learn."
"Do you think your talent in spear technique is not less than in saber technique?"
"Yes."
Ding Ling once again activated his full-level acting skills and performed:
"I believe I can definitely excel in spear technique!"
It’s important to demonstrate confidence.
How else can he persuade Cheng Huan to take him to learn spear techniques from other generals?
"Remarkable."
Cheng Huan instinctively praised but hesitated a bit, pondering for a while, then said:
"Since Gao Lan can no longer teach you, wait here for a moment, and I’ll go ask Zhang Hex."
"I can put in a good word for you with Zhang Hex."
Gao Lan seemed to greatly appreciate Ding Ling and couldn’t help interjecting:

"Zhang Hex specializes in spear technique. From initial tier to high tier, and even to his family’s spear technique, he has mastered them all! The family technique may be difficult to impart, but for other spear techniques, we should have no problem talking about it.
"That would be even better."
Cheng Huan was delighted, "Then Gao Lan, come with me."
"Okay."
Gao Lan beckoned to Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, let’s go together."
Almost at the same time.
An alert sounded.
[Achievement Medal: Earned Gao Lan’s High Recognition!]

[Note: Your performance has completely convinced Gao Lan, causing him to question his own martial arts talent. He even considers testing your spear talent to see if it is as strong as your saber talent.]
Another achievement medal.
Ding Ling grew increasingly curious about the purpose of these achievement medals.
They clearly were not something that just anyone could obtain.
Convincing a historical figure, how difficult could that be?
Clatter, clatter!
Gao Lan and Cheng Huan walked ahead.
Ding Ling followed behind.
Gao Lan touched the silk scroll of the Battlefield Saber Technique in his arms, feeling infinitely emotional. It was the first time a new recruit had made him question his life.
He had a strong premonition.
Perhaps with Zhang Hex, this Ding Ling might also create a miracle.
Very soon.
They arrived at Zhang Hex’s camp.
He, too, was a Military Marquis of the Jizhou Camp.
In terms of appearance and temperament, he slightly surpassed Gao Lan.
He was also training new recruits, and Ding Ling immediately noticed that ninety-nine percent of these recruits were players.
Zhang Hex was one of the future Five Generals, his reputation resounding through history!
Players naturally enjoyed learning martial arts under such a famous general.
Zhang Hex was very dedicated, instructing with precision, and only stopped ’working’ when Gao Lan arrived, allowing his deputy to continue training the recruits.
He then went to the tent to talk with Gao Lan and Cheng Huan.
Ding Ling didn’t go in.
He waited outside the tent.
There were some conversations he wasn’t in a position to participate in; going in would be futile.
But perhaps due to increased strength, his five senses had sharpened considerably. He could hear conversations that he previously couldn’t if he was even slightly distant.
But now he heard them clearly.
He listened to the conversation inside the tent between Gao Lan, Cheng Huan, and Zhang Hex.
Ding Ling blushed a little.
But soon, he returned to normal.
After some time.
Gao Lan lifted the curtain and came out, gesturing for Ding Ling to come over.
Ding Ling followed him into the tent.
He had just stepped inside when a melodious voice asked: "Are you Ding Ling?
"That’s right."
Ding Ling nodded instinctively and followed the voice. Sure enough, it was Zhang Hex, and he couldn’t help but say:
"Greetings, General Zhang!"
"I’m just a Military Marquis; the title of general is unnecessary."
Zhang Hex smiled and waved his hand, "You can just call me by my name."

Gao Lan, listening nearby, felt slightly embarrassed. He had accepted the title of general calmly. Hearing Zhang Hex, he felt he needed to make changes, especially in front of a genius like Ding Ling!
"I’ll skip the small talk."
Zhang Hex, evidently a decisive person, went straight to the core elements of initial-tier spear technique:
"Watch closely. This is the initial-tier spear technique that every Zhang family member learns."
As he spoke, he demonstrated without concealing anything from Gao Lan and Cheng Huan.
After two demonstrations.
He looked at Ding Ling:
"How does it feel?"
"Not bad."
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
A book formed instantly in the library of his mind.
[Initial-tier Spear Technique - Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
In just the span of a breath.
He had mastered the initial-tier spear technique.
Ding Ling had comprehended the essence and secrets of this technique, more than capable of performing a full set of spear techniques.
"Oh?"
Zhang Hex was a bit incredulous:

"The initial-tier spear technique may seem simple, but it forms the foundation of all spear techniques. Only by mastering this can you progress further in spear techniques. When I first learned it, it took me two full years to hone it to a point of perfection before moving on to middle-tier spear techniques!"
He paused, then said:
"Are you sure you’ve grasped this technique? If you have, I’ll continue teaching you the middle-tier, if not, you can leave now."
He looked intently at Ding Ling:
"Don’t lie to me!"
"I have no reason to lie."
Ding Ling walked to the side, picked a long spear from the weapon rack, then moved to an open space and began practicing.
Whoosh!
The long spear was like an arrow through the air, or a coiled snake, twisting, binding, unyielding, and indomitable in Ding Ling’s hands.
Swish, swish!
The long spear seemed capable of piercing the void, and in an instant, it stabbed out three points of starlight.
