Gao Lan was speechless and waved his hand, a bit disheartenedly:
"I can’t teach you anymore.
My specialty is the Battlefield Spear Technique.
Next is the Sword Technique.
But these two martial arts are family techniques.
I made an exception to teach you the Battlefield Saber Technique, but I can’t teach you the Battlefield Spear Technique."
"That’s a great pity."
Ding Ling expressed regret.
Cheng Huan glanced sideways, "You want to learn spear technique too?"
"If possible, I certainly would like to learn."
"Do you think your talent in spear technique is not less than in saber technique?"
"Yes."
Ding Ling once again activated his full-level acting skills and performed:
"I believe I can definitely excel in spear technique!"
It’s important to demonstrate confidence.
How else can he persuade Cheng Huan to take him to learn spear techniques from other generals?
"Remarkable."
Cheng Huan instinctively praised but hesitated a bit, pondering for a while, then said:
"Since Gao Lan can no longer teach you, wait here for a moment, and I’ll go ask Zhang Hex."
"I can put in a good word for you with Zhang Hex."
Gao Lan seemed to greatly appreciate Ding Ling and couldn’t help interjecting:
"Zhang Hex specializes in spear technique.
From initial tier to high tier, and even to his family’s spear technique, he has mastered them all!
The family technique may be difficult to impart, but for other spear techniques, we should have no problem talking about it.
"That would be even better."
Cheng Huan was delighted, "Then Gao Lan, come with me."
"Okay."
Gao Lan beckoned to Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, let’s go together."
Almost at the same time.
An alert sounded.
[Achievement Medal: Earned Gao Lan’s High Recognition!]
[Note: Your performance has completely convinced Gao Lan, causing him to question his own martial arts talent.
He even considers testing your spear talent to see if it is as strong as your saber talent.]
Another achievement medal.
Ding Ling grew increasingly curious about the purpose of these achievement medals.
They clearly were not something that just anyone could obtain.
Convincing a historical figure, how difficult could that be?
Clatter, clatter!
Gao Lan and Cheng Huan walked ahead.
Ding Ling followed behind.
Gao Lan touched the silk scroll of the Battlefield Saber Technique in his arms, feeling infinitely emotional.
It was the first time a new recruit had made him question his life.
He had a strong premonition.
Perhaps with Zhang Hex, this Ding Ling might also create a miracle.
Very soon.
They arrived at Zhang Hex’s camp.
He, too, was a Military Marquis of the Jizhou Camp.
In terms of appearance and temperament, he slightly surpassed Gao Lan.
He was also training new recruits, and Ding Ling immediately noticed that ninety-nine percent of these recruits were players.
Zhang Hex was one of the future Five Generals, his reputation resounding through history!
Players naturally enjoyed learning martial arts under such a famous general.
Zhang Hex was very dedicated, instructing with precision, and only stopped ’working’ when Gao Lan arrived, allowing his deputy to continue training the recruits.
He then went to the tent to talk with Gao Lan and Cheng Huan.
Ding Ling didn’t go in.
He waited outside the tent.
There were some conversations he wasn’t in a position to participate in; going in would be futile.
But perhaps due to increased strength, his five senses had sharpened considerably.
He could hear conversations that he previously couldn’t if he was even slightly distant.
But now he heard them clearly.
He listened to the conversation inside the tent between Gao Lan, Cheng Huan, and Zhang Hex.
Ding Ling blushed a little.
But soon, he returned to normal.
After some time.
Gao Lan lifted the curtain and came out, gesturing for Ding Ling to come over.
Ding Ling followed him into the tent.
He had just stepped inside when a melodious voice asked: "Are you Ding Ling?
"That’s right."
Ding Ling nodded instinctively and followed the voice.
Sure enough, it was Zhang Hex, and he couldn’t help but say:
"Greetings, General Zhang!"
"I’m just a Military Marquis; the title of general is unnecessary."
Zhang Hex smiled and waved his hand, "You can just call me by my name."
Gao Lan, listening nearby, felt slightly embarrassed.
He had accepted the title of general calmly.
Hearing Zhang Hex, he felt he needed to make changes, especially in front of a genius like Ding Ling!
"I’ll skip the small talk."
Zhang Hex, evidently a decisive person, went straight to the core elements of initial-tier spear technique:
"Watch closely.
This is the initial-tier spear technique that every Zhang family member learns."
As he spoke, he demonstrated without concealing anything from Gao Lan and Cheng Huan.
After two demonstrations.
He looked at Ding Ling:
"How does it feel?"
"Not bad."
Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly.
A book formed instantly in the library of his mind.
[Initial-tier Spear Technique - Full Level]
[Strength +0.1]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.1]
In just the span of a breath.
He had mastered the initial-tier spear technique.
Ding Ling had comprehended the essence and secrets of this technique, more than capable of performing a full set of spear techniques.
"Oh?"
Zhang Hex was a bit incredulous:
"The initial-tier spear technique may seem simple, but it forms the foundation of all spear techniques.
Only by mastering this can you progress further in spear techniques.
When I first learned it, it took me two full years to hone it to a point of perfection before moving on to middle-tier spear techniques!"
He paused, then said:
"Are you sure you’ve grasped this technique?
If you have, I’ll continue teaching you the middle-tier, if not, you can leave now."
He looked intently at Ding Ling:
"Don’t lie to me!"
"I have no reason to lie."
Ding Ling walked to the side, picked a long spear from the weapon rack, then moved to an open space and began practicing.
Whoosh!
The long spear was like an arrow through the air, or a coiled snake, twisting, binding, unyielding, and indomitable in Ding Ling’s hands.
Swish, swish!
The long spear seemed capable of piercing the void, and in an instant, it stabbed out three points of starlight.

chapters.title: Chapter 10: High-tier Spear Technique at Full Level
paragraphs: Dong dong!
The long spear struck a nearby pillar, instantly leaving three half-inch-deep pits on it!
Zhang Hex was stunned, his eyes wide in disbelief as he looked at Ding Ling.
Cheng Huan laughed with increasing delight:
"No wonder it’s Ding Ling! Such a genius, so incredible! Good, good, good! This is great! You’ve really made me proud!"
In order to have Zhang Hex teach Ding Ling spear techniques, Cheng Huan had recently praised Ding Ling to the skies in front of Zhang Hex, almost saying he was unmatched in heaven and earth!
Zhang Hex’s face was full of skepticism, almost openly suggesting that he thought Cheng Huan was boasting.

Now, with Ding Ling quickly mastering the initial-tier spear technique, Zhang Hex’s calm demeanor disappeared, making Cheng Huan extremely pleased, feeling that Ding Ling greatly increased his prestige!
Gao Lan shared the same thought.
Although he wasn’t as exaggerated as Cheng Huan, he also helped a lot, making Zhang Hex feel at one point that Gao Lan had changed and fallen, joining in on the praise!

Gao Lan naturally understood Zhang Hex’s expression, initially feeling aggrieved and worried that Ding Ling wouldn’t quickly learn the spear technique, which would only cement Zhang Hex’s opinions of him, leaving him without a defense.
Fortunately, to Gao Lan’s great relief and thrill, Ding Ling turned out to be impressively talented in spear techniques too!
Now let’s see how Zhang Hex could say anything against him?
"I’ve said long ago that he’s exceptionally gifted."
Gao Lan couldn’t help but feign a ’sigh’ on the side:
"You didn’t believe it. Do you now believe there are true geniuses in this world?"
Zhang Hex was at a loss for words.
Since childhood, he was one of the top geniuses within the clan, and even in all of Jizhou!
Especially in spear and staff techniques, no one could surpass him!
Yet now, he suddenly encountered someone with talent that outmatched his by a hundredfold? A thousandfold? Ten thousandfold?
How could Zhang Hex not lose composure and be shocked?
It took him two years to build a foundation for the initial-tier spear technique back then!
And how long did it take Ding Ling?
Not even a quarter of an hour!!
This was too monstrous!
"Are you sure you haven’t encountered similar initial-tier spear techniques before?"
Zhang Hex deeply doubted that Ding Ling was playing him, his expression changing rapidly.
Gao Lan glanced over and knew what Zhang Hex was thinking. After working together for so long, he understood Zhang Hex’s temperament and quickly said:
"Brother Zhang, if you don’t believe it, you can teach him the middle-tier, high-tier spear techniques, or even the Zhang Family’s ancestral Five Tigers Soul-breaking Spear Technique!"
Zhang Hex’s face darkened. The Five-Tiger Soul-Devouring Spear was a family secret; how could it be taught to outsiders casually?
Unless Ding Ling signed an indenture contract with the Zhang Family, otherwise, it would be impossible.
He didn’t say this out loud; after all, if Ding Ling was truly a genius, how could he sell himself to the Zhang Family?
With suspicion, he proceeded to explain the middle-tier spear technique to Ding Ling once more.
After two demonstrations,
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes,
and in the library, a book on ’middle-tier spear techniques’ was condensed.
A moment later,
[Middle-tier Spear Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.3]
[Physique +0.2]
Ding Ling instantly mastered the middle-tier spear technique!
His strength, agility, and physique all improved.
The hefty spear in his hands felt ever lighter!
Ding Ling had a feeling that he was now considered a strong presence among second-class generals!
How long had it been? And he’d already progressed this quickly!
If this power could really be taken back to the real world, then this ’mythical’ world was simply paradise!
"Demonstrate it once."
Zhang Hex looked at Ding Ling with bright eyes.

Ding Ling didn’t hesitate either. Spear out like a dragon, clang clang clang! The spear tip sometimes darted like a poisonous dragon, sometimes coiled like a python, as the spear pointed at a wooden pillar beside it, clang clang clang!
This time, he instantly created four shining stars, leaving four small pits on the wooden pillar.
And the depth seemed even greater than last time!
Zhang Hex was stunned.
Cheng Huan clapped and laughed.
Gao Lan sighed in admiration.
"Again!"
Zhang Hex taught the high-tier spear technique once more.
During the instruction of the spear technique, Zhang Hex probed several times and confirmed that Ding Ling indeed didn’t know or understand the high-tier spear technique!
’If he can quickly learn this high-tier spear technique as well, it would mean he’s truly an unparalleled genius!’
Zhang Hex taught it twice as usual.
Ding Ling closed his eyes once more.
Afterward, the book on high-tier spear techniques successfully condensed in the library.
Instantly...
[High-tier Spear Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.5]
[Physique +0.3]
Various secrets and essences of the high-tier spear technique seemed to merge into Ding Ling’s very bones, making this spear technique a part of his instinct.
Without needing Zhang Hex’s cue, he displayed the spear technique again.
Clang clang clang!
The spear moved like lightning, transforming into a meteor moving back and forth in the void, clang clang! In just an instant, five pits were left on the wooden pillar!
And they were nearly an inch deep!
Compared to the beginning, the combat power in the spear technique was virtually doubled!
"You!"
Zhang Hex’s eyes widened incredibly, and his lips trembled slightly; it was unclear if it was due to amazement, bewilderment, or overwhelming shock.
"So strong."
Gao Lan looked at Ding Ling as if looking at a rising war god:
"If there’s ever a war god in this world, it is definitely you, Ding Ling!"
"Indeed."
Cheng Huan felt pride as well:
"It’s my honor to have discovered Ding Ling among so many newcomers. It’s something I’ll boast about my whole life."
He looked at Ding Ling solemnly:

"Ding Ling, your talents are extraordinary, and your future is unlimited, but remember not to become too arrogant and offend influential people, so as not to ruin your future! Before achieving great success, you must stay grounded."
"Ding Ling will definitely remember the General’s words!"
Ding Ling humbly replied with clasped fists.
"That’s very good."
Cheng Huan felt more at ease.
Gao Lan also nodded secretly, knowing plenty of geniuses had met untimely ends due to offending others.
Ding Ling’s prowess was amazing!
He hoped Ding Ling wouldn’t falter, curious to see how far Ding Ling could go.
After all, they did share a bit of a ’mentor-student bond,’ and Ding Ling, once successful, might lend a hand someday!
Zhang Hex, though proud and somewhat arrogant, felt chastened by Ding Ling’s repeated demonstrations, re-evaluating his perceptions of Cheng Huan and Gao Lan.
For the first time, he openly acknowledged their keen insight, realizing he had been too narrow-minded.
"However..."
Zhang Hex shifted the topic:
"While I can’t teach Ding Ling the Five-Tiger Soul-Devouring Spear, I can offer a Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique that I happened upon to him."
"Really?"
Cheng Huan was delighted and thanked Zhang Hex on behalf of Ding Ling.
Zhang Hex raised his hand:
"No need to thank me yet. There are conditions."
"Don’t hesitate to say it."
Ding Ling said.
"Good."
Zhang Hex nodded:

"I’ll be straightforward. I know you made a bet with Gao Lan. I too will bet with you: if you can master this Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique in a short time, I’ll give you the complete guide for free..."

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique
paragraphs: "... If you cannot do it, you must become a servant of the Zhang family."
Zhang Hex paused, his eyes like sharp swords, staring directly at Ding Ling:
"What do you think?"
Without waiting for Ding Ling’s response, he added:
"Of course, you can completely refuse. Consider the previous spear technique instruction as an apology for my insolence in saying this!"
"I bet!"
Ding Ling was very decisive.
He had cheats.
This kind of gamble was the least of his worries!
"Are you sure?"
Zhang Hex was clearly a man of integrity, thought for a while, and said:

"To be honest, ever since I acquired this Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique, I have diligently studied it, but due to the lack of a good mentor, I’ve only reached the entry level to this day, so I cannot personally instruct you.
You can only train by looking at the manual.
The difficulty is as high as reaching the heavens."
If even such a high-level item as the Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique can be completed by you, Ding Ling, then I, Zhang Hex, would willingly admit defeat!
Zhang Hex only said this to himself, not out loud.
Obviously.
He was certain that Ding Ling could not successfully train in the Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique!
After all, even someone like him, who had pondered over this staff technique for five or six years, was still only at the entry-level.
This Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique is a top-level martial art, comparable to the Five Tigers Soul-breaking Spear Technique!
There was no one to guide, nor was there an initial, middle, or high tier staff technique as a transition!
It was like asking a child to lift a thousand pounds, like asking a toddler who doesn’t recognize a single character to write an essay!
Saying it’s as hard as reaching the heavens would not be an exaggeration.
"I’m sure."
Ding Ling was not intimidated at all, answering quickly.
Cheng Huan and Gao Lan were about to stop him, but seeing Ding Ling’s resolute and confident look, they hesitated and thought:
"If Ding Ling is really confident, this could be his opportunity. It would be unwise to interrupt rashly. But isn’t this gamble a bit too much?"
They did not want Ding Ling to become a servant of the Zhang family.
Because once that happened, Ding Ling would be cutting off his own future. As a servant, how high could one rank in society?
But recalling Ding Ling’s previous wager to learn the Battlefield Saber Technique, they were left unsure and pondered:
"Ding Ling possesses supernatural talent in pile skill, saber technique, and spear technique. Could he really have such talent with staff technique as well?
They found it hard to believe.
Because it was so unbelievable!
For someone who had never learned staff technique to start with a top-level staff technique! The failure rate was almost one hundred percent!
"Alright!"
Zhang Hex, being a straightforward person, did not try to dissuade further. He took out a scroll from his pocket and threw it to Ding Ling: "Catch."
Ding Ling leaped lightly, reached out in the air, and caught the scroll with the grace of a flying bird, his movements were very nimble, effortlessly catching the scroll.
Zhang Hex’s eyes lit up:

"Your agility and speed have already surpassed those of an average Third-class General. In terms of strength, you’re no less than a Second-class General; your potential for growth is significant. I will give you one last chance, if you don’t want to bet with me, return the scroll."
"No need to say more."
Ding Ling began to read the scroll intently.
As Zhang Hex felt regret, his heart was actually cheerful. In his view, he was sure to win this time!
Earlier, Gao Lan failed.

That was surely because Ding Ling had studied the initial and high-tier saber techniques, had already acquired some mastery of saber techniques, and possessed extraordinary talent, allowing him to grasp the Battlefield Saber Technique in a short time. Though incredibly astounding, it wasn’t entirely incomprehensible, after all, General Pan Feng had a similar experience with axe techniques.
But this staff technique is different!
It is a completely different discipline from saber techniques!
And there’s no initial or high-tier foundation of staff techniques for Ding Ling.
Ding Ling is essentially building a castle in the sky, how could he succeed?
Without a foundation in staff techniques, how could it be achieved?
Zhang Hex grew increasingly confident, just waiting for Ding Ling to fail.
While Ding Ling meticulously read through the Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique a few times.
On a bookshelf in the library, a book quickly materialized: "Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique"!
Then...
[Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique Full Level]
[Strength +1.4]
[Agility +1]
[Constitution +1.2]
Crack!

This time, the increase in strength and constitution was significant, causing a tremendous change in Ding Ling’s bones, so much so that the external manifestation was exceptionally obvious, and it could be clearly seen that Ding Ling’s stature suddenly grew a bit taller.
The previously well-fitting armor had now become entirely too small!
The armor that used to be loose, had already become very ill-fitting after several growth spurts.
Moreover, this time, having added a hundred more pounds of strength, combined with the original few hundred pounds of strength, it even deformed the inferior armor somewhat.
This scene was shocking to Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan.
They looked at each other, clearly seeing the astonishment in each other’s eyes!
No doubt about it.
At this moment, all three of Zhang Hex’s group considered Ding Ling a ’monster!’
How could a normal person train martial arts like this?!
Even General Pan Feng wasn’t this freakish!
It was absolutely explosive!
Boom!

Ding Ling wielded the long spear in his hand as a staff, and with a flourish, the air was filled with ’staff shadows’. It was clearly a nimble spear, yet it was wielded by Ding Ling with a domineering strength of a thousand pounds!
It was as if a mighty general wielding a heavy staff were slashing across the battlefield, free to come and go, an intensity so fierce it would make petty foes flee in fear!
That overwhelming aura of invincibility.
At one point, Gao Lan, Zhang Hex, and Cheng Huan all believed Ding Ling was a divine being able to capture dragons!
Phew!
When Ding Ling finished performing the Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique, and stood with the spear, bowing to the three of them.
The trio suddenly snapped back to reality.
Zhang Hex, with a sheen of fine sweat on his forehead, looked at Ding Ling as if seeing a monster, and after a long pause, smiled wryly:
"Ah, I underestimated a true genius. It seems in the eyes of a peerless genius, I, Zhang Hex, can only be considered mediocre!"
Zhang Hex felt utterly defeated.
Trained in martial arts from a young age!
A little overlord within his clan! A spear with which he remained invincible in his clan!
Even when he ventured out of the family, roaming all over Jizhou, he rarely met his match!
Yet today, a new recruit had utterly destroyed his confidence!
He nearly lost all his self-confidence!
"Indeed."
Gao Lan deeply agreed, feeling quite fortunate, he said:
"Thankfully, there are only a few people like Ding Ling and General Pan Feng in the world who possess such peerless talent, otherwise, we would have no place to survive or face to show!"
Cheng Huan would occasionally interject.
All three of them marveled from time to time.
Zhang Hex couldn’t help but step forward to touch Ding Ling’s bones!
In the end, he became more puzzled than ever!
Simply because Ding Ling’s bones and body didn’t seem unusually outstanding, how could he be so extraordinary!
[Achievement Medal Acquired...]

There was no one to guide, nor was there an initial, middle, or high tier staff technique as a transition!
It was like asking a child to lift a thousand pounds, like asking a toddler who doesn’t recognize a single character to write an essay!
Saying it’s as hard as reaching the heavens would not be an exaggeration.
"I’m sure."
Ding Ling was not intimidated at all, answering quickly.
Cheng Huan and Gao Lan were about to stop him, but seeing Ding Ling’s resolute and confident look, they hesitated and thought:
"If Ding Ling is really confident, this could be his opportunity.
It would be unwise to interrupt rashly.
But isn’t this gamble a bit too much?"
They did not want Ding Ling to become a servant of the Zhang family.
Because once that happened, Ding Ling would be cutting off his own future.
As a servant, how high could one rank in society?
But recalling Ding Ling’s previous wager to learn the Battlefield Saber Technique, they were left unsure and pondered:
"Ding Ling possesses supernatural talent in pile skill, saber technique, and spear technique.
Could he really have such talent with staff technique as well?
They found it hard to believe.
Because it was so unbelievable!
For someone who had never learned staff technique to start with a top-level staff technique!
The failure rate was almost one hundred percent!
"Alright!"
Zhang Hex, being a straightforward person, did not try to dissuade further.
He took out a scroll from his pocket and threw it to Ding Ling: "Catch."
Ding Ling leaped lightly, reached out in the air, and caught the scroll with the grace of a flying bird, his movements were very nimble, effortlessly catching the scroll.
Zhang Hex’s eyes lit up:
"Your agility and speed have already surpassed those of an average Third-class General.
In terms of strength, you’re no less than a Second-class General; your potential for growth is significant.
I will give you one last chance, if you don’t want to bet with me, return the scroll."
"No need to say more."
Ding Ling began to read the scroll intently.
As Zhang Hex felt regret, his heart was actually cheerful.
In his view, he was sure to win this time!
Earlier, Gao Lan failed.

That was surely because Ding Ling had studied the initial and high-tier saber techniques, had already acquired some mastery of saber techniques, and possessed extraordinary talent, allowing him to grasp the Battlefield Saber Technique in a short time.
Though incredibly astounding, it wasn’t entirely incomprehensible, after all, General Pan Feng had a similar experience with axe techniques.
But this staff technique is different!
It is a completely different discipline from saber techniques!
And there’s no initial or high-tier foundation of staff techniques for Ding Ling.
Ding Ling is essentially building a castle in the sky, how could he succeed?
Without a foundation in staff techniques, how could it be achieved?
Zhang Hex grew increasingly confident, just waiting for Ding Ling to fail.
While Ding Ling meticulously read through the Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique a few times.
On a bookshelf in the library, a book quickly materialized: "Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique"!
Then...
[Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique Full Level]
[Strength +1.4]
[Agility +1]
[Constitution +1.2]
Crack!

This time, the increase in strength and constitution was significant, causing a tremendous change in Ding Ling’s bones, so much so that the external manifestation was exceptionally obvious, and it could be clearly seen that Ding Ling’s stature suddenly grew a bit taller.
The previously well-fitting armor had now become entirely too small!
The armor that used to be loose, had already become very ill-fitting after several growth spurts.
Moreover, this time, having added a hundred more pounds of strength, combined with the original few hundred pounds of strength, it even deformed the inferior armor somewhat.
This scene was shocking to Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan.
They looked at each other, clearly seeing the astonishment in each other’s eyes!
No doubt about it.
At this moment, all three of Zhang Hex’s group considered Ding Ling a ’monster!’
How could a normal person train martial arts like this?!
Even General Pan Feng wasn’t this freakish!
It was absolutely explosive!
Boom!
Ding Ling wielded the long spear in his hand as a staff, and with a flourish, the air was filled with ’staff shadows’.
It was clearly a nimble spear, yet it was wielded by Ding Ling with a domineering strength of a thousand pounds!
It was as if a mighty general wielding a heavy staff were slashing across the battlefield, free to come and go, an intensity so fierce it would make petty foes flee in fear!
That overwhelming aura of invincibility.
At one point, Gao Lan, Zhang Hex, and Cheng Huan all believed Ding Ling was a divine being able to capture dragons!
Phew!
When Ding Ling finished performing the Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique, and stood with the spear, bowing to the three of them.
The trio suddenly snapped back to reality.
Zhang Hex, with a sheen of fine sweat on his forehead, looked at Ding Ling as if seeing a monster, and after a long pause, smiled wryly:
"Ah, I underestimated a true genius.
It seems in the eyes of a peerless genius, I, Zhang Hex, can only be considered mediocre!"
Zhang Hex felt utterly defeated.
Trained in martial arts from a young age!
A little overlord within his clan!
A spear with which he remained invincible in his clan!
Even when he ventured out of the family, roaming all over Jizhou, he rarely met his match!
Yet today, a new recruit had utterly destroyed his confidence!
He nearly lost all his self-confidence!
"Indeed."
Gao Lan deeply agreed, feeling quite fortunate, he said:
"Thankfully, there are only a few people like Ding Ling and General Pan Feng in the world who possess such peerless talent, otherwise, we would have no place to survive or face to show!"
Cheng Huan would occasionally interject.
All three of them marveled from time to time.
Zhang Hex couldn’t help but step forward to touch Ding Ling’s bones!
In the end, he became more puzzled than ever!
Simply because Ding Ling’s bones and body didn’t seem unusually outstanding, how could he be so extraordinary!
[Achievement Medal Acquired...]

chapters.title: Chapter 12: Great Strength and High Agility
paragraphs: [Achievement Medal Unlocked: Even the future famous general Zhang Hex is utterly impressed!]

[Note: Your performance has completely won over Zhang Hex! At one point, he thought you were abnormal—a non-ordinary human specimen! He wants to study you closely to see what traits you possess that allow you to learn martial arts so quickly! Be careful, and try not to die. Otherwise, even your corpse might be snatched away for research! His obsession with Martial Dao is beyond your imagination!]
Another achievement medal.
However, this note made Ding Ling feel a bit weird, causing him to shy away from Zhang Hex’s random touches.
Zhang Hex tried to approach him several times, but Ding Ling repeatedly retreated.
Realizing this, Zhang Hex awkwardly withdrew his hand, coughed lightly, and changed the subject:
"Ding Ling, your armor doesn’t fit. Why not wear mine? I have a spare set."
"I have a set too."
Cheng Huan quickly interjected:
"No need for yours, Brother Zhang. Besides, Ding Ling is a soldier of Jizhou! The Jizhou Prefecture has a set of armor that will fit him."
"It’s best to also prepare a long saber and a long staff for Ding Ling."
Gao Lan couldn’t help but interject:
"Ding Ling’s proficiency in saber and staff techniques is deep, it would be a pity not to make use of it."
"His talents in spear techniques are also quite impressive."
Zhang Hex added at the right time:
"Being able to thrust five times instantly, leaving nearly an inch-deep holes in a wooden post—such spear skills are beyond many second-class generals. He should also be equipped with a spear."
"How can he use so many weapons?"
Cheng Huan frowned, then suddenly brightened up:

"Why not craft a halberd for Ding Ling, which serves the purposes of a saber, spear, and staff! If he uses the halberd, Ding Ling can fully utilize his strengths, and on the battlefield, ordinary foes caught off guard by his various lethal moves would definitely be unseated from their horses!"
"Good idea."
Zhang Hex agreed: "It’s a pity I don’t understand halberd techniques, otherwise I could have given Ding Ling some guidance."
The three of them conversed, setting the plan.
Ding Ling stood by, not saying much.
Instead, he took the opportunity to glance at the character panel:
[Character: Ding Ling
Age: 23 years
Race: Human
Faction: Jizhou Han Fu
Occupation: Soldier
Level: 1

Strength: [Stamina 1 (ordinary human is 1 point), Wisdom 2, Strength 2.7+0.3+1.3+0.1+0.2+0.3+1.4=(6.3), Agility 2.8+0.5+1.5+0.2+0.3+0.5+1(6.8), Constitution 2.7+0.3+1.3+0.1+0.2+0.3+1.2(6.1), Defense 2, Charisma 2]
Weapons: A set of broken armor, a large saber.

Skills: Low-level Pile Skill (Level 10), Horse Stance Skill (Level 10), Initial Tier Saber Technique (Level 10), High-tier Saber Technique (Level 10), Battlefield Saber Technique (Level 10), Basic, Middle, and High-tier Spear Techniques (Level 10), Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique (Level 10), Acupuncture (Level 10), Swimming (Level 10), Fitness (Level 10), Basic Psychology (Level 10) ...]
Strength has soared to 6.3!
A force of over six hundred pounds!
A single punch could easily pulverize an ordinary person!
His high agility made Ding Ling feel as if he could leap three feet high at any moment, walking as if floating on clouds.
It was obvious.
The increase in agility was too rapid, and it would take some time to fully adjust!
Probably requiring a period of adaptation.
Nevertheless, to have gained so much in such a short time in the game world, Ding Ling was still very satisfied.
After all, he was learning true kung fu!
Moreover, the enhancements in strength, agility, and constitution were tangible!
Some time later.
Ding Ling returned to the recruit camp.
This time, he donned a brand-new, gleaming set of armor!
The ordinary saber in his hand had also been replaced with a hefty quality long saber!
Such a long saber was used by officers.
Initially, Ding Ling was not qualified.

But Cheng Huan, patting his chest, guaranteed that since an extraordinary talent had emerged in the military camp, he was entitled to use this saber, which greatly piqued the curiosity of General Pan Feng.
So Cheng Huan was ordered to bring Ding Ling to see him.
Ding Ling had barely warmed the seat in the recruit camp when a delighted Cheng Huan whisked him off to meet Pan Feng.
"Can I eat something before meeting the general?"
At the moment, Ding Ling felt an intense hunger.
He suspected this was a side effect of his growth in stature and skeletal changes.
It was clear that he needed to replenish his nutrition at this time!
He didn’t know how to eat food in this game; having never experienced it before, he could only turn to Cheng Huan for help.
"Follow me."
Cheng Huan took one look at Ding Ling and immediately understood the situation, grabbing Ding Ling as they went:

"I was negligent, completely forgetting that training in martial arts requires a substantial intake of meat! In these short two or three hours, you’ve progressed too much! If you don’t replenish your meat consumption in time, it might impair your potential."
While talking, Cheng Huan also enlightened Ding Ling along the way.
Cheng Huan realized that Ding Ling was a complete rookie!
Incidentally, the term "rookie" was something he picked up from other recruits, which seemed quite fitting for Ding Ling now.
He didn’t understand anything.
Yet his innate talent was enviable!
However, this was good, as it made it convenient for Cheng Huan to gain favor; this is called early investment!
An hour later.
Ding Ling had eaten nearly the equivalent of an entire cow, finally feeling satiated.
Cheng Huan clicked his tongue in wonder:
"Truly a genius, even when it comes to eating, it’s hundreds of times more than others!"
Typically, stronger soldiers could eat around ten pounds of beef.
Ding Ling ate about seven to eight hundred pounds!
One wonders how his stomach managed to hold it all!
Ding Ling was equally confused.
How could he eat so much?
He was startled at first, but considering his progress and that it was just a game, he soon accepted it.
Everything that seemed illogical in the game could be deemed logical.
After all, it was a game.
However, the game was so realistic that after spending some time with Cheng Huan, Gao Lan, and Zhang Hex, Ding Ling almost forgot he was in a game world!
Thankfully, the meat indeed worked.
After consuming a cow, Ding Ling felt refreshed, no longer plagued by hunger!
"Now that you’re full, let’s meet General Pan Feng."
Cheng Huan was brimming with excitement:
"He is, after all, Jizhou’s Unrivaled Divine General—an entity revered by all soldiers!"
Ding Ling had no words in reply.
At the same time, he was intrigued yet unsure.
According to the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Pan Feng was just a flash in the pan!
However, judging from the attitudes of Cheng Huan, Gao Lan, and Zhang Hex, General Pan Feng was undoubtedly a true god of war!
If General Pan Feng were indeed extraordinary, there must be significant underhanded tactics in his duel with Hua Xiong!
Ding Ling’s mind was racing.
He did not object to meeting General Pan Feng.
Instead, he followed Cheng Huan to Jizhou’s Central Army Camp.
As they walked along.
Gao Lan and Zhang Hex also joined their ranks, eagerly anticipating Ding Ling’s performance in front of General Pan Feng.
They were also curious whether Ding Ling could learn General Pan Feng’s Unparalleled Axe Technique!

chapters.title: Chapter 13: Unrivaled Divine General Pan Feng
paragraphs: We must understand that, apart from General Pan Feng himself, no one has been able to master his Unparalleled Axe Technique to this day!
General Pan Feng is deeply troubled by this.
He has declared that anyone who can find a person that meets his criteria will definitely earn his deep friendship!
Just for the sake of General Pan Feng’s friendship,
it’s worth a try.

Moreover, nowadays Ding Ling has some sort of ’mentoring friendship’ with all three of them, so it seems like something they all discovered together. Isn’t it reasonable for all three to go together and jointly earn Pan Feng’s friendship?
With this thought in mind,
they approached Ding Ling about it with mutual understanding.
Ding Ling naturally had no objections.
The three couldn’t help but feel relieved, thinking they hadn’t misjudged him. They found Ding Ling increasingly pleasing to look at.
However, in the eyes of other players, their behavior seemed very unusual.
Some new recruits who knew Ding Ling was a player were even more excited!
"That guy actually won the favor of the famous generals Zhang Hex and Gao Lan at the same time! How did he manage that?!"
"What’s most incredible is that this guy managed to win over Zhang Hex and Gao Lan in just half a day! It’s too unbelievable!"
"Unimaginable!"
The players were shocked, looking at Ding Ling with eyes full of confusion, puzzlement, incomprehension, jealousy, and envy...
It was truly a complex mix of emotions.
It’s like when two students, one scores first in the country and receives commendations and trust from high levels; the other is at the bottom of the class!
That sense of disparity is enough to be lethal!
Fortunately, the only solace for these players was: there was only one such extraordinary figure! Everyone else was still stuck, learning the Pile Skill!
"This guy is definitely an old player, but I wonder if he’s on the leaderboard? We must take a good look when we return!"
"What’s his name again?"
"It’s Ding Ling. I remember very clearly!"
The fact that Ding Ling was a player spread quickly from one to ten, ten to a hundred.
It soon echoed throughout the entire camp.
Everyone was astonished by this!
Especially the new players who previously belonged to the Zhang Hex and Gao Lan camps, they were utterly shocked!
Because at that moment, they recalled Ding Ling’s performance.
His Sword Skill, techniques, and presence were simply unbeatable! How could he possibly be a player?!
They couldn’t believe it, but after several inquiries and comparisons, they had to accept this fact.
"Who would have thought Ding Ling is actually a player! It’s terrifying. That guy’s Saber Technique isn’t ordinarily strong! Who would’ve thought he was a player!"
"I guess he’s either an old player, or in the real world, he also practices with swords. Otherwise, how could he be so ridiculously strong? The gap between us is just too big!"
Ding Ling was unaware that in the Jizhou camp, the new player recruits’ discussions about him had reached a boiling point.
He had now arrived at the Central Army Camp and met the ’legendary’ General Pan Feng.
At first sight,
Ding Ling was genuinely astounded.
It wasn’t out of fear or trepidation.
But it was his first time seeing such an enormous, burly, and robust man.
He was probably over two meters tall!
Broad shoulders and thick waist; even the phrase ’built like a bear’ wasn’t enough to describe him.
His arms seemed thick enough to ’run horses’ on.
Such a strong man!
The axe he wielded was even more exaggerated and intimidating.
An ordinary soldier couldn’t lift it; it required two people to carry.
Boom!
Pan Feng lifted the axe single-handedly from the soldier’s shoulders and planted it onto the ground with a boom, making the earth tremble in three shocks.
"So you’re the so-called unparalleled genius Ding Ling?"
Pan Feng looked Ding Ling up and down with interest, and after a while, said rather disappointedly:
"Too thin and small!"
Ding Ling was speechless.
Despite his multiple enhancements, evolutions, and growth, which had improved his height and build to be comparable to Zhang Hex and Gao Lan,
he indeed appeared like a thin stick compared to Pan Feng.
"Compared to you, General Pan Feng, naturally he’s no match."
Zhang Hex couldn’t resist:
"But under the heavens, to find someone whose physique matches yours, General Pan Feng, is probably an impossibility!"
He spoke with great certainty.
But Pan Feng replied:
"There’s a rumor that Jiuyuan Lu Bu, known as the Flying General, has a height and build comparable to mine. Who knows if it’s true?"
"A rumor is just a rumor. It’s unreliable!"
Gao Lan also said:
"Furthermore, to ordinary people, reaching your stature, General Pan Feng, or that of Lü Bu, it’s tough for them to discern any subtle differences."
"True."
Pan Feng no longer dwelled on the issue of height and build and instead fixed his gaze on Ding Ling, saying:

"Zhang Hex and Gao Lan are the fiercest in my army aside from myself! You were able to win over the two of them and even earned General Cheng Huan’s high praise. This indicates your exceptional talent. Very well then."
Pan Feng wasted no time and got straight to the point:

"I’ll personally teach you Initial, Middle, and High-tier Axe Techniques! If you truly comprehend and grasp them as quickly as Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan say, then I’ll teach you the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques!"
Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques?
The name seemed very familiar!
Suddenly, a flash of lightning crossed his mind.
Ding Ling remembered.
It seemed that Cheng Yaojin’s Three Axes in the Sui and Tang Legends originated from the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques!
Because these Axe Techniques were too complex, Cheng Yaojin could only grasp the first Three Axes: Split Head, Ghost Tooth-Picking, and Ear-Picking!
As for whether these Axe Techniques were what Cheng Yaojin learned, he would naturally find out when Pan Feng demonstrated them later.
"It really is the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques."
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan exchanged glances, understanding each other’s expressions and thoughts clearly, and each mused:

"Aside from General Pan Feng, no one else can master this Axe Technique completely! Learn it fully! Because the killing moves of these Axe Techniques are too aggressive, fierce, and the use techniques are extremely complex and variable. Without the terrifying stature and demeanor of General Pan Feng, it’s absolutely impossible to master it all. Like us, we can at most learn the first few moves. In such a case, it’s better not to learn it at all."
Zhang Hex and Gao Lan naturally had the opportunity to learn the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.
Because Pan Feng never intended to hide his skills; instead, he earnestly hoped someone could inherit these Axe Techniques, to prevent them from becoming extinct.
Unfortunately, Zhang Hex and Gao Lan couldn’t learn either, so they opted to specialize in their family’s secret techniques!
They understood the saying ’biting off more than you can chew’ very well!

Especially when the prerequisites for these Axe Techniques are extraordinarily terrifying. Even if they possessed great comprehension, achieving the physical stature and height of General Pan Feng within their lifetime would be difficult, so naturally, they abandoned practicing it.
They brought Ding Ling here also to see if Ding Ling could fully master these Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, and if he really could,
that would be astounding!
"Watch closely."
Pan Feng wasted no time; after some polite words, he delved directly into the core, principle, essence, and esoteric truth of the Initial Tier Axe Technique.
Nearby, Zhang Hex and the others listened intently, occasionally deep in thought.

"It’s Ding Ling.
I remember very clearly!"
The fact that Ding Ling was a player spread quickly from one to ten, ten to a hundred.
It soon echoed throughout the entire camp.
Everyone was astonished by this!
Especially the new players who previously belonged to the Zhang Hex and Gao Lan camps, they were utterly shocked!
Because at that moment, they recalled Ding Ling’s performance.
His Sword Skill, techniques, and presence were simply unbeatable!
How could he possibly be a player?!
They couldn’t believe it, but after several inquiries and comparisons, they had to accept this fact.
"Who would have thought Ding Ling is actually a player!
It’s terrifying.
That guy’s Saber Technique isn’t ordinarily strong!
Who would’ve thought he was a player!"
"I guess he’s either an old player, or in the real world, he also practices with swords.
Otherwise, how could he be so ridiculously strong?
The gap between us is just too big!"
Ding Ling was unaware that in the Jizhou camp, the new player recruits’ discussions about him had reached a boiling point.
He had now arrived at the Central Army Camp and met the ’legendary’ General Pan Feng.
At first sight,
Ding Ling was genuinely astounded.
It wasn’t out of fear or trepidation.
But it was his first time seeing such an enormous, burly, and robust man.
He was probably over two meters tall!
Broad shoulders and thick waist; even the phrase ’built like a bear’ wasn’t enough to describe him.
His arms seemed thick enough to ’run horses’ on.
Such a strong man!
The axe he wielded was even more exaggerated and intimidating.
An ordinary soldier couldn’t lift it; it required two people to carry.
Boom!
Pan Feng lifted the axe single-handedly from the soldier’s shoulders and planted it onto the ground with a boom, making the earth tremble in three shocks.
"So you’re the so-called unparalleled genius Ding Ling?"
Pan Feng looked Ding Ling up and down with interest, and after a while, said rather disappointedly:
"Too thin and small!"
Ding Ling was speechless.
Despite his multiple enhancements, evolutions, and growth, which had improved his height and build to be comparable to Zhang Hex and Gao Lan,
he indeed appeared like a thin stick compared to Pan Feng.
"Compared to you, General Pan Feng, naturally he’s no match."
Zhang Hex couldn’t resist:
"But under the heavens, to find someone whose physique matches yours, General Pan Feng, is probably an impossibility!"
He spoke with great certainty.
But Pan Feng replied:
"There’s a rumor that Jiuyuan Lu Bu, known as the Flying General, has a height and build comparable to mine.
Who knows if it’s true?"
"A rumor is just a rumor.
It’s unreliable!"
Gao Lan also said:
"Furthermore, to ordinary people, reaching your stature, General Pan Feng, or that of Lü Bu, it’s tough for them to discern any subtle differences."
"True."
Pan Feng no longer dwelled on the issue of height and build and instead fixed his gaze on Ding Ling, saying:
"Zhang Hex and Gao Lan are the fiercest in my army aside from myself!
You were able to win over the two of them and even earned General Cheng Huan’s high praise.
This indicates your exceptional talent.
Very well then."
Pan Feng wasted no time and got straight to the point:
"I’ll personally teach you Initial, Middle, and High-tier Axe Techniques!
If you truly comprehend and grasp them as quickly as Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan say, then I’ll teach you the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques!"
Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques?
The name seemed very familiar!
Suddenly, a flash of lightning crossed his mind.
Ding Ling remembered.
It seemed that Cheng Yaojin’s Three Axes in the Sui and Tang Legends originated from the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques!
Because these Axe Techniques were too complex, Cheng Yaojin could only grasp the first Three Axes: Split Head, Ghost Tooth-Picking, and Ear-Picking!
As for whether these Axe Techniques were what Cheng Yaojin learned, he would naturally find out when Pan Feng demonstrated them later.
"It really is the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques."
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan exchanged glances, understanding each other’s expressions and thoughts clearly, and each mused:
"Aside from General Pan Feng, no one else can master this Axe Technique completely!
Learn it fully!
Because the killing moves of these Axe Techniques are too aggressive, fierce, and the use techniques are extremely complex and variable.
Without the terrifying stature and demeanor of General Pan Feng, it’s absolutely impossible to master it all.
Like us, we can at most learn the first few moves.
In such a case, it’s better not to learn it at all."
Zhang Hex and Gao Lan naturally had the opportunity to learn the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.
Because Pan Feng never intended to hide his skills; instead, he earnestly hoped someone could inherit these Axe Techniques, to prevent them from becoming extinct.
Unfortunately, Zhang Hex and Gao Lan couldn’t learn either, so they opted to specialize in their family’s secret techniques!
They understood the saying ’biting off more than you can chew’ very well!
Especially when the prerequisites for these Axe Techniques are extraordinarily terrifying.
Even if they possessed great comprehension, achieving the physical stature and height of General Pan Feng within their lifetime would be difficult, so naturally, they abandoned practicing it.
They brought Ding Ling here also to see if Ding Ling could fully master these Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, and if he really could,
that would be astounding!
"Watch closely."
Pan Feng wasted no time; after some polite words, he delved directly into the core, principle, essence, and esoteric truth of the Initial Tier Axe Technique.
Nearby, Zhang Hex and the others listened intently, occasionally deep in thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 14: High-tier Axe Technique
paragraphs: After explaining and demonstrating twice like this.
Only then did Pan Feng stop, look at Ding Ling, and ask:
"Do you need a third explanation? If you do, I can explain once more."
His attitude was kind.
Completely different from the imagined Pan Feng.
Vastly different from the character’s image in the TV series.
Ding Ling felt a rush of emotions in his heart, but he said:
"No need, General."
He closed his eyes slightly.
A book suddenly formed in the library.
[Initial Tier Axe Mastery Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.1]
[Constitution +0.1]
In just an instant.
The Initial Tier Axe Technique was mastered.
Ding Ling understood all kinds of axe technique application skills at this moment.
He opened his eyes.
Pan Feng immediately said:
"How is it?"
"No problem."
"Oh?"
Pan Feng was a bit surprised:
"If you could truly master the Initial Tier Axe Technique just by listening to two explanations, I must admit your talent is extraordinary."
He handed the axe in his hand to Ding Ling:
"Try it."
Ding Ling took it, feeling a heavy weight, almost unable to hold it, staggering slightly.
He was shocked.
This axe must weigh over two or three hundred pounds!
To fight holding such an axe.
Indeed, a slight hit would injure, a single touch could kill!
No wonder Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan praised Pan Feng greatly, seeing Pan Feng’s relaxed and natural way of wielding the axe, one could tell he possessed immense strength!
A true formidable general!
Could Hua Xiong really kill the present Pan Feng in three rounds?! How absurd! There must be something hidden within!
"I was careless."
Pan Feng immediately took the axe back from Ding Ling, ordering a soldier nearby: "Bring a lighter axe!"
A while later.
The soldier came with a sixty-pound axe.
And said it was the lightest axe in the camp.
Pan Feng looked at Ding Ling: "Can you handle it?
He didn’t ask if it could be held, obviously realizing Ding Ling’s strength was extraordinary, otherwise, he wouldn’t have truly caught and lifted an axe weighing a few hundred pounds.
"I’ll give it a try."
Ding Ling took the axe, weighing it in his hands, indeed somewhat heavy.
But still within an acceptable range.
The previous long sword weighed around forty or fifty pounds, yet Ding Ling wielded it effortlessly as if it were weightless.
Now it was just heavier, no big issue.
Clang!

He began swinging the axe, in his hands the massive axe became as light as a feather, whether chopping, hacking, or slicing, it was extremely agile, sometimes like a Spirit Crane spreading its wings to fiercely peck the enemy, sometimes like a robust man opening mountains with sheer force.
The giant axe in Ding Ling’s hands became like a Divine Artifact!
As he swung it to the end, it seemed to become a Wind Wheel, amidst the snapping sound, actually splitting a crack in the earth.
"Good!"
Before Cheng Huan and the others could speak, Pan Feng clapped, praising:
"Cheng Huan, Zhang Hex, and Gao Lan’s words were indeed correct. Ding Ling, you’re indeed an incredible genius!"
He gave Zhang Hex and the trio an appreciative glance, his expression was self-evident.
If Ding Ling truly mastered the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, Zhang Hex and the three would gain his profound friendship!
Zhang Hex and the three understood, each one inevitably became excited, joyful.
Cheng Huan was somewhat composed.
Zhang Hex and Gao Lan were only Military Marquis at the moment, if they received Pan Feng’s assistance, their future prospects would be endless! Promotion would be as easy as drinking water!
Thinking of this.
Zhang Hex and Gao Lan couldn’t help but look at Ding Ling, the expectation and encouragement in their eyes almost overflowed!
They were originally extremely shocked by Ding Ling’s axe technique talent.
But now that surprise was completely overshadowed by the good news, they now wished even more eagerly than Ding Ling for his success!
"Next is the Middle-tier Axe Technique!"
Pan Feng demonstrated it twice, looking at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling closed his eyes.
In the library, a book immediately materialized: "Middle-tier Axe Technique"!
In an instant.
[Middle-tier Axe Mastery Full Level]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +0.2]
[Constitution +0.2]
The various Esoteric Truths of the Middle-tier Axe Technique integrated into Ding Ling’s spirit and bones at this moment, becoming part of his instinct!
His strength, constitution, and agility were enhanced again.
The bones and internal organs were undergoing subtle changes.
The previously slightly heavy axe became lighter in his hand.
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate, directly wielding the Middle-tier Axe Technique.
Boom!

In his hands, the axe was swung like a wild bull plowing the field, a Flood Dragon emerging from the water, the momentum grand and intense to the extreme! The fierce iron-blooded aura made Pan Feng, Zhang Hex, and the others involuntarily serious.
Once Ding Ling finished a set of axe techniques.
Zhang Hex and the others applauded and praised, expressing their admiration!
Pan Feng also involuntarily nodded, saying:
"Very good. Under the heavens, perhaps only I can match you in axe technique talent."
He marveled at Ding Ling’s brilliance:
"I never thought in this lifetime I would truly see such a prodigy like you."
He sighed, saying:
"It’s just a pity, you’re so small and thin, there’s absolutely no possibility you could learn the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques."
"How would you know without trying?"
Zhang Hex chimed in:
"You have to understand Ding Ling’s talent is terrifyingly great. If he can’t learn it, who else would have a chance?"
"True."
Pan Feng acknowledged Zhang Hex’s words, then began explaining the High-tier Axe Technique to Ding Ling and demonstrated:

"Watch carefully. This is the true Esoteric Truth and essence of the High-tier Axe Technique! Only by fully mastering the High-tier Axe Technique will you have a one percent chance of learning the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, otherwise, it’s hopeless!"
Boom!

Pan Feng’s large and strong figure made the axe in his hands move like a Demon King descending, Pangu opening the heavens and splitting the earth, giving Ding Ling an extremely direct feeling, that at this moment, if he faced Pan Feng, he absolutely couldn’t block a single axe strike!
Is this a Super-Elite General?
Or a First-class Martial Generals?!
Ding Ling was surprised, his gaze towards Pan Feng became more unusual.
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan clearly saw themselves as inferior to Pan Feng, and watched with great interest, when Pan Feng finished, they marveled at how impressive Pan Feng was.
Pan Feng waved his hand:
"Alright, enough with the flattery."
He looked at Ding Ling:
"Alright?"
"No problem."
Ding Ling closed his eyes.
In the library, the book "High-tier Axe Technique" materialized again.
In an instant.
[High-tier Axe Mastery Full Level]
[Strength +0.5]
[Agility +0.3]
[Constitution +0.3]
Unlike the spear technique’s emphasis on agility.
This axe technique clearly emphasizes strength more!
Each upgrade point increased strength significantly.
This time added quite a few points again.
The axe in Ding Ling’s hand became even more effortless for him.
He opened his eyes, then swung his hand, holding the axe single-handedly to cut and slice.
Clang!
The axe’s cutting and slicing were clean and efficient to the extreme, Zhang Hex and the others had no doubt...

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques
paragraphs: Now, Ding Ling’s prowess with the axe is probably enough to contend with many top second-class generals!
Some third-class generals might be felled by a single axe strike from Ding Ling.
His axe technique is astonishingly in the Transformation Realm at the foundational stage!
Not a flaw to be found!
It’s simply too perfect!
A while later.
Ding Ling sheathed his axe and stood upright.
Zhang Hex and the others snapped out of their daze and quickly applauded him!
Pan Feng also looked at Ding Ling with a face full of astonishment and admiration:
"Your talent in axe techniques surpasses my imagination! Back when I was comprehending the high-tier axe techniques, I didn’t reach the Perfection Stage as quickly as you did!"
His expression was peculiar, and a ripple rose in his heart:
"I think I now understand how Zhang Hex and the others must feel. Encountering someone more talented than oneself is indeed both shocking and surprising, and also a bit disheartening!"
The reasons for the shock and surprise are obvious.
The disheartenment comes naturally from feeling overshadowed, as he is no longer the unrivaled pioneer in this field!
"However, the more talent you show in axe technique, the happier I am."
Pan Feng changed the topic and laughed:
"I’m now more and more looking forward to your performance."
He walked to the side, took an ancient bamboo scroll from a bookshelf, and handed it to Ding Ling:
"This is an ancient bamboo scroll I acquired by chance from a mysterious realm. This bamboo scroll is impervious to water and fire, truly a Divine Object!"
Seeing Ding Ling receive the bamboo scroll, he started to flip through it.
Pan Feng didn’t mind and continued smiling as he explained:
"I don’t know the origin of this bamboo scroll, nor who forged it.
However, besides the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, this bamboo scroll also contains a complementary Breathing Technique."
Ding Ling suddenly looked up at Pan Feng:
"I didn’t see the Breathing Technique in this bamboo scroll."
Zhang Hex and the others also glanced at Pan Feng. The Breathing Technique is extremely rare. Some families regard it as a treasure that will never be shared outside!

In the eyes of Zhang Hex and the others, techniques might be static, but the Breathing Technique is dynamic; in terms of rarity, the Breathing Technique far surpasses the techniques, and is seen as the foundation of a family.
Pan Feng being able to find a matching Breathing Technique for the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques is truly incredible luck!
"There is a reason for that."
Pan Feng showed a peculiar expression:
"Strangely, after I learned the Breathing Technique, it suddenly disappeared from the bamboo scroll, and no matter how I recalled it afterward, I couldn’t remember it. So, I’m very sorry."
He said with regret:
"I cannot pass on the complementary Breathing Technique to you."
He sighed:
"Without the complementary Breathing Technique, the difficulty of learning the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques is beyond imagination!"
He pointed at himself:

"Even I, without the complementary Breathing Technique, would never master all the Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques. I might learn the first dozen axe techniques at most. For, as it progresses, the Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques become more fierce and aggressive, harming the body excessively. Without the Breathing Technique to balance it, forcing oneself might injure one’s organs, causing harm to oneself while defeating the enemy, which is too unprofitable."
Pan Feng continued to explain various details and origins of the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.
Ding Ling listened while slightly closing his eyes.
He had already finished examining the ancient bamboo scroll.
After closing his eyes.
In just a moment.
A new book appeared in the library, with flamboyant inscriptions on top: "Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques"!
Bang!
All sorts of incredible contents, essences, mysteries, roared into Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness, organs, and marrow, transforming into his instinct.
[Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques Full Level]
[Strength +2.4]
[Agility +1.6]
[Physique +2.4]
Crack!
The bones were crackling!
The organs were trembling!
Ding Ling’s physique was changing, his height increasing slightly with each cracking sound.
A mysterious force field began to change invisibly around him! As if there were fierce whirlwinds swirling around him!
At this moment.
Ding Ling seemed like a Mountain God, an incredible aura surged from his body, even beginning to affect the outside void!
"This?!"
Pan Feng shut his mouth, looking at Ding Ling in utter disbelief, his eyes almost popping out:
"How, how, how is this possible?!"
"Can’t be?!
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, Cheng Huan were also bewildered:

"Impossible! It hasn’t even been a quarter of an hour! How could he have mastered it already?! This is absolutely impossible! It must be that Ding Ling, after accumulating so much, experienced some subtle changes in his body, there’s no way he mastered the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques in such a short time. It’s just too brief!"
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan, who admired Pan Feng’s strength, had seen the first dozen moves of the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.
I have to admit.
It’s too difficult.
They tried and ended up giving up one by one, it’s simply not humanly possible to learn!

Besides, without the complementary Breathing Technique to restore the organs, even if learned, it’s hard to fully unleash the power of the Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques! So why bother learning then?
But Ding Ling?
Without the Breathing Technique.
He actually mastered the Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques?!
Zhang Hex and the others stared intently at Ding Ling, their eyes full of amazement, perplexity, expectation, confusion, and incomprehension, experiencing a kaleidoscope of emotions!
Clang!
Ding Ling opened his eyes, and without a word, wielded the sharp axe, starting to demonstrate the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.
This time, he had gained several hundred pounds of strength, his physique stronger, endurance more lasting, breathing steady!
His agility, needless to say, was high.
This made the sixty-pound sharp axe feel like a toy in his hands, light as if it had no weight!
While performing the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, it was like he was performing magic, perfect to the point of astonishment!
All sorts of incredible moves were displayed by him one after another!
Each move seemed like thunderstrikes, like an antelope’s horns hanging, with no trace or pattern to follow!
Yet they all seemed crafted by gods, extraordinarily ingenious, leaving viewers bewildered, marveling at a Celestial Being!
Bang!
As the last axe technique struck the ground, with a reverberating sound, it directly cleaved a slender fissure four to five meters long into the earth!
Ding Ling exhaled deeply, sheathed the axe, and stood still.
Zhang Hex and the others suddenly woke up, either applauding, or in shock, or simply shouting praises and admiration:
"Absolutely incredible! Is this the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques?! I wouldn’t have thought they’d look so different in Ding Ling’s hands!"
"So strong. Ding Ling can definitely be compared to a first-class general now! How long has it been? He’s grown to this extent, it’s defying fate! Practically a War God descended to earth!"
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, Cheng Huan were awed, looking at Ding Ling as if looking at a freak or monster!
How could a normal person progress so much?

So, I’m very sorry."
He said with regret:
"I cannot pass on the complementary Breathing Technique to you."
He sighed:
"Without the complementary Breathing Technique, the difficulty of learning the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques is beyond imagination!"
He pointed at himself:
"Even I, without the complementary Breathing Technique, would never master all the Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.
I might learn the first dozen axe techniques at most.
For, as it progresses, the Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques become more fierce and aggressive, harming the body excessively.
Without the Breathing Technique to balance it, forcing oneself might injure one’s organs, causing harm to oneself while defeating the enemy, which is too unprofitable."
Pan Feng continued to explain various details and origins of the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.
Ding Ling listened while slightly closing his eyes.
He had already finished examining the ancient bamboo scroll.
After closing his eyes.
In just a moment.
A new book appeared in the library, with flamboyant inscriptions on top: "Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques"!
Bang!
All sorts of incredible contents, essences, mysteries, roared into Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness, organs, and marrow, transforming into his instinct.
[Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques Full Level]
[Strength +2.4]
[Agility +1.6]
[Physique +2.4]
Crack!
The bones were crackling!
The organs were trembling!
Ding Ling’s physique was changing, his height increasing slightly with each cracking sound.
A mysterious force field began to change invisibly around him!
As if there were fierce whirlwinds swirling around him!
At this moment.
Ding Ling seemed like a Mountain God, an incredible aura surged from his body, even beginning to affect the outside void!
"This?!"
Pan Feng shut his mouth, looking at Ding Ling in utter disbelief, his eyes almost popping out:
"How, how, how is this possible?!"
"Can’t be?!
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, Cheng Huan were also bewildered:
"Impossible!
It hasn’t even been a quarter of an hour!
How could he have mastered it already?!
This is absolutely impossible!
It must be that Ding Ling, after accumulating so much, experienced some subtle changes in his body, there’s no way he mastered the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques in such a short time.
It’s just too brief!"
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan, who admired Pan Feng’s strength, had seen the first dozen moves of the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.
I have to admit.
It’s too difficult.
They tried and ended up giving up one by one, it’s simply not humanly possible to learn!
Besides, without the complementary Breathing Technique to restore the organs, even if learned, it’s hard to fully unleash the power of the Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques!
So why bother learning then?
But Ding Ling?
Without the Breathing Technique.
He actually mastered the Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques?!
Zhang Hex and the others stared intently at Ding Ling, their eyes full of amazement, perplexity, expectation, confusion, and incomprehension, experiencing a kaleidoscope of emotions!
Clang!
Ding Ling opened his eyes, and without a word, wielded the sharp axe, starting to demonstrate the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.
This time, he had gained several hundred pounds of strength, his physique stronger, endurance more lasting, breathing steady!
His agility, needless to say, was high.
This made the sixty-pound sharp axe feel like a toy in his hands, light as if it had no weight!
While performing the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, it was like he was performing magic, perfect to the point of astonishment!
All sorts of incredible moves were displayed by him one after another!
Each move seemed like thunderstrikes, like an antelope’s horns hanging, with no trace or pattern to follow!
Yet they all seemed crafted by gods, extraordinarily ingenious, leaving viewers bewildered, marveling at a Celestial Being!
Bang!
As the last axe technique struck the ground, with a reverberating sound, it directly cleaved a slender fissure four to five meters long into the earth!
Ding Ling exhaled deeply, sheathed the axe, and stood still.
Zhang Hex and the others suddenly woke up, either applauding, or in shock, or simply shouting praises and admiration:
"Absolutely incredible!
Is this the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques?!
I wouldn’t have thought they’d look so different in Ding Ling’s hands!"
"So strong.
Ding Ling can definitely be compared to a first-class general now!
How long has it been?
He’s grown to this extent, it’s defying fate!
Practically a War God descended to earth!"
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, Cheng Huan were awed, looking at Ding Ling as if looking at a freak or monster!
How could a normal person progress so much?

chapters.title: Chapter 16: E-level Achievement Medal
paragraphs: "Zhang Hex and the others are right."

Pan Feng also couldn’t help but commend, "Truly extraordinary, absolutely extraordinary. Even I didn’t learn it this quickly. You should know that back then, it was as if I was possessed by a deity, unconsciously mastering the accompanying Breathing Technique and then somehow muddling through the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques!"
He fixed his bright eyes on Ding Ling and said:

"But you’re different. You didn’t have the accompanying Breathing Technique. I didn’t even have time to guide you, yet you just looked at the illustrations and texts and within less than half a moment, comprehended and grasped the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques. This speed leaves me in awe and makes me feel inadequate."
He sighed:
"Genius, truly a genius. I, Pan Feng, have finally found the successor to the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques. Now I have no more regrets."
He looked at Zhang Hex and the other two, smiled and said:
"I keep my word; from now on, the three of you are my friends! Should anyone dare to bully you, just mention my name and say you’re under the protection of me, Pan Feng!"
Zhang Hex and the other two were overjoyed and hurriedly bowed in thanks.
Pan Feng waved his hand, indicating not to be so formal in the future, as they were all brothers and friends.
After a brief polite exchange.
Pan Feng turned his attention back to Ding Ling; he circled him a few times and couldn’t help but conduct a ’Bone Touching’ on Ding Ling just like Zhang Hex did.
It was at this moment.
The notification sound suddenly chimed.
[You’ve obtained an E-level Achievement Medal: You’ve received heartfelt admiration and praise from Jizhou’s Unrivaled Divine General, Pan Feng!]

[Note: 1: Your talent, comprehension, and learning ability have completely awed Pan Feng! He’s begun to explore why you’re so remarkable. He might even invite you to participate in blood extraction and other experiments!
Don’t doubt, this is someone even more zealous about the Martial Dao than Zhang Hex!
His dedication to the Martial Dao is beyond imagination! You need to be careful, don’t die. Because landing in Pan Feng’s hands might be worse than falling into Zhang Hex’s!]
[Note: 2: Achievement Medals are graded. Congratulations, you’ve obtained a graded medal. This will bring you numerous benefits.]
Ding Ling’s eyes slightly contracted.
He hadn’t expected Achievement Medals to have grades!
And judging by the notes, this Achievement Medal indeed has significant benefits, just unsure how to use it.
It seems everything will have to wait until he returns to Player Plaza to explore.
As for Pan Feng?
Ding Ling glanced at him, noticing his eyes glinting ’green light’ as he kept exploring him, causing Ding Ling to get goosebumps, making him involuntarily take a few steps back.

It seemed Pan Feng hadn’t figured it out yet; although his eyes showed varied emotions, his face grew increasingly puzzled. When he saw Ding Ling step back, he couldn’t help but step forward to further investigate.
Ding Ling retreated again.
Pan Feng advanced once more.
This continued several times.
Zhang Hex couldn’t help but cough a few times as a reminder.
Pan Feng snapped back to reality, awkwardly rubbing his hands and said with a forced smile:
"This is the first time I’ve seen a prodigy like you, Ding Ling. I’m very curious about how your bone structure is, so I might have been a bit intrusive earlier, I hope you don’t mind."
What bad could Ding Ling say?
He could only indicate it was fine.
Pan Feng felt relieved, then said with a puzzled look:
"Ding Ling, I just checked your bone structure, and it doesn’t seem unusual. How did you master the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques in such a short time?"
Swish, swish!
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan all turned to look at Ding Ling.
Especially Zhang Hex, his eyes filled with investigatory desire to the extreme at this moment.
He was dying to know the answer! Otherwise, he wouldn’t have done the same reckless thing as Pan Feng earlier.
"I don’t know either."
Ding Ling activated his full-level acting, appearing very bewildered and innocent:
"I seem to have been born this way."
As for the ’library’ cheats, Ding Ling planned to keep it to himself forever.
"Is that so?"
Pan Feng looked very disappointed, "That’s truly a pity."
It must be said.
Although Ding Ling’s full-level acting didn’t aid his strength improvement at all, it proved exceptionally effective when deployed at crucial moments.
Just like now, he had effortlessly deceived and placated Zhang Hex, Pan Feng, and the others.
It’s not that they lacked intelligence.
Rather, Ding Ling’s acting was just too convincing! Absolutely flawless, utterly natural!
This is the power of full-level acting!
If Ding Ling were to become an actor now, nine times out of ten, he would outshine ninety-nine percent of the stars, kings, and queens.
A bona fide talent!
"It seems it might not be related to bone structure."
Zhang Hex speculated:
"Perhaps it has to do with perception, meridians, internal organs, and so forth, which are beyond our current level of understanding.
"Perhaps so."
The group pondered for a while, but couldn’t figure it out.
Each looked at Ding Ling with increasingly peculiar expressions, as if gazing at a rare treasure.
Pan Feng was even more straightforward:

"Being able to execute the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques without the accompanying Breathing Technique is like inflicting a thousand wounds while enduring eight hundred of your own. How did you manage to perform the whole set of techniques without injury?"
"Once understood, it’s natural."
Ding Ling said it very naturally.
But these words felt like an arrow piercing Pan Feng’s heart, nearly shattering his pride and confidence.
His expression turned a bit unnatural.
Meanwhile, Zhang Hex and the others’ expressions became extremely vivid.
Each one seemed as if they were hit with a heavy blow.
But soon, they reasoned it out, Zhang Hex and Gao Lan even thought to themselves:

"Individuals like Ding Ling are world-rare, maybe even unique to this era! Truly the chosen one! Such a prodigy is rarely seen in a millennium; while I might also be a genius, there are others who can match my talent.
For instance, Zhang Hex (Gao Lan) is on par with me, not to mention General Pan Feng, Jiuyuan Lü Bu, and the like!
Therefore, there is no need to compare myself to an anomaly like Ding Ling.
Otherwise, I would be left with no self-confidence. In the future, no matter what outrageous event happens to him,
just take it lightly."
Thinking this way.
Gao Lan and Zhang Hex finally let go and stopped dwelling on how Ding Ling managed to learn the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques in such a short time.
Some time later.
Pan Feng brought Ding Ling, Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan to meet Governor of Jizhou Hann Fu.
Hann Fu usually resided in the exclusive mansion of the Governor of Jizhou.
The opulence of the mansion was the first time Ding Ling had witnessed how affluent individuals of ancient times lived!
To say the least, it was extravagance at its peak.
Many of the decorations and installations in the outer courtyard were things Ding Ling was seeing for the first time.
He was an ordinary person in his past life.
And remains so in this life.
Though he now had the library cheats, he had only obtained it a few days ago?
