chapters.title: Chapter 17: Governor of Jizhou Han Fu
paragraphs: Ding Ling is still very poor.
His experiences remain stuck in the past.
So the first time he saw the extravagant life of the ancients, he couldn’t help but secretly click his tongue.
So corrupt!
However, he sort of liked it.
Which man doesn’t like to indulge? Who doesn’t want to be drunk in the lap of beauty, waking to wield power over the world?
Ding Ling is a man, he is no exception.

But he also knows that now is not the time to indulge; he must push forward and break through the different game planes, waiting for his strength to become supreme, and his status will naturally reach the top.
By then, what enjoyment or joy wouldn’t he have?
If he indulges prematurely now, he is likely to be overtaken in the curve by others who have had fortuitous encounters!
Besides.
Who knows how many years this game world will last, if one day it mysteriously disappears just as mysteriously as it comes, where else would he find such a cultivation holy land?
Ding Ling knows what is important and will not be dazzled by the luxury before him.
On the contrary.
His mind grows increasingly clear.
For, at this moment, he already has a very clear goal: to break through the game planes and become the number one in both the game and the real world!
"Ding Ling, come here quickly."
Zhang Hex waved to Ding Ling standing at the door, a joyful expression on his face.
Not long ago.
Pan Feng took Zhang Hex and the other three to meet Hann Fu first.
Looking at Zhang Hex’s expression now, it was no surprise that he must have been promoted!
Though Hann Fu lacks great talent, he trusts Pan Feng greatly, handing over almost all military affairs of Jizhou to Pan Feng.
With Pan Feng’s help, it would be difficult for Zhang Hex and Gao Lan not to get promoted.
Ding Ling came here naturally for promotion and title too.
In such matters, Ding Ling had no reason to refuse.
After promotion.
The resources he can access will further increase, and he will be able to interact with more experts.
Otherwise, with nothing and as a civilian, how could he reach people of unusual standing?

Ding Ling also prepares to engage with Xuu Chu, Dian Wei, Cao Mengde, Lü Bu, Zhao Zilong, Zhang Zhongjing, and others, and naturally he needs some status, otherwise it would be truly difficult to approach them.
Tock tock!
Ding Ling quickly stepped forward, grabbed by Zhang Hex, and escorted to the main hall of the mansion.
After walking for a while.
Arriving at the main hall, Zhang Hex gestured to indicate that the person sitting at the head was Hann Fu, and Ding Ling could pay his respects.
Ding Ling then paid his respects.
Hann Fu nodded, scrutinizing Ding Ling up and down for a while before suddenly saying:
"Although General Pan Feng and others say you have extraordinary talent, rare in the world, I still don’t believe there could be anyone more talented than General Pan Feng."
He was tall, broad-bodied, and looked elegant, with three strips of long beard beneath his chin, quite a dignified person.
But at this moment, he frowned while examining Ding Ling, as if he were looking at a penniless, rustic person!
It’s clear that he doesn’t favor Ding Ling as a mere soldier.
If it weren’t for Pan Feng speaking for Ding Ling.
Ding Ling might not even have the qualifications to stand in front of him.
Seeing this, Ding Ling was speechless, understanding fully why Hann Fu later had the talents turn against him.
Compared to Zhang Hex and others, this Governor of Jizhou, Hann Fu, is too arrogant, too oppressive of others with his influence, looking down on people like a dog with a lowly eye!
That condescending look, as if regarding lower class people, made Ding Ling very uncomfortable!
In contrast to Cao Mengde’s unrestrictive ways of employing talents.
Hann Fu clearly belongs to the classical type that values family lineage; Ding Ling is a player, an alien in the NPC’s eyes, with no background, so how could he catch Hann Fu’s eye?
Nonetheless.
Ding Ling doesn’t mind about it.
Jizhou is merely a stepping stone.
Originally, he was worried that leaving Jizhou after gaining so many benefits would be disloyal, but seeing Hann Fu’s behavior now, he was relieved.
What he owes is Cheng Huan, Zhang Hex, and others’ guidance and help, so even if he repays favors, it will be to Cheng Huan and others; there’s no need to bother with Hann Fu.
"Lord."
Pan Feng was somewhat anxious, taking a step forward, and solemnly said:
"This matter is absolutely true. If you don’t believe it, watch Ding Ling perform a set of the exclusive Axe Technique and you will know."
"Alright."
Hann Fu reluctantly nodded.
Ding Ling’s eyes twitched, nearly unable to help himself from leaving in a huff.
Somehow he held back.
Consoling himself with the thought that Jizhou is a stepping stone, and he’ll leave once his status is elevated.
"Ding Ling, give it a try."
Pan Feng signaled with his eyes to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was straightforward too, wielding a sixty-pound sharp axe, performing the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques directly.
This Celestial Spirit Axe Technique was fierce and sharp to the extreme.
The first three moves were none other than Split Head, Ghost Tooth-Picking, and Ear Picking!
These three moves were deadly, each extremely exquisite.
But they were the simplest three moves of the thirty-six axe techniques!
The other thirty-three moves surpass one another.
By the end, it resembled an axe god swinging the dry and wet, a booming sound erupted, as if splitting thunder and wind out of thin air!
"Hmm?!"
Hann Fu couldn’t help but pay attention.
The slack and arrogance on his face receded a lot, and his gaze at Ding Ling carried a hint of surprise.
After watching Ding Ling finish a set of axe techniques, seeing him with neither flushed face nor short breath, Hann Fu was more shaken, saying outright:
"To my knowledge, these Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques must be accompanied by the Breathing Technique to learn in full. How did Ding Ling learn them?"
Pan Feng stepped out and explained for a while.
Hann Fu grew more puzzled and perplexed while listening, then turned to Ding Ling, stroked the three strips of long beard beneath his chin, and after a while said:
"You were only a new recruit who just entered the camp half a day ago. To promote you rashly does not conform to reason, law, or principle."
"Lord!"
Pan Feng couldn’t help but want to persuade.
Hann Fu gestured to Pan Feng not to say more:
"Zhang Hex and Gao Lan received promotions, that’s because they excelled in skills and have already proved themselves. Ding Ling, you must show the world your abilities too."
He pondered for a while, then said:
"Here’s the thing. Recently, a wave of bandits came near Zhongqiu in the Zhao Kingdom, you go retrieve the head of the bandit leader, and I’ll promote you immediately."
Ding Ling was speechless.
Let him single-handedly kill the bandit leader?
Though he isn’t afraid, neither is there a need to take risks.
He needs to preserve himself to learn more martial arts knowledge.
He doesn’t know if dying would cause a loss of levels, stripping him of all his martial skills, so this cannot be casually tested.
And somehow Ding Ling has a feeling that once dead, it might be extremely troublesome in the future!
So if he can avoid death, it’s best not to die!
Thinking this, Ding Ling decided: better leave Jizhou for other places after departing from this government office.
He can currently rival first-class experts.
His martial power is quite remarkable, wandering alone in the wild, he fears neither beasts nor vagrants and bandits!
After some time.
Pan Feng returned to the central army tent with Ding Ling and others, gathering officers, publicly announcing Zhang Hex and others’ appointments, and assigning Ding Ling as the Military Marquis...

Ding Ling doesn’t mind about it.
Jizhou is merely a stepping stone.
Originally, he was worried that leaving Jizhou after gaining so many benefits would be disloyal, but seeing Hann Fu’s behavior now, he was relieved.
What he owes is Cheng Huan, Zhang Hex, and others’ guidance and help, so even if he repays favors, it will be to Cheng Huan and others; there’s no need to bother with Hann Fu.
"Lord."
Pan Feng was somewhat anxious, taking a step forward, and solemnly said:
"This matter is absolutely true.
If you don’t believe it, watch Ding Ling perform a set of the exclusive Axe Technique and you will know."
"Alright."
Hann Fu reluctantly nodded.
Ding Ling’s eyes twitched, nearly unable to help himself from leaving in a huff.
Somehow he held back.
Consoling himself with the thought that Jizhou is a stepping stone, and he’ll leave once his status is elevated.
"Ding Ling, give it a try."
Pan Feng signaled with his eyes to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling was straightforward too, wielding a sixty-pound sharp axe, performing the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques directly.
This Celestial Spirit Axe Technique was fierce and sharp to the extreme.
The first three moves were none other than Split Head, Ghost Tooth-Picking, and Ear Picking!
These three moves were deadly, each extremely exquisite.
But they were the simplest three moves of the thirty-six axe techniques!
The other thirty-three moves surpass one another.
By the end, it resembled an axe god swinging the dry and wet, a booming sound erupted, as if splitting thunder and wind out of thin air!
"Hmm?!"
Hann Fu couldn’t help but pay attention.
The slack and arrogance on his face receded a lot, and his gaze at Ding Ling carried a hint of surprise.
After watching Ding Ling finish a set of axe techniques, seeing him with neither flushed face nor short breath, Hann Fu was more shaken, saying outright:
"To my knowledge, these Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques must be accompanied by the Breathing Technique to learn in full.
How did Ding Ling learn them?"
Pan Feng stepped out and explained for a while.
Hann Fu grew more puzzled and perplexed while listening, then turned to Ding Ling, stroked the three strips of long beard beneath his chin, and after a while said:
"You were only a new recruit who just entered the camp half a day ago.
To promote you rashly does not conform to reason, law, or principle."
"Lord!"
Pan Feng couldn’t help but want to persuade.
Hann Fu gestured to Pan Feng not to say more:
"Zhang Hex and Gao Lan received promotions, that’s because they excelled in skills and have already proved themselves.
Ding Ling, you must show the world your abilities too."
He pondered for a while, then said:
"Here’s the thing.
Recently, a wave of bandits came near Zhongqiu in the Zhao Kingdom, you go retrieve the head of the bandit leader, and I’ll promote you immediately."
Ding Ling was speechless.
Let him single-handedly kill the bandit leader?
Though he isn’t afraid, neither is there a need to take risks.
He needs to preserve himself to learn more martial arts knowledge.
He doesn’t know if dying would cause a loss of levels, stripping him of all his martial skills, so this cannot be casually tested.
And somehow Ding Ling has a feeling that once dead, it might be extremely troublesome in the future!
So if he can avoid death, it’s best not to die!
Thinking this, Ding Ling decided: better leave Jizhou for other places after departing from this government office.
He can currently rival first-class experts.
His martial power is quite remarkable, wandering alone in the wild, he fears neither beasts nor vagrants and bandits!
After some time.
Pan Feng returned to the central army tent with Ding Ling and others, gathering officers, publicly announcing Zhang Hex and others’ appointments, and assigning Ding Ling as the Military Marquis...

chapters.title: Chapter 18: The Military Marquis’s New Equipment
paragraphs: Ding Ling is appointed as the Military Marquis, commanding four hundred elite troops to Zhongqiu in Zhao Kingdom to suppress bandits!
Ding Ling looked up at Pan Feng in astonishment.
Pan Feng nodded with a smile, indicating that Ding Ling need not doubt.
Under the watchful eyes of everyone, Ding Ling couldn’t openly question at this time and just had to suppress the confusion in his heart.
[Achievement Medal Received: You have become the Military Marquis of Jizhou camp.]

[Note: This is the result of Pan Feng advocating for you against all odds! His sudden promotion of you carries a certain risk. But he believes you have this capability and from his heart confirms that you won’t fail to fulfill his great expectations.]
At that moment, a prompt sound suddenly rang out.
Made Ding Ling seem to understand something again.
He took a long breath.
He truly didn’t expect that becoming a Military Marquis could also earn an Achievement Medal.
What about becoming a Village Chief or Military Captain then?
These two ranks are smaller than Military Marquis, whether it can be achieved, Ding Ling was also uncertain.
However, becoming an official could actually earn an Achievement Medal.
Ding Ling naturally had no reason to refuse.
After a period of time.
Some official looked at Ding Ling with strange expressions, eyes filled with scrutiny, jealousy, envy!
They sighed and then slowly left.
When there were only Zhang Hex and a few others left in the big tent.
Pan Feng said:
"Ding Ling, I promote you to Military Marquis, because I believe you have the capability."
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan nodded involuntarily, clearly agreeing with these words.
"But General, that Governor of Jizhou..."
Ding Ling hesitated.
"Rest assured."
Pan Feng made a decision and laughed heartily:

"I am in charge of the Jizhou military affairs. Earlier, taking you to meet the Master was just hoping you leave a good impression on him. It was truly regrettable that he didn’t promote you on the spot."
Pan Feng glanced at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling called him Governor of Jizhou, obviously not recognizing Hann Fu.
He also understood Hann Fu’s shortcomings, his heart tightened as well.
A genius like Ding Ling couldn’t be let go easily!

With this thought in mind, he completely disregarded Hann Fu’s opinions and directly appointed Ding Ling as the Military Marquis on the spot. Being the absolute commander of Jizhou camp, he had this right and qualification.
"You should return quickly. Believe that some mere bandits will surely be easily defeated by you.
He took new armor, weapons, and a seal representing Military Marquis from the side and solemnly handed them to Ding Ling:
"Ding Ling, don’t let me down!"
"Don’t worry, General."
Ding Ling solemnly responded.
Half an hour later.
Ding Ling, due to rapid advancement, was once again hungry and then had a full meal of a bull.
Under the amazed expressions of Cheng Huan, Gao Lan, and others.
He donned General Armor, holding an eighty-pound Heaven-piercing Halberd, appeared on the battlefield.
He scanned the whole field.
A total of four hundred elite soldiers.
Each one was energetic, spirited.
Their bodies were robust, strong, and tall, each holding a heavy machete, clearly extraordinary soldiers.
Especially some Village Chiefs and Military Captains among them, wearing different General Armor from ordinary soldiers, appearing outstanding, majestic.
"Salute to Military Marquis!"
All four hundred people saluted Ding Ling.
The sound shook the void in all directions.
Ding Ling’s body trembled, pupils slightly expanded, for the first time feeling the blood and heroism.
His heart couldn’t help but accelerate and beat faster.
The manifestation of excitement and exhilaration:
"Indeed, every man has a General dream in his heart. I am no exception!"

Thinking thus, Ding Ling followed the process, spoke a few words, then holding the Heaven-piercing Halberd, easily leaped onto a strong horse, tugged the reins, amidst the horse’s neighing, a clear shout, drove the horse ahead like lightning, darting out of the camp.
He had read books in the real world like ’Equestrian Skill’, ’How to Ride a Horse’, ’Equestrian Skill and Upgrade’ etc.
It can be said.
His equestrian skills have already reached Full Level!
Finding someone with better equestrian skills than him is very difficult!
Therefore, even though he had never ridden a horse, once he landed on horseback, it seemed as though he and the strong horse fit together, easily controlled the horse, achieving perfect sync.
This scene fell in the eyes of Zhang Hex and others, praised involuntarily:
"This equestrian skill is indeed remarkable! Today’s world, afraid it’s hard to find someone at par!"
"Unexpectedly Ding Ling’s equestrian skill is so strong, earlier I was worried he could not handle this strong horse, seems it was overthinking."
Pan Feng felt gratified:
"This Ding Ling is indeed a born candidate for a General, his potential is not limited to this. If he returns successfully this time, I will persuade the Master to promote him again."
Zhang Hex and others were speechless.
But thinking about Ding Ling’s talent and strength, they felt at ease.
"I have an old acquaintance with Tong Yuan."
Pan Feng explained:
"Even if promoting, I will just temporarily promote Ding Ling to a local Military Officer in Changshan County."
"General wants Ding Ling to follow Tong Yuan and learn martial arts?"
Zhang Hex glanced sideways.
"Correct."
Pan Feng nodded and smiled:

"My Breathing Technique is divine and clear, fundamentally cannot be passed on to others. And your Breathing Technique is family Secret Technique, not easily passed on to outsiders. Thus can only find a worldly master to teach Ding Ling the Breathing Technique. And the only master I know is Tong Yuan, he is most selfless and generous. As long as he selects a disciple, he will teach everything!"
He spoke very confidently:
"I believe Ding Ling has the qualification to be selected by Tong Yuan!"
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan nodded involuntarily, a genius like Ding Ling, Tong Yuan wouldn’t select him? Impossible!
Other generals just felt amazed but didn’t understand.
But seeing Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan all endorsing Ding Ling, they couldn’t help but secretly prepare to make connections once Ding Ling returns victorious.
The matter of Ding Ling becoming a Military Marquis was not covered up.
Among his four hundred elite soldiers, there were several players.
However, these players were too surprised and didn’t have time to deliver messages to others.
Although so.
But there were quite a few players present who saw Ding Ling driving the horse, leading the troops.
Soon.
This matter spread throughout the Jizhou camp.
All players were dumbfounded, and then buzzed:
"In less than a day, Ding Ling went from an unknown soldier to a Military Marquis! This damn is practically a fairy tale!"
"The first time hearing such an absurd thing, if not seen with my own eyes, who would believe it!"

"This guy Ding Ling must be a master in reality, and definitely an old player. Look at his skilled horseback riding! Does a normal family have the leisure and money to train such an equestrian master?!"
Players glanced wagging.
And some who went offline and then logged in again even exposed the matter of Ding Ling ranking first on the comprehensive list, and he’s still a rookie!
Like a depth charge thrown into a fish pond, boom!

chapters.title: Chapter 19: Instant Kill of the Bandit Chief
paragraphs: The entire camp erupted!
All the players felt incredulous.
"Seriously?! Ding Ling is actually a newcomer player?!"

"This is practically a joke! How could Ding Ling be a newcomer player! I saw with my own eyes that his saber technique was extremely fierce and swift! Ordinary third-class generals are far inferior. Could a newcomer be this formidable?!"
"Exactly. How could anyone believe such outlandish nonsense!"
Even though some players were adamant, claiming they witnessed firsthand that the one topping the ranking was Ding Ling.
But some players who had seen Ding Ling’s prowess still didn’t believe it.
"If you don’t believe, why not take some time to check out the Player Plaza?"
Players who vouched for Ding Ling were getting anxious:
"Once you see, you’ll know the truth!"
"Hmph, I’ll surely check. But now is the best time for training, logging off and on again is too much hassle. Sooner or later we’ll know if what you said is true or false!"
Ding Ling carefully examined a map.
In the real world, he had thoroughly studied various geographical knowledge; now, he was a Master of Geography!
Just give him a map, and he could identify the terrain, the topography.
He absolutely wouldn’t get lost!
Just like at this moment.
Had it been before, Ding Ling would have certainly gotten himself turned around!
Because he was just an ordinary person, not a directionally challenged one, but definitely unable to ’auto-navigate’ in the vast mountain ranges!
But that’s not the case now.
He could compare the map and accurately find the correct route ahead.
Regarding this, Ding Ling couldn’t help but sigh:
’Even though many skills in the real world seem redundant. But at critical moments, they have amazing effects. It seems necessary to log off and scour the internet for some skills to learn.’
Ding Ling’s library was quite magical.
As long as there were specific knowledge points and skills, it could condense into a book, and then instantly full level.
That’s why the library and the internet were Ding Ling’s skill learning grounds.
A few hours later.
"General, up ahead is Zhongqiu of Zhao Kingdom!"
A scout rushed to Ding Ling, dismounted swiftly, and reported the military situation.
General...
Ding Ling glanced at the scout, this guy was smart. Most likely ten-to-one was a player.
Because this scout looked at him differently than other NPCs, and occasionally uttered modern trendy language, making it hard not to notice.
’Surely an experienced player.’
Thinking this, Ding Ling nodded and commanded loudly:
"Take a quarter-hour rest here, then proceed to raid the bandits immediately."
"Yes, General!"
Four hundred elite troops responded in unison.
They were all cavalry.
All carried swords on their waists, bows on their backs, and long spears in hand!
Additionally, each horse had a large saber hung on its side!
All high-grade equipment!
It’s undeniable that Pan Feng treated Ding Ling quite well!
Such high-end elite troops were definitely not common in the Jizhou camp.
"This guy looks competent enough, but is he truly skilled, or just a silver-like spear?"
A few seasoned players gathered to rest and discussed quietly:
"They say he has high skills, so he should be truly skilled!"
"Not necessarily. He could just be a poser?"

"We’ll soon find out. However, if he turns out to be mediocre, it would be a huge embarrassment. Not only would he be embarrassed, but so would Pan Feng! It was his strong recommendation that got Ding Ling rapidly promoted to the Military Marquis position from a rookie..."
Ding Ling’s strength had now impressively reached over nine hundred pounds!
His agility and physique were also extremely high values!
At this stage for him.
Sharp hearing and clear sight were considered foundational.
He vaguely heard some people’s critical remarks about him.
But he didn’t mind; he just twirled the Heaven-piercing Halberd a few times, and once he confirmed he could master this halberd perfectly, he was reassured.
Along the way, to achieve seamless integration with this Heaven-piercing Halberd, Ding Ling would occasionally practice wielding and swinging it.
After several hours, he was capable of using this halberd freely.
With techniques in staff, saber, spear, and even axe, he could all utilize with the Heaven-piercing Halberd.
Because he could wield multiple weapons, at his request,
Pan Feng went to Jizhou Prefecture’s arsenal to fetch a sealed-for-years Divine Weapon halberd!
Compared with other weapons.
This halberd indeed was extraordinary, comparable to a Divine Weapon!
Not only was its weight remarkable.
Its sharpness, durability, and flexibility far exceeded the previous sabers, spears, and axes!
Ding Ling was immensely satisfied with this weapon, or else he wouldn’t have cooperated to head to Zhongqiu to suppress the bandits.
Having received so many benefits from Pan Feng, and also gaining an Achievement Medal, how could he not give Pan Feng some face?
Ding Ling was unaware that Pan Feng was planning to promote him to go to Changshan to train with Tong Yuan.
Otherwise, his enthusiasm would surely be higher.
A quarter-hour later.
"Set off!"
Ding Ling shouted loudly.
The four hundred elite cavalry swiftly mounted their horses, wielding spears and following Ding Ling to Zhongqiu.
The journey didn’t even last half an hour.
Shouts of battle came from afar.
"Hahaha, kill them all!"
"Don’t spare a single man! Leave the women for me!"
That rough voice.
Those wild words!
That familiar, cliched ’villain’ dialogue!
Along with the brutal sounds of battle blasting into their ears!
Ding Ling was taken aback by the ’villains’ talking so crudely, furrowing his brow as he looked towards the source of the noise.
Only to see ahead on the main road, a group of men with partial armor wielding sabers and spears attacking a group of men who were obviously guards.
"General."
The scout came forward to report:
"These bandits are likely the marauders we’re supposed to find!"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling’s eyes lit up. Finding bandits this easily? How could he let such a chance slip?
Kill them and return to Ye City to report!
With this thought, Ding Ling twirled his halberd and led the charge against the men.
Their group of bandits wasn’t numerous, only about a hundred.
Ding Ling’s troops charged in full force, utterly unabashed.
These bandits were fiercely and excitedly fighting but noticed the anomaly quickly. Seeing Ding Ling’s group outnumbered them and fully armed, they panicked!
They halted and retreated, looking towards their leader.
"What a pity, so close!"
The leader of the bandits cast a longing look at the few beauties on the carriage.
Unwillingly, he waved his hand:
"Brothers, retreat!"
Swish!
The group of a hundred dispersed in chaos.
All of Ding Ling’s four hundred riders were mounted, fearless, and split to pursue.

The swift horse beneath Ding Ling chased after the bandit leader, whose steed was a drab horse, slow. Ding Ling soon caught up, raised his halberd, and with a casual strike, knocked him off the horse.
The bandit leader didn’t even have time to cry out or plead before dying on the spot!
The other bandits who intended to gang up on Ding Ling were so frightened; they shouted in panic and ran even faster.
Ding Ling pursued on horseback, continuously spearing down several men, and seeing others had fled far, lost interest in chasing. He commanded someone to collect the bandit leader’s head.
He then pondered to himself:
"My first time on the battlefield, I initially thought there’d be intense discomfort. But now it seems while there is discomfort, it isn’t as intense."
Ultimately, the gap between them was too vast.
The bandit leader wasn’t even as good as a third-class general.
He was instantly killed by Ding Ling!
Ding Ling didn’t even have time to showcase his skills!

"Set off!"
Ding Ling shouted loudly.
The four hundred elite cavalry swiftly mounted their horses, wielding spears and following Ding Ling to Zhongqiu.
The journey didn’t even last half an hour.
Shouts of battle came from afar.
"Hahaha, kill them all!"
"Don’t spare a single man!
Leave the women for me!"
That rough voice.
Those wild words!
That familiar, cliched ’villain’ dialogue!
Along with the brutal sounds of battle blasting into their ears!
Ding Ling was taken aback by the ’villains’ talking so crudely, furrowing his brow as he looked towards the source of the noise.
Only to see ahead on the main road, a group of men with partial armor wielding sabers and spears attacking a group of men who were obviously guards.
"General."
The scout came forward to report:
"These bandits are likely the marauders we’re supposed to find!"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling’s eyes lit up.
Finding bandits this easily?
How could he let such a chance slip?
Kill them and return to Ye City to report!
With this thought, Ding Ling twirled his halberd and led the charge against the men.
Their group of bandits wasn’t numerous, only about a hundred.
Ding Ling’s troops charged in full force, utterly unabashed.
These bandits were fiercely and excitedly fighting but noticed the anomaly quickly.
Seeing Ding Ling’s group outnumbered them and fully armed, they panicked!
They halted and retreated, looking towards their leader.
"What a pity, so close!"
The leader of the bandits cast a longing look at the few beauties on the carriage.
Unwillingly, he waved his hand:
"Brothers, retreat!"
Swish!
The group of a hundred dispersed in chaos.
All of Ding Ling’s four hundred riders were mounted, fearless, and split to pursue.
The swift horse beneath Ding Ling chased after the bandit leader, whose steed was a drab horse, slow.
Ding Ling soon caught up, raised his halberd, and with a casual strike, knocked him off the horse.
The bandit leader didn’t even have time to cry out or plead before dying on the spot!
The other bandits who intended to gang up on Ding Ling were so frightened; they shouted in panic and ran even faster.
Ding Ling pursued on horseback, continuously spearing down several men, and seeing others had fled far, lost interest in chasing.
He commanded someone to collect the bandit leader’s head.
He then pondered to himself:
"My first time on the battlefield, I initially thought there’d be intense discomfort.
But now it seems while there is discomfort, it isn’t as intense."
Ultimately, the gap between them was too vast.
The bandit leader wasn’t even as good as a third-class general.
He was instantly killed by Ding Ling!
Ding Ling didn’t even have time to showcase his skills!

chapters.title: Chapter 20: The Eldest Daughter of the Zhen Family
paragraphs: What?
How could he feel such intense discomfort?
Two sources of discomfort:
When he stabbed the bandit, at that moment the blood spurting out.
And the head, cut down and hanging to the side, gruesome and bloody, making one feel disgusted and terrified.
But perhaps due to his terrifyingly enhanced physical fitness, and a body filled with martial power, after the discomfort, Ding Ling felt his blood boiling.
"This was just a minor trial."
Ding Ling forced himself to suppress the impulse in his heart, tugged at the reins, and sped the sturdy horse toward the direction of the main road.
Not long after.
Upon reaching the main road.
Ding Ling saw a beautiful young girl standing by a carriage.
This young girl was clearly the leader of the group.
More than a dozen bloodstained guards stood respectfully aside.
And some other servants, similarly.
Only the girl stood straight, evidently a well-raised noblewoman, with a distinctly captivating aura.
Seeing Ding Ling approaching.
The young girl’s almond eyes shimmered slightly like autumn waters.
She stepped forward to salute Ding Ling: "Greetings, General."
Ding Ling nodded, without saying much, simply signaling the scouts to call back the others.
The scout now looked at Ding Ling with a hint of amazement, obediently went off.
The scout was an old player.
Having played this game for nearly a month.
Considered somewhat talented, coupled with Zhang Hex’s direct guidance, his progress was impressive, and his abilities not to be underestimated.
Originally, he felt a bit proud.
But today, having seen Ding Ling kill the bandit leader effortlessly and naturally, he was utterly convinced, thinking as he walked:
"Who knows where this Ding Ling came from. His strength is simply absurd."
Through his observation.

That bandit leader was definitely close to a third-class general, but Ding Ling killed him as easily as slicing a chicken. Considering Ding Ling seemed unsatisfied, clearly, he hadn’t used his full strength, not yet content!
’What a freak!’
The scout sighed:
"This guy is definitely the next Kong Tianhua!"
Kong Tianhua is now ranked first in the player power rankings! A truly fierce individual!
Not only because he was strong in the real world, but because he encountered a reclusive master in the game, passing on a set of unparalleled divine skills!
And Ding Ling?
Just stayed in the Jizhou camp for less than a day to be this fierce?
"It couldn’t be! He definitely is a beta player too!"
The scout was certain:
"Just don’t know what his ranking is among beta players? Why hadn’t I seen him on the power, agility, or physique rankings before?!"
"General."
The young girl bit her lip, seemingly hesitant, but still tearfully pleaded:
"I have a request."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling turned:
"Speak freely."
If he could help easily, he would, but for anything beyond his ability or too difficult, Ding Ling definitely wouldn’t.
Though he liked beauties.
But not a shameless dog!
If otherwise, he wouldn’t have readily agreed when his girlfriend requested to break up in this life.

"...The Bai Bo bandits suddenly broke into Zhongqiu City, many and ruthless, engaging in slaughter. My father and others personally stayed behind to aid my escape, upon reflection they must be, must be..."
The young girl explained in detail, speaking until she was extremely sorrowful, unable to speak through tears.
Ding Ling’s heart tightened.
Bai Bo bandits?
He recalled.
Guo Tai, Li Le, Hann Xian, Hu Cai were the leaders of the Bai Bo Army.
And Yang Feng seemed to have close ties with the Bai Bo Army, having joined them.
These people Ding Ling wasn’t afraid of.
He was concerned about Xu Huang beside Yang Feng!
One of the famous future Five Generals! A renowned general of Cao Wei!

’I was puzzled why the bandits were so few? Why would they need reinforcements. Just some township troops would easily resolve them. How could it shock Governor of Jizhou Hann Fu?! Now it seems, I might have only killed some minor figures.’
This time, Ding Ling came precisely for bandit extermination.
And now it seems.
The bandits he was to eliminate were nine out of ten Bai Bo bandits.
But the Bai Bo bandits were formidable.
How could mere four hundred men handle it?
Ding Ling frowned, pondering.
The young girl saw this and misunderstood, thinking Ding Ling was unwilling, causing her sorrow to grow even more.
Hearing the low sobs, Ding Ling turned, seeing it was indeed her, casually said:
"Rest assured, once I summon the troops, we’ll charge towards Zhongqiu, try to save as many people as possible, but I’m not sure if I can save your father."
"Thank you, General."
The young girl cried tears of joy, quickly bowing.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Received great gratitude from Zhen Jiang, eldest daughter of Jizhou’s richest Zhen Family!]
[Note: Zhen Jiang is known for being grateful, courteous, and loyal. She always felt grateful to you. Now that you express your intent to rescue her father, her heart is profoundly touched.]
Undoubtedly. If you save her father, she’ll likely offer herself to you.]
Ding Ling was slightly startled; he hadn’t expected the woman he casually chose to save was Zhen Jiang!
This storyline seemed off.
According to Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Zhen Jiang shouldn’t appear here at this time.
But quickly, considering the vast influx of players knowing the Three Kingdoms storyline, Ding Ling understood.
Needless to say.
The Three Kingdoms narrative is surely collapsing now!
No one knows the future path.
However...
Will this Zhen Jiang truly offer herself?
Ding Ling’s heart pounded, he couldn’t help but glance twice at Zhen Jiang, the more he looked, the brighter his eyes became.
’Bright eyes and graceful gestures. Initially just an ordinary pretty girl, yet now growing more beautiful the more I see. Like fine wine, growing more flavorful with each taste!’
’A rare, inner-charming lady indeed!’
Ding Ling noticed Zhen Jiang’s shyness, aware of her noticing him staring.
Ding Ling coughed awkwardly, turned his head away.
He silently chanted ’Mind is void, void is color’ several times.
Finally feeling calm.
The time for indulgence and recklessness is not now!
He hadn’t forgotten his goal: conquer all levels before enjoying!
Clip-clop!
Neigh!
Horse cries kept echoing.
It was those four hundred elite cavalry returning, many had a head hanging from their horse’s side.
These were their spoils.
Clearly, that small wave of bandits posed no threat to these elites.
Ding Ling had Zhen Jiang and the guards hide in the dense forest.
He, meanwhile, led the four hundred elite cavalry like a torrent charging towards Zhongqiu City.
Ding Ling also figured it out!
He was akin to a first-class general now.
And skilled with weapons such as knives, staffs, spears, axes!
He also had the full-level Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques as his trump card!
No reason for cowardice!
Remember, he’s leading four hundred elite cavalry, win if they can, flee if they can’t?
First, go and test the Bai Bo bandits’ caliber!

chapters.title: Chapter 21: Bandits Bai Bo Occupy the Ancient City
paragraphs: Zhongqiu Ancient City.
Guo Tai was seated at the County Magistrate’s position in the County Government Office.
Beneath him, on both sides, sat more than ten burly and rugged men.
These men were devouring meat and drinking wine in large cups, while continuously staring at the group of dancing girls in the center, with a ravenous gleam in their eyes.
Some of the men were already eager and impatient.
If not for Guo Tai keeping the scene under control, it might have turned chaotic long ago.
Guo Tai’s heart was like a mirror, picking up the summary booklet beside him and reading it; the more he read, the more satisfied he became, stroking his bristles, he thought:
"These grains, fabrics, gold and silver—aren’t they enough for our Great Army’s use for a year?"
He was extremely satisfied:

"Rumor has it the Zhen Family is wealthy, and indeed it’s not false. Just the goods they left in Zhongqiu are enough to cover my Great Army’s expenses for eight months. A portion of a family’s goods is comparable to a city! No, actually, it exceeds a city’s treasury!"
He contemplated for a moment and then ordered someone to bring Zhen Yi up.
Zhen Yi was an extraordinarily handsome and elegant middle-aged man.
But at this moment, he was pulled roughly into the County Government Office’s main hall by a soldier, his body bruised.
The dancing girls screamed in fright and were pulled aside by the laughing burly men.
Guo Tai ignored the weeping dancers, fixating his gaze on Zhen Yi and said:
"Zhen Yi, have you considered my offer? Just agree to my demands, and I can let you go immediately. Otherwise, we’re enemies. Someday, I might just raid your lair and take your wife and children."
Zhen Yi dared not voice his anger, merely hanging his head slightly, remaining silent.
"Really a tough guy."
Guo Tai felt it was tricky, but more so he was impatient and angry:
"If it weren’t for the few benefits you offer, I’d have sliced you up by now!"
He waved his hand:
"Take him down, find a way to make him agree!"
"Yes, General!"
The soldiers dragged Zhen Yi away.
Guo Tai frowned, pondering, when suddenly a hastily loud shout startled him.
"Report!"
A messenger suddenly barged into the main hall.
Guo Tai’s brows furrowed into a tight line, his eyes sharp as he looked at the messenger:
"What exactly happened?"
"Reporting to General."
The messenger was deferential:
"There’s someone outside the city clamoring for a duel with the generals."
"A duel with us?"
One burly man laughed loudly:
"A bold move, does he even know who we are?"
"The person knows."
The messenger replied truthfully:
"He called us a bunch of cowardly bears! Only knowing how to bully the people, cowards, rats, thieves, and vile men!"
"What?!"
Guo Tai’s brows stood up like knives: "He said what else?"
The elderly hate being called old.
The disabled are sensitive when called crippled.
Similarly, being bandits, they are infuriated when called rats, dog thieves!
"He also said the generals are emasculated women! Not daring to duel him at all!"
"Hahaha..."
Guo Tai laughed angrily, slamming the table:
"Our Bai Bo Army runs rampant across Jizhou and Bingzhou, even children stop crying at our name. Yet an ignorant wretch dares to belittle us. What should we do, you say?"
He glanced at the people below.
"Naturally, we should slaughter him."
One burly man pounded his breast and stood up, loudly shouted:
"General, why use a bull’s knife to kill a chicken? Let me, Hu Cai, meet him!"
"Better I go."
Another brawny man stood up, laughing:
"Just a petty thief! Dare come here spouting nonsense. I’ll sever his head and make it a urinal! To let the world know the consequences of offending us Bai Bo Army!"
"Indeed."
Yet another robust man walked to the center of the hall, saluting Guo Tai:

"This person not only needs to be killed publicly but should be tortured with a thousand cuts, subjected to eighteen tortures. Otherwise, the world might think we Bai Bo Army are easily swayed, and anyone dares to challenge us; this is absolutely intolerable!"
The burly men each spoke their piece, directly setting the plan.
Guo Tai asked a few more details from the messenger.
Upon learning the man had indeed come alone on horseback, he asked:
"Why haven’t you sent troops to hunt him down?"
"His horse is fast, we couldn’t catch him."
The messenger said:

"If one goes, he kills him. Ten go, they scatter, and he kills them one by one. If gathered to pursue him, he escapes, and we simply cannot catch up. After several cycles of this, with many casualties, we can only report to General."
"Hateful!"
Hu Cai’s eyes widened in anger:
"This person killing our brave soldiers is intolerable; I will confront him now."
With that, not waiting for Guo Tai to speak, he grabbed his large blade and charged out.
Not long after.
The sound of horse neighs and a galloping echoed, the noise gradually fading, Hu Cai presumably already far off.
Remaining were the coarsely featured Hann Xian, and the tall, burly Li Le, among others.
These were all good soldiers in the army.
Seeing Hu Cai take the initiative, they couldn’t help but be regretful:
"Letting this fellow seize merit; next time, I must be the first."
They evidently believed in Hu Cai’s martial power.
Continuing to eat and drink, they enjoyed watching the dancers.
Only Guo Tai patiently waited.
After a while.
"Report!"
A new messenger suddenly stormed into the main hall.
Seeing him full of anxiety and anger, Guo Tai was startled, quickly asking:
"What happened?"
"General Hu was stabbed to death by the other party."
"What?!"
Guo Tai staggered, nearly falling.
Hann Xian, Li Le, and others also glanced sideways, somewhat incredulous:
"Hu Cai is comparable to a second-class general, exceptionally strong, agile and highly flexible, how could a nameless upstart possibly kill him?!"
"Detail the situation clearly!"
Guo Tai shouted angrily.
"Yes, General."
The messenger immediately said:

"General Hu exited the city gate to hunt down the enemy, but the enemy’s horse was too fast to catch. After shouting insults at the enemy, seeing no response, he turned back, but unexpectedly at this moment, the enemy charged swiftly. General Hu turned to face the enemy, but due to being too rushed, the enemy exploited an exposed flaw, stabbing him off the horse.

Even off the horse, General Hu fought fiercely, yet the malicious foe further stabbed him several times. Without a horse, General Hu couldn’t outrun, getting stabbed to death on the spot as his blood drained. We intended to rescue, but the man ran off quickly, making pursuit challenging."
"Damnable!"
Guo Tai gnashed his teeth:
"This person, if not fried in a pot, will never quell my hatred!"
"General, I’ll confront him!"
Hann Xian leaped forward, brandishing a long spear, and without a word, went straight out the door.
"I’m going too."
Li Le said:
"I can provide assistance, be ready to stab swiftly, to prevent that guy from escaping!"

"Damnable!"
Guo Tai gnashed his teeth:
"This person, if not fried in a pot, will never quell my hatred!"
"General, I’ll confront him!"
Hann Xian leaped forward, brandishing a long spear, and without a word, went straight out the door.
"I’m going too."
Li Le said:
"I can provide assistance, be ready to stab swiftly, to prevent that guy from escaping!"

chapters.title: Chapter 22: Challenging and Slaying Over a Dozen Champions
paragraphs: Guo Tai agreed.
Li Le grabbed a spear and rushed out urgently.
After a while.
Another urgent report came in.
This time the voice was more pressing.
Guo Tai’s face darkened, causing the messenger to hold his breath.
"Speak clearly! Explain in detail!"
Guo Tai said each word with restraint, suppressing the anger in his heart.
"Yes, Commander."
The messenger immediately began to narrate, word for word:

"General Hann left the city, yet the bandit didn’t flee, instead, he confronted General Hann, battling for over a hundred rounds. The bandit suddenly changed his technique and used a bizarre move, catching General Hann off guard, sweeping him off his horse. He raised his halberd, stabbed, and killed him.
General Li saw General Hann being knocked off his horse, was shocked, and rushed to rescue him, but halfway there, he saw General Hann was already dead.
In his fury, he fought the bandit.
They battled for over another hundred rounds.
General Li was no match for the bandit and was also knocked off his horse and killed on the spot!
We wanted to rescue them, but it was too late."
The more Guo Tai listened, the angrier he became, to the point where his face was as dark as the bottom of a pot.
He couldn’t believe that the top three fierce generals under his command had died so pointlessly!

After all, whether it was Hu Cai, Hann Xian, or Li Le, they were all comparable to second-class generals. While their skills might not match that of second-class generals, their strength certainly did, each possessing innate divine power!
If it were otherwise, Guo Tai wouldn’t have had them lead a troop!
Yet such fierce generals had all fallen here today.
Guo Tai was so furious that his chest heaved, and he shouted mightily:
"Bring me my sword! Today, I must see which rat has so brazenly dared to bully Bai Bo Army!"
Over a dozen courageous generals below were also indignant, clamoring noisily.
But at this moment, not a single one suggested going out to confront the enemy.
The three fiercest of them had been slain.
Even a fool knows that the enemy must have genuine skill.
Perhaps he was a wolf in sheep’s clothing.
Going out now, there’s a high chance of dying!
As bandits, bullying the weak and fearing the strong is instinctual because this is the only way they can survive longer and better!
Seeing the enemy standing alone turned out to be a hard nut, no one else dared to claim they could take him down alone.
Everyone proposed mobilizing troops, besieging, and killing him.
Guo Tai nodded in approval.
He’s a cautious man.
He knew the skills of Hu Cai, Li Le, and Hann Xian. Even he dared not claim he could kill these three in such a short time.
Yet the enemy managed to do so.
A formidable foe.
"Sound the drums. Gather the masses!
Guo Tai shouted.
Some time later.
Guo Tai led the way.
Thousands of fierce bandits headed mightily towards the city gate.
To kill one man.
The Bai Bo Army mobilized nearly seventy to eighty percent of its forces.
To create a Celestial Net and Earth Net, to besiege and kill, blocking the enemy’s path, making sure he can’t escape again this time.
Tatat!
Clatter, clatter!
Amidst the rumbling sound of galloping hooves, the group quickly reached the city gate, fixed their gaze, and saw a lone man on a horse standing tall a hundred meters away!
The horse was obviously a top-grade warhorse!
No wonder it ran so fast!
As for the man?
Guo Tai examined him closely; the man looked handsome, almost like a pretty boy, making him look around:
"Where’s the messenger?"
"Commander."
The messenger hurried over.
Guo Tai pointed at the ’pretty boy’: "Is it him?"
"Yes, it’s him!"
The messenger was very certain.
Guo Tai’s face turned somewhat unsightly, having lost to a pretty boy. He waved his hand, and the troops under his command silently scattered.
Guo Tai was increasingly puzzled as the enemy didn’t run away.
He shouted strongly:
"Mouse, dare to state your name?"
"Your Laozi!"
"Your Laozi?"
Guo Tai frowned, mumbled it twice, suddenly understanding, became infuriated, and his temper flared. Seeing the solitary man, he didn’t bother to conceal his anger, shouting:
"Charge, slaughter that pretty boy."
"Gang up on him!"
The over a dozen skilled generals under Guo Tai exchanged glances, mounted their horses, whether holding knives, guns, or spears, charged at the ’pretty boy’.
"If you’ve got guts, don’t run!"
Fearing that the ’pretty boy’ would flee in the face of many, they hollered first.
Unexpectedly, the pretty boy was very obedient, not only not running, but also raising his halberd and making a disdainful gesture towards them.
Rather than becoming angry, the over a dozen skilled generals were delighted.
Each felt that the pretty boy was doomed.
At this point, if they didn’t cut him into pieces, boil him in oil, how would they do justice to the spirits of Hu Cai, Hann Xian, Li Le in the heavens?
No sooner said than done.
Because the distance between the two sides was only about a hundred meters, with the horses galloping, they collided quickly.
In Guo Tai’s expectant eyes.
Clang!
Clang, clang, clang!
Then came the sound of weapons clashing, in a flash, figures were stabbed and fell from their horses, some were even swept ten meters away, their heads hit the ground, dying with crushed skulls!
In a few moments.
Guo Tai hadn’t even reacted.
All over a dozen skilled generals were dead.
"Hiss!"
Guo Tai’s pupils widened, took a sharp breath.
The rest of the Bai Bo bandits were also terrified.
At this moment.
Everyone understood.
The ’pretty boy’ before them had merely been toying with them earlier!
Fishing indeed!!
Now that the fish had bitten, he wasn’t pretending anymore, directly counter-killing.
[Achievement Medal obtained: Your martial power has intimidated Bai Bo’s Great Commander, Guo Tai!]

[Note: He initially thought you were merely equal in combat power to Hu Cai, gaining victory only by horse power and trickery. But your strength was beyond his imagination! He’s now even starting to tremble, fear, and weaken.
He has lost the courage to face you alone, most likely he will abandon the idea of a duel and opt for a massive army assault!]
A hint swept across the ear.
The ’pretty boy,’ also known as Ding Ling, raised an eyebrow, then decisively shouted.
Boom!
Suddenly, two troops charged out from the dense forests on the sides.
From a distance, dust billowed skyward, the neighing of horses pierced the air, as if countless troops were swarming like a tide.
At the same time.
Thick smoke suddenly emerged from Zhongqiu Ancient City behind, and the sound of drums occasionally echoed.
The Bai Bo bandits began to panic!
Guo Tai shouted:
"Don’t panic, rally! Rally!!"
But because of the earlier preparations to besiege Ding Ling.
Although the Bai Bo bandits were vast in number, about three thousand, they were scattered.
Wanting to rally, how could it be easy?
In addition to the several times Ding Ling killed enemies.
He had killed soldiers numbering in dozens, reached seventeen to eighteen ’braves’, including the three commander-level generals Hu Cai, Hann Xian, and Li Le.
With such terrifying might, it made people fearful.
At this moment, the Bai Bo bandits suddenly shocked, discovered Ding Ling wasn’t alone, but leading numerous cavalry, rapidly charging towards them!

chapters.title: Chapter 23: The Second E-level Medal
paragraphs: The Bai Bo bandits suddenly panicked.
Their instinct to bully the weak and fear the strong, combined with their fear of death, kicked in. Some of the Bai Bo bandits fled amidst the chaos.
Meanwhile, Ding Ling decisively led over a hundred cavalrymen from the left flank towards Guo Tai.
His horse was fast and charged swiftly!
The cavalry followed behind him.
Without much care, Ding Ling charged through easily, as the Bai Bo army couldn’t compare to a regular army and was in utter disarray, without any structure!
Clang!
Clang, clang, clang!

Ding Ling wielded the Heaven-piercing Halberd, switching between the Battlefield Saber Technique, Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique, Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, and High-tier Spear Technique at times.
In his hands, a single halberd took on the essence of numerous weapons.
Whether it was the Battlefield Saber Technique, Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique, or Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, they were all top divine skills!
No ordinary person could withstand them!
Even with the High-tier Spear Technique, a random thrust flashed with five spear flowers, piercing the foreheads of five soldiers, killing them instantly!
He was drenched in blood, resembling a god of war on the battlefield.
More like a fast ship breaking through waves, and a divine spirit passing through mountains.
Wherever he went, he truly crushed all in his path!
No one was his match for even a single round!
With a halberd combining various weapon transformations, anyone daring to block his way was stabbed, chopped, slashed, or cleaved to death!
The manner of death varied.
But without exception, they all struck vital points and died swiftly!
At this moment, Ding Ling had clearly passed his novice phase!
Especially during the time he spent dueling at the city gate, as the number of people he killed and pierced through skyrocketed.
His fear and discomfort had completely vanished.
All that remained was a burning passion!
This awakened a sense of fierce heroism in him, ingrained in his very bones, meant to resonate with the battlefield!
"Ah!"
"He’s not human!"
"This man is too strong!"
"Run quickly!"
Even among the Bai Bo bandits, there were players.
Seeing Ding Ling’s fierce appearance like a demon god incarnate, veteran players who dared to confront and try obtaining ’experience points’ and ’treasures’ were easily killed.
The remaining novice players could no longer withstand it, shouted loudly, and fled on horseback.
Their flight triggered a flood-like effect, with clusters of people starting to run away.
Guo Tai was unable to stop them and, seeing Ding Ling’s overwhelming bravery, turned to flee himself in fear.
"Stop right there, Guo Tai!"
Ding Ling shouted loudly.
Guo Tai’s scalp tingled with fear and he ran even faster.
Other Bai Bo bandits, seeing their leader fleeing, also scattered, those who were trying to hold on.
This last batch of holdouts were the more spirited, fearless Bai Bo bandits. But with their leader’s departure, their morale broke, joining the panicked retreating army.
"Hah!"
Ding Ling grabbed a short spear from the side of his horse and hurled it with all his strength towards Guo Tai!
Shwoosh!
The short spear whistled through the air, hitting Guo Tai squarely in the back, pinning him dead onto his horse’s back.
His mount let out a wail, ran forward a few steps, then suddenly tipped over and fell.
"Whew."
Ding Ling let out a long breath.
Thinking to himself:
"This ’Javelin Throwing’ skill really comes in handy at critical moments."
The Javelin Throwing skill was naturally learned in the real world.
It was already at full level.
To be on the safe side, Ding Ling had prepared several short spears in advance.
They really proved effective now.
He rode over to Guo Tai’s side, looked at him, and found he wasn’t dead yet.
"You, you, who exactly are you?"
Guo Tai glared at Ding Ling with wide eyes, speaking in gasps, his eyes filled with regret, fear, and a longing for life.
Ding Ling couldn’t be bothered with him.
He waved his hand.
Immediately someone came up to cut off Guo Tai’s head.
This was key evidence to prove the success of the bandit suppression!
It must not be lost.
Ding Ling ordered someone to keep it safe.
He led the team to continue driving and slaughtering some of the Bai Bo bandits, while ordering: "Surrender, and you’ll not be killed!"
Compared to the cavalry.
The vast majority of the Bai Bo bandits were infantry, and how could two legs possibly outrun four?
With this order given.
Ninety percent of the Bai Bo bandits removed their armor, threw away their weapons, and knelt down to surrender.
Of course, there were also those who refused to surrender and ran desperately.
For such people.
Ding Ling ordered them to be killed directly.
And those who ran too fast and were out of sight, Ding Ling simply couldn’t be bothered.
As long as he could control the overall situation, that was enough.
[E-level Achievement Medal earned: Defeat of the Bai Bo Army bandits ravaging the regions of Bingzhou and Jizhou!]

[Note: This Bai Bo Army would in the future gather a crowd of a hundred thousand, joining forces with the Xiongnu Chanyu Yufuluo to plunder various regions of the Central Plains, causing great devastation, which you successfully prevented.]
Ding Ling felt slightly surprised.
He actually earned an E-level Achievement Medal.
This was quite rare.
Even Zhang Hex only earned a regular medal. Defeating the Bai Bo bandits actually came with an E-level medal.
It seems the Bai Bo bandits never had the chance to develop.
Ding Ling pondered.
The reason he divided his forces into four groups was to test the waters and see what the Bai Bo bandits were made of.
He wanted to see if Xu Huang was among them.
It seems there wasn’t.
Due to the involvement of players.
The development path of the Bai Bo bandits had already diverged completely from history.
’If Xu Huang, such a formidable general, were really present, I would most likely have retreated.’
Xu Huang is a top first-class general.
Although Ding Ling’s strength is formidable now, he wouldn’t dare claim assured victory against Xu Huang.
Plus, with the Bai Bo bandits numerous and strong.
How could they be fought?
Fortunately, he was consoled that his plan was successful.
’First, duel to probe, feign weakness to the enemy, and also eliminate the opponent’s active forces.’
’Then, secretly order a few clever veteran players to lead a team into the ancient city, await the signal, set fire, beat drums, and disrupt the hearts of the Bai Bo bandits.’

’Then, coordinate with the ambushing troops on the flanks, and the forces deceiving the enemy from afar, making them believe a vast army has arrived, causing fear and hesitation, not daring to engage.’
This was a strategy of resting to wait for labor and creating something from nothing.
Finally, capturing the bandit leader and reversing the roles, naturally, was a given.
"This time, the success was completely due to my strength and the chaos of the Bai Bo bandits. Otherwise, no amount of strategy would have worked."
If the enemy were Cao Mengde.
Ding Ling’s strategies might have had no effect.
However, Ding Ling never planned to progress in the ’Commander-in-Chief’ path.
His plan was to conquer the major checkpoints and planes of the game alone!
He just needed to make himself increasingly fierce.
Why bother with so many intrigues and schemes?
If strong enough, brute force was the way of power!
[Achievement Medal earned: Successive defeat of Hu Cai, Hann Xian, and Li Le, three historically renowned bandits.]

[Note: Hu Cai and the others were exceptionally powerful. Defeating them proves you have reached the level of a first-class general. Your fame will surely spread across the lands of Jizhou due to this battle!]
This prompt appeared after defeating Hu Cai and the others.
Ding Ling pondered:

"It’s no surprise, Achievement Medals should be related to historical figures. But why did Cheng Huan, Zhang Hex, and the others each contribute a medal, while Hu Cai and the other three only offered one? Could it be because they died, so there are fewer medals?"

[Achievement Medal earned: Successive defeat of Hu Cai, Hann Xian, and Li Le, three historically renowned bandits.]
[Note: Hu Cai and the others were exceptionally powerful.
Defeating them proves you have reached the level of a first-class general.
Your fame will surely spread across the lands of Jizhou due to this battle!]
This prompt appeared after defeating Hu Cai and the others.
Ding Ling pondered:
"It’s no surprise, Achievement Medals should be related to historical figures.
But why did Cheng Huan, Zhang Hex, and the others each contribute a medal, while Hu Cai and the other three only offered one?
Could it be because they died, so there are fewer medals?"

chapters.title: Chapter 24: Zhen Jiang’s Sachet
paragraphs: How are the specific circumstances.
Ding Ling has no way of knowing.
However, his purpose in coming to suppress the bandits this time was to complete the mission. Now that the mission is complete, he doesn’t want to stay any longer.
But he hasn’t forgotten Zhen Jiang’s plea for help.
Ordered to enter the city and instructed people to search.
Sure enough, they found Zhen Jiang’s father, Zhen Yi.
Zhen Yi apparently had already grasped the reasons from others and was extremely grateful to Ding Ling!
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You’ve received Zhen Yi’s high level of gratitude.]

[Note: Zhen Yi, as the wealthiest man in Jizhou, sees you as handsome, exceptional, and with a life-saving grace towards him. He has developed some other thoughts on you. If nothing unexpected happens, there is a high chance you will become his son-in-law in the future!]
Upon hearing the prompt, Ding Ling’s expression paused, and he glanced at Zhen Yi with a peculiar look.
Unaware, Zhen Yi continued expressing words of gratitude to Ding Ling and invited him to visit his old home in Zhongshan Wuji.
Ding Ling responded politely and formally.
He stated that currently, due to official duties, he could only leave the matter for future consideration.
Zhen Yi expressed his regret but still looked forward to Ding Ling’s visit.
Some time later.
Zhen Jiang was found by the guards sent out by Zhen Yi.
The reunion between father and daughter naturally was heartwarming.
Seeing this, Ding Ling felt conflicted and did not stay long in the main hall. Instead, he went to the treasury.
This was where the Bandits Bai Bo stored their wealth.
Indeed, it was a mountain of money, grain, and fabrics.
"How much is this worth?"
Ding Ling took the account book in his hand and discovered that most of the wealth here belonged to the Zhen Family. He felt relieved.
After some thought.
He filled a small bag with gold.
The rest he instructed to be audited according to the account books, returning the Zhen Family’s belongings and what belonged to some commoners intact.
As for the losses to the county government office’s treasury?
This wasn’t Ding Ling’s concern!
He came to suppress the bandits!
He had no obligation to recover the treasury’s property for the county government office.
After an hour.
Zhen Yi and Zhen Jiang came to thank Ding Ling once more.
"Thank you, Young Master Ding! If not for you, we would have lost not only our lives but also our wealth."
Zhen Jiang’s eyes, like a fairy lake in the sky, glimmered with gratitude towards Ding Ling.
She blushed, gracefully stepped forward, and handed him a scented sachet, saying crisply:
"This is a sachet I personally wove last year. It’s my favorite, and I usually carry it with me. Today I’m giving it to you, hoping it will bring you good luck.
Ding Ling intended to refuse, but seeing Zhen Jiang’s nervous, hopeful, and shy expression, he swallowed back the words and quietly accepted it.
Zhen Jiang indeed was a noble lady, a top beauty with inner charm.
If this Three Kingdoms World wasn’t a game world, perhaps Ding Ling might have ended up marrying such a wife home.
Comparing with the girlfriends of his past and present life.
Zhen Jiang, whether in appearance or temperament, was top-tier, a dimension-reducing blow to his previous girlfriends!
At this moment, Ding Ling even thought:

Having seen such a beauty and won her favor, could he still find marriage appealing upon returning to reality, where brides demand hundreds of thousands in dowry, don’t regard a million as significant, or insist a man must be capable of laundry and cooking, a jack-of-all-trades husband?
Ding Ling doubted if he could ever find a wife in the future.
But quickly, he became aware.
He was already a man who had activated the cheats!
Why fear not finding a wife?
As long as he remained outstanding enough, what woman could he not find?
Getting along with Zhen Jiang was a pleasure.
She was a gentle, kind, and talented young lady.

The longer Ding Ling interacted with Zhen Jiang, the more he couldn’t help but like her. Had he not constantly reminded himself that he must keep moving forward, he might have already drowned in the beautiful fantasy of this beauty.
Finally, Ding Ling chose to leave Zhongqiu Ancient City.
In the meantime.

Zhen Yi subtly hinted to Ding Ling numerous times, mentioning how thrilled Zhen Jiang was that he accepted her sachet. This gesture signified him acknowledging her feelings. She eagerly anticipated his visit to Zhongshan Wuji to marry her.
Of course, it was just a subtle hint, not made overly clear.
But they were all smart people.
Ding Ling understood.
Zhen Yi left it at that.
At this moment, the farewell was filled with reluctance to part.
Both exchanged emotional farewell words, and then amidst the sound of horses, ended their gaze upon each other.
"Hyah!"
Ding Ling spurred his horse on.
Leading over a hundred cavalry towards the direction of Ye City.
The other three hundred cavalry had already departed with thousands of Bai Bo bandit prisoners.
To keep these captives in line.
Each cavalryman was equipped with bows and arrows, having thoroughly stripped the prisoners of their clothing and weapons, leaving only a pair of pants for decency.
"They’ve left."
Zhen Yi sighed as he watched Zhen Jiang staring longingly into the distance.
"Father."
Zhen Jiang, the eldest daughter, often handled household and commercial duties, externally appearing as a delicate Jiangnan girl but possessing a resolute and strong-willed spirit.
She bit her lip, asking anxiously:
"Do you think Brother Ding will come to find us?"
"This..."
Zhen Yi hesitated.
"Father, please don’t lie to me."
"Alright."
Zhen Yi pondered and said:
"Based on my observation over this period, Ding Ling indeed is an extraordinary individual, knowledgeable in astronomy, geography, calligraphy, culture, and more, almost all-encompassing.
Moreover, he’s exceptionally brave and mighty. With merely four hundred men, he has managed to defeat several thousand Bai Bo bandits, killed and beheaded several leading outlaws.
Such a person should be a hero in these troubled times!
He won’t be confined by a single woman.
And I dare assert, unless he dies, he will surely become known far and wide!
His name destined to be engraved in history, sung for generations!"
"Then, do I still have a chance with him?"
"That, I do not know. It all depends on fate. But it seems to me that he has a fondness for you. If he establishes a family in the future, he might think of you first."
Hearing this, Zhen Jiang couldn’t help but smile with delight:
"As long as he comes to find me, it’s good."
Don’t assume Zhen Jiang is infatuated.
Where flowers bloom, butterflies naturally flutter to them.
At this moment, Ding Ling was already exceptionally outstanding, combined with several changes in his figure and appearance, making his temperament and looks greatly prominent.
In terms of looks, aura, martial arts, knowledge, etc., all were exceptional choices.
Moreover, he saved her life and didn’t covet their family’s wealth.
Such a virtuous and talented person?
Zhen Yi was tempted, wishing to acquire him as a son-in-law.
How could Zhen Jiang not be moved?
Just as a man encountering an exceptionally outstanding woman, how could he not take notice?
Midway.
Ding Ling caught up with the main force.
Seeing the night falling, he ordered a camp to be set up.
Additionally, he called two soldiers to guard the tent entrance, instructing them not to enter without his command.
Once everything was settled.
Ding Ling entered the tent, lay down, and chose to return to reality.

chapters.title: Chapter 25: The Role of Medals
paragraphs: Whew!
In the midst of the dizzying whirl, it felt like a moment, yet like eternity.
When the disorientation was at its peak, Ding Ling suddenly felt his body lighten, as if he had arrived at a new realm.
He suddenly opened his eyes.
No mistake.
It’s the familiar Player Plaza.
He glanced downward.
Below his feet was still the constantly rotating circle of light.
He scanned left and right.
The sprawling plaza was teeming with people, densely packed, stretching as far as the eye could see.
"The number of people keeps increasing."
Players were discussing:

"But this plaza is quite miraculous, it seems to automatically expand, adjusting its size according to the number of people, keeping the plaza within a range that isn’t too spacious, nor too crowded."
"What’s so rare about that."
A beautiful female player suddenly spoke:
"Haven’t you all been paying attention to the rankings lately?"
"Yao Yunxi, I know what you want to say."
A tall male player chimed in:
"You want to talk about that dark horse, Ding Ling, whose progress is astonishingly fast, right?"
"Correct. It’s him."
Yao Yunxi nodded, her face showing an unusual expression as she said:

"Not only has he suddenly shot to first place on the comprehensive ranking list! His progress on the strength, agility, and physique rankings is also extraordinarily rapid, now soaring to second place!"
Stopping here, her eyes showed a hint of shock:
"It’s hard to imagine. A day ago, Ding Ling was still just a new player!"
"Indeed. In just about a day’s time, he’s achieved what many people might not achieve in a lifetime, so defiant of the natural order. I’d love to meet him."
Other players also eagerly commented:
"If only we could learn some secrets behind his rapid progress, it would be a huge gain!"

"No kidding. His progress is even more aggressive than that of Kong Tianhua, the top player from the initial testing phase! I heard Kong Tianhua is particularly interested in meeting Ding Ling, to see just how he managed to rapidly ascend across various rankings in just one day!"
"You guys are only paying attention to the first four rankings, did you not notice the skills ranking?"
Yao Yunxi smiled slightly:
"In the top ten of the skills ranking. Ding Ling alone occupies four positions. Don’t you find that absurd?"

"First place with the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, second with the Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique, third with the Battlefield Saber Technique, tenth with High-tier Axe Technique! Holding the top three spots all by himself, it is indeed unbelievable, and this is a sudden appearance in today’s ranking. What does that imply?"
Some players seemed quite excited:
"It implies Ding Ling might have learned these four true skills in just a day’s time!!
"Wow!"
Everyone who heard this was utterly amazed.
Each of them found it hard to believe.
"This is impossible! How can such a person exist in this world?"
"But the reality is right here before us."
"Is it possible that there’s been a sequence error in the rankings? A possible bug?"
Ding Ling listened for a while, and then chose not to continue listening.
His current popularity was overwhelmingly explosive.
He thought it necessary to move out and find a new place to live after returning.
Otherwise, there was indeed a possibility of certain ill-intentioned people locating him.
After all, quite a few players had seen his true appearance.
Among them, there might actually be some highly skilled artists, if such a person were to sketch his likeness and post it online.
Wouldn’t he become an instant sensation worldwide?!
Eventually, he’d certainly be surrounded, treated as an exotic species.
In the Three Kingdoms World.
Even historical figures like Zhang Hex and Pan Feng couldn’t restrain their curiosity and desire to examine him.
In the real world, people with even greater curiosity and exploration drives surely exist!
To avoid such troubles.
Ding Ling must take preventive measures early!
"Fortunately, I returned early enough. If I were a day or two late, the apartment might have been turned over by some people!"
A sense of urgency surged in Ding Ling’s heart.
He didn’t want to be caught and turned into a guinea pig!
This world is not short of capable people.
If a strong person kidnapped him demanding research, what could he do?
If he was able to fight back, it would be acceptable, but if he couldn’t, would he just wait for death?
"I can’t sit idle and wait for danger to arrive; I must nip it in the bud."
Ding Ling had truly died once.
His temperament compared to ordinary people was comparatively steadfast.
Combined with the numerous killings in the Three Kingdoms World.
He’s becoming not only more composed but also subtly possesses an iron-blooded overbearing aura.
"I should first figure out how to bring my strength back to the real world.
Ding Ling opened the character panel:
[Character: Ding Ling
Age: 23
Race: Human
Faction: Jizhou Hann Fu
Profession: Military Marquis
Level: 1
Strength: [Root Bone 1 (average human is 1 point), Wisdom 2, Strength 6.3+0.2+0.3+0.5+2.4=(9.7), Agility 6.8+0.1+0.2+0.3+1.6=(9), Physique 6.1+0.1+0.2+0.3+2.4=(9.1), Defense 2, Charm 2]
Weapons: One General Armor, an eighty-jin Heaven-piercing Halberd, a sixty-jin Sharp Axe, one high-quality Long Saber, several Short Spears...

Skills: Low-level Pile Skill (Level 10), Horse Stance Skill (Level 10), Initial Tier Saber Technique (Level 10), High-tier Saber Technique (Level 10), Battlefield Saber Technique (Level 10), Basic, Middle, High-tier Spear Techniques (Level 10), Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique (Level 10), Basic, Middle, High-tier Axe Techniques (Level 10), Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques (Level 10), Acupuncture (Level 10), Swimming (Level 10), Fitness (Level 10), Basic Psychology (Level 10)...]
[Achievement Medal: 8 Ordinary, 2 E-grade.]
[Glory Medal: 0]
’Hmm.’
Ding Ling noticed a difference from the Game World.
That is, the Player Plaza actually contained Achievement Medal and Glory Medal lists.
Ding Ling had quite a few Achievement Medals, but what are Glory Medals?
Ding Ling clicked on the instruction next to the Achievement Medals.
After a while.
Ding Ling suddenly understood.
"Achievement Medals can be consumed to bring martial arts back to reality. The more the Achievement Medals, the more power can be brought back."
Moreover.
Achievement Medals can also be used to unlock the next dimension or exchange for Storage Space.
Glory Medals have even greater uses.
Not only can they be exchanged for Dao Rhyme World, but also for treasures that enhance root bone and so forth.
The more Ding Ling read, the more he was astounded.
He pondered:

"And from the description list, Glory Medals and Achievement Medals seem to have more roles beyond this. Yet, being at the lowest level of the Three Kingdoms Plane, I am not eligible to unlock other functionalities."
Ding Ling’s eyes flashed with a peculiar glint:
"But if the Game World truly holds the power described in the introduction, it really is phenomenal!"
’The creator of this game must be a supreme Great Power like never before.’
’Just wondering if this Great Power is observing the game in secret? Or simply created it and left it unmanaged?’
