chapters.title: Chapter 26: Bringing Martial Arts Back to Reality
paragraphs: What exactly is the situation?
Ding Ling, at his current stage of cultivation, is unable to fully grasp it.
He just silently warns himself:
He must continuously improve himself! Never get complacent!
After all, who knows if there’s a supreme master watching over everyone from the shadows?
"The library matter must never be exposed."
With a slight closing of his eyes, Ding Ling can see the library nestled within the Sea of Consciousness.
He doesn’t know if the Great Power can see through his Sea of Consciousness.
But just in case.
He still has to put all his effort into becoming stronger before anything else.
"As long as I become strong enough, everything will be insignificant worries. My current anxiety is ultimately due to my weakness!"
Ding Ling furrowed his brows thoughtfully for a while, composed himself, and turned his gaze to the Character Panel.
[Current strength requires the consumption of 7 Ordinary Achievement Medals to transfer to reality, would you like to proceed?]
It actually requires seven!
Ding Ling closely examined the instructions and gained enlightenment.
Since entering the game, his power, agility, and physique have all increased by more than 7 points! Some even exceeded that.
The game rule is: 1 point increase in power, agility, and physique requires 1 Achievement Medal for exchange. Or a 3-point increase in power. It’s the same principle.
And if the exchange goes beyond 5 Achievement Medals.
Then the game rule will automatically omit some numbers after the decimal point.
This is the reason why Ding Ling needs to spend 7 Medals.
"Achievement Medals are so useful, it’s no surprise that players would work hard to earn achievements and improve their affinity with historical characters!"
’But improving affinity takes more time. Unlike me, focusing on praise, recognition, and astonishment seems easier?’
For ordinary players, enhancing affinity is easy.
But for someone like Ding Ling who’s cheating, he needs to focus on recognition, praise, and amazement.
"It seems I’ll have to flaunt openly in the future."
Ding Ling woke up to this realization and no longer hesitated, opting for the exchange.
[Exchange successful.]
[Would you like to return to the real world?]
Yes!
Swish!
The circle of light beneath his feet shimmered, carrying Ding Ling skyward in a flash, vanishing at the top of the sky.
In the next instant.
"Whew!"
Ding Ling abruptly opened his eyes, looked around, and indeed found himself back in his rental room, taking deep breaths.
The recent flight was so fast that he almost suffocated.
"This game is too realistic."
Ding Ling muttered to himself.
Stretched his hands, clenched his fists.
"Didn’t they say martial arts and power can be brought back to the real world?"
"Why does it feel like there’s not much change?"
But in the next second.
An endless surge of power erupted from every limb and bone!
Ding Ling trembled, nearly floating with excitement.
"This agility, physique, power, it’s identical to the experience in the game!"
Ding Ling widened his eyes.
He moved his arms like wielding a spear, executing High-tier Spear Technique, hitting star points in mid-air five times.
He used his leg as a staff, able to perform Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique!
One leg, sweeping through the void, akin to an iron staff clearing the battlefield!
His palm as a blade, deploying Battlefield Saber Technique, stirring Iron Blood Evil Qi in the void.
"Very impressive."
Ding Ling was elated.
"As expected, the martial arts from the game can truly be brought back to reality."
"This is so miraculous!"
Ding Ling praised.
But then thought of the library’s unparalleled power.
He felt at ease.
All unreasonable things might be due to his current weakness.
Like an ant, it certainly can’t understand how a towering mountain could suddenly collapse.
And the towering mountains in their eyes might just be a tree, while humans chopping down trees wouldn’t be noticed by them.
Just like humans can’t comprehend the divine nature of the fourth dimension.
"Hmm?"
Ding Ling suddenly felt overwhelmingly hungry.
Such a feeling was also present in the game world.
He didn’t delay further, promptly took out the prepared food.
There was a lot of bread, instant noodles, and beef jerky amongst the food.
Ding Ling finished eating a whole thirty boxes of stock.
Yet still wasn’t full.
Until he took out the contents of the fridge to cook, only then did he feel slightly satisfied.
Ding Ling was stunned.
He touched his stomach.
Thought to himself:
"How can I eat so much? And eating this much, my stomach isn’t visibly bigger. Could it be the food’s energy was all used to replenish consumption?"
His previous powers surged rapidly.
Even his height and physique seemed to have changed.
He measured it.
Indeed, he had grown considerably taller compared to before.
It seemed his physique had also become more robust!
"I’ve truly turned into a muscle man."
Ding Ling admired himself in the mirror for a while.
Found his appearance and charisma had improved significantly.
Nodded silently in approval.
"If things continue like this, becoming a handsome gentleman might just be a matter of time."
"But the immediate priority is to leave here."
The only valuable asset is the gaming helmet.
As for the food?
It was all finished just now!
Except for two bags of rice that haven’t been cooked.
He began packing.
Boxed up clothes and pants.
Put on a hat, mask, and went straight to settle the rental agreement with the landlord.
The landlord is a stunning beauty, very easy to talk to, but surprised at why Ding Ling suddenly wanted to leave.
After all, Ding Ling had lived here for several years.
They could be considered old acquaintances.
She couldn’t help but ask several questions.
Ding Ling was puzzled:
"Don’t you play the Mythical game?"
"Does this have anything to do with you leaving?"
The landlord refunded Ding Ling’s deposit, looked up at him, and wondered:
"You know me, I don’t play games."
"I think you should try it."
Ding Ling also held some fondness for the landlord.
In fact, before Ding Ling crossed over, his predecessor had pursued the landlord, only to be rejected.
Ding Ling accepted all the memories of his predecessor, so even though he felt fond of the landlord, he didn’t pursue her again, the gap was too wide, better not humiliate himself.
If you were to discuss how wealthy the landlord is?
Just look at the dozen or so buildings she owns in several big cities!
Such assets easily exceed billions!
She’s indeed a wealthy woman!
But oddly enough, this wealthy woman only enjoys collecting rent, besides, she reads novels, listens to music, exercises, or goes to parks to listen to old folks chatter.
Not at all like a twenty-something, vibrant woman, but rather like a retired aunt.
"Really?"
The beautiful landlord nodded:
"If even you, Ding Ling, say so. Maybe there’s really a need to try playing it."
"Don’t look at me like that."
The beautiful landlord glanced at Ding Ling, smiling:
"You never played games before either, right? Suddenly playing, and suggesting I play. Looks like this game must have unique features, especially..."
She took out Ding Ling’s previous videos and photos for comparison, nodded:
"I’m now more convinced the game is worth playing."
She seemed quite excited:
"I heard playing the game can lead to a second puberty, and I didn’t believe it..."

chapters.title: Chapter 27: Master of Archery and Master of Forging
paragraphs: "... But seeing you like this now, I believe it!"
The beautiful landlady looked expectant:
"I’m also getting a bit impatient."
Ding Ling had no words to respond.
Was the landlady going to the game just because she could develop again?
However, seeing her flat chest, Ding Ling understood.
The landlady was beautiful, but when it came to figure, she could really be bros with Ding Ling.
"What are you looking at?"
The beautiful landlady turned slightly, her face flushed with anger, glaring:
"Just wait, in a few days, I’ll show you a brand new Ouyang Lingling!"
Perhaps it was because both of their names had ’Ling’ in them.
Although Ouyang Lingling rejected Ding Ling, they had a pretty good relationship, almost like friends.
"When will I see you again after you leave?"
"Mountains and rivers are long, if fate wills it, we’ll meet again someday."
The two chatted and laughed for a while.
Ouyang Lingling extended an invitation to Ding Ling: "I have properties all over the country, wherever you go, I can rent a house to you. I can continue to be your landlady, what do you think?"
Ding Ling didn’t think much of it.
Though Ouyang Lingling could be trusted.
But at this time, Ding Ling wouldn’t casually place his personal safety in the hands of an outsider.
Before he had enough strength to protect himself,
Ding Ling wouldn’t let anyone discover or find him.
He left his residence, and on the same day, with his luggage, went to the black market for cars, rented a black car, and headed to the outskirts of the neighboring city.
Traveling on the road.
Upon reaching his destination,

The black car driver, seeing no one around, and noticing that Ding Ling looked decent, tried to extort some money from him, but got roughed up by Ding Ling instead, left without asking for money, and fled.
Ding Ling saved a bit of money, touched his face, even wearing a mask, he still seemed easy to bully?
What was the black car driver thinking!
"This place is rural. It’s unlikely anyone will find me here, right?"
He had previously contacted the landlord from a public phone in a secretive place.
The landlord said he would arrive at four in the afternoon.
Ding Ling checked his watch.
It was three thirty.
He waited at the agreed location, at the entrance of the village.
After half an hour.
A man arrived punctually.

He glanced at Ding Ling, seeing him covered tightly with a hat and mask, found it a bit odd, but since he hadn’t lived here for years, renting out the house to make some money was just fine, he didn’t think much, didn’t even sign a contract with Ding Ling, and Ding Ling to appreciate this point, rented the house here.
The man showed Ding Ling the house, took the money, and left.
Ding Ling glanced around the house.
It was very dirty.
This is how places were when unoccupied for long periods.
But it had appliances, furniture, and such, saving him the trouble of buying them.
When renting a house, he usually rents one with appliances, otherwise, buying them is troublesome.
The village is located at the foot of the mountain, and it’s not big.
Only a few dozen households.
And most of them are vacant, young people have all gone to the city, leaving only the elderly and some left-behind children.
The children are also very young.
Around five or six years old, the age of playing with mud.
Seeing a new person in the village, they were particularly curious, occasionally observing Ding Ling secretly, pointing and giggling with clear, melodious laughter.
Ding Ling didn’t mind; he too had been this age, knowing children are the most innocent.
After cleaning the house,

he went out to chat proactively with the village elders, learned about the local circumstances, and under the enthusiastic guidance of an elder, visited the hot spring in the mountains and even cleaned the well and other areas.
He would have to rely on the well water for cooking and boiling water in the future.
Busy inside and out.
It took several hours.
Only when the children’s playful noises quieted down did Ding Ling enter his room, securely closed the door, took out his gaming helmet, and prepared to enter the game.
What reassured him was the gaming helmet could be used anywhere.
Internet access wasn’t even necessary.
Thinking of the internet,
Ding Ling turned over and got up again.
He began to use his phone, connecting to Uncle Zhang’s WIFI next door, and started to surf the net.
He had removed his SIM card and bought a second-hand phone a while ago to avoid being found. His preparations were comprehensive.
This time, his online goal was to learn some new knowledge.
He searched for archery courses and others.
A while later.
[Basic Archery Full Level]
[Projection Technique Full Level]
[Rapid Shooting Technique Full Level]
[Continuous Shooting Technique Full Level]
Different archery skills surged in his mind.
Ding Ling, who originally didn’t understand archery, instantly became a Master of Archery at that moment!
He had a very clear sense.
With his current power, if paired with a good bow, he could easily kill a Second-class General!
"Very good."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.

If archery skills in the real world were already this impressive, he couldn’t imagine the situation if he trained to full level the archery skills of Huang Zhong and others in the Three Kingdoms World?
"Continue."
Ding Ling searched online again for other knowledge points.
It was due to his actions in the Three Kingdoms World that made him realize that skills in the real world could also be useful at critical moments.
This time, he actively tried to learn all he could!
Some time later.
[Forging Defense Weapons Skill Full Level]
[Forging Attack Weapons Skill Full Level]
[Wooden Ox and Flowing Horse Making Skill Full Level]
Ding Ling had studied too many knowledge points in the sea of knowledge on the internet.
And since these were basic skills,
after a single read through,
the library would instantly condense into a book, allowing Ding Ling’s skills in that aspect to reach full level immediately.
This naturally made Ding Ling become a:
[Master of Forging!]
[Master Carpenter!]
[Master Smith!]
[Master Bamboo Weaver!]
[Master of Agriculture!]
[Planting Master!]
[Master of Cultivating Crops!]
He gained dozens of useful skills.
The books condensed from the knowledge points were stacked up on one of the bookshelves, numbering in the hundreds.
"Very good."
Ding Ling nodded to himself, very satisfied.
Perhaps because modern times focus more on the manufacturing of nuclear bombs and advanced weapons.
Thus, forging skills in that aspect can’t be found on the internet or in bookstores.
However, ancient skills and some modern basic skills can be found in network bookstores without hesitation.
Of course.
Some truly top-notch skills that can be passed down generations can’t be found online.
For example, Ding Ling had always wanted to learn Xingyi Fist, Yong Chun Fist, and other genuine fist techniques.
But they were not available online.
"Okay, now I can enter the Game World."
Ding Ling put on the gaming helmet.
Chose to enter the Game World.
With the familiar sensation of the world spinning around.
The next moment.
He found himself back at the Player Plaza again.
At a glance.
A sea of people.
Various discussions flooded into his ears like a surging torrent.
Ding Ling shook his head, choosing not to listen or focus.
Instead, he opened his Character Panel.
Sure enough.
This time, the Character Panel was different again.

chapters.title: Chapter 28: Opening the Path of Glory
paragraphs: The skill list now includes: Basic Archery (Level 10), Basic Forging Skill (Level 10), Basic Woodworking (Level 10), Basic Casting (Level 10), Basic Planting (Level 10), Basic Cultivation (Level 10), Basic Refining (Level 10)...
Dozens of them.
Ding Ling reflected:
’It seems that many masters in the real world can only count as proficient in basic skills in the game world.’
’But it’s not bad to get so many skills for free from reality.’
Ding Ling was quite satisfied.
Acquiring so many skills in the game world isn’t easy.
One needs to find real experts to learn from.
And even if you find them, they might not teach you.
Just like a typical player.
Some are lucky enough to be in the same sect as Zhao Yun and may have the fortune to learn some good martial arts;
But if allocated to the bitter cold lands beyond the Great Wall, then not to mention learning martial arts, even just surviving comfortably would be a big problem.
So, being allocated to Jizhou, for Ding Ling, things are looking pretty good right now.
The most crucial thing is that he met Cheng Huan, who is willing to connect him with opportunities.
Thinking of Cheng Huan,
Ding Ling has already decided that he must change his fate in the future to save him from disaster.
Ding Ling continued to look at the Character Panel.
Scrolling down.
Ding Ling discovered new differences once again.
[In view of player Ding Ling’s outstanding performance, the Path of Glory has been specially opened for player Ding Ling!]
[Note 1: The Path of Glory is the only way to obtain the Glory Medal.]
[Note 2: There are two paths on the Path of Glory. The first path: Path of the War God. The second path: Path of the Emperor.]
[Player Ding Ling can choose one of the two.]
Ding Ling carefully read through, his eyes slightly brightened:
"I didn’t expect the Glory Medal to be obtained through the Path of Glory. I was wondering how to obtain this Glory Medal before. Now I understand."
The basic condition to start the Path of Glory: must have an overall strength level of a First-class General!
Ding Ling met the condition.
So, the next time he logs in, he can start this path.
"Which path to choose?"
Ding Ling almost didn’t think much and directly chose the first path.
He can exploit the system, becoming the War God suits him best!
And the Path of the Emperor obviously focuses on conquering the world!
He doesn’t like playing tricks, he prefers to just charge ahead, crushing everything in his path.
[Confirm the choice of Path of the War God?]
Confirmed.
[Choice successful.]
[Player Ding Ling has now embarked on the Path of the War God.]
[Rules for the Path of the War God are as follows:
1. You must defeat more than twenty strong individuals from the plane. The more you defeat, the higher the honor bonus.
2. You must defeat the strongest of the plane to prove you are the true War God.
3. Your name as the War God must be known throughout the entire plane world.
There are dozens of rules in total.
The main focus is still on the first three.
Ding Ling pondered:
"Defeating twenty strong individuals isn’t too difficult. After returning, I’ll spar with Zhang Hex and Gao Lan, and maybe that’ll complete two points of progress."
It’s just that making the War God name resonate worldwide seems a bit challenging. How to make it resonate globally?"
A flash of inspiration struck Ding Ling’s mind.
He thought of a method:
"Joining a faction and having them help promote me seems to be the fastest and most time-efficient way!"
Ding Ling never thought of conquering.
Because it takes too much time!
And the time ratio between the game world and the real world is 1:1!
How many years would it take to conquer and unify the Three Kingdoms?
Even if he’s an incredible fighter, more formidable than ten Tong Yuans, crushing the Three Kingdoms would take at least a few years!
For Ding Ling, that’s too time-consuming.
He needs to quickly clear the Three Kingdoms and then move on to other plane worlds to study stronger, better martial arts and skills!

"If I can really make it to the Journey to the West World, then by that time, not to mention the emperor of the Three Kingdoms, even the whole world might not be able to withstand a single slap from me!"
Ding Ling was looking forward to the future.
But soon, he came back to his senses, suppressed these strange emotions, and chose to start the game.
Ka-bam!
A circle of light swirled beneath his feet, instantly whisking him away from the original spot.
"Did you feel that the person beside me just now looked a lot like Ding Ling?"
A girl had been staring at Ding Ling, and when she saw him disappear, she clapped her hands suddenly and exclaimed:
"That’s right. It’s Ding Ling! His looks are exactly the same as the picture posted online!"
She was very excited:

’I didn’t expect Ding Ling to be standing right next to me! He’s even better looking in person than in the picture circulating online! I wonder if he has a girlfriend? Ah! Such a missed opportunity, I forgot to ask him just now!’
"I thought he looked like Ding Ling too."
The girl’s companion was also quite surprised:
"I didn’t expect Ding Ling to be playing the game at this moment too."
"I’m most curious about his identity right now!"
The girl chattered:

"According to the information circulating online, Ding Ling’s performance in the Jizhou faction can be described as leaving others far behind, crushing all other players! Whether it’s horsemanship, sword skill, spear skill, or geographical knowledge, slaughter skill, it seems all have been refined to an extremely advanced level.
Many players in the Jizhou faction say they have seen it with their own eyes, and it was quite a spectacle!"

"Yes indeed. A new player showing such excellence in horsemanship, geographical knowledge, and other aspects, despite no such courses being offered in the Jizhou faction, even with the slightest deduction, one can tell Ding Ling surely knows these skills in real life!"
Many players joined the discussion:
"For Ding Ling to be able to learn these skills, how could he be an ordinary person? He must be a high-tier rich and handsome man! And the top kind of rich and handsome!"

"Tsk tsk. Such a top-tier person from the top of the pyramid has also entered the game world. I really want to be friends with him. This way, whether in the game world or the real world, I can rely on him and effortlessly succeed."
Many players talked more and more enthusiastically.
Some envied and were jealous of Ding Ling;
Some admired and praised him;
Some despised and looked down upon...
The various aspects of human nature were in full display.
But without exception, all begrudged Ding Ling’s family background!
In their view, Ding Ling’s monstrous performance early on as a new player must be linked to his prestigious and unparalleled background!
Of course,
most girls, in addition to envy, still more looked forward to knowing and befriending a rich and handsome guy like Ding Ling.
To marry someone young, wealthy, talented, knowledgeable, brave, and from a good family background!
Isn’t that the dream of many women?
No doubt about it.
Ding Ling meets these girls’ dreams. At least most of them think so.
Ding Ling, of course, wouldn’t expect that he has been ’verified’ as a top-tier rich and handsome man.
If he knew, he would only say that rumors are powerful, and then laugh it off.
Game World.
Ding Ling awoke, called the soldiers guarding outside, and asked about the situation.
Only then did he find out.

Dozens of them.

’It seems that many masters in the real world can only count as proficient in basic skills in the game world.’

chapters.title: Chapter 29: Juyi’s Provocation
paragraphs: Because the time spent here was relatively long, some Bai Bo bandits took advantage of the night to escape, and quite a few did so.
"General, should we set out now?"
"Set out."
Ding Ling nodded.
He could not manage that part of the Bai Bo bandits who escaped.
However, now that he’s back, he absolutely will not allow such things to happen, and immediately called for a meeting with some officers, stating the implementation of joint punishment methods.
If one Bai Bo bandit escapes, the whole team will be executed; if one team escapes, the entire platoon will be cut down!
This method was very effective.
After beheading no less than a few hundred people.
Seeing Ding Ling was serious.
The Bai Bo bandits were all terrified, some considered resisting, but upon seeing Ding Ling sitting upright on horseback, could not help but lose courage.
Some players hidden among the Bai Bo bandits, upon seeing this, logged off and left quietly.
Each cursing inwardly:
"This Ding Ling is truly a butcher, killing without blinking! Such a ruthless person! Seems like on the battlefield in the future, it’s best to detour around him!"
As for these players.
Ding Ling did not pay them any mind.
Because he couldn’t wait in place for players to log back on.
He didn’t have that much time, nor the inclination to battle players.
He has already embarked on the Path of Glory.
He needs to become a War God for his glory now.
After ten plus hours.
Ding Ling almost chased the Bai Bo bandits to run all the way to Ye City.
Along the way, countless Bai Bo bandits died from exhaustion or collapse.
Those who truly made it to Ye City were lying down, fatigued, not far from the city gate.
The four hundred cavalry all looked at Ding Ling with changed eyes, especially among them, several players thinking:

"Ding Ling has no compassion for enemies, his iron heart is astonishing. A natural-born general! Such a person suits the Three Kingdoms battlefield. After all, there’s no playing games in warfare! Being too merciful might lead to being devoured by enemies until not even bones are left!"
Having experienced various modern society trials.
Players had almost zero tolerance for mercy.
Thus, Ding Ling’s attitude towards the Bai Bo bandits, although extremely uncomfortable for them, still garnered wholehearted recognition and praise for this approach!
They also understood that sparing the Bai Bo bandits might result in more innocent civilian deaths.
Just like not long ago in Zhongqiu Ancient City, how many families were destroyed in an instant?
"General Ding is back!"
"Welcome back, Military Marquis!"
Pan Feng, leading Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, Cheng Huan and others, personally went out of the city to welcome Ding Ling.
He had long before received the news of Ding Ling’s great victory.
How so?
Because the scouts from Ye City had already interacted with Ding Ling’s troops, and after learning everything, quickly returned to Ye City to inform Pan Feng of the news.
Upon hearing it, Pan Feng was ecstatic, publicly praising Ding Ling extensively.
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan and others also echoed continuously, affirming Pan Feng’s wisdom!
Pan Feng heard and felt increasingly delighted, greatly appreciating Ding Ling making him proud.
Believing the risk taken on his own would surely offer richer rewards!
This is why Pan Feng decisively led the crowd to greet Ding Ling and cheer him on.
"Greetings to General Pan, General Zhang, General Gao..."
Ding Ling gracefully dismounted, hung the Heaven-piercing Halberd on the side of the strong horse, and walked up to Pan Feng and the others, greeting them one by one.
Seeing Ding Ling, after his great victory, showing neither arrogance nor excitement, neither fear nor joy, Pan Feng, Zhang Hex and their group inwardly praised:
"This young man’s temperament is becoming increasingly stable, surely destined for greatness!"
[Achievement Medal Earned: You have gained the recognition of all officials in the Jizhou camp]

[Notes: Your great victory news, under Pan Feng, Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, Cheng Huan’s deliberate embellishment and publicity, has spread throughout the Jizhou camp, every general knows your deeds and is curious about you! Wants to learn more about you!]
The prompt sounded timely.
Ding Ling paused slightly, then very composedly continued chatting with Pan Feng and others.
Pan Feng evidently satisfied with Ding Ling, under full gaze, extolling Ding Ling greatly:

"As far as I know, the group of thugs led by Guo Tai, Hu Cai, Hann Xian among the Bai Bo bandits rampaged through regions like Bingzhou, leaving devastation as wildfire, almost nothing grows where they go, a veritable pack of scoundrels. Yet many officials have no way of dealing with them.
Ding Ling defeats them in one battle! Truly remarkable!
His position as Military Marquis is truly unworthy! I will later recommend Ding Ling to Governor of Jizhou, to have him stationed at Changshan County as a Military General for guarding one region!"
As these words left the mouth.
The entire army was in an uproar!
Except for a few like Zhang Hex, everyone present felt Pan Feng’s decision was indeed excessive!
After all, Ding Ling was just a regular soldier a few days ago!
How long has it been?
And now he’s about to be promoted again!
Isn’t that absurd!
Many expressed opposition.
Among them, Juyi’s faction’s dissent was the strongest.

Juyi, also known as Qu Yi, with a stern face and sturdy physique, famous far and wide for his ability in combat, in future battles like Jieqiao, he defeated Gongsun Zan’s twenty thousand infantry and ten thousand cavalry with just eight hundred soldiers! His fame shook the world in one battle!
But due to arrogance from high merit was killed by Yuan Shao.
To such a fierce character.
Ding Ling didn’t know him at first.
It was only after getting familiar with Cheng Huan, Zhang Hex, they introduced some officials from Jizhou to him.
Only then did Ding Ling recognize Juyi.
Seeing Juyi now opposing him so fiercely, he was surprised, a bit unclear but after thinking slightly he became understanding.
His promotion did indeed come quickly, being envied and feared by Juyi was quite normal.
"Juyi."
Pan Feng furrowed his brow, looked unpleasantly at Juyi and said:
"You think you’re better than Ding Ling?"
"You have to fight to know."
Juyi stepped out, holding a crossbow in one hand and a spear in the other, looking directly at Ding Ling:

"If I wanted to fight you before, others would say I bullied you with size and oppressed with power, but now your status is equal, fame is equal. I suppose if I wanted to spar with you now, you wouldn’t refuse me, would you?"
"I dare not."
Ding Ling, courteous and poised, showed his demeanor:
"If General Juyi wants to spar with me, I would be honored."
This was his heartfelt thought.
The Path of the War God must defeat over twenty plane powerhouses.
Juyi likely possesses the qualifications as a plane powerhouse.
Once they spoke openly.
Pan Feng couldn’t stop them.
Just saying that the city gate is not a place for duel sparring and needs to go to the arena.
Juyi and Ding Ling did not object.
At once, a group headed toward the arena.
As for the Bai Bo bandits, they were assigned to do hard labor, and the heads of Guo Tai and others had been sent to Governor of Jizhou Han Fu’s mansion.
These were proof of Ding Ling’s achievements, and could not be allowed to be lost.
Naturally arranged by Pan Feng to be sent to Han Fu promptly.
A while later.
The arena.
Players who received the news surrounded the place, leaving no room to move.

chapters.title: Chapter 30: Dragon-Tiger Stance
paragraphs: "Who do you think will win this time?"
The players were excited and thrilled, just like onlookers watching celebrities fight:
"It has to be Juyi, right? Isn’t it obvious?"

"I think it’s Juyi too! Juyi is the Commander-in-Chief of the First Assault Warriors! The secret techniques passed down through his family are incredibly powerful. He’s a true first-class fierce general! No matter how strong Ding Ling is, how could he possibly be a match for him?"

"Not necessarily. Isn’t Ding Ling currently ranked first on the comprehensive ranking list and second on the power ranking? Plus, he knows the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, Battlefield Saber Technique, and Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique and other martial arts! Maybe he could defeat Juyi!"
"Are you kidding me? Ding Ling is a newbie player! No matter how powerful, how could he be stronger than the legendary Juyi?"
The players were divided into two camps.
Most believed that Juyi would definitely win.

A small number thought that Ding Ling had a chance of winning, after all, Ding Ling is likely a super-elite from a hidden noble clan in the real world! Such a talented person confronting Juyi might unexpectedly turn the tides in his favor!
A very few were convinced that Ding Ling would win.
This minority was made up of players who had witnessed Ding Ling’s display of power outside Zhongqiu Ancient City.
Ding Ling killed mighty figures like Guo Tai with ease, as if he was playing.
These players were deeply shocked!
They came to watch naturally choosing to support Ding Ling.
The on-site debates were endless.
Some even took the opportunity to start betting with silver on who would win.
Juyi couldn’t wait to grab his weapon and step onto the arena.
You could tell.
He was a decisive and extremely competitive person.
He also believed that he was destined to win.
Even though the Jizhou Camp had already spread Ding Ling’s talents as something extraordinary.
But Juyi didn’t buy it.
He thought Ding Ling was probably a fraud, how could it be possible that someone could learn martial arts after just hearing about it once or twice?!
Does he think Juyi is a fool?
As for why Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and Cheng Huan were willing to ’clear Ding Ling’s name’?
Juyi just thought they were all in cahoots, thick as thieves!
"Today, I, Juyi, will utterly crush this unhealthy trend!"
Juyi had big ambitions.
He was not content with just being a captain.
He wanted to climb higher. Beating Ding Ling and reducing Pan Feng’s prestige was just the first step!
"Why isn’t Ding Ling here yet?"
Juyi looked straight ahead: "Is he scared?"
Of course, Ding Ling was not afraid.
He didn’t go to the center of the arena right away. Instead, he found Pan Feng and asked him for the secrets of the ’Dragon-Tiger Stance Skill’.
Pan Feng was astonished and bewildered:
"At this point, you still have the mind to learn Dragon-Tiger Stance Skill?!"
Isn’t this just a desperate attempt to learn something last minute?

"True. Temporary honing may not help others much, but you’re different!"

A moment later.
[Dragon-Tiger Stance Skill is Full Level]
[Strength +0.8]
[Agility +0.8]
[Constitution +0.8]
Crack!
Ding Ling’s body grew slightly taller again.
This time he seemed to break through a certain bottleneck, his aura as a fierce general became more intense.
Standing there, he gave off a sense of overwhelming power!
"You?!"
Pan Feng was dumbfounded.
"Not bad."
Ding Ling smiled: "Thank you, General, for teaching. I’ve already mastered Dragon-Tiger Stance Skill!"
Compared to the Horse Stance Skill, which adds 0.4 to strength, agility, and constitution.
Dragon-Tiger Stance Skill adds 0.8!
It deserves its name!
After the three stats increased.
Now Ding Ling’s scores were:
Strength broke through ten!
Ding Ling felt like he was transforming, stepping into a new world!
His five senses were extraordinarily sharp, not only improving by a notch compared to before but his stability and resilience in all aspects had doubled!
It seemed like only an increase of 0.8 points.
But his physical qualities underwent an earth-shaking transformation.
As if from mortal to immortal!
Like a chrysalis becoming a butterfly.
The whole person seemed to be reborn.
"Is this super-elite or top first-class fierce general?"
Ding Ling clenched his fist, feeling a surging power flowing through his arm.
"Really?"
Ninety percent of Pan Feng believed it because of Ding Ling’s previous performance, and ten percent was skeptical, because he himself had to practice the Dragon-Tiger Stance Skill for a long time!
Training was calculated in years!

It’s safe to say, aside from mastering esoteric Breathing Technique and naturally transparent learning of Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques, in other areas, Pan Feng wasn’t much different from regular geniuses.
Precisely because he studied for a long time, Pan Feng couldn’t believe Ding Ling learned it after one glance!
Ding Ling didn’t waste words and demonstrated directly.
Whoosh!
With a deep breath, Ding Ling leaped slightly, resembling a tiger landing on the ground, a monstrous evil qi burst from his body, with Pan Feng bearing the brunt, causing him to gasp:
"This, this is indeed the state achieved only when Tiger Stance Skill in Dragon-Tiger Stance Skill reaches perfection! He really mastered it? What about Dragon Walk Skill?"

Ding Ling’s body rotated slightly, changing as he pleased, naturally and effortlessly, a moment later, switched to the mode of Dragon Walk Skill, looking prone on the ground, his body slightly inclined, but the upper body was suspended in the air, both feet firmly planted, resembling a flying Divine Dragon in the sky, seemingly disappearing at any moment!
Giving a strong impact as if a true dragon descended to earth!
"Hiss!"
Pan Feng’s eye twitched, unable to help exclaiming:
"This is the indication of Dragon Walk Skill being perfected. You’ve really mastered it!"
He had some doubt:
"Ding Ling, are you sure you haven’t learned Dragon-Tiger Stance Skill before?"
"Yes."
Pan Feng was speechless, sighing:
"Truly a top genius. I am not as good as you!"
[Gained an Achievement Medal: You Made Pan Feng Feel Ashamed!]

[Note: Due to your defying performance, Pan Feng felt deeply ashamed of his previous arrogance and conceit! He realized for the first time that he might not be a genius after all! In front of a true genius, Pan Feng is just a mediocre talent! You are the true prodigy in his eyes!]
Another achievement medal.
Ding Ling was surprised.
He knew he had earned an [E-level Achievement Medal] from Pan Feng before!
How could he earn another achievement medal now?
Ding Ling was initially puzzled.
Then he speculated:
’Could it be that an E-level achievement medal can be earned again as an ordinary medal?’
What the truth was.
Ding Ling didn’t know.
He might have to go back to the player plaza to check the manual for the answer.
But it’s a good thing, Ding Ling didn’t think much about it and said to Pan Feng:

chapters.title: Chapter 31: Battlefield Saber Technique vs. First Assault Secret Technique
paragraphs: "General, you’re too modest. Your talent is unparalleled in Jizhou, and people praise you as an Unrivaled Divine General. Compared to you, I still have a long way to go!"
"You’re quite good."
Pan Feng glanced sideways, extending a large hand to pat Ding Ling on the shoulder, expressing his admiration:
"Such a genius, yet you’re neither arrogant nor impatient. Truly rare. When I was your age, I wasn’t as steady as you."
He smiled slightly, gesturing to Ding Ling that he didn’t need to comfort him:
"I know myself well. Comparing myself to before, now my killing qi and blood qi are no longer as strong."
He looked at Ding Ling:
"Young talents like you are the future. By the way."
He candidly told Ding Ling:
"I plan to send you to Changshan County as a military general and have you deliver a greeting card to Tong Yuan. Have you heard of Tong Yuan? The renowned Penglai Spear God!"
Ding Ling nodded.
Who hasn’t heard of Tong Yuan, after reading Romance of the Three Kingdoms?
The master of the mighty Three Kingdoms Zhao Zilong, Zhang Xiu, and Zhang Ren!
"As long as you know. I won’t say more."
Pan Feng smiled mysteriously:
"Once you defeat Juyi, have met the lord, and truly become a military general of Changshan County, I’ll give you a surprise."
"Oh?"
What kind of surprise could Pan Feng offer?
Ding Ling was quite looking forward to it.
"Ding Ling."
At this moment, Zhang Hex rushed in and said to Ding Ling:
"Are you sure you want to duel Juyi?"
"Yes."
Ding Ling nodded.
"There’s a lot of buzz outside now, and many are convinced you can’t beat Juyi. Even Juyi thinks you’re afraid and hence haven’t dared to fight him yet!"
"Ridiculous."
Pan Feng chuckled: "Ding Ling fearing Juyi?"
He was confident: "Ding Ling will definitely win this battle!"
Having witnessed Ding Ling’s talent and the momentum he had just unleashed, Pan Feng knew that Ding Ling must have broken through some bottleneck, entering a new realm!
This was precisely when Ding Ling’s sharpness was at its peak, how could he possibly fail?
"I think so too."
Zhang Hex nodded, then, turning his tone slightly worried, he said:
"But if Ding Ling is defeated, the consequences could be severe. Not only would Ding Ling’s future suffer, his reputation would plummet, but even your prestige, General, would be affected."
"I believe in Ding Ling."
Pan Feng gave Ding Ling a look, "Ding Ling, I support you!"
"Thank you, General, for your kindness!"
Ding Ling saluted, then, holding the Heaven-piercing Halberd, walked out with head held high.
Encountering people in Jizhou like Cheng Huan, Zhang Hex, Pan Feng, and Gao Lan who appreciate talent is truly rare.
Encountering people like Juyi, who are arrogant and jealous of him, is also quite normal.
Ding Ling maintained a very positive mindset.
For his own people, he wouldn’t provoke trouble, but he would never be afraid of trouble either!
Soon.
Ding Ling arrived at the arena.
As soon as he appeared.
The scene erupted.
Cheers, shouts... the sounds were incessant, echoing through the sky.
Especially the bystander players, their shouts were the loudest, infecting even numerous NPCs who joined in, shouting and yelling.
"Ding Ling, I love you!"
"Ding Ling, I want to bear your child!"
Among them, a few female voices peculiarly drilled into Ding Ling’s ears.
Ding Ling paused slightly, glanced sideways.
Indeed, it was two heavily made-up women shouting at him.
Seeing Ding Ling glance over, the two women looked faint as if they were about to faint, inwardly overjoyed:

"Ding Ling looked at me, he looked at me! He must like me. Oh my, oh my! I’ve caught the eye of a top-notch wealthy guy, what should I do, what should I do? Should I freshen up and personally deliver myself to his room later, or wait modestly for him to come?"
Ever since some women learned that Ding Ling was a top-notch wealthy guy from a Hidden Clan, they tried every means to ensnare Ding Ling, the wealthy man.
Clearly, these two women were among them, they even went to the extent of spending heavily, bribing the gatekeepers to sneak into this arena.
Ding Ling, however, was unaware of the reason, somewhat baffled, thinking;
"When did my charm become so great?! Impossible."
He glanced at the character panel, and his Charm Value was still 2 points, unchanged.
He was utterly confused.
But he didn’t have time to think more.
Because Juyi was already scrutinizing, even looking down on him.
Click clack!
Ding Ling briskly walked to the center of the arena, confronting Juyi directly.
Juyi laughed heartily:
"I thought you were too cowardly to come!
His eyes were fixed on Ding Ling:
"I’ll give you a chance to surrender, otherwise, once we really start fighting, I won’t hold back!"
"Is that so?"
Ding Ling was unfazed, smiling slightly, responding with action, clang! His Heaven-piercing Halberd quivered, its sharpness sweeping in all directions:
"I really want to experience General Ju’s martial arts."
"I hope you won’t regret it."
Juyi’s eyes flashed with a fierce glint, he gave Ding Ling a deep look, then suddenly leaped, twirling the long spear in his hand, thrusting it towards Ding Ling!
The ancestral First Assault Secret Technique surged in his body!

With every breath, a mysterious force circulated within, then infused into his right arm, making it seem as if it had the power to support the heavens. With a roar, the spear emitted the sound of wind and thunder.
With a single spear, he forcefully manifested a dragon python big enough to swallow the heavens!
The people below were astonished.
Ding Ling was also slightly taken aback, he mustered all his strength, the Battlefield Saber Technique was activated, thrusting the Heaven-piercing Halberd towards Juyi’s position, boom!
A fierce Battlefield Martial Qi transformed into whirlwinds rushing towards Juyi.
One spear, one halberd!
As soon as they contacted.
It was like a meteor crashing onto Earth! Instantly entering the white heat stage!
Clang clang clang!
The long spear and halberd constantly clashed, emitting the metallic sounds of battle, deafening, many people’s eardrums trembled, feeling dizzy.
They were astonished, each one staring wide-eyed into the arena.
Boom!
In a blink, after exchanging ten rounds, Juyi fought more and more fiercely, suddenly with a flick of his left hand, a crossbow arrow shot explosively towards Ding Ling’s head.
Ding Ling was taken aback, activating the High Sensitivity, the Dragon-Tiger Stance showed its might, his body tilted slightly, resembling a true dragon lying low, dodging the arrow.
Without even looking back, he launched the Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique, sweeping towards Juyi with a mighty sweep.
Boom!
This strike was mighty and forceful!
It encompassed the entire essence of the Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique, its sweep making the void tremble, emitting a woeful moan.
"What?!"
Juyi was shocked, he couldn’t believe Ding Ling would suddenly change tactics, caught off guard, having no choice but to instinctively defend with his spear in front of him.
Boom! A heavy impact, the halberd’s shaft met the spear, blasting Juyi flying out with an explosive force!
Thud!
Juyi fell off the arena platform.
Rolling on the ground, he got up somewhat embarrassed, having diffused the dreadful force.

chapters.title: Chapter 32: War God Path Progress Bar
paragraphs: "Thanks for letting me win."
Ding Ling clasped his hands toward Juyi.
Juyi’s face was ashen, full of unwillingness and defiance.
"What’s wrong?"
Pan Feng stood on the high platform, looking at Juyi below the ring:
"Juyi, do you still want to compete?"
"Indeed."
Juyi was indeed straightforward:
"I wasn’t prepared just now! This time, I’ll definitely win."
Hiss!
The whole arena erupted in boos.
Some girls were booing the loudest!
And without exception, these girls were players!

Juyi was annoyed and angry by the boos, especially seeing women at the arena, he became furious, thinking that once the competition was over, he must properly discipline the gatekeeper! How dare they let some women into the camp!
If women were dressed as soldiers, it wouldn’t be too much.
But these women were heavily made up, which was truly eye-catching. Defeated, Juyi noticed this scene and was naturally enraged.
On the contrary, Pan Feng was happy and didn’t bother with these minor details. After all, the arena wasn’t a solemn and serious place, and public participation was not a problem.
"Then let’s go again."
Ding Ling didn’t hear the relevant alert sound, couldn’t help but check the character panel.
There was no progress bar for the Path of the War God.
He couldn’t help but feel puzzled.
Seeing Juyi still wanting to compete, he simply went along with it.
"Alright."
Without waiting for Pan Feng to speak, Juyi jumped onto the arena stage again, holding a crossbow in one hand and a spear in the other, his aura skyrocketing, Evil Qi rising fiercely:
"Ding Ling, you’re even stronger than I imagined. This time I won’t show mercy."
Ding Ling smiled without saying a word, disinclined to provoke him.

Juyi understood Ding Ling’s smile, his face becoming increasingly unsightly. Without more words, he let out a loud shout, fully activating the First Assault Secret Technique, turning the spear in his hand into a bolt of lightning, aimed at Ding Ling’s neck and heart.
Ding Ling already understood Juyi’s spear and crossbow techniques!
Prepared.
The halberd in his hand sometimes transformed into a fierce single-bladed vertical slash, battlefield aura overflowing, intimidating a region;
At other times it turned into a Dragon-Caging Staff, each strike and sweep carrying a majestic wind!
Sometimes it became a giant axe seemingly capable of splitting heaven and earth, one swing and the world seemed to tear apart!
This time.
It’s only within ten moves.

Juyi was struck on the arm by the Celestial Spirit Axe Technique, cried out in pain, the spear fell to the ground, and before he could use the crossbow arrow, the halberd with a very clever move rose, hooking, right on Juyi’s other arm.
Bam!
Juyi cried out in pain again, the crossbow in his hand fell to the ground too.
"Thanks for letting me win."
Ding Ling clasped his hands and said.
Juyi was speechless, his face alternating between green and white, seemingly unable to face Ding Ling anymore, he turned quickly, jumped off the stage, and hurried away.
He didn’t even want the weapons left on the stage.
"In this battle. Ding Ling wins!"
Cheng Huan couldn’t wait to jump on stage and announce the results.
All at once.
Cheers like thunder.
Of course, there were more discussions and arguments:
"I can’t believe that the renowned, famous, War God-like presence of Juyi actually lost! This is too unbelievable. You have to know that Ding Ling is a newcomer!"

"Yes. Before, I also thought he was sure to lose. Didn’t expect he’d win so cleanly and decisively. If he hadn’t held back, Juyi might have already died on the stage! Such combat power is terrifying. How did he train?!"
Previous doubters were incredulous.
And those sure of Ding Ling, who bet on Ding Ling winning, were in ecstatic joy:

"I knew Ding Ling, a person ranked number one on the comprehensive ranking list, would win! After all, he’s one of the first among us players. If he lost to Juyi, how could he face Lü Bu, Zhao Zilong, and others?!"
"Exactly. Ranked number one among tens of billions of humans, that’s quite remarkable! Ding Ling, being from the Hidden Clan, winning is quite normal!"
The skeptics couldn’t help but counterattack the supporters.
But the supporters had a sentence that left the skeptics speechless: "You bet on Juyi losing, we bet on Ding Ling winning, the facts are in front of us, do you still dare to argue with us here?"
The skeptics were completely defeated!
[Achievement Medal: You’ve earned Juyi’s respect!]
[Note: Juyi is proud in nature, only respecting strong individuals, looking down on the weak and inappropriate conduct! He disdains forming cliques or debates! An honest, brave person!
Without a doubt, confronting him twice directly! Winning fairly, openly!
You thoroughly impressed him!
Leaving him embarrassed, ashamed!
In the future, if he encounters you, he will likely choose to avoid you!
Because you didn’t injure his vital parts or severely damage his arms, he feels both grateful and ashamed! Therefore, he holds great respect for you!]
Ding Ling glanced at the character panel.
Somewhat surprised to have received another Achievement Medal.
He originally thought after getting the Achievement Medal for [winning the recognition of all Generals in the Jizhou Camp], it would be impossible to earn another medal from them.
Apparently, he misunderstood.
The previous Achievement Medal might have only been for generals recognizing his ’contribution in eliminating enemies’.
’What about the Path of Glory?’
Ding Ling flipped to the bottom of the character panel.
He saw it clearly now.
[Progress of Path of Glory/Path of the War God is as follows:]
[1: Defeat over 20 plane strong individuals: 1/20.]
Progress for 2, 3, etc. is still 0.
Only progress for 1 jumped forward a scale.
Ding Ling pondered:
"It seems only when someone sincerely admits defeat does it count as complete victory?"
Undoubtedly.
This progress bar surely came from Juyi.
Juyi is indeed a good hand among the first-class fierce generals!
If Ding Ling hadn’t timely mastered Dragon-Tiger Stance to enhance himself and break through the shackles, he definitely wouldn’t have won so easily.
"Congratulations on your victory."
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and others also congratulated him.
Ding Ling smiled in return.
"Now there’s no obstacle on your path to advancement."
Pan Feng laughed heartily:
"To even subdue the headstrong Juyi. I wonder who else would dare to wildly claim you’re just a silver spear head! Come, let’s go meet the master!"
Pan Feng led the way, taking Ding Ling and the group to the Governor of Jizhou’s residence.
While some players in the arena were still discussing Ding Ling.
Some female players were also following behind Ding Ling shouting:
"Ding Ling, how about leaving a phone number?"
"Ding Ling, my home is at... My number is... Remember to contact me! I’m available anytime!"
Although Pan Feng didn’t understand what a phone number meant, he saw the enthusiasm from female players and couldn’t help but admire:
"Ding Ling, to have reserved women chase you publicly. You’re the first I’ve seen! That’s amazing!"

chapters.title: Chapter 33: Competing in Painting Skills with Jushou
paragraphs: Ding Ling was speechless.
He was quite confused himself.
Although he was much more formidable than other players,
it was only in the game. No one could know that he had already redeemed all his strength and returned to the real world, so why were these people so fanatical about him?
Especially these women, it was simply baffling.
Just a few days ago, he was still single!
Women in the company couldn’t be bothered to take a second look at him!
Now, suddenly acting like this, the contrast from before was too great, even Ding Ling was a bit bewildered.
Of course, he also speculated that it might be related to him becoming more handsome, ranking first on the combined leaderboard, and his recent good performance.
But wasn’t this a bit much?
"Seeing your expression. Could it be that you don’t know what’s going on either?"
Zhang Hex gave Ding Ling a strange look and said:
"If not, you could personally go and ask those women, or I could ask for you?"
"Forget it."
Ding Ling shook his head.
What the players thought was none of his business.
He just wanted to complete the Path of Glory in the Three Kingdoms World.
The Glory Medal had tremendous benefits and couldn’t be missed.
Of course, the most crucial thing was that he had already rented a house in the countryside! Living at the foot of a mountain, it was practically impossible for anyone to find him.
With safety assured, there was no need to overly focus on player dynamics.
Some time later.
Jizhou Governor’s Mansion.
Hann Fu sat at the head of the table.
He was scrutinizing Ding Ling.
Not just him,
Tian Feng, Jushou, Geng Wu, Min Chun, Xun Chen, and others were all fixated on Ding Ling, examining him closely.
Without exception,
they were all formidable figures renowned in later generations.
Ding Ling knew about them, thanks to Zhang Hex whispering introductions beside him.
"Your major achievements have alarmed Tian Feng, Jushou, Geng Wu, and all of them, hence their presence at this meeting."
Gao Lan quietly added:
"News of your recent defeat of Juyi has also reached their ears. Looks like you’ll face fewer challenges ahead."
And indeed, this was the case.
Initially, many questioned Ding Ling’s martial arts prowess.
Yet, under everyone’s gaze, Ding Ling defeated the valiant Jizhou General Juyi twice in face-to-face combat, proving with undeniable facts that his prowess was not just talk!
"I’ve already seen the heads of Guo Tai and the others."
Hann Fu paused for a moment, then said:
"I also mentioned earlier that I would promote you immediately after you dealt with the bandit leaders. Now it’s time to fulfill my promise."
"My lord."
Jushou couldn’t hold back and stepped out to oppose:
"Ding Ling is an alien, a mere recruit, yet General Pan has already promoted him. If our lord promotes him again, it might not be fair and could breed resentment!"
Ding Ling took a glance at Jushou. This guy wasn’t loyal to Hann Fu, yet he still called him ’lord’?
Compared to Tian Feng, Jushou seemed much more cunning!
But who knew if Jushou had contacted Yuan Shao yet?
If he had, Hann Fu’s tenure as Governor of Jizhou might soon end.
Ding Ling thought: if that’s the case, I’d better find a way out quickly.
Serving as a general under Yuan Shao?
Better to go solo!
Ding Ling just thought going solo was too time-consuming and demanding, and besides, he chose the Path of the War God, making being a general the best fit for him.
If that’s the case, then surely choosing the most capable and charismatic person to serve as a great general was the way to go.
’Cao Mengde...’
This name flashed through Ding Ling’s mind.
While Cao Mengde had his flaws, at least he recognized talent and wouldn’t look down on those from humble beginnings!
Moreover, Ding Ling wasn’t just involved in the Three Kingdoms Plane; once he completed the Path of the War God, it would probably be nearly time for him to leave this plane.
How to unlock other planes?
Ding Ling knew it was related to the Achievement Medal, but he also suspected it was tied to the Path of Glory.
Therefore, choosing a good leader was crucial.
He had no regard for people like Hann Fu or Yuan Shao.
"Captain, that’s going too far."
Pan Feng couldn’t help but stand up and retort angrily:

"Ding Ling’s military exploits are outstanding. The Bandits Bai Bo, who gave many headaches, were handled by him with just 400 troops. Doesn’t that prove his martial prowess? He’s entirely qualified to be a general!
If anyone’s unconvinced, they can step up and challenge Ding Ling. I believe Ding Ling can definitely make you all convinced!"
Jushou was speechless; how could a scholar like him compete with Ding Ling in martial arts?
He voiced this thought.
Pan Feng asked:
"So what do you want to compete in?"
"Chess, calligraphy, military strategy, governance, astronomy, geography, music, arithmetic, painting—they’re all options."
Jushou was confident, giving Ding Ling a sidelong glance:
"Just beat me in any one of these, and I’ll shut up."
He looked at Ding Ling, eyes bright:
"What does the Military Marquis think?"
"Alright."
Ding Ling smiled lightly:
"Let’s compete in painting then."
"Good."
Jushou didn’t flinch and immediately looked to Hann Fu, indicating his stance.
Hann Fu was also very interested, wanting to see how this match would turn out.
After all, Jushou was a renowned scholar in Jizhou!
Whereas in his eyes, Ding Ling was just an alien with no organization, discipline, or family background!
Just a soldier by birth, with no background to speak of, how could he possibly stand up to Jushou?
He already seemed to see Ding Ling’s embarrassment.
It wasn’t just him.
Many present believed Ding Ling was sure to lose!
After all, Jushou’s fame was widespread, and he was said to be proficient in music, chess, calligraphy, and painting—not just an empty boast!
Before long.
Paper and ink were ready.
Perhaps due to players joining the Three Kingdoms game.
The ’paper’ development in the Three Kingdoms suddenly surged to modern craftsmanship standards!
Extremely exquisite!
Especially the paper used by Hann Fu, the Governor of Jizhou, was as smooth and thick as satin.

While secretly marveling at how the Three Kingdoms World had been warped, Ding Ling didn’t hesitate to wield his brush, and in just a moment, a vivid landscape painting emerged before everyone’s eyes.
In terms of painting.
Ding Ling’s skills had already peaked!
Especially after returning to the real world, he, to be prepared for anything, thoroughly honed all various painting skills in the web world.
Now in painting, Ding Ling could truly claim to be at the Grandmaster Level with no exaggeration.
One painting.
Not only completed quickly,
but also with such spirit that if not looked at closely, one might think the mountains and rivers in the painting were real!
"Amazing!"
Tian Feng, Geng Wu, and others, well-versed in knowledge, understood it immediately, astonished and shaken:
"Such painting skill! It’s incredibly strong!! Jushou is sure to lose!"
"To think that a mere martial artist could be so perfect in painting. This skill level is probably already at the superb Painting Saint realm!"
Min Chun, including Hann Fu, couldn’t help but exclaim in surprise, starting to regard Ding Ling with seriousness.
[Achievement Medal earned: Your painting skills have gained high recognition from the scholars present!]
[Note: Tian Feng, Geng Wu, Hann Fu, and others initially thought of you as just a martial artist, often treating you with neglect and disdain...]

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Calligraphy Contest with Tian Feng
paragraphs: [...But your powerful painting skills have proven yourself! You shocked all of them, making them feel ashamed!
Because they all know, in terms of painting skills, no one can surpass you!
Your painting has reached the Sacred Realm! It is not something these ordinary folks can compare to!]
Another Achievement Medal.
Ding Ling slightly calmed down, feeling confident inside.
As expected.
Soon after.
Jushou admitted defeat without finishing his painting and said admiringly:
"In the field of painting, I am ashamed of my inferiority, so I won’t compete with you to avoid making a fool of myself."
His painting wasn’t even complete.

However, after witnessing Ding Ling’s artwork, he was deeply moved, feeling that even if he worked hard for another ten years, he might not catch up to Ding Ling in painting. Continuing to paint forcibly would be meaningless and would only invite ridicule for being a sore loser.
Jushou was clearly a person who could afford to lose and let go, and he expressed to Hann Fu on the spot:
"I think General Pan is right, with such talent, Ding Ling being a General has no major issue."
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You earned Jushou’s respect and recognition.]
[Note: Undoubtedly, you have directly defeated him in the field of painting. You made him choose to remain silent and surrender.]
Ding Ling’s eyes gleamed slightly.
Got another one.
It seems my previous guess was indeed correct.
This is the best and fastest place to harvest medals from the famous!
"Hmm."
Hann Fu nodded and was about to agree.
Tian Feng stepped out, bowed to Hann Fu, and then pointed to Ding Ling, saying:
"My Lord, I want to contend with General Ding."
He directly addressed him as General Ding.
It shows Tian Feng has also recognized Ding Ling’s status, talent, and martial arts.
"Oh?"
Hann Fu’s interest grew stronger:
"What do you want to compete in?"
"That depends on what General Ding says."
Tian Feng looked at Ding Ling, paused, and added, "Of course, not in painting."
Ding Ling smiled: "Then let’s compete in calligraphy."
Competitions can earn achievement medals.
Ding Ling couldn’t wish for more.
He wanted to activate the legendary storage space last time.
But there weren’t enough achievement medals to activate it.
This time, he planned to earn more to try.
"Alright. Come, prepare ink quickly."
Hann Fu, like an excited onlooker, shouted.
Scholars love competitions in music, chess, calligraphy, and painting.
It’s just like how basketball players love to watch basketball games. Not surprising.
After a while.
Ding Ling wrote a row of characters in flowing script:
The road to knowledge is diligence!
The sea of learning is bounded by hardship!
The brushwork is powerful, and the vigorous qi is like the sea!
Each of the dozen words is like a knife or sword, as if engraved on one’s heart door!
This is a superb calligraphy work of unparalleled excellence.
Not only is there no flaw to be found,
it also carries a special charm within.
Everyone was amazed.
"This, this, this is an extraordinary masterpiece!"
"Unbelievable. Ding Ling’s martial arts are already amazing, but how can both his painting and calligraphy also reach the Transformation Realm?!"
"Yes. It’s already remarkable for ordinary people to reach the Transformation Realm in one field in a lifetime. How can Ding Ling be so extraordinary?!"
Jushou, including Tian Feng and Hann Fu, were all shocked, each looking at Ding Ling with eyes that changed yet again.
This time it was not only more respectful and admiring, but also carried a hint of shock and disbelief.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Your calligraphy work has gained high recognition from the civil and military officials of Jizhou!]

[Note: Your calligraphy has entered the Transformation Realm. Reaching a peak level that many can never achieve in a lifetime! What’s more, your work combines the essence of calligraphy from all dynasties.
Comparing with Tian Feng from the Three Kingdoms Era is like dimensional reduction attack!]
Ding Ling heard the prompt, nodded slightly, and thought: It seems spending time practicing calligraphy skills from various eras in the real world has been very effective!
Top calligraphers from various periods, such as Wang Xizhi, Yan Zhenqing, Zhang Zhi, and the scripts and posts they created.
All were used by Ding Ling to hone his calligraphy skills!
It is imaginable how high Ding Ling’s calligraphy standard is now!
"I lost."
Tian Feng admitted defeat dejectedly, but soon cast aside his negative emotions and looked at Ding Ling with admiration:
"For someone of your age to be so adept in calligraphy is truly extraordinary. I concede defeat to you, wholeheartedly and sincerely!"
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You have impressed Tian Feng.]
[Note: Tian Feng intended to test your capabilities. But your weight was so immense, it almost crushed his confidence! He once doubted his own life, feeling his noble title was just superficial!
Otherwise, how could he be overwhelmed by a martial artist like you in calligraphy, his strength?]
Ding Ling smiled slightly upon hearing this.
All are honest people here.
These achievement medals are being ’given’ very conveniently.
"Who else wants to compete?"
Ding Ling looked expectantly at the other scholars.
Jushou and others glanced at each other, clearly seeing the confusion, bewilderment, shame, embarrassment, and guilt in each other’s eyes...
Confusion arose from Ding Ling’s eagerness to compete?!
What is going on?
The shame and embarrassment stemmed from so many nobles being overshadowed by a military general. Such news would be embarrassing!
"I’ll do it."
Xun Chen stepped forward with confidence, looked directly at Ding Ling, and said aloud, "I want to compete with you in chess! But do you dare?"
"What’s there to be afraid of?"
Ding Ling smiled slightly: "I accept!"
"Hmm?"

Xun Chen was taken aback, and after confirming he had heard it right, seeing Ding Ling’s calm demeanor, he became apprehensive, but quickly regained confidence, just because he didn’t believe one could reach the pinnacle in martial arts, painting, calligraphy, and chess simultaneously!
And being so young!
Moreover, chess was Xun Family’s specialty, so how could they possibly lose?
Not only did he think so.
Hann Fu, Jushou, Tian Feng, and others were also convinced of Xun Chen’s certain victory, each pondering:

"Xun Chen is from the Xun Family of Yingchuan. His father is one of the eight dragons of the Xun Clan, Xun Gun! Having received a good education from a young age, Xun Chen had long obtained the title of a noble. In a field he excels at, opposing Ding Ling, there’s no way to lose!"
As Hann Fu instructed people to bring over chess pieces, tables, and chairs,
Xun Chen and Ding Ling began their confrontation on the spot.
The two were playing Go.
At the beginning, the moves were made quickly!
All scholars watched unblinkingly.
This included Hann Fu, the Governor of Jizhou, who watched with delight, not even sipping his tea, keeping his eyes fixed.
Meanwhile, the military generals were somewhat uncomfortable.
Those who understood were fine.
But those who didn’t, really felt like sitting on pins and needles, wishing to leave immediately for home.
This included Pan Feng.
He didn’t understand chess.
Looking at the scholarly Tian Feng and Jushou, and military generals Zhang Hex and Gao Lan’s expressions, he felt a bit frustrated, thinking:

sentences.text: [...But your powerful painting skills have proven yourself!
You shocked all of them, making them feel ashamed!
Because they all know, in terms of painting skills, no one can surpass you!
Your painting has reached the Sacred Realm!
It is not something these ordinary folks can compare to!]
Another Achievement Medal.
Ding Ling slightly calmed down, feeling confident inside.
As expected.
Soon after.
Jushou admitted defeat without finishing his painting and said admiringly:
"In the field of painting, I am ashamed of my inferiority, so I won’t compete with you to avoid making a fool of myself."
His painting wasn’t even complete.
However, after witnessing Ding Ling’s artwork, he was deeply moved, feeling that even if he worked hard for another ten years, he might not catch up to Ding Ling in painting.
Continuing to paint forcibly would be meaningless and would only invite ridicule for being a sore loser.
Jushou was clearly a person who could afford to lose and let go, and he expressed to Hann Fu on the spot:
"I think General Pan is right, with such talent, Ding Ling being a General has no major issue."
[Achievement Medal Acquired: You earned Jushou’s respect and recognition.]
[Note: Undoubtedly, you have directly defeated him in the field of painting.
You made him choose to remain silent and surrender.]
Ding Ling’s eyes gleamed slightly.
Got another one.
It seems my previous guess was indeed correct.
This is the best and fastest place to harvest medals from the famous!
"Hmm."
Hann Fu nodded and was about to agree.
Tian Feng stepped out, bowed to Hann Fu, and then pointed to Ding Ling, saying:
"My Lord, I want to contend with General Ding."
He directly addressed him as General Ding.
It shows Tian Feng has also recognized Ding Ling’s status, talent, and martial arts.
"Oh?"
Hann Fu’s interest grew stronger:
"What do you want to compete in?"
"That depends on what General Ding says."
Tian Feng looked at Ding Ling, paused, and added, "Of course, not in painting."
Ding Ling smiled: "Then let’s compete in calligraphy."
Competitions can earn achievement medals.
Ding Ling couldn’t wish for more.
He wanted to activate the legendary storage space last time.
But there weren’t enough achievement medals to activate it.
This time, he planned to earn more to try.
"Alright.
Come, prepare ink quickly."
Hann Fu, like an excited onlooker, shouted.
Scholars love competitions in music, chess, calligraphy, and painting.
It’s just like how basketball players love to watch basketball games.
Not surprising.
After a while.
Ding Ling wrote a row of characters in flowing script:
The road to knowledge is diligence!
The sea of learning is bounded by hardship!
The brushwork is powerful, and the vigorous qi is like the sea!
Each of the dozen words is like a knife or sword, as if engraved on one’s heart door!
This is a superb calligraphy work of unparalleled excellence.
Not only is there no flaw to be found,
it also carries a special charm within.
Everyone was amazed.
"This, this, this is an extraordinary masterpiece!"
"Unbelievable.
Ding Ling’s martial arts are already amazing, but how can both his painting and calligraphy also reach the Transformation Realm?!"
"Yes.
It’s already remarkable for ordinary people to reach the Transformation Realm in one field in a lifetime.
How can Ding Ling be so extraordinary?!"
Jushou, including Tian Feng and Hann Fu, were all shocked, each looking at Ding Ling with eyes that changed yet again.
This time it was not only more respectful and admiring, but also carried a hint of shock and disbelief.
[Achievement Medal Acquired: Your calligraphy work has gained high recognition from the civil and military officials of Jizhou!]
[Note: Your calligraphy has entered the Transformation Realm.
Reaching a peak level that many can never achieve in a lifetime!
What’s more, your work combines the essence of calligraphy from all dynasties.
Comparing with Tian Feng from the Three Kingdoms Era is like dimensional reduction attack!]
Ding Ling heard the prompt, nodded slightly, and thought: It seems spending time practicing calligraphy skills from various eras in the real world has been very effective!
Top calligraphers from various periods, such as Wang Xizhi, Yan Zhenqing, Zhang Zhi, and the scripts and posts they created.
All were used by Ding Ling to hone his calligraphy skills!
It is imaginable how high Ding Ling’s calligraphy standard is now!

chapters.title: Chapter 35: Winning Over All the Prominent Warriors of Jizhou
paragraphs: "Even my subordinates, like Zhang Hex and Gao Lan, can understand the chess manual. But I can’t, it’s so embarrassing. It seems I need to study it well when I have time."
Pan Feng couldn’t understand the chess match, so he quietly asked Zhang Hex about the situation.
Zhang Hex looked astonished and shocked:

"One can only say, the battle is extremely fierce. Especially Ding Ling’s play, it’s like a Heavenly Horse Soaring in the Sky, breaking all norms, always unexpected, catching Xun Chen off guard and in trouble repeatedly. In my opinion, Xun Chen is destined to lose!"
"So strong?"
Pan Feng was surprised:
"This is Xun Chen of the Xun family!"
"Yes."
Zhang Hex sighed in admiration, looking at Ding Ling as if seeing a Divine Being:
"That’s why I say Ding Ling is truly extraordinary! I really wonder what he grew up eating. How can he know everything! And reach an extraordinary level in every area, it truly is awe-inspiring!"
"It’s incredible!"
Cheng Huan was extremely excited, feeling overwhelmed:
"Perhaps discovering Ding Ling at his most down-and-out moment is the most correct, fortunate, and admirable thing I’ve ever done!"
Watching Ding Ling ’cut through thorns and brambles’, crushing various renowned figures!
He felt honored by association.
Gao Lan also shared the same feeling!
After all, compared to others,
He had an excellent relationship with Ding Ling.
The more skilled Ding Ling became and the higher his status in the future, the happier and more honored he felt!
"This guy is just too incredible!"
Among the rows of elite soldiers guarding the council hall doors, there was an old player.
He had seen it all and was truly stunned!

Especially watching Ding Ling win against various renowned figures from the Three Kingdoms, causing them to question themselves, automatically concede defeat, he couldn’t help but click his tongue in secret:
"Could this guy really be from a Hidden Clan?!"
He pondered:
"Which Hidden Clan could possibly raise such an extraordinary person? He’s simply not human, he’s a walking beast!"
After most of the day passed.
"I lost."
Xun Chen’s face was ghostly pale as he shakily stood up to bow to Ding Ling, but Ding Ling stepped back, signaling no need for such formality.
Xun Chen sighed:
"One chess match nearly exhausted all my Essence, Qi, and Spirit. I am now mentally fatigued, but my mind is extremely clear."
He looked at Ding Ling with bright eyes:
"Ding Ling, your chess skills are truly earth-shattering. I want to become chess friends with you, what do you think?"
Could Ding Ling refuse?
To publicly refuse such a request would be putting Xun Chen in a difficult spot.
Ding Ling could only nod in agreement.
Xun Chen was overjoyed, immediately bowing to Ding Ling, saying it’s the etiquette between chess friends.
[Achievement Medal: Your chess skills have astounded everyone present!]

[Annotation: This chess match has been fully replicated by Jushou, Tian Feng, and others. Undoubtedly, this game will spread across the Four Seas and Eight Wildernesses. Your name is destined to be engraved in this match, on these chess manuals!
You will be celebrated for eternity!
In the future, you might earn the title of Chess Saint in the Three Kingdoms World!]
[Achievement Medal: You have gained Xun Chen’s friendship!]

[Annotation: Xun Chen’s chess skills are unmatched within the Xun family! You are the only master he has encountered since his debut! After his defeat, he wanted to apprentice under you to learn chess skills, but considering he’s older and constrained by family rules, arbitrarily apprenticing is inappropriate! Thus, he wants to become friends!
Before fully exploring your chess skills.
He probably won’t let you leave Ye City easily.
Even if you leave Ye City.
He will most likely follow you.
His dedication to chess exceeds your imagination!]
Ding Ling glanced at the Character Panel, feeling pleased yet couldn’t help but be slightly startled at Xun Chen’s special note.
But soon it didn’t bother him.
If Xun Chen wants to follow, so be it.
Anyway, he won’t be associating with Hann Fu or Yuan Shao!
"Magnificent! Absolutely magnificent!"
Hann Fu clapped, exclaiming:
"This chess match truly makes one’s heart dance."
He looked at Jushou:
"Remember to make a copy for me; I need to study it thoroughly upon returning home!"
Jushou nodded.
Only then was Hann Fu satisfied; he looked at Ding Ling and found him increasingly agreeable!
Indeed, the saying that scholars see each other lightly is not false.
But scholars do form groups! Naturally opposed to Military Officers!
Though Hann Fu was the Governor of Jizhou, he valued intellectual opinions more. Pan Feng was the only exception.
Because Pan Feng saved his life and was his hometown fellow! Plus, his skills were truly Unrivaled, making his heavy use understandable.
And this time, he would look at Ding Ling differently.
Naturally, Ding Ling proved his talents to be truly extraordinary!
A master not weaker, maybe stronger than most renowned figures!
Such a master naturally should be honored as a guest of honor!
"Anyone else want to compete?"
Hann Fu eagerly looked around.
He now just wanted to see where Ding Ling’s limits lay.
Immediately, Geng Wu came forward to compete with Ding Ling in geography.
Then Min Chun in playing the Guqin.
Various competitions ensued.
By nightfall.
Had to be interrupted.
At this point, no matter who.
Looking at Ding Ling as if seeing a monster!
"This damn...!"
The elite soldier standing guard, also the old player, hadn’t logged off, kept watching Ding Ling, curious about Ding Ling’s limits.
After watching for so long, he was numb, feeling chills on his scalp!
"Is this person really human?!"
"Too unbelievable!"
"If not seen with my own eyes, who would believe this reality?!"
"Terrifying beyond measure!"
The old player felt both tired and hungry and immediately switched places with another elite soldier to log off.
He was going to spread this matter far and wide!
Let the world witness what it means to be the strongest newcomer!
What it means to be the most extraordinary descendant of a Hidden Clan!!
Ding Ling and his group had plenty to eat and drink in the council hall.
Ding Ling wasn’t tired, just easily hungry, fortunately, there was plenty of food.
After eating and drinking.
Continued competing.
And now.
[Achievement Medal: 20 pieces!]
These are the glorious results of the battle!
It’s truly a big win!
No doubt, the increased skills can be perfectly brought back to the real world, maybe even open up Storage Space?
"Come, come. General Ding, I toast to you!"
At the banquet.
Chattering and laughter.
All the scholars were in awe, offering cheers to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling can be called the All-Powerful King!
Music, Chess, Calligraphy, and Painting, Poetry, Astronomy, Geography, Agriculture and cultivation, etc., almost everything has reached its limit!
This definitely leaves the scholars shocked ’to the point of raising their brows’?
Hann Fu, the Governor of Jizhou, dropped his jaw a few times in disbelief during the event.
Because Ding Ling knows so much.
And each aspect overwhelms the vast majority of those present!
Such heavenly performance.
Enough to move anyone, causing trembling and shuddering.
