chapters.title: Chapter 36: The Object of Everyone’s Pursuit
paragraphs: Many people began to question their lives.
But seeing that the vast majority were similar to themselves, and only Ding Ling was exceptional, they felt much relieved.
They were, of course, also puzzled as to why Ding Ling was so accomplished.
Ding Ling’s response was simply ’a gift from heaven.’
And he ’knocked them down.’
At this moment.
Han Fu was also toasting Ding Ling:
"General Ding. The official insignia and attire for the Commander of Changshan County will be delivered to you tomorrow!"
Ding Ling returned the courtesy and stood up to express his gratitude.
Han Fu laughed heartily, his mood evidently excellent.
To put it simply: it was like a basketball enthusiast watching an exhilarating basketball game.
The contest between Ding Ling and Jushou, Tian Feng, Geng Wu, Min Chun, and Xun Chen was far more thrilling than any ordinary competition!
Han Fu was greatly entertained!
Thus, Han Fu’s favor towards Ding Ling was extremely high; not only did he award Ding Ling an Achievement Medal, but he also promised:
"To make your military title more legitimate, I will contact the court to promptly issue a Holy Decree to officially recognize your position!"
Of course, Ding Ling expressed his gratitude extensively.
The banquet concluded with everyone thoroughly enjoying themselves!
Xun Chen, Jushou, Tian Feng, and the others became very friendly with Ding Ling and admired him greatly! They invited him several times to visit their homes.
To be the first to invite Ding Ling, Xun Chen even glared at Jushou and the others, hoping they wouldn’t interfere.

However, Jushou and Tian Feng, deeply impressed by Ding Ling, were extremely curious about him and their minds were filled with ideas about exploring military strategy and governance concepts with him!
They had no regard for Xun Chen’s warnings.
Zhang Hex, seeing the situation going awry, quickly pulled Ding Ling aside.
Pan Feng boldly stated:
"General Ding has already agreed to visit my home. There’s no need for you all to compete."
Xun Chen, Jushou, and Tian Feng couldn’t help but regret, each saying:
"Then come to my house tomorrow."
Gao Lan watched from the side, full of envy.
When could he become a guest of these esteemed gentlemen?
It was something he longed for but couldn’t attain.
Yet here was Ding Ling, now troubled by which invitation to accept.
Such is the gap!
Truly, people cannot be compared!
How long had Ding Ling been in Jizhou?
And he had already become so familiar with the Jizhou elites! Indeed, a rare talent!
This strengthened Gao Lan’s resolve to befriend Ding Ling!
Cheng Huan watched with satisfaction!
’This is a talent I, Cheng Huan, valued and unearthed!’
In the end.
Ding Ling returned to his own residence and invited everyone over.
The residence was a gift from Han Fu.

In his delighted state, and with Xun Chen, Jushou, Pan Feng, and others speaking on his behalf, Han Fu bestowed various rewards and accolades upon Ding Ling, with the residence being just one of them.
Another banquet unfolded that night.
It wasn’t until late at night that it finally adjourned.
After seeing everyone off.
Ding Ling stood at the entrance of his residence and took a look.
Two stone lions guarded the gate!
A plaque hanging high above the entrance bore two large, bright characters: Ding Mansion!!
"I now also own a house, no, a mansion!"
Ding Ling walked into the courtyard of the residence, unable to hold back a sigh.
This mansion was enormous.
At least several thousand square meters!
With mountains, water, and corridors everywhere, and all sorts of beautiful landscapes dotting the area!
If this were in the real world.
It wouldn’t be purchased for anything less than several billion!
"Have I struck it rich?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, "Unfortunately, this house can’t be taken back to reality."
Moreover, tomorrow he had to go to Changshan County, and he definitely wouldn’t stay in Yuan Shao’s domain in the future; this house would surely be taken back.
"Live day by day,"
Ding Ling thought to himself, since it was a freebie anyway.
As he walked towards the inner courtyard.
He saw a pretty maid making his bed.
Ding Ling’s heart fluttered, he glanced at the maid and thought:
"This maid is prettier than any girlfriend I’ve had in my past or present life! Han Fu is indeed generous; giving away such an excellent maid."
"Greetings, General."
The maid, stared at by Ding Ling, blushed and shyly bowed in a grand salute.
Ding Ling snapped out of it, refraining from looking further, merely signaling that formalities weren’t necessary, and asked for the maid’s name, birth date, and so on.
Learning her name was Zhao Bingxuan, he couldn’t help but be slightly surprised.
A girl with such a name didn’t seem to come from an ordinary family.

Further inquiry revealed that her father was once an official, and during the Yellow Turban Rebellion, almost all her family members were killed; only she and her siblings narrowly escaped by hiding in a secret chamber.
Speaking of the sorrowful parts.
Zhao Bingxuan couldn’t help but sob.
Ding Ling casually offered comforting words, only to unexpectedly cause Zhao Bingxuan to break down, her tears flowing like a river.
Ding Ling was stunned.
Zhao Bingxuan, choking with sobs, explained:
"It seems that the masters of Ye City only saw me as a lowly person, knowing only how to abuse and suppress me; you’re the only exception, General."
She looked at Ding Ling affectionately and declared firmly:
"From now on, I will serve you well, General. Just please don’t make me leave."
Ding Ling hesitated.
He wanted to say: ’I’m leaving tomorrow. I probably won’t return here.’
But everyone appreciates beauty.
Moreover, this girl seemed sensible, gentle, and strong.
Soft-hearted, Ding Ling agreed, and allowed her to bring her siblings to live there as well.
Zhao Bingxuan was overjoyed, kneeling to thank Ding Ling.
Ding Ling helped her up.
She solemnly promised: never to betray the General and to faithfully serve him for life.
Ding Ling had no words.
Zhao Bingxuan appeared to be about seventeen or eighteen, someone who, in the modern world, would likely still be in high school.
Yet she had already endured countless worldly hardships!
Ding Ling, contemplating various thoughts, lay down on his bed and fell asleep.
As he awoke.
Ding Ling felt rejuvenated and couldn’t help but be surprised:
"Sleeping two hours in this game seems equivalent to sleeping seven or eight hours in the real world!"
"Is it because the quality of sleep in the game is better? Or is it because of my improved physical condition?"
Ding Ling pondered.
Next time, by sleeping in reality and comparing, he would know.
"Ding Ling."
Pan Feng, along with Zhang Hex, came to find Ding Ling early in the morning.
They brought the official seal and robe and other items.
Ding Ling accepted them one by one and looked at the seal: Tiger Valor General!
This was a position of the seventh rank.
Far superior to a Military Marquis.
This was thanks to the imminent collapse of the Han Dynasty and the great power of state governors.
In the past, it would have been impossible to bestow an official seal upon Ding Ling so casually.
"Congratulations."
Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, Cheng Huan, and Pan Feng all congratulated Ding Ling, noting:
"As soon as the court issues a Holy Decree, your position will be fully recognized, and your official seal cannot be easily taken away!"
Ding Ling nodded with a smile.
"Besides, I mentioned last time that I have a surprise for you."
Pan Feng handed Ding Ling a handwritten note.

sentences.text: Many people began to question their lives.
But seeing that the vast majority were similar to themselves, and only Ding Ling was exceptional, they felt much relieved.
They were, of course, also puzzled as to why Ding Ling was so accomplished.
Ding Ling’s response was simply ’a gift from heaven.’
And he ’knocked them down.’
At this moment.
Han Fu was also toasting Ding Ling:
"General Ding.
The official insignia and attire for the Commander of Changshan County will be delivered to you tomorrow!"
Ding Ling returned the courtesy and stood up to express his gratitude.
Han Fu laughed heartily, his mood evidently excellent.
To put it simply: it was like a basketball enthusiast watching an exhilarating basketball game.
The contest between Ding Ling and Jushou, Tian Feng, Geng Wu, Min Chun, and Xun Chen was far more thrilling than any ordinary competition!
Han Fu was greatly entertained!
Thus, Han Fu’s favor towards Ding Ling was extremely high; not only did he award Ding Ling an Achievement Medal, but he also promised:
"To make your military title more legitimate, I will contact the court to promptly issue a Holy Decree to officially recognize your position!"
Of course, Ding Ling expressed his gratitude extensively.
The banquet concluded with everyone thoroughly enjoying themselves!
Xun Chen, Jushou, Tian Feng, and the others became very friendly with Ding Ling and admired him greatly!
They invited him several times to visit their homes.
To be the first to invite Ding Ling, Xun Chen even glared at Jushou and the others, hoping they wouldn’t interfere.

However, Jushou and Tian Feng, deeply impressed by Ding Ling, were extremely curious about him and their minds were filled with ideas about exploring military strategy and governance concepts with him!
They had no regard for Xun Chen’s warnings.
Zhang Hex, seeing the situation going awry, quickly pulled Ding Ling aside.
Pan Feng boldly stated:
"General Ding has already agreed to visit my home.
There’s no need for you all to compete."
Xun Chen, Jushou, and Tian Feng couldn’t help but regret, each saying:
"Then come to my house tomorrow."
Gao Lan watched from the side, full of envy.
When could he become a guest of these esteemed gentlemen?
It was something he longed for but couldn’t attain.
Yet here was Ding Ling, now troubled by which invitation to accept.
Such is the gap!
Truly, people cannot be compared!
How long had Ding Ling been in Jizhou?
And he had already become so familiar with the Jizhou elites!
Indeed, a rare talent!
This strengthened Gao Lan’s resolve to befriend Ding Ling!
Cheng Huan watched with satisfaction!
’This is a talent I, Cheng Huan, valued and unearthed!’
In the end.
Ding Ling returned to his own residence and invited everyone over.
The residence was a gift from Han Fu.

In his delighted state, and with Xun Chen, Jushou, Pan Feng, and others speaking on his behalf, Han Fu bestowed various rewards and accolades upon Ding Ling, with the residence being just one of them.
Another banquet unfolded that night.
It wasn’t until late at night that it finally adjourned.
After seeing everyone off.
Ding Ling stood at the entrance of his residence and took a look.
Two stone lions guarded the gate!
A plaque hanging high above the entrance bore two large, bright characters: Ding Mansion!!
"I now also own a house, no, a mansion!"
Ding Ling walked into the courtyard of the residence, unable to hold back a sigh.
This mansion was enormous.
At least several thousand square meters!
With mountains, water, and corridors everywhere, and all sorts of beautiful landscapes dotting the area!
If this were in the real world.
It wouldn’t be purchased for anything less than several billion!
"Have I struck it rich?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, "Unfortunately, this house can’t be taken back to reality."
Moreover, tomorrow he had to go to Changshan County, and he definitely wouldn’t stay in Yuan Shao’s domain in the future; this house would surely be taken back.
"Live day by day,"
Ding Ling thought to himself, since it was a freebie anyway.
As he walked towards the inner courtyard.
He saw a pretty maid making his bed.
Ding Ling’s heart fluttered, he glanced at the maid and thought:
"This maid is prettier than any girlfriend I’ve had in my past or present life!
Han Fu is indeed generous; giving away such an excellent maid."
"Greetings, General."
The maid, stared at by Ding Ling, blushed and shyly bowed in a grand salute.
Ding Ling snapped out of it, refraining from looking further, merely signaling that formalities weren’t necessary, and asked for the maid’s name, birth date, and so on.
Learning her name was Zhao Bingxuan, he couldn’t help but be slightly surprised.
A girl with such a name didn’t seem to come from an ordinary family.

Further inquiry revealed that her father was once an official, and during the Yellow Turban Rebellion, almost all her family members were killed; only she and her siblings narrowly escaped by hiding in a secret chamber.
Speaking of the sorrowful parts.
Zhao Bingxuan couldn’t help but sob.
Ding Ling casually offered comforting words, only to unexpectedly cause Zhao Bingxuan to break down, her tears flowing like a river.
Ding Ling was stunned.
Zhao Bingxuan, choking with sobs, explained:
"It seems that the masters of Ye City only saw me as a lowly person, knowing only how to abuse and suppress me; you’re the only exception, General."
She looked at Ding Ling affectionately and declared firmly:
"From now on, I will serve you well, General.
Just please don’t make me leave."
Ding Ling hesitated.
He wanted to say: ’I’m leaving tomorrow.
I probably won’t return here.’
But everyone appreciates beauty.
Moreover, this girl seemed sensible, gentle, and strong.
Soft-hearted, Ding Ling agreed, and allowed her to bring her siblings to live there as well.
Zhao Bingxuan was overjoyed, kneeling to thank Ding Ling.
Ding Ling helped her up.
She solemnly promised: never to betray the General and to faithfully serve him for life.
Ding Ling had no words.
Zhao Bingxuan appeared to be about seventeen or eighteen, someone who, in the modern world, would likely still be in high school.
Yet she had already endured countless worldly hardships!

chapters.title: Chapter 37: Farewell to Renowned Scholars and Player Uproar
paragraphs: "What is this?"
Ding Ling looked at the letter in his hand, puzzled.
"This is a letter to Tong Yuan."
Pan Feng laughed aloud:
"Tong Yuan is an old acquaintance of mine! Take my letter, and he will likely accept you as his disciple!"
"Oh?"
Ding Ling was pleasantly surprised.
Tong Yuan is the Spear God who taught Zhao Zilong, Zhang Xiu, and Zhang Ren!
If he could become his apprentice.
His progress would surely be rapid, as he could level up quickly!
"Haha..."
Pan Feng saw Ding Ling’s expression, seemingly expected, and laughed heartily, patting Ding Ling’s shoulder, saying:
"I have high hopes for you! I believe you won’t disappoint me!"
"Indeed."
Zhang Hex said next to him:

"Anyone with real Kung Fu and some social standing knows of the Penglai Spear God. Many wish to become his apprentice, including myself, but unfortunately, the requirements to be accepted are extremely strict, and I don’t meet them."
"What are the requirements?"
Ding Ling glanced sideways. Even someone as talented as Zhang Hex didn’t fit?
"Haha..."
Zhang Hex chuckled awkwardly twice before saying:

"Learning from him means staying by his side constantly until you’ve mastered the Martial Arts he teaches. Only then will he let you leave. I have family secrets to learn and need to attend private school, so it’s impossible for me to stay on the mountain to learn Kung Fu from him."
"I see."
Ding Ling understood.
"So, if the Spear God chooses you, he will most likely make you master his skills before letting you leave. Be mentally prepared for that."
Pan Feng said with a smile:
"However, your talent is extraordinary. You may not need to stay long up the mountain, and it won’t affect your official duties. Prepare yourself and get ready to travel."
He glanced at the sky:
"Oh, I forgot, we have prepared a farewell banquet for you. You should leave after the banquet."
After the banquet.
Ding Ling returned to the mansion, donned his General Armor, took the official seal, and held a Heaven-piercing Halberd, ready to depart.
The maid Zhao Bingxuan, tearful, looked at Ding Ling, pleading to accompany him, promising to take good care of him.
Ding Ling hesitated.
Zhao Bingxuan promptly said:
"General, traveling, you’ll need someone to attend to you, right? I can wash clothes, cook meals, make the bed, and keep it warm for you!"
It made sense.
He couldn’t eat at the big mess hall with soldiers every day, right?
Or go to a restaurant?
Moreover, the household chores need attention, right?
Hiring someone would be troublesome.
Might as well take Zhao Bingxuan along.
Ding Ling asked if she could ride a horse; Zhao Bingxuan said she could.
So, Ding Ling had a horse brought for Zhao Bingxuan to ride.
He specifically asked Zhang Hex to help look after Zhao Bingxuan’s younger siblings.
For this, Zhao Bingxuan was naturally very grateful.
With Ding Ling’s instruction.
The people living in this large mansion naturally have little to worry about.
Even if Yuan Shao ruled Ye City.
But with Zhang Hex, Gao Lan, and others, there’s no need to worry.
Ding Ling rode away.
Zhao Bingxuan also changed into a soldier’s outfit and followed closely behind.
At the city gate.
He saw Jushou, Tian Feng, and others coming to see him off.
Jushou, Tian Feng, and others, having been defeated by Ding Ling, were full of admiration, and after several interactions, they were thoroughly impressed by Ding Ling’s talent and prowess!
They admired Ding Ling deeply.
Countless gestures of goodwill followed naturally.
That they would come to see him off was to be expected.
"Originally, I wanted to discuss state governance and Military Strategy with you."
Jushou felt deeply regretful:
"We must wait for another opportunity."

Ding Ling’s eyebrow twitched slightly. Could he say he liked straightforward approaches and disliked those cunning and deceitful tactics? Discussing Military Strategy with Jushou and others left him drained, but they didn’t know this.
They thought Ding Ling was truly omnipotent! Amazingly powerful!
Naturally, Ding Ling wouldn’t reveal this illusion!
It wouldn’t benefit him.
On the contrary.
The more others think he’s formidable, the more his reputation might spread far and wide.
This greatly helps his Path of Glory.
"Hope to meet again."
Tian Feng and others came one by one to greet him.
Xun Chen was the most straightforward. He packed his belongings and rode a horse, expressing his desire to travel with Ding Ling to Changshan County.
Everyone was dumbfounded.
But those who knew Xun Chen understood that his ’Chess Fanatic’ trait was at play, driving him to learn chess with Ding Ling.
Having grasped this through his Achievement Medal, Ding Ling earnestly persuaded Xun Chen, promising to gift him a Chess Manual upon returning.
With others’ support, Xun Chen’s desire to accompany them to Changshan County was quelled.
After bidding farewell to everyone.
Ding Ling called out, urging his horse forward. In the clamor of horse hooves, he and Zhao Bingxuan went farther and farther, until they disappeared completely.
Tian Feng, Jushou, Xun Chen, and others all returned with a sense of loss, pondering how the Shenzhou Land could produce such a genius like Ding Ling.
Cheng Huan, Gao Lan, Zhang Hex, and Pan Feng listened, feeling immensely proud.
As they considered Ding Ling one of their own.
Hearing this high praise from previously arrogant and superior scholars about their friend naturally filled them with pride and a full sense of achievement!
Meanwhile, the players in the Jizhou camp were stirred.

"Did you see?! Jushou and the others personally came to see Ding Ling off! And they looked so reluctant to part, how did Ding Ling achieve this?! To make such a proud group of scholars bow to him within a short time!"
"Unbelievable! As far as I know, Tian Feng is extremely upright and self-assured! Most people don’t catch his eye, yet he came to see Ding Ling and was very cordial to him, it’s simply unfathomable!"
"Did you notice how Jushou and others looked at Ding Ling? As if looking at a beacon of light! At a veritable Deity!"
"Oh?! Now that you mention it, really? What did Ding Ling do to make the Jizhou scholars, who would later be praised by Cao Mengde, behave this way?!"
The entire Ye City buzzed with excitement!
Especially after some newly online player revealed what Ding Ling did at the Jizhou Governor’s Mansion, astonishing all players!
"This can’t be true. How could a new player comprehensively defeat the scholars! Even learning a subject a year wouldn’t make him this versatile! How old is he?!"
"Indeed. That’s why we find Ding Ling so terrifying. He must be a peerless genius nurtured by a Hidden Clan!"
"But I also heard someone say Ding Ling is just an ordinary person?"
Suddenly.
There were countless speculations.
The matter was so explosive, it even topped the trending topics list in the real world!

chapters.title: Chapter 38: Tiger Valor General
paragraphs: [All-Purpose King Ding Ling Crushes Jizhou Celebrities! How Strong is His Background Really?]
This has become the top trending search!
Below are various discussions, discussing all sorts of topics.
Outrageous stories with thousands of likes.
And someone commented below:
"I know Ding Ling, he was my former colleague, just an ordinary office worker. How could he be the heir of a Hidden Clan? Haha, laughable. Online rumors have really gone too far!"
This comment enraged countless netizens.
Especially those from the Jizhou faction who witnessed Ding Ling’s glory firsthand, all united in fiercely criticizing this ’colleague of Ding Ling.’
They only stopped after forcing the ’colleague’ to delete their account.
Of course, they inevitably left behind a parting comment:
"What kind of nonsense? Everyone wants to associate with a Hidden Clan member like Ding Ling?! Pfft!"
This remark made Ding Ling’s classmates and colleagues instantly speechless.
Those who originally wanted to say they knew Ding Ling hesitated.
The fact is that Ding Ling’s appearance and demeanor have changed greatly from the past.
They weren’t sure whether he was the same person.
If not, they risk being criticized and having to delete their accounts, wouldn’t that be tragic?
So many of Ding Ling’s acquaintances decided to wait and see.
Regarding these matters, Ding Ling was completely unaware.
Because he rarely logged out.
Even when offline, he hurriedly ate and quickly logged back in, seldom lingering in the Player Plaza, naturally not interacting with other players.
To make eating more convenient, he had even given his last remaining money to Uncle Zhang, the neighbor next door, asking him to cook meals as a fee.
Uncle Zhang was agreeable; he took the money and did the job, and at least for the short term, Ding Ling didn’t need to worry about going hungry.
As for what to do when the money runs out?
Anyway, there’s no worry about food, drink, or housing now.
Once the meal money runs out, he’ll go out and earn some more.
He could be considered an All-Purpose King now, does he fear earning money?
He could even earn quite a bit by doing some ’minor language’ translations on foreign websites!
Thus.
Ding Ling wasn’t worried at all!
Unlike before, where he was too mediocre, always fearing unemployment and not making money, anxiety was a regular occurrence.
Now he was much more composed.
[Achievement Medal Obtained: Your fame has already resonated throughout Jizhou Ye City!]
[Note: Through word of mouth among players, your name isn’t only widely known in Ye City, but all across Jiuzhou people are starting to notice you.]
Another achievement medal?
Ding Ling was taken aback.
"You can earn an achievement medal just from spreading fame?"
Ding Ling thought it over:
"Looks like as long as you’re strong enough with enough influence, achievement medals are basically guaranteed."
He glanced at his character panel.
He found another notification:
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You’ve become the Tiger Valor General of Jizhou’s faction!]

[Note: Hann Fu greatly admires you! Believes you are more than capable as a Military Officer, even planning to move you to be an Assistant by his side. It was Pan Feng insisting you be the Defender General of Changshan County that led to your appointment as Tiger Valor General!
The request has been sent to the court, and soon the imperial decree will arrive, officially confirming your position.]
Indeed, holding an official position also earned achievement medals.
Yet being a Military Marquis, Tiger Valor General seemed merely ordinary achievement medals.
The difference was so vast!
Ding Ling was perplexed.
But he didn’t dwell on it further.
Getting them was great.
He dashed forward.
Encountering numerous bandits, robbers, thieves on the way.
But no matter who, upon meeting Ding Ling, were left in utter defeat, fleeing in terror!
Currently, Ding Ling could be deemed an absolute master among first-class generals!
Even Juyi was defeated by him.
Zhang Hex and Gao Lan sparred with him privately, and were similarly beaten by him each time!
One could say, besides Zhao Zilong and other top experts, Ding Ling feared no one now.
Moreover, progress on his Path of Glory had also changed:
[1: Defeat 20 Plane Strongmen: 3/20.]
Zhang Hex and Gao Lan clearly met the characteristics of Plane Strongmen.
Pan Feng fit the profile too.
Unfortunately, Ding Ling couldn’t defeat Pan Feng.
Pan Feng may not have as many varied skills as Ding Ling.
But his strength combined with the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques was enough to utterly crush Ding Ling.
No doubt.
Pan Feng was truly super-elite.
It was due to confronting Pan Feng and being thoroughly suppressed by him.
Ding Ling now longed to become a super-elite general.
"On this trip to Changshan County in search of Penglai Spear God, I must learn his secret Kung Fu and become a super-elite warrior!"
With Pan Feng’s endorsement.
And being the Tiger Valor General, the Defensive General of Changshan County!
In charge of defending the county, armory, soldiers, and more!
This facilitates meeting Tong Yuan, further increasing the chances of successfully mastering martial arts.
On this day.
Ding Ling arrived at Zhending City in Changshan County.
He took his official seal and went directly to see the Prefect.
The Prefect was a tall man with a bulging belly named Dong Xuan, Ding Ling thought for a moment, he didn’t recall such a famous figure in the Three Kingdoms.
He still exchanged pleasantries with him.
Unexpectedly, Dong Xuan liked to bully others with his power and had a strong desire for control!
He never wanted to relinquish military power, and seeing Ding Ling’s baby-faced, agreeable nature, he showed disdain, barely paying him any mind.
When Ding Ling spoke, it took ages for him to respond.
Seeing this, Ding Ling frowned and immediately turned around and left.
"Humph!"
Dong Xuan gave Ding Ling’s departing figure a disdainful glance:
"He dares to come to Changshan County alone to snatch my troops? Where is it so easy?"
"But my lord."
An aide was worried:

"He is a Tiger Valor General sent by the Governor of Jizhou, a squarely seventh-rank official. Our Changshan County’s Defensive General! If we neglect him, it may be hard to explain to the Governor of Jizhou."
"What is there to fear?"
Dong Xuan was full of confidence:

"I am very close with the Governor of Jizhou, I know his character well, he absolutely looks down on martial artists. Who knows what tricks Ding Ling used to get such a position, but never mind, I’ll just file a report against him, and have him kicked out immediately!"
He smugly stroked his beard:
"I know quite a few people over in Ye City, Geng Wu, Min Chun are my friends. Just a few words from them, and Ding Ling will be dismissed, isn’t it just a simple matter?"
"Are you going to frame Ding Ling, my lord?"
"Exactly."
Dong Xuan chuckled:
"If this guy dares to oppose me! Then don’t blame me for overturning his ship! I’ll simply accuse him of negligence, insulting me. These alone are enough to make him suffer!"
Ding Ling had no idea Dong Xuan was plotting against him.
But he knew one thing: he was ill-suited for the officialdom!
He himself was not committed to the officialdom anyway, otherwise he wouldn’t have chosen the Path of the War God.
Regarding holding official positions, his attitude was to go with the flow.
Therefore, seeing Dong Xuan’s demeanor, he directly headed to the archives to find Zhao Zilong’s former residence in Zhending.

Especially those from the Jizhou faction who witnessed Ding Ling’s glory firsthand, all united in fiercely criticizing this ’colleague of Ding Ling.’
They only stopped after forcing the ’colleague’ to delete their account.
Of course, they inevitably left behind a parting comment:
"What kind of nonsense?
Everyone wants to associate with a Hidden Clan member like Ding Ling?!
Pfft!"
This remark made Ding Ling’s classmates and colleagues instantly speechless.
Those who originally wanted to say they knew Ding Ling hesitated.
The fact is that Ding Ling’s appearance and demeanor have changed greatly from the past.
They weren’t sure whether he was the same person.
If not, they risk being criticized and having to delete their accounts, wouldn’t that be tragic?
So many of Ding Ling’s acquaintances decided to wait and see.
Regarding these matters, Ding Ling was completely unaware.
Because he rarely logged out.
Even when offline, he hurriedly ate and quickly logged back in, seldom lingering in the Player Plaza, naturally not interacting with other players.
To make eating more convenient, he had even given his last remaining money to Uncle Zhang, the neighbor next door, asking him to cook meals as a fee.
Uncle Zhang was agreeable; he took the money and did the job, and at least for the short term, Ding Ling didn’t need to worry about going hungry.
As for what to do when the money runs out?
Anyway, there’s no worry about food, drink, or housing now.
Once the meal money runs out, he’ll go out and earn some more.
He could be considered an All-Purpose King now, does he fear earning money?
He could even earn quite a bit by doing some ’minor language’ translations on foreign websites!
Thus.
Ding Ling wasn’t worried at all!
Unlike before, where he was too mediocre, always fearing unemployment and not making money, anxiety was a regular occurrence.
Now he was much more composed.
[Achievement Medal Obtained: Your fame has already resonated throughout Jizhou Ye City!]
[Note: Through word of mouth among players, your name isn’t only widely known in Ye City, but all across Jiuzhou people are starting to notice you.]
Another achievement medal?
Ding Ling was taken aback.
"You can earn an achievement medal just from spreading fame?"
Ding Ling thought it over:
"Looks like as long as you’re strong enough with enough influence, achievement medals are basically guaranteed."
He glanced at his character panel.
He found another notification:
[Achievement Medal Obtained: You’ve become the Tiger Valor General of Jizhou’s faction!]
[Note: Hann Fu greatly admires you!
Believes you are more than capable as a Military Officer, even planning to move you to be an Assistant by his side.
It was Pan Feng insisting you be the Defender General of Changshan County that led to your appointment as Tiger Valor General!
The request has been sent to the court, and soon the imperial decree will arrive, officially confirming your position.]
Indeed, holding an official position also earned achievement medals.
Yet being a Military Marquis, Tiger Valor General seemed merely ordinary achievement medals.
The difference was so vast!
Ding Ling was perplexed.
But he didn’t dwell on it further.
Getting them was great.
He dashed forward.
Encountering numerous bandits, robbers, thieves on the way.
But no matter who, upon meeting Ding Ling, were left in utter defeat, fleeing in terror!
Currently, Ding Ling could be deemed an absolute master among first-class generals!
Even Juyi was defeated by him.
Zhang Hex and Gao Lan sparred with him privately, and were similarly beaten by him each time!
One could say, besides Zhao Zilong and other top experts, Ding Ling feared no one now.
Moreover, progress on his Path of Glory had also changed:
[1: Defeat 20 Plane Strongmen: 3/20.]
Zhang Hex and Gao Lan clearly met the characteristics of Plane Strongmen.
Pan Feng fit the profile too.
Unfortunately, Ding Ling couldn’t defeat Pan Feng.
Pan Feng may not have as many varied skills as Ding Ling.
But his strength combined with the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques was enough to utterly crush Ding Ling.
No doubt.
Pan Feng was truly super-elite.
It was due to confronting Pan Feng and being thoroughly suppressed by him.
Ding Ling now longed to become a super-elite general.
"On this trip to Changshan County in search of Penglai Spear God, I must learn his secret Kung Fu and become a super-elite warrior!"
With Pan Feng’s endorsement.
And being the Tiger Valor General, the Defensive General of Changshan County!
In charge of defending the county, armory, soldiers, and more!
This facilitates meeting Tong Yuan, further increasing the chances of successfully mastering martial arts.
On this day.
Ding Ling arrived at Zhending City in Changshan County.
He took his official seal and went directly to see the Prefect.
The Prefect was a tall man with a bulging belly named Dong Xuan, Ding Ling thought for a moment, he didn’t recall such a famous figure in the Three Kingdoms.
He still exchanged pleasantries with him.
Unexpectedly, Dong Xuan liked to bully others with his power and had a strong desire for control!
He never wanted to relinquish military power, and seeing Ding Ling’s baby-faced, agreeable nature, he showed disdain, barely paying him any mind.
When Ding Ling spoke, it took ages for him to respond.
Seeing this, Ding Ling frowned and immediately turned around and left.
"Humph!"
Dong Xuan gave Ding Ling’s departing figure a disdainful glance:
"He dares to come to Changshan County alone to snatch my troops?
Where is it so easy?"
"But my lord."
An aide was worried:
"He is a Tiger Valor General sent by the Governor of Jizhou, a squarely seventh-rank official.
Our Changshan County’s Defensive General!
If we neglect him, it may be hard to explain to the Governor of Jizhou."
"What is there to fear?"
Dong Xuan was full of confidence:
"I am very close with the Governor of Jizhou, I know his character well, he absolutely looks down on martial artists.
Who knows what tricks Ding Ling used to get such a position, but never mind, I’ll just file a report against him, and have him kicked out immediately!"
He smugly stroked his beard:
"I know quite a few people over in Ye City, Geng Wu, Min Chun are my friends.
Just a few words from them, and Ding Ling will be dismissed, isn’t it just a simple matter?"
"Are you going to frame Ding Ling, my lord?"
"Exactly."
Dong Xuan chuckled:
"If this guy dares to oppose me!
Then don’t blame me for overturning his ship!
I’ll simply accuse him of negligence, insulting me.
These alone are enough to make him suffer!"
Ding Ling had no idea Dong Xuan was plotting against him.
But he knew one thing: he was ill-suited for the officialdom!
He himself was not committed to the officialdom anyway, otherwise he wouldn’t have chosen the Path of the War God.
Regarding holding official positions, his attitude was to go with the flow.
Therefore, seeing Dong Xuan’s demeanor, he directly headed to the archives to find Zhao Zilong’s former residence in Zhending.

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Zhao Family Village in Changshan County Plundered
paragraphs: As long as we find Zhao Zilong’s former residence.
And compare it with the map Pan Feng gave him.
Finding Tong Yuan won’t be difficult.
The archives are also located within the Governor’s Mansion.
Ding Ling charged forward, taking advantage of a timing gap to intimidate the archive guards and gather information.
He did not care at all about how Dong Xuan perceived him; after obtaining the information he sought, he would immediately leave to learn martial arts.
Once he became a Super-Elite General, he could probably rival an entire army alone!
Why care about Dong Xuan then?
Indeed.
The archive manager, seeing the official seal of the Tiger Valor General and Ding Ling in full General Armor, with a fierce glare, was terrified.
Not daring to resist.
He obediently cooperated with Ding Ling in searching the records.
This archive contained information on all the large and small villages of Zhending.
There were more than a dozen Zhao Family Villages.
Finding Zhao Yun’s village wasn’t hard.
Because Zhao Yun was already of age and had registered his name long ago.
Ding Ling had all the archive staff searching.
Zhao Bingxuan and Ding Ling also searched together.
In the end, it was Zhao Bingxuan who found it by chance.
Ding Ling gave an approving glance at Zhao Bingxuan.
Zhao Bingxuan was delighted at heart; being able to help Ding Ling was a great sense of achievement for her!
After obtaining the information, Ding Ling left directly, mounted his horse, and galloped towards Zhao Family Village.
Two hours later.
Ding Ling was about to reach his destination.
On the way, Ding Ling saw yet again the chaos in Jizhou.
The place was really overrun with bandits and mountain bandits!
Especially after players entered this world, the number of bandits increased even more rapidly; many players had already joined the mountain bandit ranks!
Robbing and killing civilians and players alike!
Of course, acts of robbery and other indecent acts were not uncommon.
In the real world, society is law-based and strictly regulated.
But here, in this era of moral collapse.
Many players were elated!
If not for the fact that most of them were so weak, this world would long have descended into complete chaos.
For these players, Ding Ling naturally spared no one.
Clip-clop!
Amidst the sound of hooves, Ding Ling arrived at Zhao Family Village.
He once again witnessed bandits plundering the village.
"Zhao Family Village is under attack?!"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, told Zhao Bingxuan to hide outside, and charged in alone, wielding a large halberd like a whirlwind, scattering thieves like fallen leaves in the autumn wind.
Sparks flickered in the void, occasionally a sharp ’flash of the axe’ streaked by, as if an Axe God was toying with the cosmos!
Though it was a halberd!
Yet it demonstrated the essence of axe, spear, saber, and staff techniques!
The thieves were slaughtered in countless numbers!
"Big brother! Don’t kill me."
One thief, with well-defined features but sinister eyes, holding a beautiful girl, knelt and pleaded for mercy as Ding Ling approached.
Seeing Ding Ling pause, and glancing at the girl, the thief immediately pushed her forward, flattering and saying:
"We’re all players, show mercy whenever possible, don’t kill us all!"
He smiled dryly and awkwardly: "It wasn’t easy for me to practice, I don’t want to die and lose all the skills and kung fu I’ve worked hard to master. Spare me this time, Hero Ding, Great God Ding!"
Thud!
Ding Ling pierced through, directly shattering his skull.
"You, you, you..."
The player widened his eyes, filled with disbelief.
"Be careful next time, don’t cross paths with me, or you’ll meet the same fate."
Ding Ling coldly said, he didn’t care if they were players or not; as long as they were in his way and displeased him, he killed them just the same!
He maneuvered his horse around the beautiful maiden, charging at the other thieves.
One man, one halberd.
Yet single-handedly drove the hundreds of bandits into disarray!
If they formed an army, Ding Ling might not stand a chance.
But scattered as they were, they posed no threat!
Not a single one was his match.
As easily as chopping vegetables, he killed over a hundred.
When no more figures were seen in the village, Ding Ling called Zhao Bingxuan over.
"Zhao Xiaoyiu."
When Zhao Bingxuan rode over and saw the beautiful girl, she was startled and couldn’t help but exclaim.
"Zhao Bingxuan. It’s really you."
The girl’s beautiful eyes were misty with tears, but upon seeing Zhao Bingxuan, she cried out in surprise and delight:
"It’s wonderful that you’re alright!"
It turned out Zhao Bingxuan knew Zhao Xiaoyiu from Zhao Family Village?
Ding Ling looked over, surprised.
Quite the coincidence?
"I wondered why the General was looking for Zhao Yun, Zhao Zilong, it sounded so familiar. Turns out it really is you!"
Zhao Bingxuan dismounted and embraced Zhao Xiaoyiu, speaking many heartfelt words. After Zhao Xiaoyiu’s emotions calmed a bit, she asked:
"Where’s your second brother?"
"Second brother has been training in martial arts on the mountain for years and hasn’t returned yet."
Zhao Xiaoyiu felt a bit down:
"Big brother is seriously ill, if it weren’t for your General arriving in time to save us, Zhao Family Village would be finished."
"How did Brother Zhao Feng become seriously ill?!"
Zhao Bingxuan couldn’t believe it:
"I remember he was very brave, often going out to fish during storms, how could he be seriously ill?"
"This is related to the bandits rampant around Changshan County."
Zhao Xiaoyiu spoke with indignation:

"In recent years, the bandits have grown increasingly rampant and reckless! Especially this month, the number of bandits has surged, almost every few days they harass Zhao Family Village and neighboring villages.
Our village had big brother and a few other skilled people, holding on till now.
The neighboring village, I’ve heard, was overrun by bandits half a month ago, the men were killed, and the women were taken to the mountains as slaves."
Still fearful, she involuntarily glanced at Ding Ling sitting on the horse not far away.
Seeing Ding Ling looking back at her.
Her heart fluttered, and her face flushed inexplicably, not daring to meet Ding Ling’s gaze, she quickly turned aside and continued:

"Three days ago, big brother was critically injured in a battle with bandits. He hasn’t woken up since. Once the bandits confirmed that big brother was severely injured, they launched a massive attack today. The skilled defenders in our village were nearly wiped out...
In our moment of despair, thankfully you arrived."
"Take me to see your big brother."
Not waiting for Zhao Bingxuan to speak, Ding Ling suddenly said:
"Maybe I can treat him."
His proficiency in Western medicine and acupuncture skills were already at full level.
In terms of medical skills, perhaps not as skilled as Hua Tuo and others.
But compared to many renowned experts in the real world, he was much more advanced.
"Really?"
Zhao Xiaoyiu was overjoyed, forgetting her shyness, she immediately saluted Ding Ling and quickly led the way, guiding him to their house.
Along the way, they saw many corpses.
They also saw white silk hung in front of every household!
But without exception, every household would show great courtesy to Ding Ling, some even kneeling in gratitude to express their thanks.

chapters.title: Chapter 40: Zilong’s Brother and Sister
paragraphs: Ding Ling tried several times to indicate that such formal gestures were unnecessary.
But it had the opposite effect.
Eventually, nearly everyone knelt on the ground to express their gratitude.
Seeing that stopping them was futile, Ding Ling had no choice but to accept it.
He hadn’t expected things to unfold so coincidentally.
Not only did he save the people of Zhao Family Village just in time, but his maid Zhao Bingxuan was actually acquainted with Zhao Yun and his group!
This was just too absurd and coincidental.
But considering that Zhao Bingxuan and Zhao Yun both carried the Zhao surname and both hailed from Zhending in Changshan County,
Ding Ling felt relieved.
After all, they were people from the Zhending Zhao Family, having some connection was quite normal.
Clip-clop!
Zhao Xiaoyiu led the way ahead, running swiftly.
Ding Ling and Zhao Bingxuan rode horses, following behind.
Soon, they arrived in front of a courtyard.
"This is the place."
Zhao Xiaoyiu seemed slightly nervous, but considering her brother’s life was at stake, she disregarded some trivial formalities, opened the door, and allowed Ding Ling and the others inside.
Ding Ling handed the reins to Zhao Bingxuan.
He immediately followed Zhao Xiaoyiu into the courtyard.
Glancing around.
Perhaps due to the recent chaotic battle.
The courtyard and the house were filled with debris.
Zhao Xiaoyiu observed Ding Ling, who was clad in general armor, appearing exceptionally imposing, with a glimpse of luxurious clothing showing from his sleeve.
Clearly, he was a young man from a prominent family.
Her own family seemed too impoverished.
Zhao Xiaoyiu inevitably felt somewhat inferior, timid, and embarrassed.
The closer she got to Ding Ling, the stronger these emotions became.
However, it was her brother’s safety that suppressed these feelings!
She clutched her sleeve and led Ding Ling into the inner chamber, pointing to a man lying on the bed:
"This is my brother, Zhao Feng."
Ding Ling stepped forward, looking at Zhao Feng.
He saw Zhao Feng with thick eyebrows and big eyes, an indomitable face, a robust physique, and hands full of calluses, clearly a person who had been working and practicing martial arts for years.
But at this moment, he appeared defeated, with icy skin.
Ding Ling conducted a detailed diagnosis and understood.
This was the result of an infected wound that hadn’t received timely treatment.
Ding Ling might not have a solution for such internal injuries.
But he was particularly skilled at handling such wounds.
In the real world’s library and online world, he had read an enormous number of medical books!
He was truly a master of medicine!
A surgeon of great expertise!
He immediately asked Zhao Xiaoyiu and the recently arrived Zhao Bingxuan to prepare hot water, needles, and other supplies.
One and a half hours later.
Everything was ready.
Ding Ling started using a heated knife to cut off the infected areas on Zhao Feng’s body and immediately applied hemostatic and healing herbs he had picked from the mountains!
The herbs had undergone Ding Ling’s special preparation, granting them remarkable efficacy.
After about an hour of hard work.
Ding Ling finally finished, drenched in sweat.
This was his first time performing surgery on someone, although he was already adept at the techniques, having ingrained them in his mind as a kind of instinct, which made his methods notably steady!
To an ordinary observer, he would appear as an experienced expert!

But one’s own family knows its own situation. This was indeed his first time doing such a task, and considering Zhao Feng was Zhao Zilong’s elder brother, Ding Ling inevitably took it seriously and felt anxious!
This resulted in him expending immense heart power during the treatment.
Fortunately, he succeeded in the end.
Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan watched all this intently.
They were extremely impressed by Ding Ling.
For someone so young to be incredibly brave and powerful was already astonishing enough!
But he was also a master in the medical field!
He was just too formidable!
They looked at him with admiration.
Zhao Xiaoyiu was particularly grateful, slaughtering the family’s only old hen to make soup and stew for Ding Ling, hoping he would eat well and be satiated.
[Achievement Medal Earned: You saved Zhao Feng, who was certain to die.]
[Note: According to historical trends, Zhao Feng would have unlikely lived for long. Your treatment eradicated his fatal injury.]
[Achievement Medal Earned: Gratitude from Zhao Xiaoyiu!]
[Note: Zhao Xiaoyiu was like a fleeting firework in the historical tide. Undoubtedly, without your rescue, her fate would have definitely been unfavorable.
She understands this.
Her gratitude towards you was already intense, even more so at the moment you treated Zhao Feng.
She already had thoughts of repaying you by serving as a loyal follower!
If you make an effort, marrying her wouldn’t be difficult!
In ancient times, having three wives and four concubines was quite common. You shouldn’t doubt your charm and capability!]
Earned two achievement medals consecutively.
[Ordinary Achievement Medal: 24]!
This was Ding Ling’s current progress.
Rather significant!
Zhao Feng and Zhao Xiaoyiu can hardly be found in historical records, who would have thought he could earn achievement medals from them?
Was this due to their connection to Zhao Zilong?
As the later-stage character deemed strongest by combat power in Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Zhao Zilong’s Qi fortune was undoubtedly high.
Being his relatives, and Zhao Feng not having low combat power himself, it seemed understandable for him to carry an achievement medal.
As for Zhao Xiaoyiu? Perhaps she gained favor from Zhao Feng and Zhao Zilong, and due to her deep gratitude towards him, she would likely have an achievement medal?
Ding Ling pondered, not overthinking it.
After all, it was a good thing, wishing for more of it was natural.
The next day.
Zhao Feng awoke, naturally expressing profound gratitude towards Ding Ling.
Upon learning Ding Ling’s journey was to seek Zhao Zilong’s mentor Tong Yuan,
Zhao Feng wanted to volunteer to guide him, but due to his injuries, moving was inconvenient.
Ultimately, Zhao Xiaoyiu proactively said:
"I’ve been to Penglai Mountain several times, and I can lead the way!"
She seemed concerned Ding Ling wouldn’t believe her, adding:

"Actually, my martial arts skills aren’t bad either. But I fought several battles earlier, exhausted myself, and sustained minor injuries, which led to my capture by bandits. With my skills, traveling to remote mountainous areas is safe."
Ding Ling pondered and said:
"Let’s wait until your brother recovers sufficiently before going. Otherwise, if the bandits return, wouldn’t you be in danger?"
Zhao Xiaoyiu felt increasingly grateful about this.
In this era, few prominent figures would consider matters from the viewpoint of the ’common folk’.
Ding Ling was indeed the only general she had met who knew how to empathize and consider the plight of the ’common folk’.
Ding Ling was unaware of what Zhao Xiaoyiu was thinking.
He acted this way,
also aiming to improve his rapport with Zhao Feng and Zhao Xiaoyiu.
Facilitating the recruitment of Zhao Zilong and his three siblings.
Even if he decided to walk the Path of the War God and temporarily align with a wise leader, Ding Ling hoped to recruit several experts to accompany him.
This way, his journey would be much smoother.
Three days passed like this.
During this period, Ding Ling logged in and out three times.
His comings and goings were brief.
Still not interacting with any players.
However, he knew his reputation must have spread across many regions, as every time he logged in and out, he noticed some players giving him ’peculiar’ looks.
"What do they mean by this?"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
But he didn’t bother to investigate.
He had moved to a countryside area far from the city’s disputes.
There were only old folks and children there.
None of them played games or surfed the internet, at most, they watched television and movies through connectivity.
But Ding Ling was unaware that...

She clutched her sleeve and led Ding Ling into the inner chamber, pointing to a man lying on the bed:
"This is my brother, Zhao Feng."
Ding Ling stepped forward, looking at Zhao Feng.
He saw Zhao Feng with thick eyebrows and big eyes, an indomitable face, a robust physique, and hands full of calluses, clearly a person who had been working and practicing martial arts for years.
But at this moment, he appeared defeated, with icy skin.
Ding Ling conducted a detailed diagnosis and understood.
This was the result of an infected wound that hadn’t received timely treatment.
Ding Ling might not have a solution for such internal injuries.
But he was particularly skilled at handling such wounds.
In the real world’s library and online world, he had read an enormous number of medical books!
He was truly a master of medicine!
A surgeon of great expertise!
He immediately asked Zhao Xiaoyiu and the recently arrived Zhao Bingxuan to prepare hot water, needles, and other supplies.
One and a half hours later.
Everything was ready.
Ding Ling started using a heated knife to cut off the infected areas on Zhao Feng’s body and immediately applied hemostatic and healing herbs he had picked from the mountains!
The herbs had undergone Ding Ling’s special preparation, granting them remarkable efficacy.
After about an hour of hard work.
Ding Ling finally finished, drenched in sweat.
This was his first time performing surgery on someone, although he was already adept at the techniques, having ingrained them in his mind as a kind of instinct, which made his methods notably steady!
To an ordinary observer, he would appear as an experienced expert!
But one’s own family knows its own situation.
This was indeed his first time doing such a task, and considering Zhao Feng was Zhao Zilong’s elder brother, Ding Ling inevitably took it seriously and felt anxious!
This resulted in him expending immense heart power during the treatment.
Fortunately, he succeeded in the end.
Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan watched all this intently.
They were extremely impressed by Ding Ling.
For someone so young to be incredibly brave and powerful was already astonishing enough!
But he was also a master in the medical field!
He was just too formidable!
They looked at him with admiration.
Zhao Xiaoyiu was particularly grateful, slaughtering the family’s only old hen to make soup and stew for Ding Ling, hoping he would eat well and be satiated.
[Achievement Medal Earned: You saved Zhao Feng, who was certain to die.]
[Note: According to historical trends, Zhao Feng would have unlikely lived for long.
Your treatment eradicated his fatal injury.]
[Achievement Medal Earned: Gratitude from Zhao Xiaoyiu!]
[Note: Zhao Xiaoyiu was like a fleeting firework in the historical tide.
Undoubtedly, without your rescue, her fate would have definitely been unfavorable.
She understands this.
Her gratitude towards you was already intense, even more so at the moment you treated Zhao Feng.
She already had thoughts of repaying you by serving as a loyal follower!
If you make an effort, marrying her wouldn’t be difficult!
In ancient times, having three wives and four concubines was quite common.
You shouldn’t doubt your charm and capability!]
Earned two achievement medals consecutively.
[Ordinary Achievement Medal: 24]!
This was Ding Ling’s current progress.
Rather significant!
Zhao Feng and Zhao Xiaoyiu can hardly be found in historical records, who would have thought he could earn achievement medals from them?
Was this due to their connection to Zhao Zilong?
As the later-stage character deemed strongest by combat power in Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Zhao Zilong’s Qi fortune was undoubtedly high.
Being his relatives, and Zhao Feng not having low combat power himself, it seemed understandable for him to carry an achievement medal.
As for Zhao Xiaoyiu?
Perhaps she gained favor from Zhao Feng and Zhao Zilong, and due to her deep gratitude towards him, she would likely have an achievement medal?
Ding Ling pondered, not overthinking it.
After all, it was a good thing, wishing for more of it was natural.
The next day.
Zhao Feng awoke, naturally expressing profound gratitude towards Ding Ling.
Upon learning Ding Ling’s journey was to seek Zhao Zilong’s mentor Tong Yuan,
Zhao Feng wanted to volunteer to guide him, but due to his injuries, moving was inconvenient.
Ultimately, Zhao Xiaoyiu proactively said:
"I’ve been to Penglai Mountain several times, and I can lead the way!"
She seemed concerned Ding Ling wouldn’t believe her, adding:
"Actually, my martial arts skills aren’t bad either.
But I fought several battles earlier, exhausted myself, and sustained minor injuries, which led to my capture by bandits.
With my skills, traveling to remote mountainous areas is safe."
Ding Ling pondered and said:
"Let’s wait until your brother recovers sufficiently before going.
Otherwise, if the bandits return, wouldn’t you be in danger?"
Zhao Xiaoyiu felt increasingly grateful about this.
In this era, few prominent figures would consider matters from the viewpoint of the ’common folk’.
Ding Ling was indeed the only general she had met who knew how to empathize and consider the plight of the ’common folk’.
Ding Ling was unaware of what Zhao Xiaoyiu was thinking.
He acted this way,
also aiming to improve his rapport with Zhao Feng and Zhao Xiaoyiu.
Facilitating the recruitment of Zhao Zilong and his three siblings.
Even if he decided to walk the Path of the War God and temporarily align with a wise leader, Ding Ling hoped to recruit several experts to accompany him.
This way, his journey would be much smoother.
Three days passed like this.
During this period, Ding Ling logged in and out three times.
His comings and goings were brief.
Still not interacting with any players.
However, he knew his reputation must have spread across many regions, as every time he logged in and out, he noticed some players giving him ’peculiar’ looks.
"What do they mean by this?"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
But he didn’t bother to investigate.
He had moved to a countryside area far from the city’s disputes.
There were only old folks and children there.
None of them played games or surfed the internet, at most, they watched television and movies through connectivity.
But Ding Ling was unaware that...

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Players’ Investigation of Ding Ling
paragraphs: As Ding Ling’s fame increased, his rank on the leaderboard rose higher and higher.
Many of his past activities were uncovered by some knowledgeable individuals.

Moreover, to discover the secret behind Ding Ling’s rapid rise in power, some wealthy second-generation and first-generation individuals even hired mercenaries to search for Ding Ling in the city where he resided!
Of course, the outcome was not satisfactory.
Ding Ling chose his hiding places and times very well.
In the short term, there was no need to worry about being found.
Even if he were found, Ding Ling could hide deep in the mountains for some time.
The game helmet didn’t need to connect to the internet, which was one of Ding Ling’s sources of confidence.
If the helmet needed an internet connection, things would certainly be troublesome.
But fortunately, it didn’t.
Offline, they temporarily couldn’t find Ding Ling.
These wealthy individuals then tried to search for him online.
But now, Ding Ling’s status and strength in the Three Kingdoms World were extraordinary; even if they found him, they couldn’t do anything to him.
Unless their power or influence could suppress Ding Ling.
But at least for now, that seemed impossible.
They then waited at the Player Plaza.
However, Ding Ling came and went in a hurry, and their strategy also proved ineffective.
Yet, with the increased frequency and duration of their stakeout,
the information they gathered about Ding Ling constantly changed.
"Ding Ling defeated Juyi in front of everyone!"

"Ding Ling is the so-called All-Purpose King! He defeated famous scholars like Tian Feng and Jushou from Jizhou, gaining the sincere admiration of all the scholars, who didn’t hesitate to humble themselves and approach him!"
"Ding Ling got promoted. He became the Tiger Valor General!"
"It seems Ding Ling is at odds with the Prefect of Changshan County."

"Ding Ling is known for being decisive and ruthless. Some players say they were killed twice by Ding Ling near Changshan County! Their skill levels dropped from level 2 to level 0. A month’s hard work returned to square one!"
One incident after another!
Extremely impactful!
It shocked many of the mercenaries!
They couldn’t believe there was such a person in this world!
Even after confirming this multiple times, they still found it utterly incredible!
Thus, they each personally went to Jizhou Ye City and conducted a secret investigation for a few days!
But the results were even more shocking than the rumors!
"Hann Fu kept Ding Ling and Xun Chen’s chess manual, and couldn’t help but study it during meals!
"Tian Feng and Jushou praised Ding Ling’s excellence to everyone!"
"Pan Feng felt proud to have unearthed such a talent as Ding Ling!"
The mercenaries were almost shocked to the point of dropping their jaws.
"A newcomer! How could he be so formidable? Could he really be a descendant of a Hidden Clan?!"
They were bewildered.
They provided all the details of their investigation to their employer.
Upon learning this, the employers instinctively felt the ’information’ was false, and were infuriated. However, every mercenary, detective, and player said the same thing.
They had no choice but to believe it:

"Is there really such an all-powerful person in this world?! Not only knowledgeable in everything, but also proficient? Defeating various famous scholars?! How old is Ding Ling anyway? Even if he started learning in his past life, he shouldn’t be this impossibly exceptional, right?!"
The employers were stunned.
One by one, they began to delve into every detail of Ding Ling’s past, trying to find traces of him being a Hidden Clan’s inheritor!
How could an ordinary family possibly nurture such a prodigy?!
There must be a terrifying, unknown mastermind behind all this!
This mastermind controlled everything!
This person perfectly concealed all traces of Ding Ling! Making him appear so ordinary!
If not for the advent of the Mythical Game, this inheritor Ding Ling might have remained hidden in the vast Red Dust, unknown to anyone!
"Too terrifying!"
"A Hidden Clan indeed!"

"Only the legendary Hidden Clan could possess this kind of power! Remember, do not conduct any more high-profile investigations, lest we anger the big player behind Ding Ling! That would spell trouble!"

"But, Patriarch... I think Ding Ling might just be an ordinary person. From what I’ve investigated, everything from Ding Ling’s birth certificate to school records, along with his classmates and colleagues... all prove that Ding Ling is an ordinary person!"
Someone refuted, objecting.
The Patriarch sighed:

"That’s precisely what makes it so frightening! Doing everything so flawlessly, yet even when we know something is amiss, we find no clues! Such methods are truly terrifying to an unparalleled degree! Be cautious! You must not offend the person behind Ding Ling!"
"The Patriarch is absolutely right! Better safe than sorry. Caution is the key to safety!"
"Indeed. Whether or not there is a big player behind Ding Ling, be cautious! If there really is, our thousand-year-old clan could be destroyed overnight?! That is not something we can accept!"
With the help of Ding Ling’s ’Medical Full Level’ skill.
After a few days of recuperation.
Zhao Feng had mostly recovered.
Without further concerns, Zhao Xiaoyiu immediately took Ding Ling to Penglai Mountain.
The name Penglai Mountain sounds celestial.
But in reality, it’s a nameless mountain hidden within Changshan County.
This place is a good thirty to forty miles away from Zhao Family Village.
The journey was tough and arduous, treading only mountain paths.
Halfway through, due to the rugged path, Ding Ling had to dismount and lead his horse forward.
They walked for several hours like this.
Finally reaching the foot of Penglai Mountain.
Here,
Ding Ling finally saw many players.
"Hey. Look, doesn’t that person look like Ding Ling?!"
Some players also noticed Ding Ling, pointed at him, and whispered:
"Who would have thought he came to Penglai Mountain too? Is he here to be apprenticed?"

"We were assigned here from the start to learn, so we’ve never left these deep mountains and forests! It’s different for outsiders coming to Penglai Mountain, they must pass a test, otherwise, they leave empty-handed!"
Ding Ling understood, and smiled slightly; he didn’t need to undergo testing.
Because Zhao Xiaoyiu had connections here at Penglai Mountain.
Ding Ling handed the letter to Zhao Xiaoyiu, asking her to deliver it to Tong Yuan.
Zhao Xiaoyiu nodded vigorously, joyfully taking the letter up the mountain.

Being able to help Ding Ling was something very enjoyable for her; after spending a few days together, Ding Ling’s omnipotent and invincible image had deeply rooted in Zhao Xiaoyiu’s heart, making her admire and adore him immensely!
A moment later.
Zhao Xiaoyiu returned down the mountain with a majestic-looking, eight-foot tall man.
"Second Brother, this is Ding Ling."
Zhao Xiaoyiu pointed at Ding Ling and said crisply.
The majestic man’s eyes lit up slightly, sped up to Ding Ling, and without further ado, gave a grand salute:
"Benefactor, please accept the bow from Zhao Yun!"
Zhao Yun?
Ding Ling’s pupils slightly contracted, unable to resist scrutinizing Zhao Yun up and down.
Sure enough, he was full of vigor and robustness, with an excellent appearance.

chapters.title: Chapter 42: Spear God Tong Yuan
paragraphs: The first meeting between Zhao Yun and Ding Ling was very pleasant.
Both parties were courteous and respectful, neither arrogant nor humble, and they already had a favorable impression of each other.
Therefore, after the initial ’adaptation’, the two quickly found themselves laughing and chatting.
This scene, from the perspective of the players, nearly shattered their preconceived notions.
They couldn’t make sense of it!
How did Ding Ling, who just arrived, become so familiar with Zhao Zilong, whom they had tried every means to ingratiate themselves with?!
"Comparing oneself to others can really anger you!"
They sighed.
"How much effort have we spent? Only to earn a slight favor from Zhao Zilong. But Ding Ling? This guy is truly a human-shaped beast as others say! It’s frightening!"
Especially when they saw Ding Ling enter without an assessment.
They were even more shocked, nearly spitting blood in disbelief!
Ding Ling followed Zhao Zilong and the others up the mountain.
He met Tong Yuan.
Scattered across the mountain were several bamboo houses.
Tong Yuan lived in the central bamboo house.
He was practicing with his spear.
Ding Ling stood to the side with Zhao Zilong, Zhao Xiaoyiu, and Zhao Bingxuan, waiting.
After a while.
Tong Yuan stopped, turned around, and glanced at Ding Ling.
At this moment, Ding Ling clearly saw Tong Yuan’s appearance and figure.
Ancient like a towering cypress;
Vigorous like a wild horse with flowing mane!
With grizzled hair and beard, a face ruddy, like an old immortal stepping on clouds!
Standing with a long spear in hand, like a Spear God towering in the forest!
This was a peerless master of the Martial Dao!
Ding Ling quickly saluted him.
Tong Yuan waved his hand and said loudly:
"We do not practice customary etiquette here. No need for this anymore in the future."
He asked Ding Ling to come closer and to stretch out his hand.
He wanted to assess Ding Ling’s bone structure.
Ding Ling did not refuse.
After a long time.
Tong Yuan released his hand, his face filled with bewilderment and doubt:
"According to Pan Feng, you have exceptional talent, almost the child of this era. But why is your bone so ordinary?"
Ding Ling was speechless, only able to say he didn’t know.
"This is truly against logic."
Tong Yuan stroked his beard, his eyes bright and piercing as he stared at Ding Ling, as if trying to see through him:

"I know Pan Feng well, he’s definitely not someone who speaks thoughtlessly. He praised you highly in his letter and requested that I teach you Breathing Technique and Spear Technique. Out of regard for my friendship with him, I can agree."
Ding Ling showed a joyful expression.
"Don’t get too happy too soon."
Tong Yuan smiled and said:
"Let me say this first: if you can’t master the martial arts I teach you at a proficient level, I won’t let you descend the mountain. Unless you’re willing to..."
He pointed to the players at the foot of the mountain:
"Learn from the Pile Skill like them."
"No problem."
Ding Ling confidently replied, activating full-level acting:
"I will definitely learn the Breathing Technique and Spear Technique taught by the senior."
"Quite confident indeed."
Tong Yuan chuckled:
"However, the more confident one is, often the greater the setbacks. I hope you can endure the upcoming period. Don’t give up lightly."
Ding Ling naturally agreed.
Zhao Yun was watching from the side, not speaking.
When Tong Yuan asked Ding Ling to visit him again the next day, Zhao Yun finally pulled Ding Ling aside and said:
"Ding Ling, although the master is easy-going, he is extremely strict when teaching disciples! You need to be mentally prepared."
Due to Ding Ling’s request, Zhao Yun began calling Ding Ling by name, no longer addressing him as benefactor.
"Don’t worry. I know my limits."
"I also need to remind you of a few things."
"Go ahead."

"The master’s specialty: Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique is really difficult. I’ve been practicing it for a long time, but I still haven’t reached the Transformation Realm! Also, the master’s signature supreme skill, ’Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear’, is particularly hard! I’ve already practiced to a successful completion. But when I learned this spear technique, it was extremely tough, and it took a long time before I finally succeeded."
Zhao Yun spoke wholeheartedly to Ding Ling.
Saying everything in detail.
Ding Ling understood Zhao Yun’s meaning, occasionally nodding to indicate he would pay attention.
Zhao Xiaoyiu also occasionally chimed in:

"The master said my second brother’s talent is rare through the ages. But even so, my second brother has been learning Breathing Technique and Spear Technique for over ten years. To this day, he hasn’t achieved Great Success into Innate Ability! It shows the difficulty of these skills."
She paused, comforting Ding Ling:
"The master is only strict when teaching skills. He’s usually very easy to talk to. You mustn’t take it too hard. Study well, I’m sure you will succeed!"
It’s obvious.
Including Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Yun, no one believed Ding Ling could master Tong Yuan’s specialty in a short time.
Except for Zhao Bingxuan.
She had stayed in Ye City.
Clearly aware of Ding Ling’s terrifying accomplishments.
She held a nearly blind admiration for Ding Ling.
The next day.
Zhao Yun took Ding Ling, Zhao Xiaoyiu, and Zhao Bingxuan to visit Tong Yuan after breakfast.
Still in front of that bamboo house.
This time, however, Tong Yuan seemed to be engaging in some special practice.
He was sitting cross-legged on a bamboo stalk, floating gently, as if ready to ascend like an immortal at any moment.
With each breath.
White mist spouted from his nostrils.
Ding Ling was astounded.
Zhao Yun explained in a low voice:
"This is the external manifestation of the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique reaching the Transformation Realm."
"This is incredible."
Ding Ling was stunned.
Despite having seen many martial arts and xianxia films with high-flying characters.
It still paled compared to witnessing it in ’real life’ with his own eyes.
Moreover.
This is the Three Kingdoms World! Not the Martial World!
"Indeed. The master’s martial arts are divine. I wonder when I will reach his level."
Zhao Yun was envious.
- Whoosh!
Tong Yuan exhaled a deep breath, suddenly his body expanded, leaping over ten feet, floating away like the wind, and landed before Ding Ling.
- Creak!
The bamboo he was sitting on squeaked, bounced a few times, then straightened like a sword.
"Show me your spear technique."
Tong Yuan’s eyebrows were sharp as swords, his gaze electric as he looked at Ding Ling.
At that moment, he was clearly in teaching mode.
Although unexpected, Ding Ling was prepared following Zhao Yun’s advice, immediately shaking a long spear.
This long spear was borrowed from Zhao Yun.
Ding Ling only brought a halberd up the mountain, lacking a spear.
And as Zhao Yun foretold, Tong Yuan required him to demonstrate his spear technique.
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate.
High-tier Spear Technique burst like starlight in the void, vigorously shooting out five star points consecutively, with vigorous qi splitting the air, forming small swirling blasts at the spot.
After a moment.
Ding Ling retracted his spear and stood, bowing towards Tong Yuan.
Tong Yuan nodded, his tense face relaxed slightly, stroking his beard affirmingly:

"Your spear technique foundation is solid. It seems we can skip the basics. I’ll teach you a Spiritual Snake Spear Technique next. It surpasses high-tier spear technique as true martial arts. Pay attention!"
