"No problem."
Ding Ling confidently replied, activating full-level acting:
"I will definitely learn the Breathing Technique and Spear Technique taught by the senior."
"Quite confident indeed."
Tong Yuan chuckled:
"However, the more confident one is, often the greater the setbacks.
I hope you can endure the upcoming period.
Don’t give up lightly."
Ding Ling naturally agreed.
Zhao Yun was watching from the side, not speaking.
When Tong Yuan asked Ding Ling to visit him again the next day, Zhao Yun finally pulled Ding Ling aside and said:
"Ding Ling, although the master is easy-going, he is extremely strict when teaching disciples!
You need to be mentally prepared."
Due to Ding Ling’s request, Zhao Yun began calling Ding Ling by name, no longer addressing him as benefactor.
"Don’t worry.
I know my limits."
"I also need to remind you of a few things."
"Go ahead."
"The master’s specialty: Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique is really difficult.
I’ve been practicing it for a long time, but I still haven’t reached the Transformation Realm!
Also, the master’s signature supreme skill, ’Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear’, is particularly hard!
I’ve already practiced to a successful completion.
But when I learned this spear technique, it was extremely tough, and it took a long time before I finally succeeded."
Zhao Yun spoke wholeheartedly to Ding Ling.
Saying everything in detail.
Ding Ling understood Zhao Yun’s meaning, occasionally nodding to indicate he would pay attention.
Zhao Xiaoyiu also occasionally chimed in:
"The master said my second brother’s talent is rare through the ages.
But even so, my second brother has been learning Breathing Technique and Spear Technique for over ten years.
To this day, he hasn’t achieved Great Success into Innate Ability!
It shows the difficulty of these skills."
She paused, comforting Ding Ling:
"The master is only strict when teaching skills.
He’s usually very easy to talk to.
You mustn’t take it too hard.
Study well, I’m sure you will succeed!"
It’s obvious.
Including Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Yun, no one believed Ding Ling could master Tong Yuan’s specialty in a short time.
Except for Zhao Bingxuan.
She had stayed in Ye City.
Clearly aware of Ding Ling’s terrifying accomplishments.
She held a nearly blind admiration for Ding Ling.
The next day.
Zhao Yun took Ding Ling, Zhao Xiaoyiu, and Zhao Bingxuan to visit Tong Yuan after breakfast.
Still in front of that bamboo house.
This time, however, Tong Yuan seemed to be engaging in some special practice.
He was sitting cross-legged on a bamboo stalk, floating gently, as if ready to ascend like an immortal at any moment.
With each breath.
White mist spouted from his nostrils.
Ding Ling was astounded.
Zhao Yun explained in a low voice:
"This is the external manifestation of the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique reaching the Transformation Realm."
"This is incredible."
Ding Ling was stunned.
Despite having seen many martial arts and xianxia films with high-flying characters.
It still paled compared to witnessing it in ’real life’ with his own eyes.
Moreover.
This is the Three Kingdoms World!
Not the Martial World!
"Indeed.
The master’s martial arts are divine.
I wonder when I will reach his level."
Zhao Yun was envious.
- Whoosh!
Tong Yuan exhaled a deep breath, suddenly his body expanded, leaping over ten feet, floating away like the wind, and landed before Ding Ling.
- Creak!
The bamboo he was sitting on squeaked, bounced a few times, then straightened like a sword.
"Show me your spear technique."
Tong Yuan’s eyebrows were sharp as swords, his gaze electric as he looked at Ding Ling.
At that moment, he was clearly in teaching mode.
Although unexpected, Ding Ling was prepared following Zhao Yun’s advice, immediately shaking a long spear.
This long spear was borrowed from Zhao Yun.
Ding Ling only brought a halberd up the mountain, lacking a spear.
And as Zhao Yun foretold, Tong Yuan required him to demonstrate his spear technique.
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate.
High-tier Spear Technique burst like starlight in the void, vigorously shooting out five star points consecutively, with vigorous qi splitting the air, forming small swirling blasts at the spot.
After a moment.
Ding Ling retracted his spear and stood, bowing towards Tong Yuan.
Tong Yuan nodded, his tense face relaxed slightly, stroking his beard affirmingly:
"Your spear technique foundation is solid.
It seems we can skip the basics.
I’ll teach you a Spiritual Snake Spear Technique next.
It surpasses high-tier spear technique as true martial arts.
Pay attention!"

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Zhao Yun Shocked
paragraphs: Clang!
Clang, clang, clang!

Tong Yuan directly used a wooden stick as a spear, not only demonstrating the essence of the Spiritual Snake Spear Technique, but also personally demonstrating and practicing the various mysteries of the technique.
It was clearly just a rotten piece of deadwood!
Yet in his hands, it transformed into a divine ruler that seemed capable of measuring Heaven and Earth, a giant serpent seemingly ready to devour anyone in its path!
At its peak, it stirred up waves from thin air, the deadwood unleashing an astonishing and horrifying dance of myriad snakes!
Swoosh!
Tong Yuan exhaled deeply, putting away the deadwood, and looked at Ding Ling:
"How do you feel?"
He had demonstrated the full version of the Spiritual Snake Spear Technique once:
"If you find it too difficult, I can explain and demonstrate it in parts. You can learn it move by move until you fully comprehend and master it!"
He pointed at Zhao Zilong and said:

"Zhao Yun is the most proud closed-door disciple of my life. Even he took no less than three years to reach the Realm of Perfection with the Spiritual Snake Spear Technique. Although this technique seems simple, it is actually extremely difficult to master completely. The vast majority of people can only grasp its surface in a lifetime, unable to truly understand the essence of this spear technique.
If you can learn this spear technique within two or three years, I will teach you the advanced version.
If not,
then you should go down the mountain."
It was clear that only by learning the Spiritual Snake Spear Technique would he accept Ding Ling as his disciple and then begin targeted and strict teaching!
Ding Ling understood in his heart, nodded, and said nothing. He just closed his eyes slightly, and everything he had just seen and heard flashed quickly through his mind.
The bookshelves in the library also quickly condensed a book at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Several large characters were boldly engraved on the book:
Spiritual Snake Spear Technique
Boom!
[Spiritual Snake Spear Technique Full Level]
[Strength +1.1]
[Agility +1.3]
[Constitution +1.1]
All the essence of the Spiritual Snake Spear Technique crashed into the Sea of Consciousness!
One by one, incredible esoteric truths were etched into his bones as instinct.
In just an instant, the Spiritual Snake Spear Technique had startlingly reached full level, attaining a state of perfection, ease, and natural harmony.
Clang!
Ding Ling shook the spear in his hand, and at this moment, it seemed to transform into a spirit snake, darting through his hands, swimming through the void, reaching the pinnacle of flexibility.
Whoosh, whoosh!
In an instant, eight starlight points were pierced out!
Each one seemed capable of piercing through the universe, radiating brilliant light!

After completing a full version of the Spiritual Snake Spear Technique, Ding Ling’s momentum sharply increased, his aura continuously soaring, with his entire physique and height seemingly breaking through to a new level in the unseen.
He became increasingly perfect, strong, and resilient!
After all, his agility and constitution both surpassed 10 points!
This allowed Ding Ling to break through two constraints once again.
An aura of transcendence became increasingly apparent.
Zhao Yun was stunned:
"This, this, this...?"
"How is this possible?!"
Tong Yuan was shocked, so much so that he unconsciously pulled out one of his beard hairs, the pain making the corners of his eyes twitch twice.
"So powerful!"
Zhao Xiaoyiu found it unbelievable:
"This is the Spiritual Snake Spear Technique! How could you learn it so easily?!"
Zhao Xiaoyiu had also been taught some spear techniques by Tong Yuan.
She knew a little about the Spiritual Snake Spear Technique but only a mere skin-deep understanding.

Because she was not from Penglai Mountain and compared to Zhao Yun, she was too clumsy, she had not been accepted as a closed-door disciple by Tong Yuan and naturally did not have to learn the skills to go down the mountain.
So she was free to go up and down the mountain.
"No wonder you’re a general."
Zhao Bingxuan looked full of admiration and worship, especially seeing the disbelief on Zhao Yun, Tong Yuan, and Zhao Xiaoyiu’s faces, filling her with even more pride.

After all, she had long since regarded Ding Ling as her master. The stronger and more admired Ding Ling was, the happier and more delighted she became. Her sense of achievement and honor naturally grew stronger.
At this moment, she had a feeling of indescribable satisfaction.
She even thought: Tong Yuan and Zhao Yun never thought the general could learn the Spiritual Snake Spear Technique so quickly, and yet?
"Are you sure you’ve never learned the Spiritual Snake Spear Technique before?"
Tong Yuan questioned.
"Absolutely sure."
Ding Ling answered confidently.
He was also extremely satisfied in his heart.
He had just climbed the mountain and was taught a spear technique almost as potent as the Battlefield Saber Technique!
Tong Yuan was truly generous!
"Who would believe such a scene without witnessing it?"
Zhao Yun took a deep breath, feeling a bit self-conscious:
"I took three years to reach your level, Ding Ling!"
"Yes, even such an extraordinary talent like Zhao Yun took three years!"
Tong Yuan couldn’t help but look Ding Ling up and down:
"How could you possibly learn this in less than half a moment? And you’ve learned it to such a highly skilled, instinctive level! How could this be possible?!"
Ding Ling did not speak further.
Tong Yuan still wore a face of disbelief.
If Ding Ling were relatively talented, he could accept it.
But Ding Ling’s talent defied all reason.
Tong Yuan couldn’t accept this.
Because it didn’t fit his worldview or his life’s perspective!
He pondered:

"Pan Feng said you could be called a child of the era, and it seems he wasn’t wrong. Of course, provided you are truly extraordinary. But given the Spiritual Snake Spear Technique just performed, you indeed display the traits of the legendary child of the era."
His eyes seemed to contain sharp blades, attempting to see through Ding Ling:
"I still find it hard to believe there could be such a prodigy like you in this world. How about this."
He swung the wooden stick in his hand:

"I’ll teach you a Spirit Crane Spear Technique next! The Spirit Crane Spear Technique is as challenging as the Spiritual Snake Spear Technique. However, it is the foundation of my supreme skill, the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear. Only by mastering the Spirit Crane Spear Technique, and then moving on to the Spirit Phoenix Spear Technique, will you have a chance to learn and master my Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear. Now, what I will be demonstrating is the Spirit Crane Spear Technique. Watch carefully!"
Boom!
A burst of vigorous qi arose from thin air.

A piece of deadwood at that moment seemed to transform into a Spirit Crane spreading its wings and flying, sometimes flapping its wings, soaring high into the sky; other times surveying the mortal world, roaming the nine skies and ten lands for 100,000 miles;
Sometimes it dove toward the earth, its beak like a needle, as if to pierce through everything.
A piece of deadwood, yet it was practiced, like a dream, like an illusion!
It was as if a crane was truly dancing before his eyes, manipulating Heaven and Earth, showcasing a life’s learned essence.
Ding Ling watched, mesmerized.
At his current level,
he could already understand some of the Spirit Crane Spear Technique.
It was precisely because he could understand, that he realized the remarkable nature of this spear technique. This was another technique not inferior to the Battlefield Saber Technique!
Tong Yuan was much more generous than he had imagined!
He had expected Tong Yuan to evaluate him with various tests and pressure.
But there wasn’t a single test.
He went straight into substantial teaching content!
Undoubtedly, Pan Feng’s letter played a key role.
Ding Ling felt a sense of gratitude towards Pan Feng, thinking there was a necessity to change Pan Feng’s fate of being ’accidentally’ killed by Hua Xiong!
Of course, this was based on another grand event of the campaign against Dong Zhuo occurring again in this Three Kingdoms World!
However, with player intervention, the Three Kingdoms World would inevitably change beyond recognition. It was uncertain if this great event would happen again as expected.
Boom!
A surge of overwhelming qi turned into a whirlwind, rushing towards a side of bamboo and wood, shattering it with a loud sound.
Swoosh!
Tong Yuan settled into a stance, looking at Ding Ling and smiling slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 44: Spirit Crane Spear Technique
paragraphs: "How does it feel?"
"Not bad."
Ding Ling activated his full-level acting skills and said confidently.
Actually, he had just understood a bit of the spear technique’s esoteric truths and essence, realizing just how powerful it was.
Truly asking him to learn and practice it,
it would take several months to master in an ideal situation. In an unideal situation, three to five years is just normal.
"Oh?"
Tong Yuan looked suspicious, stroking his beard as he considered Ding Ling with numerous questions wanting to spill from his lips, but after deliberating for a while, he only said,
"Can you demonstrate it once?"
"I can."
Ding Ling nodded with certainty and then slightly closed his eyes.
He employed the same old trick.
The various aspects of the Spirit Crane Spear Technique flashed through his mind.
Afterward...
A book quickly materialized on the library’s bookshelf:
"Spirit Crane Spear Technique"
Boom!
[Spirit Crane Spear Technique Full Level]
[Strength +1]
[Agility +1.4]
[Constitution +1]
All the esoteric truths and essence of the Spirit Crane Spear Technique were comprehended by Ding Ling in an instant.
The various moves of the spear technique seemed to become engrained as instinct onto Ding Ling’s body.
Ding Ling grasped the spear, giving it a shake.
His body moved with the spear.
Clang, clang, clang!
Nine spear shadows emerged out of nowhere!

In an instant, nine points of starlight flashed by, each seeming capable of piercing through a person’s skull, the vigorous qi immense, creating a cold wind, the speed so fast it was hard to perceive with the naked eye!
Chirp!
One could vaguely hear the cry of a spirit crane!
The spear danced until the end, like a spirit crane soaring high, as if it could fly a thousand miles and gaze upon the world below! A dynamic and overbearing aura formed in the void.
Phew!
Ding Ling retracted the spear and stood, took a deep breath, and cupped his hand toward Tong Yuan to indicate he had finished the demonstration.
Tong Yuan was dumbfounded.
"How is this possible?!"
Zhao Yun was stunned.
"Incredible!"
Zhao Xiaoyiu trembled.
"Deserving of the title of General.
Zhao Bingxuan’s almond-shaped eyes glowed with admiration.
For a long while.
Tong Yuan seemed to come back to his senses.
He was no longer composed.
Nor was he as stern as at the beginning.
He just stared at Ding Ling, as if mumbling to himself, or speaking to Ding Ling:

"It’s inconceivable, truly inconceivable! I have lived to this age and encountered all manner of extraordinary people, but never have I heard, let alone witnessed, someone as terrifying as you, Ding Ling! Even the legendary chosen ones of the era shouldn’t be this shocking!"
To make the master lose his composure so,
throughout history, I’m afraid only Ding Ling has managed it.
Zhao Yun thought this way in his heart, but his gaze at Ding Ling grew more peculiar and awestruck.
He really couldn’t understand how Ding Ling could accomplish all this, knowing that he took years to learn the Spirit Crane Spear Technique!
Ding Ling had mastered it in an extraordinarily short time.
Even with the master’s demonstration, it had only been about a quarter of an hour!
This was simply too unbelievable!
"Are you sure you’ve never learned the Spirit Crane Spear Technique before?"
Tong Yuan asked the same question again.
It was evident his state of mind was very unstable at the moment.
"I’m sure."
Ding Ling still replied with assurance, his full-level acting activated, appearing completely natural, confident, and calm.
There was no trace of any guilty conscience!
In truth, Ding Ling was utilizing cheats, this wasn’t a reflection of his own talents.
Thus, each time people questioned him in such a manner, he felt an inexplicable sense of guilt.
At this time, his acting skills served to conceal it perfectly!

Of course, as time went on, Ding Ling’s shamelessness grew, and he became more accustomed to the cheats, so his sense of guilt was gradually dissipating. It’s likely that in a while, this guilt will completely vanish.
"Phew."
Tong Yuan exhaled deeply, forcefully suppressing the turbulent waves of his emotions!
His worldview and life philosophy were becoming unstable at this moment.
He needed some time to recover.
After a long while.
He collected himself and said to Ding Ling,
"I really can’t understand your level of genius! It’s beyond my realm of comprehension!"
He spoke to himself,

"From a young age, I was obsessed with the path of cultivation, so in my youth, I traveled north and south, studying the Hundred Schools of Martial Arts, ultimately acquiring the mysterious Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique and Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique on Penglai Island.
With this legacy, I worked hard for many years and finally became the Spear God known to the world!
And even then, as recorded in the legacy, I could be considered fairly talented. However, comparing to you, I really am nothing."
"You are too modest, senior.
Ding Ling activated his acting, solemnly saying,
"In this era, aside from you, there is no one else who can hold the title of Spear God! You have already ascended to the pinnacle of the mundane world. How could you undermine yourself?"
"You are right."
Tong Yuan, comforted in turn by Ding Ling, couldn’t help but smile wryly,
"Indeed, I was under an illusion."
He sighed,

"But your genius is not even recorded in the legacy. The legacy records identify the top spear master from the Ancient Era as Chiyou. And even Chiyou didn’t possess talent as terrifying as yours! That’s why I feel your existence is like a fantasy, incomprehensible!"
Chiyou?
Ding Ling was secretly astonished.
Could it be that this Spear God’s legacy comes from Chiyou?
Tong Yuan seemed to see through Ding Ling’s thoughts and said,
"This legacy does not originate from Chiyou. But it does record the spear techniques Chiyou mastered."
"Senior, are you saying?"
"Exactly."
Tong Yuan stroked his beard and said,

"The Spirit Snake, Spirit Crane, Spirit Phoenix, and other spear techniques were all mastered by Chiyou. It could be said that the legacy evolved from Chiyou’s martial skills. Later, it was revised and improved several times, hence the names of the techniques also changed, becoming the current spear techniques. As for the original name of the spear skill? I don’t know either."
"I see."
Ding Ling’s heart surged with emotion.
Never did he think Tong Yuan’s legacy could be traced back to the Ancient Era.
No wonder he calls himself the Penglai Spear God.
It turns out it’s because the legacy was acquired from Penglai Island.
"But to my knowledge, wasn’t Chiyou’s divine weapon the Tiger Soul Saber?"
"Who told you Chiyou only mastered saber techniques?"
Tong Yuan displayed a peculiar expression,

"Chiyou was adept with all eighteen classical weapons, and while he may have been most skilled with saber techniques, his proficiency in spear techniques wasn’t lacking either. Otherwise, this legacy wouldn’t have lasted through the ages."
After a conversation lasting a while.
Tong Yuan’s unusual demeanor faded, and he regained a solemn demeanor,

"Let’s put aside the subject of the legacy. Let’s continue with the teaching. This time, I’ll impart to you the Spirit Phoenix Spear Technique! Compared to the Spirit Crane Spear Technique, the Spirit Phoenix Spear Technique is faster, more dynamic, and more fierce, naturally making it more difficult. It’s not easy to master. Even I had to put in significant effort to cultivate it to perfection."
He glanced at Ding Ling,
"If you learn the Spirit Phoenix Spear Technique quickly too, then..."
Then what?
He didn’t continue.
Instead, he directly began to animate the withered wood.
A piece of withered wood in that moment seemed transformed into a vividly alive phoenix!
Boom!
Every casual move held immense power.
Most importantly, it was fast!
So fast that it was like lightning, and with a swift thrust, dozens of starlight points appeared!

Chirp!
One could vaguely hear the cry of a spirit crane!
The spear danced until the end, like a spirit crane soaring high, as if it could fly a thousand miles and gaze upon the world below!
A dynamic and overbearing aura formed in the void.
Phew!
Ding Ling retracted the spear and stood, took a deep breath, and cupped his hand toward Tong Yuan to indicate he had finished the demonstration.
Tong Yuan was dumbfounded.
"How is this possible?!"
Zhao Yun was stunned.
"Incredible!"
Zhao Xiaoyiu trembled.
"Deserving of the title of General.
Zhao Bingxuan’s almond-shaped eyes glowed with admiration.
For a long while.
Tong Yuan seemed to come back to his senses.
He was no longer composed.
Nor was he as stern as at the beginning.
He just stared at Ding Ling, as if mumbling to himself, or speaking to Ding Ling:
"It’s inconceivable, truly inconceivable!
I have lived to this age and encountered all manner of extraordinary people, but never have I heard, let alone witnessed, someone as terrifying as you, Ding Ling!
Even the legendary chosen ones of the era shouldn’t be this shocking!"
To make the master lose his composure so,
throughout history, I’m afraid only Ding Ling has managed it.
Zhao Yun thought this way in his heart, but his gaze at Ding Ling grew more peculiar and awestruck.
He really couldn’t understand how Ding Ling could accomplish all this, knowing that he took years to learn the Spirit Crane Spear Technique!
Ding Ling had mastered it in an extraordinarily short time.
Even with the master’s demonstration, it had only been about a quarter of an hour!
This was simply too unbelievable!
"Are you sure you’ve never learned the Spirit Crane Spear Technique before?"
Tong Yuan asked the same question again.
It was evident his state of mind was very unstable at the moment.
"I’m sure."
Ding Ling still replied with assurance, his full-level acting activated, appearing completely natural, confident, and calm.
There was no trace of any guilty conscience!
In truth, Ding Ling was utilizing cheats, this wasn’t a reflection of his own talents.
Thus, each time people questioned him in such a manner, he felt an inexplicable sense of guilt.
At this time, his acting skills served to conceal it perfectly!
Of course, as time went on, Ding Ling’s shamelessness grew, and he became more accustomed to the cheats, so his sense of guilt was gradually dissipating.
It’s likely that in a while, this guilt will completely vanish.
"Phew."
Tong Yuan exhaled deeply, forcefully suppressing the turbulent waves of his emotions!
His worldview and life philosophy were becoming unstable at this moment.
He needed some time to recover.
After a long while.
He collected himself and said to Ding Ling,
"I really can’t understand your level of genius!
It’s beyond my realm of comprehension!"
He spoke to himself,

"From a young age, I was obsessed with the path of cultivation, so in my youth, I traveled north and south, studying the Hundred Schools of Martial Arts, ultimately acquiring the mysterious Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique and Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique on Penglai Island.
With this legacy, I worked hard for many years and finally became the Spear God known to the world!
And even then, as recorded in the legacy, I could be considered fairly talented.
However, comparing to you, I really am nothing."
"You are too modest, senior.
Ding Ling activated his acting, solemnly saying,
"In this era, aside from you, there is no one else who can hold the title of Spear God!
You have already ascended to the pinnacle of the mundane world.
How could you undermine yourself?"
"You are right."
Tong Yuan, comforted in turn by Ding Ling, couldn’t help but smile wryly,
"Indeed, I was under an illusion."
He sighed,
"But your genius is not even recorded in the legacy.
The legacy records identify the top spear master from the Ancient Era as Chiyou.
And even Chiyou didn’t possess talent as terrifying as yours!
That’s why I feel your existence is like a fantasy, incomprehensible!"
Chiyou?
Ding Ling was secretly astonished.
Could it be that this Spear God’s legacy comes from Chiyou?
Tong Yuan seemed to see through Ding Ling’s thoughts and said,
"This legacy does not originate from Chiyou.
But it does record the spear techniques Chiyou mastered."
"Senior, are you saying?"
"Exactly."
Tong Yuan stroked his beard and said,
"The Spirit Snake, Spirit Crane, Spirit Phoenix, and other spear techniques were all mastered by Chiyou.
It could be said that the legacy evolved from Chiyou’s martial skills.
Later, it was revised and improved several times, hence the names of the techniques also changed, becoming the current spear techniques.
As for the original name of the spear skill?
I don’t know either."
"I see."
Ding Ling’s heart surged with emotion.
Never did he think Tong Yuan’s legacy could be traced back to the Ancient Era.
No wonder he calls himself the Penglai Spear God.
It turns out it’s because the legacy was acquired from Penglai Island.
"But to my knowledge, wasn’t Chiyou’s divine weapon the Tiger Soul Saber?"
"Who told you Chiyou only mastered saber techniques?"
Tong Yuan displayed a peculiar expression,
"Chiyou was adept with all eighteen classical weapons, and while he may have been most skilled with saber techniques, his proficiency in spear techniques wasn’t lacking either.
Otherwise, this legacy wouldn’t have lasted through the ages."
After a conversation lasting a while.
Tong Yuan’s unusual demeanor faded, and he regained a solemn demeanor,
"Let’s put aside the subject of the legacy.
Let’s continue with the teaching.
This time, I’ll impart to you the Spirit Phoenix Spear Technique!
Compared to the Spirit Crane Spear Technique, the Spirit Phoenix Spear Technique is faster, more dynamic, and more fierce, naturally making it more difficult.
It’s not easy to master.
Even I had to put in significant effort to cultivate it to perfection."
He glanced at Ding Ling,
"If you learn the Spirit Phoenix Spear Technique quickly too, then..."
Then what?
He didn’t continue.
Instead, he directly began to animate the withered wood.
A piece of withered wood in that moment seemed transformed into a vividly alive phoenix!
Boom!
Every casual move held immense power.
Most importantly, it was fast!
So fast that it was like lightning, and with a swift thrust, dozens of starlight points appeared!

chapters.title: Chapter 45: Ten Spear Flowers Take Shape
paragraphs: Could not imagine.
If this spear hit someone, what kind of damage would it cause.
A thrust of the spear, yet it seems like dozens of spears are striking simultaneously!
The force of each strike seems capable of piercing through a large tree.
An average person facing this spear would not only be unable to block it, but preserving a whole corpse would be questionable.
Woo!
Tong Yuan finished demonstrating the spear technique and looked at Ding Ling:
"How was it?"
"It’s good."
Ding Ling nodded seriously and closed his eyes slightly.
The fierce and swift moves flashed through his mind one by one.
At the same time, a book quickly formed on the library shelf.
A moment later.
[Spirit Phoenix Spear Technique Full Level]
[Strength +0.8]
[Agility +1.6]
[Constitution +0.8]
All the essence of the techniques was instantly mastered by Ding Ling.
He opened his eyes, gripped the long spear, shook the spear body, followed the spear’s movement, and thrusted into the air, perfectly forming ten spear flowers!
Clang, clang, clang!
The long spear was practiced as fast as a storm, unbelievably fast!
When observed with the naked eye.
One could only see the shadows of the spear flashing across the void!
It was difficult to discern the real spear body.
After a while.
Ding Ling positioned himself and bowed to Tong Yuan: "Elder, please advise."
Tong Yuan looked up speechlessly at the sky, thinking: ’You’ve already mastered it to this level, how can I advise?!’
"Still so fast."
Zhao Yun felt ashamed, his pride shattered.
No longer showing the arrogant demeanor from before.
Becoming more humble and composed!
Only because, compared to Ding Ling.
Zhao Yun realized he was just a lousy fighter!
How could he feel proud?
Thinking about his earlier repeated instructions to Ding Ling, Zhao Yun couldn’t help but blush and feel embarrassed!
Ding Ling is such a genius.
Do I still need to worry?
Totally my overthinking!
"Too strong!"
Zhao Xiaoyiu stood stunned.
Though already shocked several times before, this time still left her dazed and speechless.
Only because she knew better than anyone the hardships her second brother endured to master the Spirit Phoenix Spear Technique!
Waking at dawn was common, practicing thrusts with hand as spear in the night was the norm.
Look at second brother.
Then look at Ding Ling.
How could Zhao Xiaoyiu not feel the turmoil within her heart, unable to contain it!
"General!"
Zhao Bingxuan looked at Ding Ling with dreamy eyes, completely captivated by Ding Ling’s charisma, demeanor, and genius.
After a while.
When Ding Ling’s hand-bowing became somewhat tired.
Tong Yuan sighed:
"Your existence makes me start to question life itself."
He spoke frankly, without considering his elder’s status.
"My mentality is particularly unstable right now. I need to rest for a day. Come learn the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear from me tomorrow."
With that said.
He quickly turned away.
As if a terrifying monster was chasing behind him, appearing rather embarrassed.
To act like this.
Shows that Tong Yuan’s mentality has completely shattered.
Almost simultaneously.
The prompt sounded:
[Obtained E-level Achievement Medal: You have received high admiration from Tong Yuan!]
[Annotation: No doubt. You learned his spear skill three consecutive times in an extremely short period! Leaving him extremely shocked, unable to contain himself!
His worldview is on the verge of collapsing.
His life’s persistence, beliefs all began to rewrite at this moment!
Your presence has caused Tong Yuan’s thoughts and mentality to undergo tremendous change.
You succeeded in astonishing and outshining a generation of Spear Gods!
Another E-level Achievement Medal.
Recalling the one on Pan Feng.
Ding Ling speculated that the E-level medal might currently only be obtainable from super-elite experts. Or by defeating, suppressing bandits significant enough to rewrite the course of history.
[Obtained Achievement Medal: You’ve gained deep recognition from Zhao Yun!]
[Annotation: Zhao Yun originally held gratitude towards you in his heart. Your performance today deeply impressed him!]
Zhao Yun’s achievement medal is not E-level.
Showing Zhao Yun is still in the growing stage.
Yet to become a super-elite expert.
Ding Ling understood.
He has now some clarity on obtaining the E-level medal.
Inside Zhao Yun’s bamboo house.
Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan prepared the meal.
The group sat down, eating and talking.
Zhao Yun looked admiringly at Ding Ling:
"You can now strike out ten spear flowers. This level is truly exceptional! I can only manage nine and a half at full effort; you are stronger than me!"
He seemed quite frustrated:
"I’ve practiced spear skills for many years. But compared to your half an hour of practicing, the gap is too wide."
He drank a cup of ’fine’ wine.
But as the wine entered his stomach, it grew increasingly bitter!
He knew this was the bitterness in his heart, the sourness in his mouth, making the food and wine tasteless.
"Indeed."
Zhao Xiaoyiu looked at Ding Ling with admiration:
"My second brother endured much hardship learning spear skills, but reaching the point of graduating soon within ten years is quite remarkable!
After all, the master’s high standards are beyond the reach of average geniuses.
Second brother achieved this, truly possessing extraordinary talent and unrivaled aptitude.
But now compared to you, this, this..."
This something.
He did not continue.
But Zhao Yun seemed to become even more miserable.
He drank a few more gulps, still unable to find relief.
Zhao Bingxuan comforted beside him:

"When my general was in Ye City, he was renowned for his unparalleled talent. Whether it’s General Zhang Hex, General Pan Feng, or even Governor of Jizhou Han Fu, they all held my general in high regard, considering him the first under heaven, an unrivaled genius through the ages!
So there’s no need for you to compare yourself with him.
Because my general is too outstanding.
Throughout history, there’s likely no one similar to him!"
These words were filled with ’sense of honor,’ ’pride,’ and ’sense of belonging.’
Claiming him as her general repeatedly, fearing others might not know Zhao Bingxuan belonged to Ding Ling.
Zhao Xiaoyiu glanced at Zhao Bingxuan with a mysterious expression, not knowing what she was thinking, only stopping her gaze after seeing Zhao Bingxuan blush with embarrassment.
"Indeed."
Zhao Yun took a deep breath, seeming much more at peace:
"Even though I can’t compare with a peerless figure like Ding Ling, but the world is vast, I believe there must be a place for Zhao Yun!"
"That’s for sure."
Ding Ling nodded solemnly:
"Brother Zhao, your martial arts are extraordinary and rare; you seem destined to be a hero of legends. I’m sure history will remember you!"
Many players have said this to Zhao Yun.
Yet Zhao Yun felt nothing when hearing it.
But Ding Ling saying these words had a completely different effect.
Zhao Yun felt uplifted, nodded and smiled:
"Even Brother Ding says so. It seems my future is bound to be exceptional!"
It’s like a beggar speaking to Zhao Yun;
Compared to a king’s words to Zhao Yun!
When the beggar says it, Zhao Yun may feel only a slight ripple.
When the king speaks.
Zhao Yun must be full of confidence, mentally invigorated!

chapters.title: Chapter 46: Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear
paragraphs: No doubt about it.
At this moment, the weight of Ding Ling in Zhao Yun’s heart is that heavy!
So heavy that Zhao Yun couldn’t even notice it.
Ding Ling admired Zhao Yun greatly.
Zhao Yun, in turn, expressed high praise and recognition for Ding Ling.
After the two opened up, they found more and more common ground, their conversation becoming increasingly joyful.
In the end, at the height of their enjoyment.
They couldn’t help but bring up Tong Yuan’s martial arts.
Ding Ling was extremely shocked by Tong Yuan’s ability to thrust dozens of spear flowers in an instant.
Zhao Yun smiled and said:

"My master is a scholar of the celestial beings, spending a lifetime researching spear techniques, condensing the martial arts of a hundred schools into spear techniques, with the help of the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique for cultivation. It is perfectly normal to reach this level."
He looked at Ding Ling with envy and amazement in his eyes:
"But given your talent, Brother Ding, I believe you will reach my master’s level sooner or later. As for me, I’m not so sure."
He sighed.
Ding Ling laughed and said:

"Brother Zhao, even your master frequently praises your talent, showing that it is extraordinary. I believe that as long as you work hard and practice diligently, you’ll eventually reach the level of your master!"
"I appreciate your kind words."
Zhao Yun laughed heartily and was very pleased:
"If I really do reach my master’s level one day, I will definitely drink three hundred cups with you!"
"It’s a deal."
"It’s a deal!"
The next day.
Zhao Yun once again brought Ding Ling and others to meet Tong Yuan.
Tong Yuan was still seated cross-legged on the bamboo.
Only this time, he no longer exuded the demeanor of a master; seeing Ding Ling, even his breath was disturbed, and his posture began to falter.
He leaped down from the bamboo, coming to stand before Ding Ling and the others.
It seemed like he had been pondering all night.
Dark circles were quite evident.
Seeing Ding Ling, Tong Yuan’s expression became unusual.
Zhao Yun understood without words that his master certainly couldn’t figure out why Ding Ling was so powerful! To the extent that he couldn’t sleep all night!
Indeed, that was the case.
Tong Yuan is a persistent person.
He must thoroughly understand and study many things before he can let go.
Otherwise, he might lose his appetite.
Therefore.
Seeing Ding Ling this morning, he couldn’t control the upheaval in his heart, his face visibly changed.
"I won’t beat around the bush.
Tong Yuan took a deep breath and got straight to the point:
"If you can also learn my Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear quickly today, I will be wholeheartedly convinced. I won’t take you as my apprentice because I am not qualified!"
’Senior...’
Ding Ling was about to say something else.
Tong Yuan raised his hand to stop him, sighing:

"If merely demonstrating and explaining once allows you to cultivate a martial art to the level of perfection, how could I teach you? How could I take you as an apprentice? Let’s just consider ourselves martial friends. Of course..."
He paused:
"The premise is that you can quickly learn my Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, let’s say in a year, no, a month."
His expression was very conflicted.
Obviously, when he mentioned a month, it was with considerable bitterness.
You have to know that whether it’s Zhao Yun or himself, learning the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear took a long time.
If Ding Ling can learn this spear technique within a year, he would already be considered an unparalleled genius!
A month?
That’s simply unimaginable!
But thinking about Ding Ling’s previous performance, he inexplicably felt some anticipation and unease.
Hopeful that this world could truly produce a remarkable, history-shaking talent!
Uneasy that if Ding Ling indeed learns so quickly, would his own title as Spear God need to ’step down in favor’?
"Yes, Senior."
Ding Ling had great respect for Tong Yuan.
Tong Yuan looked at Ding Ling with gratification and admiration.
A prodigy of such caliber, yet he is not conceited, arrogant, nor does he underestimate others, truly rare indeed!
He had seen countless people.
Jiuyuan Lu Bu was also someone he encountered.
He was also extremely talented but looked down on others, overly arrogant!
Unlike Ding Ling, who is merely confident!
This is the correct and should-be attitude in life!
"Alright."
Tong Yuan nodded.
He had secretly been observing Ding Ling all along.
Found that Ding Ling handled matters with extreme steadiness and wisdom.
This greatly aligned with Tong Yuan’s tastes.
If not for Ding Ling being so extraordinary to the point of being overwhelming, he would’ve taken him as a disciple long ago.
But precisely because Ding Ling was so superb, far exceeding his expectations, he felt unqualified to be Ding Ling’s master!
"Watch closely!"
Once Tong Yuan had clarity in his heart, he wasted no time.
Immediately began to demonstrate the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear technique!
He didn’t shy away from Zhao Xiaoyiu, Zhao Bingxuan, and the other ladies.
Explaining while demonstrating.
In Tong Yuan’s eyes, such an advanced spear technique, even if Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan watched, they wouldn’t understand!
Does everyone really think they are Zhao Zilong? Or Ding Ling?!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Tong Yuan still held a piece of dried wood.
But in his hands, the dried wood seemed to transform into an Immortal Weapon or Divine Spear!
Where the dried wood swept, starlights like meteors streak across the sky, exceedingly dazzling!
Clang clang clang!
In an instant, he thrust out dozens of spear flowers, the blooming spear flowers even gathered into spirit magpies in mid-air!
Finally, the spear flowers exploded.
Transforming in mid-air into a pattern of Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix!
The pattern was fleeting.
Yet it shone brightly and colorfully like a meteor falling in the sky!
It had reached the pinnacle of what martial prowess could describe!
"Bravo!"
"Excellent Kung Fu!"
Ding Ling, Zhao Xiaoyiu, Zhao Bingxuan, including Zhao Yun, couldn’t help but applaud and cheer.
Tong Yuan smiled slightly and glanced at the dried wood in his hand.
Crack!
Crack crack!
The dried wood turned into powder, drifting in the air.
Tong Yuan sighed:
"I still can’t infuse Vigorous Qi through wood without damaging the wood itself."
Ding Ling was speechless, thinking: You are already as formidable as an Earth Immortal, a martial arts master! Requiring even more, what about other renowned figures and fierce generals?
After watching the full spear technique of the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear.
For the sharp points of this spear technique, he had a more complete and clearer understanding.
No doubt about it.
This is an absolute spear technique not inferior to Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.

In later years, Zhao Zilong surpassed his master, researching another spear technique more suited to himself on this foundation, the Seven Probes Coiling Snake Spear Technique, proving his astounding talent!
Of course, now Zhao Zilong was still on the mountain, though he could graduate, because of Ding Ling’s arrival, he planned to stay a little longer.
It was because he realized his own inadequacies.
Comparing himself to Ding Ling, his comprehension seemed rather poor.
Of course, this was just Zhao Zilong’s opinion, as everyone including Ding Ling understood Zhao Zilong’s extraordinary nature, recognizing his comprehension as practically heavenly!
However, being around Ding Ling, Zhao Zilong felt crushed and would absolutely not believe others saying his comprehension was number one.
"Did you understand?"

To the extent that he couldn’t sleep all night!
Indeed, that was the case.
Tong Yuan is a persistent person.
He must thoroughly understand and study many things before he can let go.
Otherwise, he might lose his appetite.
Therefore.
Seeing Ding Ling this morning, he couldn’t control the upheaval in his heart, his face visibly changed.
"I won’t beat around the bush.
Tong Yuan took a deep breath and got straight to the point:
"If you can also learn my Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear quickly today, I will be wholeheartedly convinced.
I won’t take you as my apprentice because I am not qualified!"
’Senior...’
Ding Ling was about to say something else.
Tong Yuan raised his hand to stop him, sighing:
"If merely demonstrating and explaining once allows you to cultivate a martial art to the level of perfection, how could I teach you?
How could I take you as an apprentice?
Let’s just consider ourselves martial friends.
Of course..."
He paused:
"The premise is that you can quickly learn my Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear, let’s say in a year, no, a month."
His expression was very conflicted.
Obviously, when he mentioned a month, it was with considerable bitterness.
You have to know that whether it’s Zhao Yun or himself, learning the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear took a long time.
If Ding Ling can learn this spear technique within a year, he would already be considered an unparalleled genius!
A month?
That’s simply unimaginable!
But thinking about Ding Ling’s previous performance, he inexplicably felt some anticipation and unease.
Hopeful that this world could truly produce a remarkable, history-shaking talent!
Uneasy that if Ding Ling indeed learns so quickly, would his own title as Spear God need to ’step down in favor’?
"Yes, Senior."
Ding Ling had great respect for Tong Yuan.
Tong Yuan looked at Ding Ling with gratification and admiration.
A prodigy of such caliber, yet he is not conceited, arrogant, nor does he underestimate others, truly rare indeed!
He had seen countless people.
Jiuyuan Lu Bu was also someone he encountered.
He was also extremely talented but looked down on others, overly arrogant!
Unlike Ding Ling, who is merely confident!
This is the correct and should-be attitude in life!
"Alright."
Tong Yuan nodded.
He had secretly been observing Ding Ling all along.
Found that Ding Ling handled matters with extreme steadiness and wisdom.
This greatly aligned with Tong Yuan’s tastes.
If not for Ding Ling being so extraordinary to the point of being overwhelming, he would’ve taken him as a disciple long ago.
But precisely because Ding Ling was so superb, far exceeding his expectations, he felt unqualified to be Ding Ling’s master!
"Watch closely!"
Once Tong Yuan had clarity in his heart, he wasted no time.
Immediately began to demonstrate the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear technique!
He didn’t shy away from Zhao Xiaoyiu, Zhao Bingxuan, and the other ladies.
Explaining while demonstrating.
In Tong Yuan’s eyes, such an advanced spear technique, even if Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan watched, they wouldn’t understand!
Does everyone really think they are Zhao Zilong?
Or Ding Ling?!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Tong Yuan still held a piece of dried wood.
But in his hands, the dried wood seemed to transform into an Immortal Weapon or Divine Spear!
Where the dried wood swept, starlights like meteors streak across the sky, exceedingly dazzling!
Clang clang clang!
In an instant, he thrust out dozens of spear flowers, the blooming spear flowers even gathered into spirit magpies in mid-air!
Finally, the spear flowers exploded.
Transforming in mid-air into a pattern of Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix!
The pattern was fleeting.
Yet it shone brightly and colorfully like a meteor falling in the sky!
It had reached the pinnacle of what martial prowess could describe!
"Bravo!"
"Excellent Kung Fu!"
Ding Ling, Zhao Xiaoyiu, Zhao Bingxuan, including Zhao Yun, couldn’t help but applaud and cheer.
Tong Yuan smiled slightly and glanced at the dried wood in his hand.
Crack!
Crack crack!
The dried wood turned into powder, drifting in the air.
Tong Yuan sighed:
"I still can’t infuse Vigorous Qi through wood without damaging the wood itself."
Ding Ling was speechless, thinking: You are already as formidable as an Earth Immortal, a martial arts master!
Requiring even more, what about other renowned figures and fierce generals?
After watching the full spear technique of the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear.
For the sharp points of this spear technique, he had a more complete and clearer understanding.
No doubt about it.
This is an absolute spear technique not inferior to Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.

In later years, Zhao Zilong surpassed his master, researching another spear technique more suited to himself on this foundation, the Seven Probes Coiling Snake Spear Technique, proving his astounding talent!
Of course, now Zhao Zilong was still on the mountain, though he could graduate, because of Ding Ling’s arrival, he planned to stay a little longer.
It was because he realized his own inadequacies.
Comparing himself to Ding Ling, his comprehension seemed rather poor.
Of course, this was just Zhao Zilong’s opinion, as everyone including Ding Ling understood Zhao Zilong’s extraordinary nature, recognizing his comprehension as practically heavenly!
However, being around Ding Ling, Zhao Zilong felt crushed and would absolutely not believe others saying his comprehension was number one.
"Did you understand?"

chapters.title: Chapter 47: Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique
paragraphs: Tong Yuan looked at Ding Ling with a friendly demeanor:
"If you don’t understand, I can explain and demonstrate it once more."
Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan instinctively nodded.
They truly didn’t understand.
Let alone remember, comprehend, or master it!
Seeing this, Ding Ling asked Tong Yuan to demonstrate it again.
Tong Yuan’s spear technique was exceedingly graceful.
He had elevated martial arts to a level that could be considered an art form!
Being able to appreciate it once more wasn’t a bad thing.
Besides.

Ding Ling knew it wasn’t proper to get it right in one go. After all, learning the Spirit Snake, Spirit Crane, and Spirit Phoenix Spear Techniques yesterday had already greatly impacted and shocked Tong Yuan.
If this highly difficult Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear was also something he could instantly grasp, instantly master, and once mastered, reach perfection to the point it becomes instinctive.
How would Tong Yuan feel then?
Even knowing Ding Ling’s extraordinary comprehension, Tong Yuan still believed it would take about a month for Ding Ling to learn the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique.
This showed his respect and recognition for the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique.
Having Ding Ling ask for it to be demonstrated twice would definitely make Tong Yuan feel better.
As for delaying it for a month?
Ding Ling hadn’t thought about it because it wasn’t necessary. Moreover, his Path of the War God still had a long way to go, and he didn’t want to waste too much time.
Clang, clang, clang!
Tong Yuan demonstrated once again, still using a piece of rotten wood.
After a while, he finished the demonstration.
He looked at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes, and the mantra imprinted into his sea of consciousness, with the moves flashing across his mind.
A book quickly formed on the library shelf: "Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique!"
In an instant.
[Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique Full Level]
[Strength +2]
[Agility +2.6]
[Constitution +2]
Crack!
Rumble!
His bones were resonating!
His internal organs were quivering!
Ding Ling’s physique began to change once more, his height increased a little amidst the sound of thunder, and his frame became more robust and sturdy.
"This kind of transformation?!"
Tong Yuan was dumbfounded.
"No way?!"
Zhao Yun could hardly believe it.
"Perhaps Brother Ding’s transformation is the result of long hands of accumulation?"
Zhao Xiaoyiu speculated.
"General."
Zhao Bingxuan’s eyes were almost overflowing with admiration.
Boom!

Ding Ling gripped the spear tightly, moving in tandem with it, his whole being seemed to become a whirlwind between heaven and earth, where he passed, spear energy surged, blossoming into a spray of brilliant spear flowers!
More so, like wind rolling clouds, within ten meters around, nothing remained intact, all being pierced by spear lights!
In an instant, he speared out thirteen spear flowers!
Each bloomed in mid-air, finally coalescing into a "Hundred Birds Paying Homage to the Phoenix" image!
This was clearly the iconic pattern that only manifested when the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique reached great success!
Despite having some expectations earlier.
When faced with this scene, Tong Yuan was deeply shocked, his lips began to tremble, unable to find words for a while!
"Is this for real?!"
Zhao Yun’s jaw almost dropped to the ground:

"I’ve studied this spear technique for over a decade and nearly reached perfection, but there’s still a long way to go before it becomes natural and instinctive. Yet, looking at Brother Ding’s progress, he seems to have already taken the lead, reaching that Transformation Realm!!"
"Incredible!!"
Zhao Xiaoyiu’s scalp tingled with fascination:
"Although I always knew of Brother Ding’s talent, at this moment, I truly understand his terrifying prowess!"
The difference between sprinting a hundred meters in an instant versus ten thousand meters is enormous!
But Ding Ling?
In their eyes, he appeared to be such a person.
Mastering the Spirit Crane Spear Technique, etc., in half a moment.
Mastering the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique in about the same time!
Moreover, Tong Yuan and Zhao Yun seriously suspected that Ding Ling might have asked for an additional explanation out of consideration for their feelings.
Otherwise.
He might have mastered it in just one demonstration.
Thinking about this.
Tong Yuan was simultaneously shocked, gratified, and satisfied while he couldn’t help but sigh and feel embarrassed.
Shocked at Ding Ling’s terrifying talent.
Gratified that this world finally has a truly heaven-defying level powerhouse emerging.
Satisfied to exchange martial dao insights with such an unrivaled genius!
Embarrassed and ashamed that what he learned throughout his life couldn’t compare to the half-moment insight and practice of the other!
"Too monstrous, too perverse!"
Even such a hermit spear god as Tong Yuan couldn’t help but click his tongue in admiration:
"If I were younger and met a genius like you, I might have been struck into a state of self-doubt and questioning my existence.
Ding Ling couldn’t say much beside him, just staying silent.
"Steady, decent, neither arrogant nor impatient. His future is limitless."
Tong Yuan praised Ding Ling vehemently:
"I initially thought no matter how talented you were, learning it in a month was impossible. But you, you..."
He shook his head, clearly lost for words:
"Alright then."
He sighed:
"I originally planned to keep the Breathing Technique as the final trump card. But since you are so outstanding, I will also pass on the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique to you today!"
Ding Ling bowed and expressed his gratitude.
Tong Yuan waved his hand:
"You qualified to learn this Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique the moment you mastered the Spirit Snake Spear Technique. I just didn’t anticipate you being this formidable."
He paused and said:
"Listen carefully."
He began to explain and demonstrate the essence and esoteric truths of the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique.
He didn’t shy away from Zhao Xiaoyiu or Zhao Bingxuan either.
Clearly not believing they could learn it.
This Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique might seem like a breathing technique.
But in reality, it’s a vigorous Qi technique for strengthening the skin membranes and bones!

In this, one also needs to use some ancient methods to refine herbs, use the refined herbs as a paste for bathing, and pair it with the breathing technique to absorb the paste’s nutrients into the skin membranes and bones.
In this way.
The skin membranes and bones would gradually become stronger.
Until reaching an extraordinary state, where leaping tens of meters effortlessly becomes as natural as that of a land god.
Ding Ling listened once.
In the library, a new book quickly formed on a new shelf:
"Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique!"
Just in an instant.
[Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique Full Level]
[Charm +1]
Various related esoteric truths surged and circled in his sea of consciousness.
Transforming into an instinctive force flowing throughout Ding Ling’s entire body.
Causing Ding Ling’s breathing to entirely change at that moment, in each rise and fall, it resembled an ancient Spiritual Phoenix coiling up.
This was the external manifestation of the breathing technique penetrating deep into the bones and spirit.
With every breath.
Ding Ling felt himself becoming stronger.
’So this is the true essence of the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique?’
Ding Ling gathered his thoughts with dawning comprehension:
’It’s unlike some external martial arts that allow instant strength. Because the essence of this breathing technique requires herbs to be effective.’

’But since I’ve cultivated it to Great Perfection. In the future, perhaps even without much refining, directly consuming herbs can still allow me to absorb their nutrients and enhance my physical quality.’

chapters.title: Chapter 48: Winning Over Tong Yuan
paragraphs: Ding Ling had deep insights into the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique.
He reached the Perfect Realm.
Because the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique was ingrained into his very bones as an instinct, he naturally exuded a sense of nobility.
This enhanced his Charm Value!
However, strength and agility required the aid of medicinal herbs.
"The Breathing Technique is like this. What about Inner Power?"
Ding Ling pondered:

"External Skills directly extract strength, but also require timely replenishment of meat. The Breathing Technique has limitless potential, allowing simultaneous intake of medicinal herbs to enhance oneself.
How is Inner Power then?"
Ding Ling didn’t know.
Because he was still mingling in the Historical Plane.
He didn’t know when he would be able to break through to access the Martial Hero Plane.
But even with the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique, he felt extraordinary, sensing the boundless potential of this Breathing Technique!
It is definitely a top-tier Cultivation Skill surpassing both the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques and the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique.
This doesn’t mean it surpasses in difficulty but in potential.
The Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques can only enhance limited strength, agility, and physique.
But the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique is different, as it can enhance strength, agility, etc., far beyond the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques.
However, the Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques are inherently a technical Attack Skill.
It’s naturally different from a Cultivation Skill like the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique.
"You actually achieved enlightenment?!"
Tong Yuan’s eyes widened like saucers.
Zhao Yun was speechless.
He felt like he’d been hit with a ten-thousand-point critical strike!
How difficult is the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique?
It’s even more mysterious and elusive than the Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique, hard to comprehend.
It’s like a mortal trying to learn the language of immortals, understanding it feels as difficult as ascending to the heavens!
Back then, Zhao Yun suffered plenty to learn this Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique, not knowing how many medicinal baths he endured daily.
If not for his master’s ample reserves, he couldn’t have held on until he mastered the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique!
But even so, after over a decade, his Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique still couldn’t reach Great Success! He could never enter the realm of the Spiritual Phoenix Illusion Body!
Yet Ding Ling?
Seeing Ding Ling, imbued with an inexplicable aura of nobility, put a lump in Zhao Yun’s throat, almost choking him!
"Indeed."
Ding Ling was honest and had no intention of hiding it, hoping Tong Yuan could teach him more Martial Arts and skills.
Preferably more skills.
Because skills could directly enhance his strength, agility, and physique!
"Hiss!"
Even though it was clear that Ding Ling had successfully cultivated it, hearing the confirmation, Tong Yuan and Zhao Yun couldn’t help but gasp.
Each of them looked at Ding Ling as if he were a monster!
"To think that even the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique from the Ancient Era can be mastered so quickly! Truly remarkable."
Tong Yuan felt as if he’d heard a fantasy:
"If I hadn’t seen this with my own eyes, even if a thousand, ten thousand people swore it to me, I wouldn’t have believed it."
Because it shattered his worldview!
Tong Yuan’s understanding of the world and life was utterly broken!
He felt his worldview and understanding of life need a complete reconstruction!
And the culprit behind all this was none other than Ding Ling in front of him!
"Indeed."
Zhao Xiaoyiu was also astounded:
"How long has it been? You’ve already surpassed Second Brother’s decade of diligent study!"
"Truly deserving of the title of General."
Zhao Bingxuan was thoroughly captivated by Ding Ling.
Especially seeing Tong Yuan and the others’ admiration for Ding Ling made her feel a deep sense of fulfillment!
This is indeed her family’s General!
"Show us."
Tong Yuan was eager.
Ding Ling nodded.

Then, his entire being seemed to transform into an ancient Spiritual Phoenix, traversing the earth, with his arms extending like wings in flight, moving with elegance and swiftness as if the Spiritual Phoenix soared the nine heavens, surveying all beings below, an overbearing and noble aura sweeping in all directions.
It stunned Tong Yuan and the others as their pupils dilated:
"He really did it!"
"Sigh. Compared to Ding Ling, I feel like a mere mediocre talent!"
Zhao Yun sighed, feeling ashamed.
"I’m truly unworthy of teaching you, Ding Ling."
Tong Yuan smiled wryly:
"From now on, let us be friends through our Martial Arts. I look forward to the day you become a Martial God!"
It’s not just bestowing Ding Ling titles like Spear God.
But directly assuming that Ding Ling will be a Martial God in the future!
This shows Tong Yuan’s absolute recognition of Ding Ling at this moment.
[Achievement Medal Unlocked: You have completely subdued Tong Yuan.]

[Note: Your genius has made even the unparalleled Spear God Tong Yuan feel inadequate and deeply shaken! He even thought of letting you master the Hundred Schools of Martial Arts to become a true Martial God!]
Seeing this hint message,
Ding Ling couldn’t help but brighten his eyes.
And through Tong Yuan’s Achievement Medal, he was already sure.
Those with an E-level Achievement Medal generally also have a normal medal.
It’s the same for Pan Feng.
The same for Tong Yuan.
’If Tong Yuan really allows me to learn the Hundred Schools of Martial Arts, won’t I become invincibly strong?’
Ding Ling looked forward with anticipation.
But due to consecutive advancements,
he currently only felt especially hungry in his stomach.
So after chatting with Tong Yuan and the others for a while,
he went with Zhao Yun to the deep mountains and forests, where they killed a tiger and a wild boar.
Then they dragged them back for a barbecue.
After eating and drinking to his fill,
Ding Ling felt full of spirit and energy! An indescribable sense of clarity and comfort!
"Indeed, after a rapid enhancement, there’s a need to replenish with meat."
’Moreover, I discovered something. After leveling up in the game, returning to reality to enhance seems to consume much less energy.’
Ding Ling truly ate solid meat.
And whether it was the beef from before or the current tiger and pork, all were of extremely high quality.
Far surpassing the quality of bread, instant noodles, and beef jerky.
Yet he consumed a majority of bread and instant noodles, etc.
"It seems necessary to eat more."
Ding Ling pondered.
In the game, he can bring his power back.
It seems some energy can also be brought back.
Only not all can be brought back. If more energy is supplemented, then the energy supplemented in reality may be much less.
Ding Ling decided to try this later.
If this is true, then it’s worth crazily eating in the game.
After all, his martial arts progress in the game is extremely fast, with a very strong digestion ability.
Just like now, Zhao Yun watching as most of the tiger and pork went into Ding Ling’s stomach couldn’t help being tongue-tied:
"You’re eating so much!"
"Being able to eat is a blessing."
Tong Yuan gazed at Ding Ling with eyes shining with Marvelous Light:

"I could eat half a cow in my youth too! That was when my power increased the fastest. The way you eat now, it’s obvious you have unlimited potential. Your strength will surely leap forward rapidly in the near future."
He was very envious:
"Eat more. I eagerly await the day when I can hear the name Ding Ling, Martial God, resounding throughout the land."

Even though it was clear that Ding Ling had successfully cultivated it, hearing the confirmation, Tong Yuan and Zhao Yun couldn’t help but gasp.
Each of them looked at Ding Ling as if he were a monster!
"To think that even the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique from the Ancient Era can be mastered so quickly!
Truly remarkable."
Tong Yuan felt as if he’d heard a fantasy:
"If I hadn’t seen this with my own eyes, even if a thousand, ten thousand people swore it to me, I wouldn’t have believed it."
Because it shattered his worldview!
Tong Yuan’s understanding of the world and life was utterly broken!
He felt his worldview and understanding of life need a complete reconstruction!
And the culprit behind all this was none other than Ding Ling in front of him!
"Indeed."
Zhao Xiaoyiu was also astounded:
"How long has it been?
You’ve already surpassed Second Brother’s decade of diligent study!"
"Truly deserving of the title of General."
Zhao Bingxuan was thoroughly captivated by Ding Ling.
Especially seeing Tong Yuan and the others’ admiration for Ding Ling made her feel a deep sense of fulfillment!
This is indeed her family’s General!
"Show us."
Tong Yuan was eager.
Ding Ling nodded.

Then, his entire being seemed to transform into an ancient Spiritual Phoenix, traversing the earth, with his arms extending like wings in flight, moving with elegance and swiftness as if the Spiritual Phoenix soared the nine heavens, surveying all beings below, an overbearing and noble aura sweeping in all directions.
It stunned Tong Yuan and the others as their pupils dilated:
"He really did it!"
"Sigh.
Compared to Ding Ling, I feel like a mere mediocre talent!"
Zhao Yun sighed, feeling ashamed.
"I’m truly unworthy of teaching you, Ding Ling."
Tong Yuan smiled wryly:
"From now on, let us be friends through our Martial Arts.
I look forward to the day you become a Martial God!"
It’s not just bestowing Ding Ling titles like Spear God.
But directly assuming that Ding Ling will be a Martial God in the future!
This shows Tong Yuan’s absolute recognition of Ding Ling at this moment.
[Achievement Medal Unlocked: You have completely subdued Tong Yuan.]
[Note: Your genius has made even the unparalleled Spear God Tong Yuan feel inadequate and deeply shaken!
He even thought of letting you master the Hundred Schools of Martial Arts to become a true Martial God!]
Seeing this hint message,
Ding Ling couldn’t help but brighten his eyes.
And through Tong Yuan’s Achievement Medal, he was already sure.
Those with an E-level Achievement Medal generally also have a normal medal.
It’s the same for Pan Feng.
The same for Tong Yuan.
’If Tong Yuan really allows me to learn the Hundred Schools of Martial Arts, won’t I become invincibly strong?’
Ding Ling looked forward with anticipation.
But due to consecutive advancements,
he currently only felt especially hungry in his stomach.
So after chatting with Tong Yuan and the others for a while,
he went with Zhao Yun to the deep mountains and forests, where they killed a tiger and a wild boar.
Then they dragged them back for a barbecue.
After eating and drinking to his fill,
Ding Ling felt full of spirit and energy!
An indescribable sense of clarity and comfort!
"Indeed, after a rapid enhancement, there’s a need to replenish with meat."
’Moreover, I discovered something.
After leveling up in the game, returning to reality to enhance seems to consume much less energy.’
Ding Ling truly ate solid meat.
And whether it was the beef from before or the current tiger and pork, all were of extremely high quality.
Far surpassing the quality of bread, instant noodles, and beef jerky.
Yet he consumed a majority of bread and instant noodles, etc.
"It seems necessary to eat more."
Ding Ling pondered.
In the game, he can bring his power back.
It seems some energy can also be brought back.
Only not all can be brought back.
If more energy is supplemented, then the energy supplemented in reality may be much less.
Ding Ling decided to try this later.
If this is true, then it’s worth crazily eating in the game.
After all, his martial arts progress in the game is extremely fast, with a very strong digestion ability.
Just like now, Zhao Yun watching as most of the tiger and pork went into Ding Ling’s stomach couldn’t help being tongue-tied:
"You’re eating so much!"
"Being able to eat is a blessing."
Tong Yuan gazed at Ding Ling with eyes shining with Marvelous Light:
"I could eat half a cow in my youth too!
That was when my power increased the fastest.
The way you eat now, it’s obvious you have unlimited potential.
Your strength will surely leap forward rapidly in the near future."
He was very envious:
"Eat more.
I eagerly await the day when I can hear the name Ding Ling, Martial God, resounding throughout the land."

chapters.title: Chapter 49: Body Technique of the Hundred Schools of Martial Arts
paragraphs: Ding Ling was having a delightful conversation with Tong Yuan, Zhao Yun, and the others.
After letting go of his initial reservations, Tong Yuan grew increasingly appreciative, admiring, and respectful towards Ding Ling.
He pondered for a while and said:

"My life’s essence in learning is all gathered in the Spear Technique and Breathing Technique. Although I understand quite a bit of various other martial arts, I suppose you wouldn’t be interested in learning them."
"No."
Ding Ling quickly replied:
"I’m interested!"
"Oh?"
Tong Yuan glanced over but, considering Ding Ling’s astonishing capacity for comprehension and learning, he was not surprised:
"That’s true. For someone like Zhao Yun and me, learning these miscellaneous martial arts might be a waste of time, but for you, it’s different."
Zhao Yun was a bit embarrassed.
He knew his master’s words were meant to comfort him.
In this world, anyone familiar with Spear God Tong Yuan knows he masters a hundred schools of martial arts, his talent legendary and unparalleled!
Even so, facing someone as extraordinary as Ding Ling, even a generation’s Spear God could only sigh that the younger generation surpasses the old!

"I know Fist Technique, Palm Technique, Saber Technique, Halberd Technique, Body Technique, Stepping Technique, Spear Technique, Sword Technique, Hammer Technique, Whip Technique, Fork Technique, Staff Technique, Shield Attack Technique, Axe Technique..."
Tong Yuan listed out more than a dozen types of martial arts.
Ding Ling listened, secretly in awe.
Though Tong Yuan wasn’t proficient in all eighteen weapons!
But the number of weapons he mastered indeed reached ten!
Furthermore, he knew Fist, Palm, and Body Techniques!
Truly worthy of the title Land Gun God of Penglai, Tong Yuan!
An embodiment of the ’Human Martial Arsenal’!
A single person that could rival many martial arts sects!
No wonder the three disciples he taught are each more exceptional than the last, all capable of overwhelming their peers!
"What do you want to learn?"
Tong Yuan looked at Ding Ling with bright eyes, stroking his beard and said:
"Feel free to say."
"I want to learn everything!"
Ding Ling answered decisively.
Zhao Yun was speechless.

Zhao Xiaoyiu was initially surprised, then understanding: This is the prodigious Brother Ding Ling! He quickly learned and mastered the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique that I couldn’t comprehend! Learning a hundred schools of miscellaneous arts shouldn’t be hard for him!
Zhao Bingxuan, on the other hand, looked completely unsurprised. If her General couldn’t learn it, then surely others would have no chance!
"...Alright."
After a moment of silence, Tong Yuan nodded, agreeing.
He originally wanted to warn Ding Ling not to be greedy and risk regretting it for a lifetime!
But considering Ding Ling’s incredible talent.
He couldn’t be bothered to dwell on it any further.
For the more he thought, the more his worldview crumbled, though his entire weltanschauung and outlook on life were thoroughly shattered, needing reconstruction.
But to shatter again after breaking was still deeply unsettling, distressing, unbearable.
For a dignified generation’s Spear God to feel oppressed, bitter, and perturbed was hard to believe if told.
Tong Yuan took a deep breath, calming the turbulent thoughts in his mind, as an image of an old friend flashed through his head.
He pondered.
If he were to introduce Ding Ling to this old friend, would he also question his existence, overwhelmed just like him?
At that moment, he actually began to anticipate.
With his mind made up.
After teaching Ding Ling the hundred schools of martial arts, he’d let Ding Ling go to Luoyang to learn from this old friend!
Considering this.
Tong Yuan stood up, striking a pose, and said:

"I’ve taught you all I can about spear techniques. Your body and palm techniques seem mediocre, so I’ll first teach you the body technique. The most important basic skill technique for body techniques is the Pile Skill. Show me the Pile Skills you know."
Thus, Ding Ling got up and demonstrated three Pile Skills including the Low-level Pile Skill, Horse Stance Skill, and Dragon-Tiger Stance.
Tong Yuan watched, nodding secretly in praise:

"The Dragon-Tiger Stance is Pan Feng’s signature pile skill. It’s the best basic pile skill for learning heavy weapons like the Axe Technique! Reaching a level of mastery where your posture is natural and flexible is truly remarkable."
He struck a pile skill pose:

"Since you have already learned these three Pile Skills, I’ll teach you the Flying Crane Stance. This Pile Skill was once lost, and I learned it in my youth from an unnamed old man who was most proficient in body techniques.

Unfortunately, due to family poverty, he resorted to being a thief for the sake of his family, ultimately suffering a severe injury after a failed attempt, passing on his skills to me just before his death.
I once lamented that the old man’s mastery might be lost to time.
Unexpectedly, in my old age, I encountered you, Ding Ling!"
He laughed and said:
"It seems fate has its way! Heaven wants me to pass these skills to you. Watch closely now. This is the true Flying Crane Stance..."
Tong Yuan adopted a crane-spread wings posture, relaxed, as if ready to soar to the Celestial Extreme at any moment.
He explained the various essentials and esoteric truths of the Pile Skill clearly.
Beside him, Zhao Yun, Zhao Xiaoyiu, and Zhao Bingxuan listened too.
But today, the sheer number of knowledge points they had to absorb was overwhelming, leaving them dizzy, and they turned away, unable to listen any further.
However, Zhao Yun listened intently.
Tong Yuan finished the explanation and looked at Ding Ling: "How does it feel?"
"Not bad."
Ding Ling nodded.
He closed his eyes slightly.
Swish!
Streams of light flashed across his sea of consciousness, quickly forming a book named "Flying Crane Stance" on the library shelf!
In an instant.
[Flying Crane Stance Mastery Full Level]
[Strength +0.2]
[Agility +0.6]
[Physique +0.2]
As expected.
Once again, the added agility points were particularly high.
Just like with the previously learned Spear Technique, agility is emphasized.
The higher the agility, the faster the speed of actions!
Tong Yuan had obviously delved deeply into the concept of ’in martial arts, speed is the ultimate strength’!
There might not be anyone in the realm who surpasses him in speed!
Whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling exhaled deeply, relaxing his body, using his hand as a wing, hovering in mid-air, and the Flying Crane Stance took form perfectly and effortlessly!
There was simply not a flaw to be found!
’As expected, he learned just from one explanation.’

Zhao Yun was not surprised, but still felt defeated: ’Sigh, this Flying Crane Stance I just understood, not fully comprehended, let alone mastered to merge into instinct down to the bone. But Ding Ling did it. A monster! An anomaly!’
"Not bad."
Tong Yuan’s mouth twitched slightly.
Fortunately, having been thoroughly shaken and stunned by Ding Ling before, he felt peculiar but could completely accept it now.
Even the Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique and Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique were quickly learned by Ding Ling. Mastering the Flying Crane Stance so quickly was perfectly normal.
Tong Yuan comforted himself, stretching his body and said next:
"The advanced technique of the Flying Crane Stance is the Wall-Climbing Technique. Once you comprehend this technique, climbing walls and scaling heights is as easy as pie!"
He demonstrated while explaining.
After one demonstration.
