chapters.title: Chapter 50: Chain Palm and Eight Trigrams Palm
paragraphs: Tong Yuan couldn’t help but look at Ding Ling.
Ding Ling slightly closed his eyes.
A book immediately materialized on the library shelf: "Wall-Climbing Technique"
In an instant.
[Full Level Wall-Climbing Technique]
[Strength +0.3]
[Agility +1.2]
[Constitution +0.3]
The increase in strength and constitution wasn’t much.
But agility exceeded 1 point directly! The enhancement was significant, causing Ding Ling’s bones and meridians to undergo subtle changes again.
Whoosh!
With each breath in and out, Ding Ling’s whole body felt as lightweight as if he might soar into the clouds at any moment.
"This level of agility!"
Zhao Yun was amazed and envious!
"Could it be that he really succeeded in one go? This is the signature skill of a thief! A long-lost supreme skill! Ding Ling couldn’t have learned it just by looking at it once, right?"
Tong Yuan was in disbelief.
Although he long accepted Ding Ling’s setting as a peerless genius.
Thinking of the hardships he went through to learn the Wall-Climbing Technique made him feel slightly bitter, a sour taste in his heart.
’Sigh.’
Tong Yuan couldn’t help but feel envious as well:
’As expected, a peerless genius is different. At this pace, mastering the Hundred Schools of Martial Arts is only a matter of time!’
Swish!

Ding Ling immediately began to practice the Wall-Climbing Technique, feeling as if some meridians in his legs had been cleared, and with a slight push of his legs, he burst forth like an arrow from a bowstring, incredibly swift!
His entire body floated like a leaf in the air, seemingly weightless.
"This is the Lightweight Body Technique?"
Ding Ling was pleasantly surprised.
"Even with just the basic Wall-Climbing Technique, it feels like this; I can’t imagine what true Lightweight Skill would be like."

He pushed hard off the ground, like a galloping horse or a fleeing rabbit on the grasslands, dashed to the edge of a bamboo grove, and with another push, his feet trod on the bamboo trunks, taking five or six steps and rising about six meters high on the bamboo!
At this height, Ding Ling couldn’t continue and had to descend.
Six meters high.
He spun in the air, dissipating the momentum, landed gently, and with another push, flew towards Tong Yuan and the others like a cannonball.
He suddenly stood, cupped his hands toward them.
Zhao Yun was speechless, looking up at the sky.
Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan looked on with faces full of admiration.
Tong Yuan took a deep breath, calmed his inner turmoil, and applauded:
"Absolutely beautiful. The entire set of movements flowed smoothly, without obstruction, proving you’ve thoroughly mastered the Wall-Climbing Technique."
His eyes involuntarily twitched as he sighed:
"I can’t comprehend the thought process and training path of a peerless genius like you. But that doesn’t prevent me from teaching more. Come, let’s continue."
Ding Ling really shocked him; his scalp tingled, and "fear" couldn’t even begin to describe how he felt!
Such a prodigious talent.
He shouldn’t be the only one to guide and nurture him.
This thought of recommending him to other old friends grew stronger and stronger.
Tong Yuan decided that once Ding Ling mastered the Hundred Schools of Martial Arts, he’d send him away.
Such a prodigious talent, keeping him here would only waste his time!
He should spend more time on breaking the barriers of the world to become a true Martial God!
Tong Yuan thought this way, and his expectations for Ding Ling grew higher and higher.

"Next, I’ll teach you palm techniques. I’ve learned five types of palm techniques. Among them, I’m most skilled in Chain Palm and Eight Trigrams Palm, while I only dabbled in Iron Sand Palm, Lion Palm, and Python Palm."
With that, he began to explain the esoteric truths and essence of the Chain Palm to Ding Ling, while demonstrating the techniques.
After Ding Ling watched once.
A book then materialized on the library shelf: "Chain Palm"!
In an instant.
[Full Level Chain Palm]
[Strength +0.9]
[Agility +0.8]
[Constitution +0.9]
The esoteric truths of the Chain Palm flowed through his limbs and bones, turning into an instinct, moving naturally.
Boom!
Ding Ling’s stance was like a pine tree, his palm strikes like lightning, and in an instant, he unleashed seven or eight palm strikes.
Each palm strike resounded with the linked movements of vigorous qi, the crackling sound reverberating!
"He has learned it just like that?!"
Zhao Yun was speechless, unable to speak.
"So strong."
Zhao Xiaoyiu and Zhao Bingxuan’s admiration seeped into their bones, their eyes full of infatuation as they looked at Ding Ling.
"Very, very impressive."
Tong Yuan’s hand trembled slightly as he stroked his beard.
He was increasingly envious of such a peerless genius now.
Truly exceptional.
Back then, he trained his hands till they were swollen in order to learn Chain Palm! Practiced for a full year but couldn’t achieve great success!
And Ding Ling?
’Don’t think about it, don’t compare with him, otherwise these old bones of mine might just burst from the shock!’
Tong Yuan didn’t ponder further, forcibly suppressing his inner agitation, and began teaching and explaining the "Eight Trigrams Palm"
After another round.
Another book materialized on the library shelf: "Eight Trigrams Palm"!
In an instant.
[Full Level Eight Trigrams Palm]
[Strength +1]
[Agility +0.7]
[Constitution +1]
Boom!
Ding Ling’s bones crackled, and he seemingly broke through some kind of shackle again!
With the Eight Trigrams Palm at full level, he not only embedded the Eight Trigrams Palm as an instinct in his bones.
His body also seemed to evolve and upgrade.
Becoming lighter, as if it were just floating hair.
This feeling was like rebirth, akin to a butterfly emerging from a cocoon, an indescribable sense of lightness and freedom.
Ding Ling was astonished.
He couldn’t help but glance at the character panel:
[Character: Ding Ling
Age: 23
Race: Human
Faction: Jizhou Hann Fu
Occupation: Tiger Valor General (seventh-rank official)
Level: 1
Weapons: A set of General Armor, an eighty-pound Heaven-piercing Halberd, etc.

Skills: Low-level Pile Skill (Level 10), Horse Stance Skill (Level 10), Initial Tier Saber Technique (Level 10), High-tier Saber Technique (Level 10), Battlefield Saber Technique (Level 10), Basic, Middle, and High-tier Spear Techniques (Level 10), Water and Fire Dragon Capturing Staff Technique (Level 10), Basic, Middle, and High-tier Axe Techniques (Level 10), Thirty-Six Celestial Spirit Axe Techniques (Level 10), Dragon-Tiger Stance (Level 10), Spiritual Snake Spear Technique (Level 10), Spirit Crane Spear Technique (Level 10), Spirit Phoenix Spear Technique (Level 10), Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear (Level 10), Spiritual Phoenix Breathing Technique (Level 10), Flying Crane Stance (Level 10), Wall-Climbing Technique (Level 10), Chain Palm (Level 10), Eight Trigrams Palm (Level 10), Basic Archery (Level 10), Basic Forging Skill (Level 10), Basic Woodworking (Level 10), Basic Casting (Level 10), Basic Refining (Level 10), Acupuncture (Level 10)...
Achievement Medals: Ordinary 26, E-level 3
Glory Medals: 0
Path of the War God: 1: Defeat more than 20 plane powerhouses: 3/20.
Ding Ling examined it carefully.
Finally, he identified the source of the anomaly.
